items.text: 862年：Rurik came to rule in Novgorod, establishing the Rurikid Dynasty.
882年：Oleg the Wise conquered Kiev and moved the capital there.
907年：Rus'–Byzantine War (907): Oleg led an army to the walls of Constantinople.
907年：Rus'-Byzantine War (907): A Rus'-Byzantine Treaty allowed Rus' merchants to enter the city under guard.
912年：Oleg died and was succeeded by Igor, who was Rurik's son.
941年5月：Rus'–Byzantine War (941): A Rus' army landed at Bithynia.
941年9月：Rus'–Byzantine War (941): The Byzantines destroyed the Rus' fleet.
945年：Rus'-Byzantine War (941): Another Rus'-Byzantine Treaty was signed. Rus' renounced some Byzantine territories.
945年：Igor died; his wife Olga became regent of Kievan Rus' for their son, Sviatoslav I.
957年或962年：Olga's regency ended.
965年：Sviatoslav conquered Khazaria.
968年：Siege of Kiev (968): The Pechenegs besieged Kiev. A Rus' created the illusion of a much larger army, and frightened them away.
969年7月8日：Sviatoslav moved the capital from Kiev to Pereyaslavets in Bulgaria.
971年：The Byzantine Empire captured Pereyaslavets. The capital moved back to Kiev.
972年：Sviatoslav was killed by the Pechenegs during an expedition on their territory. His son Yaropolk I succeeded him.
978年：Yaropolk was betrayed and murdered by his brother Vladimir the Great, who succeeded him as Prince of Kiev.
981年：Vladimir conquered Red Ruthenia from the Poles.
988年：Christianization of Kievan Rus': Vladimir destroyed the pagan idols of Kiev and urged the city's inhabitants to baptize themselves in the Dnieper River.
1015年7月15日：Vladimir died. He was succeeded by Sviatopolk I, who may have been his biological son by the rape of Yaropolk's wife. Sviatopolk ordered the murder of three of Vladimir's younger sons.
1016年：Yaroslav I, another of Sviatopolk's brothers, led an army against him and defeated him, forcing him to flee to Poland.
1017年：Yaroslav issued the first Russian code of law, the Russkaya Pravda.
1018年：Polish Expedition to Kiev: Sviatopolk led the Polish army into Rus'. Red Ruthenia returned to Polish possession.
1018年8月14日：Polish Expedition to Kiev: The Polish army captured Kiev; Yaroslav fled to Novgorod.
1019年：Yaroslav defeated Sviatopolk and returned to the princedom of Kiev. He granted autonomy to Novgorod as a reward for her prior loyalty. Sviatopolk died.
1030年：Yaroslav reconquered Red Ruthenia from the Poles.

1043年2月30日：Rus'–Byzantine War (1043): Yaroslav led an unsuccessful naval raid on Constantinople. According to the peace settlement, Yaroslav's son Vsevolod I married a daughter of the Byzantine emperor Constantine IX Monomachos.
1054年：Yaroslav died. He was succeeded by his oldest son, Iziaslav I.
1068年：Iziaslav was overthrown in a popular uprising and forced to flee to Poland.
1069年：Iziaslav led the Polish army back into Kiev and reestablished himself on the throne.
1073年：Two of Iziaslav's brothers, Sviatoslav II and Vsevolod I, overthrew him; the former became prince of Kiev.
1076年12月27日：Sviatoslav died. Vsevolod I succeeded him, but traded the princedom of Kiev to Iziaslav in exchange for Chernigov.
1078年10月3日：Iziaslav died. The throne of Kiev went to Vsevolod.
1093年4月13日：Vsevolod died. Kiev and Chernigov went to Iziaslav's illegitimate son, Sviatopolk II.
1093年5月26日：Battle of the Stugna River: Rus' forces attacked the Cumans at the Stugna River and were defeated.
1113年4月16日：Sviatopolk died. He was succeeded by Vsevolod's son, his cousin, Vladimir II Monomakh.
1125年5月19日：Vladimir died. His oldest son, Mstislav I, succeeded him.
1132年4月14日：Mstislav died. His brother Yaropolk II followed him as prince of Kiev.
1136年：Novgorod expelled the prince appointed for them by Kiev and vastly circumscribed the authority of the office.
1139年2月18日：Yaropolk died. His younger brother Viacheslav followed him, but in March Viacheslav was overthrown by his cousin, prince of Chernigov, Vsevolod.

1146年8月1日：Vsevolod died. His brother Igor followed him as a ruler of Kiev. Citizens of Kiev required him to depose old boyars of Vsevolod. Igor swore to fulfill their request, but then reconsidered to do it. Citizens of Kiev considered that oath-breaker is not a legitimate ruler anymore and chose to summon prince Iziaslav of Pereyaslavl to be a new prince of Kiev.
1146年8月13日：Iziaslav overthrow Igor. A brother of Igor, Sviatoslav, prince of Novgorod-Seversk asked prince of Rostov-Suzdal Yuri Dolgorukiy for help in realising Igor from captivity.
1147年：The first reference to Moscow when Yuri Dolgorukiy called upon Sviatoslav of Novgorod-Seversk to "come to me, brother, to Moscow".
1149年：Yuri Dolgorukiy captured Kiev. Iziaslav escaped.
1150年：With assistance of Black Klobuks Iziaslav kicked away Yuri from Kiev. After some time, with help of Volodimirko of Galych, Yuri took Kiev again.
1151年：Hungarian king Géza II helped Iziaslav to return Kiev. Yuri escaped
1154年11月13日：Iziaslav II died. His brother, prince of Smolensk Rostislav was summoned to become a new prince of Kiev.
1155年：Yuri Dolgorukiy expelled Rostislav with assistance of prince of Chernigov.
1157年：Yuri I was intoxicated and died. Iziaslav of Chernigov became prince of Kiev.
1159年：Iziaslav of Chernigov was overthrown by princes of Galych and Volyn. Allies called Rostislav to be prince of Kiev again.
1167年：Rostislav died. His nephew, Mstislav of Volyn, became new ruler of Kiev.

1169年：Andrey Bogolyubsky, the elder son of Yuri Dolgorukiy, prince of new strong principality of Vladimir-Suzdal attacked and plundered Kiev. A majority of Russian princes recognized him as a new grand prince. Unlike previous grand princes Andrey I did not move his residence to Kiev, instead remaining in Vladimir. Andrey appointed his brother Gleb as prince of Kiev. From this time, Kiev stopped being the center of Russian lands. The political and cultural center was moved to Vladimir. New princes of Kiev became dependent on the grand princes of Vladimir-Suzdal
1223年：Battle of the Kalka River: The warriors of Rus' first encountered the Mongol armies of Genghis Khan.
1227年：Boyar intrigues forced Mstislav, the prince of Novgorod, to give the throne to his son-in-law Andrew II of Hungary.
1236年：Alexander Nevsky was summoned by the Novgorodians to become Grand Prince of Novgorod and, as their military leader, to defend their northwest lands from Swedish and German invaders.
1237年12月：Mongol invasion of Rus: Batu Khan set fire to Moscow and slaughtered and enslaved its civilian inhabitants.
1240年7月15日：Battle of the Neva: The Novgorodian army defeated a Swedish invasion force at the confluence of the Izhora and Neva Rivers.
1242年4月5日：Battle on the Ice: The army of Novgorod defeated the invading Teutonic Knights on the frozen surface of Lake Peipus.

1263年11月14日：Nevsky died. His appanages were divided within his family; his youngest son Daniel became the first Prince of Moscow. His younger brother Yaroslav of Tver had become the Grand Prince of Tver and of Vladimir and had appointed deputies to run the Principality of Moscow during Daniel's minority.
1303年3月5日：Daniel died. His oldest son Yury succeeded him as Prince of Moscow.
1317年：Yury married the sister of Uzbeg Khan who was Mongolian prince. Uzbeg deposed the Grand Prince of Vladimir and appointed Yury to that office.

1322年：Dmitry the Terrible Eyes, the son of the last Grand Prince of Vladimir, convinced Uzbeg Khan that Yury had been stealing from the khan's tribute money. He was reappointed to the princedom of Vladimir.
1325年11月21日：Yury was murdered by Dmitry. His younger brother Ivan I Kalita succeeded him.
1327年8月15日：The ambassador of the Golden Horde of Mongolian Empire was trapped and burned alive during an uprising in the Grand Duchy of Tver.
1328年：Ivan led a Horde army against the Grand Prince of Tver, also the Grand Prince of Vladimir. Ivan was allowed to replace him in the latter office.
1340年3月31日：Ivan died. His son Simeon succeeded him both as Grand Prince of Moscow and as Grand Prince of Vladimir
1353年：Simeon died. His younger brother Ivan II, The Fair, succeeded him as Grand Prince of Moscow.
1359年11月13日：Ivan died. His son, Dmitri Donskoi, succeeded him.
1380年9月8日：Battle of Kulikovo: A Muscovite force defeated a significantly larger Blue Horde army of Mongolia at Kulikovo Field.
1382年：The Mongol khan Tokhtamysh reasserted his power by looting and burning Moscow.
1389年5月19日：Dmitri died. The throne fell to his son, Vasili I.

1425年2月：Vasili I died. His son Vasili II, succeeded him as Grand Prince of Moscow; his wife Sophia became regent. His younger brother, Yury Dmitrievich of Zvenigorod, also issued a claim to the throne.
1430年：Yury appealed to the khan of the Golden Horde to support his claim to the throne. Vasili II retained the Duchy of Moscow, but Yury was given the Duchy of Dmitrov.

1432年：Muscovite Civil War: Vasili II led an army to capture Dmitrov. His army was defeated and he was forced to flee to Kolomna. Yury arrived in Moscow and declared himself the Grand Prince. Vasili II was pardoned and made mayor of Kolomna.
1433年：Muscovite Civil War: The exodus of Muscovite boyars to Vasili II's court in Kolomna persuaded Yury to return Moscow to his nephew and move to Galich.
1434年：Muscovite Civil War: Vasily II burned Galich.
1434年3月16日：Muscovite Civil War: The army of Yury Dmitrievich defeated the army of Vasily II. The latter fled to Nizhny Novgorod.
1434年4月1日：Muscovite Civil War: Yury arrived in Moscow and again declared himself the Grand Prince.
1434年7月5日：Yury died. His oldest son Vasily the Squint, succeeded him as Grand Prince.

1435年：Muscovite Civil War: Yury's second son, Dmitry Shemyaka, allied himself with Vasily II. Vasily the Squint was expelled from the Kremlin and blinded. Vasili II returned to the throne of the Grand Prince.
1438年：Russo-Kazan Wars: The khan of the recently established Khanate of Kazan led an army towards Moscow.
1445年7月7日：Battle of Suzdal: The Russian army suffered a great defeat at the hands of the Tatars of Kazan. Vasili II was taken prisoner; operation of the government fell to Dmitry Shemyaka.
1445年12月：Muscovite Civil War: Vasili II was ransomed back to Muscovy.
1446年：Muscovite Civil War: Shemyaka had Vasili II blinded and exiled to Uglich, and had himself declared the Grand Prince.
1450年：Muscovite Civil War: The boyars of Moscow expelled Shemyaka from the Kremlin and recalled Vasili II to the throne.
1452年：Muscovite Civil War: Shemyaka was forced to flee to the Novgorod Republic.
1453年：Shemyaka was poisoned by Muscovite agents.
1462年3月27日：Vasili II died. His son Ivan III, The Great, succeeded him as Grand Prince.
1463年：Grand Duchy of Moscow annexed the Duchy of Yaroslavl.
1471年7月14日：Battle of Shelon: A Muscovite army defeated a numerically superior Novgorodian force.
1474年：Grand Duchy of Moscow annexed the Rostov Duchy.
1476年：Ivan stopped paying tribute to the Great Horde.
1478年1月14日：The Novgorod Republic surrendered to the authority of Moscow.
1480年11月11日：Great stand on the Ugra river: Ivan's forces deterred Akhmat Khan of the Great Horde from invading Muscovy.
links: Great stand on the Ugra river

items.text: 1485年：Ivan annexed the Grand Duchy of Tver.
1497年：Ivan issued a legal code, the Sudebnik, which standardized the Muscovite law, expanded the role of the criminal justice system, and limited the ability of the serfs to leave their masters.
1505年10月29日：Ivan died. He was succeeded as Grand Duke of Muscovy by his son, Vasili III.
1507年：Russo-Crimean Wars: The Crimean Khanate raided the Muscovite towns of Belyov and Kozelsk.
1510年：With the approval of most of the local nobility, Vasili arrived in the Pskov Republic and declared it dissolved.
1517年：The last Grand Prince of the Ryazan Principality was captured and imprisoned in Moscow.
1533年12月3日：Vasili died; his son Ivan IV, The Terrible, succeeded him. His wife Elena Glinskaya became regent.
1538年4月4日：Glinskaya died. She was succeeded as regent by Prince Vasily Nemoy.
1547年1月16日：An elaborate ceremony crowned Ivan the first Tsar of Russia.
1552年8月22日：Siege of Kazan (1552): Russian armed forces arrived at Kazan.
1552年10月2日：Siege of Kazan (1552): The Russian army breached the walls of Kazan.
1552年10月13日：Siege of Kazan (1552): The civilian population of Kazan was massacred, the city occupied.
1553年－1554年：First book printed in Russia, the Narrow-typed Gospel Book.
1556年：Russia conquered and annexed the Astrakhan Khanate.

1558年：Livonian War: Ivan demanded a back-breaking tribute from the Bishopric of Dorpat. The Bishop sent diplomats to Moscow to renegotiate the amount; Ivan expelled them and invaded and occupied the Bishopric.
1560年8月2日：Battle of Ergeme: Ivan's army crushed the forces of the Livonian Order.

1561年11月28日：Livonian War: The Livonian Order agreed to the Union of Wilno, under which the Livonian Confederation was partitioned between Lithuania, Sweden and Denmark. Lithuania and Sweden sent troops to liberate their new territories from Russian possession.
1565年2月：Ivan established the Oprichnina, a territory ruled directly by the tsar.
1569年7月1日：The Union of Lublin was signed. Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania were merged into the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth; Poland began aiding Lithuania in its war against Russia.
1572年：The Oprichnina was abolished.
1581年11月16日：Ivan killed his oldest son.
1582年1月15日：Livonian War: The Peace of Jam Zapolski ended Polish–Lithuanian participation in the war. Russia gave up its claims to Livonia and the city of Polatsk.
1582年10月23日：Battle of Chuvash Cape: Russian soldiers dispersed the armed forces of the Siberia Khanate from its capital, Qashliq.
1583年：Livonian War: The war was ended with the Treaty of Plussa. Narva and the Gulf of Finland coast went to Sweden.
1584年3月18日：Ivan died. The throne fell to his intellectually disabled son Feodor I; his son-in-law Boris Godunov took de facto charge of government.
1590年1月18日：Russo-Swedish War (1590–1595): The Treaty of Plussa expired. Russian troops laid siege to Narva.
1590年2月25日：Russo-Swedish War (1590–1595): A Swedish governor on the disputed territory surrendered to Russians.

1591年5月15日：Dimitry Ivanovich, Ivan the Terrible's youngest son, died in exile from a stab wound to the throat. Long-regarded as murdered by agents of Boris Godunov, more recently scholars have begun to defend the theory that Dimitry's death was self-inflicted during an epileptic seizure.
1595年5月18日：Russo-Swedish War (1590–1595): The Treaty of Tyavzino was signed. Ingria went to Russia.
1598年1月7日：Feodor I died with no children giving a start to Time of Troubles
1598年2月21日：A zemsky sobor elected Godunov the first non-Rurikid tsar of Russia.
1601年－1603年：Devastating famine, that undermined Boris's authority.
1604年10月：False Dmitriy I, a man claiming to be the deceased Dmitriy Ivanovich, son of Ivan IV, invaded Russia with help of Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth
1605年4月13日：Boris died. His son Feodor II was pronounced tsar.
1605年6月1日：A group of boyars defected in support of False Dmitriy, seized control of the Kremlin, and arrested Feodor.
1605年6月20日：False Dmitriy and his army arrived in Moscow. Feodor and his mother were strangled.
1605年7月21日：False Dmitriy was crowned tsar.
1606年5月8日：False Dmitriy married a Catholic, Marina Mniszech, inflaming suspicions that he meant to convert Russia to Catholicism.
1606年5月17日：Conservative boyars led by Vasili Shuisky stormed the Kremlin and shot False Dmitriy to death during his escape.
1606年5月19日：Shuisky's allies declared him Tsar Vasili IV.
1607年：False Dmitriy II, another claimant to the identity of Dmitriy Ivanovich, obtained financial and military support from a group of Polish magnates
1609年2月28日：Vasili Shuisky ceded border territory to Sweden in exchange for military aid against the government of False Dmitriy II; around this time Smolensk got besieged
1609年9月：Polish–Muscovite War (1609–1618): The Polish king Sigismund III led an army into Russia;
1610年7月4日：Battle of Klushino: Seven thousand Polish cavalrymen defeated a vastly superior Russian force at Klushino.
1610年7月19日：Vasili was overthrown. A group of nobles, the Seven Boyars, replaced him at the head of the government.

1610年7月27日：Polish–Russian War (1609–1618): A truce was established. The boyars promised to recognize Sigismund's son and heir Władysław as tsar, conditional on severe limits to his power and his conversion to Orthodoxy.
1610年8月：Polish–Russian War (1609–1618): Sigismund rejected the boyars' conditions.
1610年12月：Hermogenes, the patriarch of the Russian Orthodox Church, urged the Muscovite people to rise against the Poles.
1610年12月11日：False Dmitriy II was shot and beheaded by one of his entourage.
1612年11月1日：Polish–Russian War (1609–1618): Muscovite populace rising against the Poles recaptured the Kremlin.
1613年：Ingrian War: Sweden invaded Russia.
1613年2月21日：A zemsky sobor elected Michael Romanov, a grandson of Ivan the Terrible's brother-in-law, the tsar of Russia.
1617年2月27日：Ingrian War: The Treaty of Stolbovo ended the war. Kexholm, Ingria, Estonia and Livonia went to Sweden.
1618年12月11日：Polish–Russian War (1609–1618): The Truce of Deulino ended the war. Russia ceded the city of Smolensk and the Czernihów Voivodeship to Poland.
1619年2月13日：Feodor Romanov, Michael's father, was released from Polish prison and allowed to return to Moscow.
1632年10月：Smolensk War: With the expiration of the Truce of Deulino, a Russian army was sent to lay siege to Smolensk.
1634年3月1日：Smolensk War: The Russian army, surrounded, was forced to surrender.
1634年6月14日：Smolensk War: The Treaty of Polyanovka was signed, ending the war. Poland retained Smolensk, but Władysław renounced his claim to the Russian throne.
1645年7月13日：Michael died. His son, Alexis, succeeded him.
1648年1月25日：Khmelnytsky Uprising: A Polish szlachta, Bohdan Khmelnytsky, leads the Cossacks of the Zaporizhian Sich against the Polish Crown.
1648年6月1日：Salt Riot: Upset over the introduction of a salt tax, the townspeople launched a rebellion in Moscow.
1648年6月11日：Salt Riot: A group of nobles demanded a zemsky sobor on behalf of the rebellion.
1648年7月3日：Salt Riot: Many of the rebellion's leaders were executed.
1648年12月25日：Khmelnytsky Uprising: Khmelnytsky entered the Ukrainian capital, Kiev.
1649年1月：A zemsky sobor ratified a new legal code, the Sobornoye Ulozheniye.
1653年：Raskol: Nikon, the Patriarch of Moscow, reformed Russian liturgy to align with the rituals of the Greek Church.
1654年1月：Khmelnytsky Uprising: Under the Treaty of Pereyaslav, Left-bank Ukraine, the territory of the Zaporozhian Host, allies itself with Russia.
1654年：Raskol: Nikon arranges a church council, which decides to correct Russian divine service books using ancient Greek and Slavic manuscripts.
1654年7月：Russo-Polish War (1654–1667): The Russian army invaded Poland.
1655年：Swedish Deluge: Sweden invaded the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.
1655年7月3日：Russo-Polish War (1654–1667): Russian army captured Vilnius.
1655年7月25日：Swedish Deluge: The voivode of Poznań surrendered to the Swedish invaders.
1655年11月2日：Russia negotiated a ceasefire with Poland.
1656年7月：Russo-Swedish War (1656–1658): Russian reserves invaded Ingria.
1658年2月26日：Dano-Swedish War (1657–1658): The Treaty of Roskilde ended Sweden's war with Denmark, allowing her to shift her troops to the eastern conflicts.
1658年7月10日：Raskol: Patriarch Nikon leaves Moscow.

1658年9月16日：Russo-Polish War (1654–1667): The Treaty of Hadiach established a military alliance between Poland and the Zaporozhian Host, and promised the creation of a Commonwealth of three nations: Poland, Lithuania and Rus'.
1658年12月28日：Russo-Swedish War (1656–1658): The Treaty of Valiesar established a peace. The conquered Ingrian territories were ceded to Russia for three years.
1660年4月23日：Swedish Deluge: The Treaty of Oliva ended the conflict between Poland and Sweden.
1661年：Russo-Polish War (1654–1667): Polish forces recaptured Vilnius.
1661年7月1日：The Treaty of Valiesar expired. Russia returned Ingria to the Swedish Empire by the Treaty of Cardis.

1662年7月25日：Copper Riot: In the early morning, a group of Muscovites marched to Kolomenskoye and demanded punishment for the government ministers who had debased Russia's copper currency. On their arrival, they were countered by the military; a thousand were hanged or drowned. The rest were exiled.
1665年：Lubomirski's Rokosz: A Polish nobleman launched a rokosz (rebellion) against the king.
1665年：The pro-Turkish Cossack noble Petro Doroshenko defeated his pro-Russian adversaries in the Right-bank Ukraine.
1666年：Raskol: Great Moscow Synod deposed Nikon from the patriarchy. The Old Believers were anathematized.

1667年1月30日：Russo-Polish War (1654–1667): The Treaty of Andrusovo ended the war between Poland and Russia without Cossack representation. Poland agreed to cede the Smoleńsk and Czernihów Voivodships and acknowledged Russian control over the Left-bank Ukraine.
1669年：Doroshenko signed a treaty that recognized his state as a vassal state of the Ottoman Empire.
1670年：The Cossack Stenka Razin began a rebellion against the Russian government.
1671年：Razin was captured, tortured, and quartered in Red Square on the Lobnoye Mesto.
1674年：The Cossacks of the Right-bank Ukraine elected the pro-Russian Ivan Samoylovych, Hetman of the Left-bank Ukraine, to replace Doroshenko and become the Hetman of a unified Ukraine.
1676年：Russo-Turkish War (1676–1681): The Ottoman army joined Doroshenko's forces in an attack on the Left-bank city of Chyhyryn.
1676年1月29日：Alexis died. His son Feodor III became tsar.
1676年2月1日：Raskol: The 8-year-long siege of Solovki ended.
1680年：Russo-Crimean Wars: The Crimean invasions of Russia ended.
1681年1月3日：Russo-Turkish War (1676–1681): The war ended with the Treaty of Bakhchisarai. The Russo-Turkish border was settled at the Dnieper River.
1682年1月：Feodor III abolished the mestnichestvo, an ancient, un-meritocratic system of making political appointments.
1682年4月14日：Raskol: Avvakum, the most prominent leader of the Old Believer movement, was burned at the stake.
1682年4月27日：Feodor died with no children. Peter I, Alexis's son by his second wife Natalia Naryshkina, was declared tsar. His mother became regent.

1682年5月17日：Moscow Uprising of 1682: Streltsy regiments belonging to the faction of Alexis's first wife, Maria Miloslavskaya, took over the Kremlin, executed Naryshkina's brothers, and declared Miloslavskaya's invalid son Ivan V the "senior tsar," with Peter remaining on the throne as the junior. Miloslavskaya's oldest daughter Sophia Alekseyevna became regent.
1687年5月：Crimean campaigns: Russian army launched an invasion against an Ottoman vassal, the Crimean Khanate.
1687年6月17日：Crimean campaigns: Faced with a burned steppe incapable of feeding their horses, Russians turned back.

1689年6月：Fyodor Shaklovity, the head of the Streltsy Department, persuaded Sophia to proclaim herself tsarina and attempted to ignite a new rebellion in her support. The streltsy instead defected in support of Peter.
1689年10月11日：Shaklovity was executed.
1696年1月29日：Ivan V died.
1696年4月23日：Second Azov campaign: Russian army began its deployment to an important Ottoman fortress, Azov.
1696年5月27日：Second Azov campaign: Russian navy arrived at the sea and blockaded Azov.
1696年7月19日：Second Azov campaign: The Ottoman garrison surrendered.
1698年6月6日：Streltsy Uprising: Approximately four thousand streltsy overthrew their commanders and headed to Moscow, where they meant to demand the enthroning of the exiled Sophia Alekseyevna.
1698年6月18日：Streltsy Uprising: The rebels were defeated.
1700年8月19日：Great Northern War: Russia declared war on Sweden.
1700年10月16日：Adrian, the patriarch of the Russian Orthodox Church, died. Peter prevented the election of a successor.
1703年5月27日：Foundation of Saint Petersburg.
1707年10月8日：Bulavin Rebellion: A small band of Don Cossacks killed a noble searching their territory for tax fugitives.
1708年7月7日：Bulavin Rebellion: After a series of devastating military reversals, Bulavin was shot by his former followers.
1708年12月18日：An imperial decree divided Russia into eight guberniyas (governorates).
1709年6月28日：Battle of Poltava: A decisive Russian military victory over the Swedes at Poltava marked the turning point of the war, the end of Cossack independence and the dawn of the Russian Empire.
1710年10月14日：The Russian guberniyas were divided into lots according to noble population.
1710年11月20日：Russo-Turkish War (1710–1711): Charles XII of Sweden persuaded the Ottoman sultan to declare war on Russia.
1711年2月22日：Government reform of Peter I: Peter established the Governing Senate to pass laws in his absence.
1711年7月21日：Russo-Turkish War (1710–1711): Peace was concluded with the Treaty of the Pruth. Russia returned Azov to the Ottoman Empire and demolished the town of Taganrog.
1713年5月8日：The Russian capital was moved from Moscow to Saint Petersburg.
1713年7月17日：The Riga Governorate was established on the conquered territory of Livonia.
1713年7月17日：The territory of the Smolensk Governorate was divided between the Moscow and Riga Governorates.
1714年1月15日：The northwestern territory of the Kazan Governorate was transferred to the newly established Nizhny Novgorod Governorate.
1715年10月11日：Peter demanded that his son, the tsarevich Alexei Petrovich, endorse his reforms or renounce his right to the throne.
1716年：Alexei fled to Vienna to avoid military service.
1717年11月22日：The Astrakhan Governorate was formed on the southern lands of Kazan Governorate.
1717年11月22日：The territory of the Nizhny Novgorod Governorate was reincorporated into the Kazan Governorate.
1717年12月12日：Government reform of Peter I: Peter established collegia, government ministries that superseded the prikazy.
1718年1月31日：Alexei returned to Moscow under a promise he would not be harmed.
1718年2月18日：After torture, Alexei publicly renounced the throne and implicated a number of reactionaries in a conspiracy to overthrow his father.
1718年6月13日：Alexei was put on trial for treason.
1718年6月26日：Alexei died after torture in the Peter and Paul Fortress.

1719年5月29日：Lots were abolished; the guberniyas were divided instead into provinces, each governed and taxed under a preexisting elected office (the Voyevoda). Provinces were further divided into districts, replacing the old uyezds. The district commissars were to be elected by local gentry.
1719年5月29日：The Nizhny Novgorod Governorate was reestablished.
1719年5月29日：The Reval Governorate was established on the conquered territory of Estonia.
1721年1月25日：Peter established the Holy Synod, a body of ten clergymen chaired by a secular official, that was to head the Russian Orthodox Church in lieu of the Patriarch of Moscow.
1721年8月30日：Great Northern War: The Treaty of Nystad ended the war. Sweden ceded Estonia, Livonia and Ingria to Russia.
1721年10月22日：Peter was declared Emperor.
1722年：Peter introduced the Table of Ranks, which granted the privileges of nobility based on state service.
1722年7月：Russo-Persian War (1722–1723): A Russian military expedition sailed in support of the independence of two Christian kingdoms, Kartli and Armenia.

1723年9月12日：Russo-Persian War (1722–1723): The Persian shah signed a peace treaty ceding the cities of Derbent and Baku and the provinces of Shirvan, Guilan, Mazandaran and Astrabad to the Russian Empire.

1725年1月28日：Peter died of urinary problems. He failed to name a successor; one of Peter's closest advisers, Aleksandr Menshikov, convinced the Imperial Guard to declare in favor of Peter's wife Catherine I.
1726年：The Smolensk Governorate was reestablished.
1726年2月8日：Catherine established an advisory body, the Supreme Privy Council.
1727年：Catherine established the Belgorod and Novgorod Governorates and adjusted the borders of several others. Districts were abolished; uyezds were reestablished.
1727年5月17日：Catherine died.

1727年5月18日：According to Catherine's wishes the eleven-year-old Peter II, the son of Alexei Petrovich and grandson of Peter the Great, became emperor. The Supreme Privy Council was to hold power during his minority.
1727年9月9日：The conservative members of the Supreme Privy Council expelled its most powerful member, the liberal Menshikov.
1730年1月30日：Peter died of smallpox.

1730年2月1日：The Supreme Privy Council offered the throne to Anna Ivanovna, the daughter of Ivan V, on the conditions that the Council retain the powers of war and peace and taxation, among others, and that she never marry or appoint an heir.
1730年3月4日：Anna tore up the terms of her accession and dissolved the Supreme Privy Council.
1736年5月20日：Russo-Turkish War (1735–1739): The Russian army captured the Ottoman fortifications at Perekop.
1736年6月19日：Russo-Turkish War (1735–1739): The Russians captured Azov.
1737年7月：Russo-Turkish War (1735–1739): Austria joined the war on the Russian side.
1739年8月21日：Russo-Turkish War (1735–1739): Austria agreed by the Treaty of Belgrade to end its participation in the war.
1739年9月18日：Russo-Turkish War (1735–1739): The Treaty of Nissa ended the war. Russia gave up its claims on Crimea and Moldavia and its navy was barred from the Black Sea.
1740年10月17日：Anna died of kidney disease. She left the throne to her adopted infant son, Ivan VI.
1740年10月18日：Anna's lover, Ernst Johann von Biron, was declared regent.
1740年11月8日：Biron was arrested on the orders of his rival, the Count Burkhard Christoph von Munnich. Ivan's biological mother, Anna Leopoldovna, replaced Biron as regent.
1741年8月8日：Russo-Swedish War (1741–1743): Sweden declared war on Russia.
1741年11月25日：Elizabeth, the youngest daughter of Peter the Great, led the Preobrazhensky regiment to the Winter Palace to overthrow the regency of Anna Leopoldovna and install herself as empress.
1741年12月2日：Ivan was imprisoned in the Daugavgriva fortress.
1742年9月4日：Russo-Swedish War (1741–1743): Encircled by the Russians at Helsinki, the Swedish army surrendered.

1743年8月7日：Russo-Swedish War (1741–1743): The Treaty of Åbo was signed, ending the war. Russia relinquished most of the conquered territory, keeping only the lands east of the Kymi River. In exchange Adolf Frederick of Holstein-Gottorp, the uncle of the Russian heir to the throne, was to become King of Sweden.
1744年：The Vyborg Governorate was established on conquered Swedish territories.
1755年：Mikhail Lomonosov and Count Ivan Shuvalov founded the University of Moscow.
1756年8月29日：Seven Years' War: The Kingdom of Prussia invaded the Austrian protectorate of Saxony.
1757年5月1日：Diplomatic Revolution: Under the Second Treaty of Versailles, Russia joined the Franco-Austrian military alliance.
1757年5月17日：Seven Years' War: Russian troops entered the war.
1761年12月25日：Miracle of the House of Brandenburg: Elizabeth died. Her nephew, Peter III, became emperor.
links: Miracle of the House of Brandenburg

items.text: 1762年5月5日：Seven Years' War: The Treaty of Saint Petersburg ended Russian participation in the war at no territorial gain.
1762年7月17日：Peter was overthrown by the Imperial Guard and replaced with his wife, Catherine II, The Great, on her orders.
1764年7月5日：A group of soldiers attempted to release the imprisoned Ivan VI; he was murdered.
1767年8月10日：The Instruction of Catherine the Great is issued to the Legislative Commission.
1767年10月13日：Repnin Sejm: Four Polish senators who opposed the policies of the Russian ambassador Nicholas Repnin were arrested by Russian troops and imprisoned in Kaluga.
1768年2月27日：Repnin Sejm: Delegates of the Sejm adopted a treaty ensuring future Russian influence in Polish internal politics.
1768年2月29日：Polish nobles established the Bar Confederation in order to end Russian influence in their country.
1768年9月25日：Russo-Turkish War (1768–1774): The Ottoman sultan declared war on Russia.
1771年9月15日：Plague Riot: A crowd of rioters entered Red Square, broke into the Kremlin and destroyed the Chudov Monastery.
1771年9月17日：Plague Riot: The army suppressed the riot.
1772年8月5日：The first partition of Poland was announced. Poland lost 30% of its territory, which was divided between Prussia, Austria, and Russia.
1773年：Pugachev's Rebellion: The army of the Cossack Yemelyan Pugachev attacked and occupied Samara.
1773年9月18日：A confederated sejm was forced to ratify the first partition of Poland.

1774年7月21日：Russo-Turkish War (1768–1774): The Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca was signed. The portion of the Yedisan region east of the Southern Bug river, the Kabarda region in the Caucasus, and several Crimean ports, went to Russia. The Crimean Khanate received independence from the Ottoman Empire, which also declared Russia the protector of Christians on its territory.
1774年9月14日：Pugachev's Rebellion: Upset with the rebellion's bleak outlook, Pugachev's officers delivered him to the Russians.
1783年4月8日：The Crimean Khanate was incorporated into the Russian Empire.
1783年7月24日：Threatened by the Persian and Ottoman Empires, the kingdom of Kartl-Kakheti signed the Treaty of Georgievsk under which it became a Russian protectorate.
1788年：Russo-Turkish War (1787–1792): The Ottoman Empire declared war on Russia and imprisoned her ambassador.
1788年6月27日：Russo-Swedish War (1788–1790): The Swedish army playacted a skirmish between themselves and the Russians.
1788年7月6日：Battle of Hogland: The Russian navy dispersed a Swedish invasion fleet near Hogland in the Gulf of Finland.
1788年10月6日：Great Sejm: A confederated sejm was called to restore the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth.
1790年8月14日：Russo-Swedish War (1788–1790): The Treaty of Värälä ended the war, with no changes in territory.

1791年5月3日：Great Sejm: Poland's Constitution of 3 May was ratified in secret. The new constitution abolished the liberum veto, reducing the power of the nobles and limiting Russia's ability to influence Polish internal politics.
1791年12月23日：Catherine established the Pale of Settlement, an area in European Russia into which Russian Jews were transported.
1792年1月9日：Russo-Turkish War (1787–1792): The Treaty of Jassy was signed, ending the war. The Russian border in Yedisan was extended to the Dniester river.
1792年5月18日：Polish–Russian War of 1792: The army of the Targowica Confederation, which opposed the liberal Polish Constitution of 3 May, invaded Poland.
1793年1月23日：Polish–Russian War of 1792: The second partition of Poland left the country with one-third of its 1772 population.
1793年11月23日：Grodno Sejm: The last sejm of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth ratified the second partition.
1794年3月24日：Kościuszko Uprising: An announcement by Tadeusz Kościuszko sparked a nationalist uprising in Poland.
1794年11月4日：Battle of Praga: Russian troops captured the Praga borough of Warsaw and massacred its civilian population.
1794年11月5日：Kościuszko Uprising: The uprising ended with the Russian occupation of Warsaw.
1795年9月11日：Battle of Krtsanisi: The Persian army demolished the armed forces of Kartl-Kakheti.
1795年10月24日：The third partition of Poland divided up the remainder of its territory.
1796年4月：Persian Expedition of 1796: Catherine launched a military expedition to punish Persia for its incursion into the Russian protectorate of Kartl-Kakheti.
1796年11月5日：Catherine suffered a stroke in the bathtub.
1796年11月6日：Catherine died. The throne fell to her son, Paul I.
1801年1月8日：Paul authorized the incorporation of Kartl-Kakheti into the Russian empire.
1801年3月11日：Paul was killed in his bed.
1801年3月23日：Paul's son, Alexander I, ascended to the throne.
1802年9月：Alexander established the Ministry of Internal Affairs (MVD).
1804年：Russo-Persian War (1804–1813): Russian forces attacked the Persian settlement of Üçkilise.
1805年：The Ottoman Empire dismissed the pro-Russian hospodars of its vassal states, Wallachia and Moldavia.
1805年12月26日：War of the Third Coalition: The Treaty of Pressburg ceded Austrian possessions in Dalmatia to France.
1806年10月：To counter the French presence in Dalmatia, Russia invaded Wallachia and Moldavia.
1806年12月27日：Russo-Turkish War (1806–1812): The Ottoman Empire declared war on Russia.
1807年6月14日：Battle of Friedland: The Russian army suffered a defeat against the French, suffering twenty thousand dead.

1807年7月7日：The Treaty of Tilsit was signed. Alexander agreed to evacuate Wallachia and Moldavia and ceded the Ionian Islands and Cattaro to the French. The treaty ended Russia's conflict with France; Napoleon promised to aid Russia in conflicts with the Ottoman Empire.
1807年11月16日：Alexander demanded that Sweden close the Baltic Sea to British warships.
1808年2月21日：Finnish War: Russian troops crossed the Swedish border and captured Hämeenlinna.
1809年3月29日：Diet of Porvoo: The four Estates of Finland swore allegiance to the Russian crown.
1809年9月17日：Finnish War: The Treaty of Fredrikshamn was signed, ending the war and ceding Finland to the Russian Empire.
1810年：The first military settlement was established near Klimovichi.
1810年1月1日：Alexander established the State Council, which received the executive powers of the Governing Senate.
1810年2月20日：The Russian government proclaimed the deposition of Solomon II from the throne of Imereti.
1811年3月27日：Regional military companies were merged into the Internal Guard.
1812年5月28日：Russo-Turkish War (1806–1812): The Treaty of Bucharest ended the war and transferred Bessarabia to Russia.
1812年6月24日：French invasion of Russia (1812): The French army crossed the Neman River into Russia.
1812年9月14日：French invasion of Russia (1812): The French army entered a deserted Moscow, the high-water mark of their invasion.
1812年12月14日：French invasion of Russia (1812): The last French troops were forced off of Russian territory.
1813年10月24日：Russo-Persian War (1804–1813): According to the Treaty of Gulistan, the Persian Empire ceded its Transcaucasian territories to Russia.

1815年6月9日：Congress of Vienna: The territory of the Duchy of Warsaw was divided between Prussia, Russia, and three newly established states: the Grand Duchy of Posen, the Free City of Kraków and Congress Poland. The latter was a constitutional monarchy with Alexander as its king.

1825年11月19日：Alexander died of typhus. The army swore allegiance to his oldest brother, the Grand Duke Constantine Pavlovich. Constantine, however, following Alexander's choice of successor, swore allegiance to his younger brother, Nicholas I.
links: Grand Duke Constantine Pavlovich of Russia

items.text: 1825年12月12日：Under pressure from Constantine, Nicholas published Alexander's succession manifesto.
links: Grand Duke Constantine Pavlovich of Russia

items.text: 1825年12月14日：Decembrist revolt: Three thousand soldiers gathered at the Senate Square in Saint Petersburg, and declared their loyalty to Constantine and to the idea of a Russian constitution. When talk failed, the tsarist army dispersed the demonstrators with artillery, killing at least sixty.
links: Grand Duke Constantine Pavlovich of Russia

items.text: 1826年：An imperial decree established the Second Section of His Majesty's Own Chancery, concerned with codifying and publishing the law, and the Third Section, which operated as the Empire's secret police.
links: Third Section of His Imperial Majesty's Own Chancellery

items.text: 1826年7月：Nicholas established the office of Chief of Gendarmes, in charge of the Gendarmerie units of the Internal Guard.
1826年7月16日：Russo-Persian War (1826–1828): The Persian army invaded the Russian-owned Talysh Khanate.
1828年2月21日：Russo-Persian War (1826–1828) Facing the possibility of a Russian conquest of Tehran, Persia signed the Treaty of Turkmenchay.
1828年5月：The Russian army occupied Wallachia.
1828年6月：Russo-Turkish War (1828–1829): The Russian armed forces crossed into Dobruja, an Ottoman territory.
1829年9月14日：Russo-Turkish War (1828–1829): The Treaty of Adrianople was signed, ceding the eastern shore of the Black Sea and the mouth of the Danube to the Russians.
1830年11月29日：November Uprising: A group of Polish nationalists attacked Belweder Palace, the seat of the Governor-General.
1831年1月25日：November Uprising: An act of the Sejm dethroned Nicholas from the Polish crown.
1831年1月29日：November Uprising: A new government took office in Poland.
1831年2月4日：November Uprising: Russian troops crossed the Polish border.
1831年9月：Battle of Warsaw (1831): The Russian army captured Warsaw, ending the November Uprising.
1836年：The Gendarmerie of the Internal Guard was spun off as the Special Corps of Gendarmes.
1852年12月：The Ottoman sultan confirmed the supremacy of France and the Catholic Church over Christians in the Holy Land.
1853年7月3日：Russia invaded the Ottoman provinces of Wallachia and Moldavia.
1853年10月4日：Crimean War: The Ottoman Empire declared war on Russia.
1854年3月28日：Crimean War: Britain and France declared war on Russia.
links: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

items.text: 1854年8月：Crimean War: In order to prevent the Austrian Empire entering the war, Russia evacuated Wallachia and Moldavia.
1855年2月18日：Nicholas died. His son, Alexander II, became emperor.

1856年3月30日：Crimean War: The Treaty of Paris was signed, officially ending the war. The Black Sea was demilitarized. Russia lost territory it had been granted at the mouth of the Danube, abandoned claims to protect Turkish Christians, and lost its influence over the Danubian Principalities.
1857年：The last military settlements were disbanded.
1858年5月28日：The Treaty of Aigun was signed, pushing the Russo-Chinese border east to the Amur river; Tariff Act reduces import tax.
1860年10月18日：The Convention of Peking transferred the Ussuri krai from China to Russia.
1861年3月3日：Emancipation reform of 1861: Alexander issued a manifesto emancipating the serfs; Student Protests against the Tsar.
1863年1月22日：January Uprising: An anti-Imperial uprising began in Poland; girls allowed into secondary schools and standard curriculum set.
1864年1月1日：Zemstva were established for the local self-government of Russian citizens.
1864年5月1日：The Russian army began an incursion into the Khanate of Kokand.
1864年5月21日：Caucasian War: Alexander declared the war over.
1864年8月5日：January Uprising: Romuald Traugutt, the dictator of the rebellion, was hanged.
1864年11月20日：Judicial reform of Alexander II: A royal decree introduced new laws unifying and liberalizing the Russian judiciary.
1865年6月17日：The Russian army captured Tashkent
1867年：The conquered territories of Central Asia became a separate Guberniya, the Russian Turkestan.
1867年3月30日：Alaska Purchase: Russia agreed to the sale of Alaska to the United States of America.
1868年：The Khanate of Kokand became a Russian vassal state.
1870年：More vocational subjects taught to girls in schools
1873年：The Narodnik rebellion began.
1873年：The Emirate of Bukhara became a Russian protectorate.
1873年5月18日：Khiva was captured by Russian troops.
1873年8月12日：A peace treaty was signed that established the Khanate of Khiva as a quasi-independent Russian protectorate.
1876年3月：The Khanate of Kokand was incorporated into the Russian Empire.
1876年4月20日：April Uprising: Bulgarian nationalists attacked the Ottoman police headquarters in Oborishte.
1876年5月：Alexander signed the Ems Ukaz, banning the use of the Ukrainian language in print.
1876年7月8日：A secret treaty prepared for the division of the Balkans between Russia and Austria-Hungary, depending on the outcome of local revolutionary movements.
1876年12月6日：Kazan demonstration: A political demonstration in front of the Kazan Cathedral in Saint Petersburg marked the appearance of the revolutionary group Land and Liberty.
1877年2月：The Trial of the 193 occurred, punishing the participants of the Narodnik rebellion.
1877年4月24日：Russo-Turkish War (1877–1878): Russia declared war on the Ottoman Empire.

1878年3月3日：Russo-Turkish War (1877–1878): The Treaty of San Stefano was signed, concluding the war and transferring Northern Dobruja and some Caucasian territories into Russian hands. Several Slavic states, Montenegro, Serbia, Romania, and Bulgaria, received independence or autonomy.
1878年7月13日：Congress of Berlin: The Treaty of Berlin, imposed on Russia by the West, divided Bulgaria into Eastern Rumelia and the Principality of Bulgaria.
1879年8月：Land and Liberty split into the moderate Black Repartition and the radical terrorist group People's Will.
1880年8月6日：The Special Corps of Gendarmes and the Third Section were disbanded; their functions and most capable officers were transferred to the new Department of State Police under the MVD.
links: Third Section of His Imperial Majesty's Own Chancellery

items.text: 1881年：Constitution proposed, Alexander II agrees to it but doesn't get a chance to sign it
1881年3月10日：Alexander II was assassinated by Ignacy Hryniewiecki of the People's Will. His son, Alexander III, becomes emperor.
1881年9月21日：Persia officially recognized Russia's annexation of Khwarazm in the Treaty of Akhal.
1882年：Alexander III introduces factory inspections and restricts working hours for women and children
1883年：Peasant Land Bank set up
1890年6月12日：An imperial decree subordinated the zemstva to the authority of the appointed regional governors.
1891年：Severe famine affects almost half of Russia's provinces
1892年：Witte's Great Spurt increases industrial growth; women banned from mines and children under 12 banned from working in factories
1894年11月1日：Alexander III dies. His son Nicholas II succeeds him as emperor.
1898年3月1日：The Marxist Russian Social Democratic Labour Party (RSDLP) held its first Party Congress.
links: 1st Congress of the Russian Social Democratic Labour Party

items.text: 1900年：In response to a local trade blockade, Russia invades and occupies the Sixty-Four Villages East of the Heilongjiang River. All 30,000 Qing dynasty citizens are expelled from their homes and driven across the Amur River, where most drown.
links: Sixty-Four Villages East of the Heilongjiang River

items.text: 1900年2月6日：As part of the Russification of Finland, Nicholas issues the Language Manifesto of 1900, making Russian the official language of Finnish administration.
1901年6月30日：Russification of Finland: The Military Service Act incorporated the Finnish and Russian armies.
1902年：Russification of Finland: Nikolay Bobrikov, the Governor-General of Finland, was given the power to dismiss opponents of Russification from the Finnish government.
1902年1月：The Socialist Revolutionary Party was founded.
1903年3月20日：Russification of Finland: The office of the Governor-General was given dictatorial powers.
1903年4月6日：Kishinev pogrom: A three-day pogrom began, which would leave forty-seven Jews dead.
1903年11月17日：At the second congress of the RSDLP, the party split into two factions: the Bolsheviks, led by Vladimir Lenin, and the less radical Mensheviks.
1904年2月8日：Russo-Japanese War: Japan launched a surprise torpedo attack on the Russian navy at Port Arthur.
1905年1月3日：Russian Revolution of 1905: A strike began at the Putilov Works in St. Petersburg.

1905年1月9日：Bloody Sunday (1905): Peaceful demonstrators arrived at the Winter Palace in Saint Petersburg to present a petition to the emperor, leading was a priest named Georgi Gapon. The Imperial Guard fired on the crowd, killing around 200 and wounding 800.
1905年：Russo-Japanese War: The Russian Baltic Fleet was practically destroyed in the Battle of Tsushima, effectively ending the Russo-Japanese War in Japan's favour.
1905年5月28日：Russian Revolution of 1905: The first soviet was formed in the midst of a textile strike in Ivanovo-Voznesensk.
1905年6月14日：Russian Revolution of 1905: A mutiny occurred aboard the battleship Potemkin.
1905年6月25日：Russian Revolution of 1905: The Potemkin sailors defected to Romania.
1905年9月5日：Russo-Japanese War: The Treaty of Portsmouth was signed, ceding some Russian property and territory to Japan and ending the war.
1905年10月17日：Russian Revolution of 1905: Nicholas signed the October Manifesto, expanding civil liberties and establishing and empowering the first State Duma of the Russian Empire.
links: State Duma of the Russian Empire

items.text: 1906年3月：1906 Russian legislative election: The first free elections to the Duma gave majorities to liberal and socialist parties.
1906年4月23日：The Fundamental Laws were issued, reaffirming the autocratic supremacy of the emperor.
1906年4月23日：The First Duma was called.
1906年7月21日：The First Duma was dissolved.

1906年7月23日：The Constitutional Democratic Party (Kadets) issued the Vyborg Manifesto, calling on the Russian people to evade taxes and the draft. All signatories to the Manifesto lost their right to hold office in the Duma.
1906年11月9日：A decree by Prime Minister Pyotr Stolypin signaled the start of the Stolypin reform, intended to replace the obshchina with a more progressive, capitalist form of agriculture.
1907年2月9日：The secret police units of the MVD Department of State Police were unified under the authority of the new Okhrana.
1907年2月20日：The Second Duma began. The Kadets dropped seats, benefiting the RSDLP and the Socialist Revolutionary Party.
1907年6月3日：The Second Duma was dissolved.
1907年6月3日：Nicholas changed the electoral law and gave greater electoral value to the votes of nobility and landowners.
1907年11月1日：The Third Duma began.
1912年4月4日：Lena massacre: The Russian army fired on a crowd of striking miners, killing 150.
1912年6月9日：The Third Duma ended.
links: State Duma of the Russian Empire

items.text: 1912年11月15日：The Fourth Duma was called.
links: State Duma of the Russian Empire of the Fourth Convocation

items.text: 1914年6月28日：Assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand: Archduke Franz Ferdinand of Austria was assassinated by Gavrilo Princip of the Bosnian separatist group Young Bosnia.

1914年7月23日：World War I: Austria-Hungary issued the July Ultimatum to Serbia, demanding, among other things, the right to participate in the investigation into the assassination of Franz Ferdinand, which Serbia refused.
1914年7月28日：World War I: Austria-Hungary declared war on Serbia.
1914年7月30日：World War I: Russia mobilized its army to defend Serbia.
1914年8月1日：World War I: Germany declared war on Russia in defense of Austria-Hungary.
1915年5月2日：Gorlice–Tarnów offensive: The German army launched an offensive across the length of the Eastern Front.
1915年8月4日：Gorlice-Tarnów Offensive: Germany conquered Warsaw.
1915年9月19日：Gorlice-Tarnów Offensive: German forces captured Vilnius.
1916年6月25日：Basmachi Revolt: Nicholas issued a decree ordering the conscription of Central Asians.
1916年11月5日：By the Act of 5th November, the German government established the nominally independent Kingdom of Poland.
1916年12月16日：Royal adviser Grigori Rasputin was murdered by a group of nobles in the house of Prince Felix Yusupov.
1917年：February Revolution: The workers at the Putilov Plant in Petrograd went on strike, demanding the end of the Russian autocracy and the end of Russian participation in World War I.
1917年2月25日：February Revolution: A battalion of soldiers was sent to Petrograd to end the uprising.

1917年2月26日：February Revolution: Nicholas ordered the dissolution of the Fourth Duma. The Duma ignored his order and decreed the establishment of a Provisional Government with Georgy Lvov as Prime Minister.
links: State Duma of the Russian Empire of the Fourth Convocation

items.text: 1917年2月27日：February Revolution: The soldiers sent to suppress the protestors defected and joined them. It started off as the "National Women's day" then, after two days, the women convinced the soldiers to join their revolution due to the fact that they were women and the soldiers did not want to kill them. On top of this, the Cossacks did not try to stop the protestors. Menshevik leaders were freed from the Peter and Paul Fortress and founded the Petrograd Soviet.
1917年3月2日：February Revolution: Nicholas abdicated.
1917年3月17日：A legislative council, the Central Rada, was founded in Ukraine.
1917年3月30日：The Provisional Government established the autonomous province of Estonia and scheduled elections to an Estonian legislative body, the Maapäev.
1917年4月3日：Communist leader Vladimir Lenin returns to Petrograd after a 10-year exile from Russia and begins to rebuild his power as leader of the Bolsheviks.
1917年5月10日：The Rumcherod, the Soviet government of southwestern Ukraine]and Bessarabia, was established.
1917年6月23日：The Central Rada ratified Ukrainian autonomy.
1917年7月3日：July Days: A spontaneous pro-soviet demonstration occurred on the streets of Petrograd.
1917年7月6日：July Days: The rebellion was put down. The Provisional Government ordered the arrest of Bolshevik leaders.
1917年7月14日：The Maapäev took office.
1917年7月21日：Alexander Kerensky succeeded Lvov as Prime Minister.
1917年8月27日：Kornilov Affair: General Lavr Kornilov ordered an army corps to Petrograd to destroy the soviets.
1917年8月29日：Kornilov Affair: The Provisional Government armed tens of thousands of Red Guards to defend Petrograd.
1917年8月31日：Kornilov Affair: Kornilov was arrested.
1917年9月4日：Under public pressure, Bolshevik leaders were released from prison.
1917年10月23日：Estonian Bolsheviks under Jaan Anvelt captured the capital, Tallinn.
1917年10月25日：October Revolution: Soldiers directed by the Military Revolutionary Committee of the Petrograd Soviet captured the Winter Palace, ending the power of the Russian Provisional Government.

1917年10月25日：The Second All-Russian Congress of Soviets convened. Menshevik and moderate SR representatives walked out to protest the October Revolution. The Congress established and elected the Sovnarkom, and Lenin its first chairman, to run the country between sessions.

1917年10月26日：The Second All-Russian Congress of Soviets issued the Decree on Peace, promising an end to Russian participation in World War I, and the Decree on Land, approving the expropriation of land from the nobility.
1917年11月21日：The Moldavian legislature, the Sfatul Țării, held its first meeting.
1917年12月5日：A local nationalist group, the Alash Orda, established an autonomous government in Kazakhstan.
1917年12月6日：The Finnish parliament issued a declaration of independence.
1917年12月7日：The Cheka was established.
1917年12月12日：A Muslim republic, the Idel-Ural State, was established in central Russia.
1917年12月25日：Ukrainian Bolsheviks established the Soviet Ukrainian Republic in Kharkiv.
1917年12月27日：Russian Civil War: The counterrevolutionary Volunteer Army was established.
1918年1月12日：The Tsentralna Rada declared the independence of the Ukrainian People's Republic.
1918年1月14日：The Rumcherod declared itself the supreme power in Bessarabia.
1918年1月15日：A decree of the Sovnarkom established the Red Army.
1918年1月16日：The Romanian army occupied Kishinev and evicted the Rumcherod.
1918年1月24日：The Moldavian Democratic Republic declared its independence from Russia.
1918年1月28日：The Transcaucasian parliament held its first meeting.
1918年2月18日：The Red Army conquered Kiev.
1918年2月23日：Mass conscription to the Red Army began in Moscow and Petrograd.
1918年2月24日：The Red Army retreated from Estonia in the face of the German armed forces.

1918年3月3日：Soviet Russia signed the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk, ending its participation in World War I, relinquishing Finland, Estonia, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Belarus, and Ukraine, and ceding to the Ottoman Empire all territory captured in the Russo-Turkish War.
1918年3月6日：Allied intervention in the Russian Civil War: Two hundred British marines arrived at Murmansk.
links: Allied intervention in the Russian Civil War

items.text: 1918年3月25日：The Belarusian Democratic Republic was established by the Second Constituent Charter.
1918年4月：The Idel-Ural State was occupied and dissolved by the Red Army.
1918年4月30日：The Turkestan Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic (ASSR) was established on the territory of the defunct Russian Turkestan.
1918年5月26日：Russian Civil War: The Czecho-Slovak Legions began its revolt against the Bolshevik government.
1918年5月28日：Armenia and Azerbaijan declared their mutual independence.
1918年6月8日：Russian Civil War: An anti-Bolshevik government, the Committee of Members of the Constituent Assembly, was established in Samara under the protection of the Czecho-Slovak Legions
links: Committee of Members of the Constituent Assembly

items.text: 1918年6月28日：A decree by the Central Executive Committee made war communism, under which all industry and food distribution was nationalized, the economic policy of the Soviet state.
links: Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1918年6月29日：Russian Civil War: The Provisional Government of Autonomous Siberia was established in Vladivostok.
1918年7月：The Idel-Ural State was restored by the Czecho-Slovak Legions.
1918年7月：Nestor Makhno declared his opposition to the Hetmanate regime by some operations in the southeastern Ukraine.

1918年7月10日：The Russian Constitution of 1918 was adopted by the Fifth All-Russian Congress of Soviets. The legislative power was transferred from the Sovnarkom to the Central Executive Committee, which also received the power to pass constitutional amendments.
links: Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1918年7月17日：Nicholas and the rest of the royal family were executed.
1918年8月30日：After giving a speech at a Moscow factory, Lenin was shot twice by SR Fanny Kaplan, but survived.
1918年9月3日：Red Terror: Izvestia called on the Russian people to "crush the hydra of counterrevolution with massive terror."
1918年9月23日：Russian Civil War: A meeting in Ufa established a unified anti-Bolshevik government, the Ufa Directory.
1918年11月：Makhnovists established an anarchist society run by peasants and workers in Ukraine, in the territory of Berdiansk, Donetsk, Oleksandrivsk and Katerynoslav.
1918年11月11日：World War I: An armistice treaty was signed, ending the war.
1918年11月17日：Two Latvian political parties founded a provisional legislature, the People's Council of Latvia.
1918年11月18日：A military coup overthrew the Ufa Directorate and established its war minister, Aleksandr Kolchak, as dictator.
1918年11月19日：The Maapäev returned to power in Estonia.
1918年11月22日：Estonian War of Independence: The Russian Red Army invaded Estonia.
1918年11月24日：Béla Kun, a friend of Lenin, founded the Hungarian Communist Party.
1918年11月29日：Estonian War of Independence: The Red Army captured the Estonian town of Narva. Local Bolsheviks reestablished the Anvelt government as the Commune of the Working People of Estonia.
links: Commune of the Working People of Estonia

items.text: 1918年12月：The Idel-Ural State was again occupied and dissolved by the Red Army.
1918年12月8日：The Communist Party of Lithuania established a revolutionary government in Vilnius.
1919年1月1日：Local Bolsheviks established the Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic (SSR).
1919年1月3日：Latvian War of Independence: The Red Army invaded Latvia.
1919年1月5日：The Red Army occupied Vilnius, the Lithuanian capital, in support of the local Communist government.
1919年1月5日：The Red Army captured Minsk and pronounced it the capital of the Byelorussian SSR.
1919年1月16日：The Orgburo was established to oversee the membership and organization of the Communist Party.
links: Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1919年2月14日：Polish–Soviet War: The Polish army attacked Soviet forces occupying the town of Biaroza.
1919年2月27日：Lithuania was absorbed into the Lithuanian-Byelorussian Soviet Socialist Republic.
1919年3月4日：The First Congress of the Comintern began in Moscow.
1919年3月4日：The White Army launches a Spring Offensive against the Red Army.
links: Spring offensive of the White Army

items.text: 1919年3月21日：Seeking a military alliance with Russia against the French, the Hungarian Social Democrats merged with the Communist Party, released Kun from prison and appointed him Commissar for Foreign Affairs. Kun dismissed the president and proclaimed the Hungarian Soviet Republic.
1919年3月25日：The Eighth Party Congress reinstituted the Politburo as the central governing body of the Communist Party.
links: Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union
Politburo of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union
Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1919年4月16日：The Romanian army invaded Hungary.
1919年4月21日：Polish–Soviet War: The Polish army consolidated its control of Vilnius.
1919年4月28日：The Red Army counteroffensive in the Eastern front begins.
1919年4月29日：The White Army Spring offensive ends.
1919年5月30日：An anti-communist Hungarian government headed by Gyula Károlyi was established in Szeged.
1919年6月16日：Hungarian occupiers established the Slovak Soviet Republic.
1919年7月：The Red Army Counteroffensive ends.
1919年7月7日：The Czechoslovak Army reoccupied its territory and dissolved the Slovak Soviet Republic.
1919年7月：Red Army detachments numbering some 40,000 troops in Crimea mutinied and deposed their commanders; many set out to join the Revolutionary Insurgent Army of Ukraine.
1919年8月1日：Threatened by the approach of the Romanian army, Kun fled to Austria.
1919年8月14日：The Romanian army left the Hungarian capital, Budapest. Admiral Miklós Horthy stepped into the power vacuum with the army of the Károlyi government.
1919年8月25日：Polish–Soviet War: After its total occupation by Polish forces, the Lithuanian-Byelorussian SSR was dissolved.
1919年11月14日：Great Siberian Ice March:Admiral Kolchak's Army starts retreating from Omsk to Chita
1920年2月2日：Estonian War of Independence: Soviet Russia signed the Treaty of Tartu, renouncing all claims on Estonian territory.
1920年2月2日：An insurgency in the Khanate of Khiva forced the abdication of the Khan.
1920年2月7日：Russian Civil War: Kolchak was executed by a Bolshevik military tribunal.

1920年2月：The Makhnovshchina was inundated with Red Army troops, including the 42nd Rifle Division and the Latvian & Estonian Red Division – in total at least 20,000 soldiers. The Makhnovists disarmed the 10,000-strong Estonian Division in Huliaipole.
1920年3月26日：Russian Civil War: The Volunteer Army evacuated to the Crimea to join the army of Pyotr Nikolayevich Wrangel.
1920年4月25日：The Russian Eleventh Army invaded the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic.
1920年4月26日：The Khorezm People's Soviet Republic was established on the territory of the defunct Khanate of Khiva.
1920年4月28日：With the Azerbaijani capital Baku under Eleventh Army occupation, the parliament agreed to transfer power to the communist government of the Azerbaijan SSR.
1920年6月12日：Soviet Russia recognized Lithuanian independence.
1920年7月8日：Polish–Soviet War: The Galician Soviet Socialist Republic (SSR) was established in Ternopil.
1920年8月11日：Latvian War of Independence: The Treaty of Riga was signed. Soviet Russia renounced all claims on Latvian territory.
1920年8月13日：Battle of Warsaw: The battle began with a Bolsheviks' attack across the Vistula.
1920年8月26日：The Bolsheviks defeated the government of the Alash Orda and established the Kyrgyz ASSR (1920–1925)
1920年8月31日：Battle of Warsaw: The total defeat of the Russian Fourth, Fifteenth and Sixteenth Armies marked the end of the battle.
1920年9月2日：The Red Army attacked Bukhara, the capital of the Emirate of Bukhara.
1920年9月21日：Polish–Soviet War: The Polish army occupied Galicia and ended the rule of the Galician SSR.
1920年9月25日：The Revolutionary Insurgent Army of Ukraine suddenly turned from south to east, attacking the main forces of General Denikin's army.
1920年9月26日：The Revolutionary Insurgent Army of Ukraine routed elements of the white Volunteer Army in the Battle of Peregonovka, Uman (Ukraine).
1920年10月8日：The Bukharan People's Soviet Republic was established.
1920年11月14日：Russian Civil War: Pyotr Wrangel fled Russia.
1920年11月29日：The Eleventh Army entered Armenia.
1920年12月1日：The Armenian Prime Minister ceded control of the country to the invading communists.
1921年2月16日：Red Army invasion of Georgia: The Eleventh Army crossed into Georgia.
1921年2月22日：Gosplan, the economic planning committee of the Soviet Union, was created by a decree of the Sovnarkom.
1921年2月25日：Red Army invasion of Georgia: The Eleventh Army captured Tbilisi and announced the formation of the Georgian SSR.
1921年2月28日：Kronstadt rebellion: The crews of the battleships Petropavlovsk and Sevastopol, harbored at Kronstadt, published a list of demands on the government.
1921年3月16日：Treaty of Moscow is signed between Grand National Assembly of Turkey and Russian SFSR.
1921年3月17日：Kronstadt rebellion: After over a week of fighting, government troops pacified Kronstadt.
1921年3月21日：A decree of the Tenth Party Congress replaced war communism with the more liberal New Economic Policy.
links: 10th Congress of the Russian Communist Party (Bolsheviks)

items.text: 1921年3月18日：Polish–Soviet War: Poland and Soviet Russia signed the Peace of Riga, ending the war. The disputed territories were divided between Poland, Russia and the newly reestablished Ukrainian and Byelorussian SSRs.
1921年7月：The Red Army captured Ulaanbaatar, the Mongolian capital.
1921年7月13日：Russian famine of 1921: The writer Maxim Gorky brought world attention to the looming famine.

1921年8月：Nestor Makhno's headquarters staff and several subordinate commanders were arrested and executed on the spot by a Red Army firing squad: the Makhnovist treaty delegation, still in Kharkiv, was also arrested and liquidated. Makhnovist forces were defeated and dispersed by Red Army.
1921年11月6日：East Karelian Uprising begins between Finnish and Karelian forces.
1922年2月23日：Russian famine of 1921: A decree published in Izvestia authorized the seizure of church valuables for famine relief.
1922年3月12日：The Georgian, Armenian and Azerbaijani SSRs were merged into the Transcaucasian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic (SFSR).
1922年3月21日：East Karelian Uprising ends between Finnish and Karelian forces.
1922年4月3日：The Eleventh Communist Party Congress established the office of the General Secretary of the Communist Party and appointed Joseph Stalin to fill it.
links: Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union
General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1922年5月16日：Tikhon, the Patriarch of Moscow, was put under house arrest.
1922年8月4日：Basmachi Revolt: Enver Pasha was killed in Turkestan.

1922年12月29日：The Treaty on the Creation of the USSR united its signatories, the Russian and Transcaucasian SFSRs and the Byelorussian and Ukrainian SSRs, under the power of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics.
links: Treaty on the Creation of the USSR

items.text: 1923年5月3日：A council of the pro-government Living Church declared Tikhon an apostate and abolished the Patriarchate.
1923年6月16日：Russian Civil War officially ends.

1923年10月15日：The Declaration of 46 was written. The Declaration echoed earlier concerns expressed by Leon Trotsky, the Chairman of the Revolutionary Military Council, that the Communist Party was insufficiently democratic.
1924年1月21日：Lenin died.
1924年1月31日：The 1924 Soviet Constitution came into effect.
1924年2月18日：The Thirteenth Party Congress, led by Stalin, Comintern chairman Grigory Zinoviev and Politburo chairman Lev Kamenev, denounced Trotsky and his faction, the Left Opposition.
links: Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union
Politburo of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1924年10月10日：The territory of the Khorezm SSR was incorporated into the Turkestan ASSR.
1924年10月12日：The Moldavian ASSR was established in the Ukrainian SSR.
1924年10月14日：The Kara-Kyrgyz Autonomous Oblast was spun off of the Turkestan ASSR and incorporated into the Russian SFSR.
1924年10月27日：The Uzbek SSR was spun out of the Turkestan ASSR.
1924年11月25日：The Mongolian People's Republic was established.
1924年11月27日：The Bukharan People's Soviet Republic was incorporated into the Uzbek SSR.
1925年1月6日：Trotsky was forced to resign his military offices.
1925年2月19日：The lands of the Karakalpaks became the Karakalpak Autonomous Oblast, an oblast of the Kyrgyz ASSR (1920–1925).
1925年4月7日：Tikhon died. The Communist government would not allow elections to the patriarchate to be held; Metropolitan Peter of Krutitsy became the Patriarchal locum tenens according to his will.
1925年4月19日：The Kyrgyz ASSR (1920–1925) was renamed the Kazakh ASSR.
1925年5月13日：The Uzbek SSR joined the Soviet Union.
1925年5月13日：The remainder of the Turkestan ASSR became the Turkmen SSR.
1925年12月10日：Peter of Krutitsy was arrested. Sergius of Nizhny Novgorod, whom he had named to succeed him, took the title of Deputy Patriarchal locum tenens.
1925年12月23日：The Fourteenth Party Congress endorsed the leadership of Stalin and his rightist ally Nikolai Bukharin, soundly defeating the New Opposition faction of Kamenev and Zinoviev.
links: Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1926年2月11日：The Kara-Kyrgyz Autonomous Oblast was reorganized into the Kyrgyz ASSR (1926–1936).
1926年10月23日：Trotsky was expelled from the Politburo.
links: Politburo of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1927年2月25日：Article 58 of the RFSR Penal Code revised the penalties for counterrevolutionary activity.
1927年7月29日：Sergius affirmed the loyalty of the Russian Orthodox Church to the Soviet government.
1927年11月12日：Trotsky and Zinoviev were expelled from the Communist Party.
1927年12月2日：The Fifteenth Party Congress expelled the remainder of the United Opposition from the Party.
links: Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1928年3月7日：Shakhty Trial: Police arrested a group of engineers in the town of Shakhty and accused them of conspiring to sabotage the Soviet economy.
1928年10月1日：First five-year plan: Stalin announced the beginning of state industrialisation of the Soviet economy.
1929年11月17日：Bukharin was expelled from the Politburo.
1929年11月17日：Collectivisation in the USSR: A Central Committee resolution began the collectivisation of Soviet agriculture.
links: Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1929年12月5日：The Tajik ASSR of the Uzbek SSR became the Tajik SSR.
1930年4月15日：The Gulag was officially established.
1930年7月20日：The Karakalpak Autonomous Oblast was transferred to the Russian SFSR.
1932年3月20日：The Karakalpak Autonomous Oblast became the Karakalpak ASSR.

1932年8月7日：Collectivisation in the USSR: The Central Executive Committee and the Sovnarkom issued the Decree about the Protection of Socialist Property, under which any theft of public property was punishable by death.
links: Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1932年9月11日：Holodomor: Stalin sent a letter to a Politburo ally, Lazar Kaganovich, demanding the subjection of the Ukrainian SSR.
links: Politburo of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1932年12月27日：A decree by the Central Executive Committee and the Sovnarkom established a passport system in the Soviet Union.
links: Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union
Passport system in the Soviet Union

items.text: 1932年12月31日：First Five-Year Plan: It was announced that the plan had been fulfilled.
1933年1月22日：Holodomor: Police were instructed to prevent Ukrainian peasants from leaving their homes in search of food.
1934年2月8日：Elections to the Central Committee at the Seventeenth Party Congress revealed Sergey Kirov, the chief of the Leningrad Party, to be the most popular member.
links: Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union
Congress of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1934年7月10日：The Main Directorate of State Security (GUGB) was established under the NKVD as a successor to the OGPU.
1934年12月1日：Kirov was murdered by Leonid Nikolaev, possibly at the behest of Stalin.
1935年8月31日：Aleksei Grigorievich Stakhanov was reported to have mined over one hundred tons of coal in a single shift, sowing the seeds of the Stakhanovite movement.
1936年8月19日：Moscow Trials: The Trial of the Sixteen, in which Kamenev and Zinoviev were the primary defendants, began.
1936年8月25日：Moscow Trials: The defendants in the Trial of the Sixteen were executed.
1936年12月5日：The Stalin Constitution came into effect. The Central Executive Committee was renamed the Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union.
links: Supreme Soviet of the Soviet Union

items.text: 1936年12月5日：The Kyrgyz ASSR (1926–1936) became a Union-level republic, the Kyrgyz SSR.
1936年12月5日：The Kazakh ASSR became the Kazakh SSR.
1936年12月5日：The territory of the Karakalpak ASSR was incorporated into the Uzbek SSR.
1937年1月23日：Moscow Trials: The Second Trial began.
1937年1月30日：Moscow Trials: The Second Trial ended. Of seventeen defendants, all but four were sentenced to death.
1937年5月22日：Case of Trotskyist Anti-Soviet Military Organization: Mikhail Tukhachevsky, a Marshal of the Soviet Union and hero of the Russian Civil War, was arrested.
links: Case of Trotskyist Anti-Soviet Military Organization

items.text: 1937年6月12日：Case of Trotskyist Anti-Soviet Military Organization: Tukhachevsky was executed, with eight other military leaders.

1937年7月30日：Great Purge: NKVD Order No. 00447 was issued. The order established a new judicial method, the NKVD troika, and set nationwide quotas for the execution and enslavement of "anti-Soviet elements."
1937年8月11日：Polish operation of the NKVD: The NKVD chief signed Order No. 00485, classifying all potential Polish nationalists as enemies of the state.
1937年8月15日：Great Purge: NKVD Order No. 00486 made relatives of accused traitors subject to imprisonment in labor camps.
1937年10月10日：Peter of Krutitsy was executed in solitary confinement.
1938年：A new decree required the teaching of Russian in all non-Russian schools.
1938年3月2日：Trial of the Twenty One: The third Moscow Trial, at which Bukharin was the primary defendant, began.
1938年3月15日：Trial of the Twenty One: The defendants were executed.
1938年7月29日：Battle of Lake Khasan: The armed forces of Japanese Manchukuo attacked the Soviet military at Lake Khasan.
1938年8月31日：Battle of Lake Khasan: The battle ended in a Japanese defeat.
1939年8月23日：The Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact was signed, promising mutual non-aggression between Germany and the Soviet Union and agreeing to a division of much of Europe between those two countries.
1939年9月17日：Soviet invasion of Poland: The Red Army invaded Poland.
1939年10月22日：Elections were held to the Supreme Soviets of the Polish areas annexed by the Soviet Union.
links: Polish areas annexed by the Soviet Union

items.text: 1939年11月26日：Shelling of Mainila: The Red Army shelled the Russian village of Mainila and blamed the Finns for invented casualties.
1939年11月30日：Winter War: The Soviet army attacked Finland.
1939年12月1日：Winter War: The Soviet Union established the Finnish Democratic Republic in the border town of Terijoki.

1940年1月29日：Winter War: The Soviet Union recognized the Finnish government as the legitimate government of Finland, thereby abandoning the Finnish Democratic Republic, and informed the Finnish government that the Soviets were willing to negotiate peace.
1940年3月5日：Katyn massacre: The Politburo signed an order to execute 27,500 imprisoned Polish nationals.
links: Politburo of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union
Polish areas annexed by the Soviet Union

items.text: 1940年3月12日：Winter War: The Moscow Peace Treaty was signed, ending the war. Finland ceded 9% of its territory to the Soviet Union, leading to the evacuation of Finnish Karelia. The Soviet attempt to conquer Finland failed.
1940年3月31日：The Karelian ASSR merged with the Finnish Democratic Republic into the Karelo-Finnish SSR.
1940年6月15日：The Red Army occupied Lithuania.
1940年6月17日：The Red Army occupied Estonia and Latvia.
1940年6月28日：Soviet occupation of Bessarabia: Bessarabia and northern Bukovina were occupied by the Soviet Union.
1940年7月21日：Lithuania became the Lithuanian SSR; Latvia became the Latvian SSR.
1940年8月2日：The Moldavian ASSR became the Moldavian SSR, with much of its territory on the former Bessarabia and Bukovina. The old territory of the Moldavian ASSR remained in the Ukrainian SSR.
1940年8月3日：The Lithuanian SSR was accepted into the Soviet Union.
1940年8月5日：The Latvian SSR was annexed by the Soviet Union.
1940年8月6日：Estonia became the Estonian SSR and was incorporated into the Soviet Union.
1940年8月21日：Trotsky is assassinated by Ramón Mercader on Stalin's orders.
1941年4月13日：Soviet–Japanese border conflicts: A Soviet–Japanese Neutrality Pact was signed.
1941年6月22日：Operation Barbarossa: Three million Axis soldiers invaded the Soviet Union.
links: Axis powers of World War II

items.text: 1941年6月25日：Continuation War: The Soviet Union launched a major air offensive against Finnish targets.
1941年6月28日：Operation Barbarossa: The Germans captured Minsk.
1941年7月27日：Operation Barbarossa: The German and Romanian armies entered Kishinev.
1941年8月21日：Anglo-Soviet invasion of Iran: Three Soviet armies invaded Iran from the north.
1941年9月8日：Siege of Leningrad: The Germans army cut the last land tie to Leningrad.
1941年9月19日：Operation Barbarossa: Kiev fell to the Germans.
1941年10月2日：Battle of Moscow: Three German armies began an advance on Moscow.
1941年11月20日：Siege of Leningrad: The first food was carried into Leningrad across the Road of Life on the frozen Lake Ladoga.
1941年12月5日：Battle of Moscow: The Soviet army launched a counterattack from Kalinin.
1942年1月7日：Battle of Moscow: The Soviet counteroffensive ended between sixty and one-hundred fifty miles from Moscow.
1942年8月21日：Battle of Stalingrad: The German Luftwaffe began a bombing raid against Stalingrad.
1942年11月19日：Operation Uranus: The Soviet army began a pincer movement against the German forces besieging Stalingrad.
1942年11月22日：Operation Uranus: The German Sixth Army was surrounded.
1943年1月12日：Operation Spark (1943): The Soviet army launched a military offensive to break the Siege of Leningrad.
1943年1月18日：Operation Spark (1943): The meeting of the Leningrad and Volkhov Front units opened a land corridor to Leningrad.
1943年2月2日：Battle of Stalingrad: The German Sixth Army surrendered.
1943年5月15日：The Comintern was dissolved.
1943年9月8日：Stalin allowed a church council, which unanimously elected Sergius to the Patriarchate of Moscow.
1943年11月6日：The Russians recaptured Kiev.
1944年1月6日：The Red Army crossed into Poland.
links: Polish areas annexed by Nazi Germany

items.text: 1944年1月27日：Siege of Leningrad: The last German forces were expelled from the city.
1944年5月15日：Patriarch Sergius died.
1944年8月31日：Soviet occupation of Romania: The Red Army captured Bucharest.
1944年9月12日：Romania signed an armistice with the Allies, placing itself under the command of an Allied Commission led by Marshal of the Soviet Union Rodion Malinovsky.
1944年9月19日：Continuation War: The Moscow Armistice was signed, ending the war at roughly the prewar borders.
1944年9月21日：Soviet and Czechoslovak partisan armed forces entered German-occupied Czechoslovakia.
1944年11月14日：The Committee for the Liberation of the Peoples of Russia was established in Prague.
links: Committee for the Liberation of the Peoples of Russia

items.text: 1945年1月17日：The Soviet Union captured Warsaw.
1945年1月18日：The Soviet Union captured Budapest.
1945年2月2日：Alexius I was elected Patriarch of Moscow.
1945年2月11日：The Soviet Union gained the right to Sakhalin and the Kuril Islands at the Yalta Conference
1945年4月20日：Battle of Berlin: The Soviet army began shelling Berlin.
1945年5月2日：Battle of Berlin: The defenders of Berlin surrendered to the Soviet Union.
1945年5月9日：The Soviet army captured Prague.
1945年6月18日：Trial of the Sixteen: Leaders of the Polish Secret State were tried in the Soviet Union for collaboration.
links: Collaboration with Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy

items.text: 1945年6月21日：Trial of the Sixteen: The defendants were sentenced.
1945年8月16日：Invasion of Manchuria: Soviet armed forces landed on Sakhalin.
1945年8月18日：Invasion of Manchuria: Soviet amphibious forces landed in Korea.
1945年8月20日：Invasion of Manchuria: The Soviet Union captured Changchun, the capital of Manchukuo.
1945年11月：The Soviet Union established the Azerbaijan People's Government in Iranian Azerbaijan.
1946年1月22日：The Soviet-backed Kurdish Republic of Mahabad declared its independence from Iran.
1946年3月2日：Iran crisis: British troops withdrew from Iran. The Soviet Union violated its prior agreement and remained.
1946年3月10日：The Ukrainian Greek Catholic Church was liquidated by a rump synod in Lviv and driven underground.
1946年5月9日：Iran crisis: The Soviet Union withdrew from Iran.
1947年10月5日：The Cominform was established in order to coordinate Communist parties under Soviet control.
