979年：The nobles Nguyễn Bặc and Đinh Điền attacked the Đại Cồ Việt capital Hoa Lư in response to Lê Hoàn's apparent usurpation.
979年：Nguyễn Bặc and Đinh Điền were executed.
981年：Lê Hoàn declared himself emperor at Hoa Lư.
981年：Battle of Bạch Đằng (981): Đại Cồ Việt forces defeated a Song invasion near Lạng Sơn, forcing the Song fleet on the Bạch Đằng River to withdraw.
981年：Nam quốc sơn hà, a poem celebrating the sovereignty of Đại Cồ Việt over its territory, was written.
982年：Đại Cồ Việt forces sacked the Champa capital Indrapura.
1005年：Lê Hoàn died.
1009年：The imperial court acclaimed Lý Thái Tổ emperor of Đại Cồ Việt.
1010年：Lý Thái Tổ issued the chiếu dời đô, an edict ordering the transfer of the capital from Hoa Lư to Đại La.
1028年：Lý Thái Tổ's son Lý Thái Tông became emperor of Đại Cồ Việt.
1038年：The Nùng warlord Nùng Tồn Phúc launched a failed rebellion against Lý Thái Tông.
1054年：Lý Thái Tông died. He was succeeded by his son Lý Thánh Tông.
1070年：The Temple of Literature, Hanoi, a Confucian temple, was constructed.
1072年1月：Lý Thánh Tông died. He was succeeded as emperor by his young son Lý Nhân Tông, with the latter's mother Ỷ Lan and the chancellor Lý Đạo Thành acting as regents.
1075年：Minor officials were chosen by examination for the first time.
1075年：Lý–Song War: Đại Cồ Việt invaded Song in response to a trade blockade.
1127年1月15日：Lý Nhân Tông died.
1176年：The young Lý Cao Tông became emperor under the regency of Tô Hiến Thành.
1209年：The general Quách Bốc entered the capital, dethroned Lý Cao Tông and installed his young son Lý Thẩm as emperor.
1226年1月11日：Trần Thái Tông was crowned emperor of Đại Việt.
1258年1月：Mongol invasions of Vietnam: The Mongol Empire invaded Đại Việt and conquered the capital at modern Hanoi. Trần Thái Tông fled to an island.
1278年11月：Trần Thánh Tông ceded the throne to his son Trần Nhân Tông.
1282年：The Bình Than Conference took place.
1284年：The Diên Hồng Conference took place.
1285年：Mongol invasions of Vietnam: The Đại Việt commander-in-chief Trần Hưng Đạo drew out and harassed a Yuan invasion force, forcing their retreat.
1287年：Mongol invasions of Vietnam: The Mongol navy was destroyed, forcing the army, left without provisions, to begin its retreat from Đại Việt.
1293年3月3日：Trần Nhân Tông ceded the throne to his son Trần Anh Tông.
1306年：Trần Anh Tông's sister Huyền Trân married the Champa king Chế Mân in Huế.
1341年：The young Trần Dụ Tông was crowned emperor of Đại Việt under the regency of his father, the retired emperor Trần Minh Tông.
1360年：Champa launched several border attacks against Đại Việt.
1400年：Hồ Quý Ly overthrew the Đại Việt emperor, enthroned himself, renamed the country Đại Ngu and moved the capital to the citadel of the Hồ dynasty.
1400年：The Cham-Vietnamese War (1400–1407) began.
1401年：Hồ Quý Ly ceded the throne to his son Hồ Hán Thương.
1406年11月19日：Ming–Hồ War: Ming forces captured the Đại Ngu capitals.
1428年：Lê Lợi was declared emperor of an independent Đại Việt.
1428年：The Bình Ngô đại cáo was published, affirming that Đại Việt was independent from and equal to China.
1460年：Lê Thánh Tông was crowned emperor of Đại Việt.
1479年：The Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư, an official history of Đại Việt, was completed.
links: Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư

items.text: 1483年：The Hồng Đức legal code was promulgated.
1497年1月30日：Lê Thánh Tông died.
1509年：Lê Oanh assassinated his cousin, the tyrant Lê Uy Mục, and replaced him as emperor Lê Tương Dực.
1511年：The Trần Tuân Uprising took place.
1516年：Trần Cao rebellion: Trần Cao, a mandarin of Đại Việt who identified himself as an incarnation of Śakra, launched a revolt against the government.
1516年：Portuguese seafarers arrived.
1516年：Lê Tương Dực was murdered in the capital by a group of palace guards.
1527年：Mạc Đăng Dung forced Emperor Lê Cung Hoàng to abdicate, establishing the Mạc dynasty.
1533年：Lê–Mạc War.
1592年：The Revival Lê dynasty defeated the Mạc dynasty and regained control of the country.
1627年：Trịnh–Nguyễn War.
1778年：The forces of the Tây Sơn dynasty took Gia Định in modern Saigon and massacred the Nguyễn lords, the de facto rulers of southern Đại Việt, sparing only the young Nguyễn Thế Tổ.
1778年：Nguyễn Văn Nhạc proclaimed himself emperor of Đại Việt with his capital at Quy Nhơn.
1783年：Nguyễn Thế Tổ fled the country.

1785年1月20日：Battle of Rạch Gầm-Xoài Mút: Đại Việt forces under a banner of truce surprised and defeat a Siamese force, then invade with the intention of installing Nguyễn Thế Tổ on the throne, on the Mekong River in modern Tiền Giang Province.
1786年：The Phú Xuân Campaign (1786) took place.
1786年：The Thăng Long Campaign took place.
1787年：The Nguyễn Nhạc-Nguyễn Huệ split occurred.

1787年11月21日：The French priest Pierre Pigneau de Behaine signed the Treaty of Versailles on behalf of Nguyễn Thế Tổ. The French government agreed to support the latter in taking the throne of Đại Việt in exchange for Côn Sơn Island and exclusive trading rights.
1788年10月：Battle of Ngọc Hồi-Đống Đa: Qing forces invaded Đại Việt in support of the deposed emperor Lê Chiêu Thống.
1788年：Nguyễn Văn Nhạc's younger brother Nguyễn Văn Huệ proclaimed himself emperor of Đại Việt. Nguyễn Văn Nhạc relinquished the title, taking that of king instead.
1788年：Nguyễn Thế Tổ conquered Gia Định in modern Saigon.
1790年：The Battle of Bình Thuận took place.
1792年：Nguyễn Văn Huệ died, probably from a stroke. He was succeeded by his young son Nguyễn Quang Toản.
1800年：The Siege of Quy Nhơn took place.
1801年：Battle of Thị Nại.
1802年：Battle of Trấn Ninh
1802年：The Nguyễn defeat last of Tây Sơn forces.
1802年：Capital moved to Huế.
1802年：Emperor Cảnh Thịnh died, Emperor Gia Long became ruler of Vietnam.
1806年：Tang thương ngẫu lục (Random Record of Great Changes) is finalized.
1809年：Nguyễn Du completes The Tale of Kieu.
1815年：Hoàng Việt law enforced.
1815年：Emperor Gia Long (1802–1820) ended his rule of Vietnam.
1820年：Emperor Minh Mạng (1820–1841) became ruler of Vietnam.
1825年：Phan Bá Vành Uprising.
1833年：Nông Văn Vân Uprising.
1833年：Lê Văn Khôi Revolt.
1833年：Emperor Minh Mạng (1820–1841) ended his rule of Vietnam.
1845年：Emperor Thiệu Trị (1841–1847) became ruler of Vietnam.
1845年：USS Constitution lands in Da Nang as a company of US Marines moves overland to Huế and rescues a French Bishop who had been captured by the Vietnamese.
1847年：French bombardment of Da Nang in response to persecution of Catholic missionaries.
1847年：Emperor Thiệu Trị (1841–1847) ended his rule of Vietnam.
1854年：Emperor Tự Đức (1847–1883) became ruler of Vietnam.
1854年：Cao Bá Quát Uprising.
1858年：Cochinchina Campaign.
1859年：Thủ Khoa Huân Uprising.
1861年：Sinking of L'Esperance
1861年：Trương Định Uprising.
1862年：Treaty of Saigon.
1867年：The French establishes the colony of Cochinchina.
1880年－1889年：Discovery of Quang Yen coalfield
1883年：Emperor Tự Đức (1847–1883) ended his rule of Vietnam.
1885年：Ruler: Emperor Hàm Nghi (1884–1885)
1885年：Battle of the Huế Imperial City. Hàm Nghi leads resistance.
links: Battle of the Huế Imperial City

items.text: 1885年：Emperor Đồng Khánh (1885–1889) became ruler of Vietnam.
1885年：Cần Vương Movement.
1888年：Hàm Nghi captured and exiled to Algeria.
1888年：Emperor Đồng Khánh (1885–1889) ended his rule of Vietnam.
20世紀：Films about Vietnamese history
1904年：Ruler: Emperor Thành Thái (1889–1907)
1904年：Đông Du Movement.
1906年：The Duy Tân movement, initiated by Phan Châu Trinh, was launched.
1917年：Ruler: Emperor Khải Định (1916–1925)
1917年：Thái Nguyên uprising.
1930年：Emperor Bảo Đại (r. 1926–1945) became ruler of Vietnam.
1930年：Nghệ Tĩnh Revolt.
1930年2月3日：Communist Party of Vietnam (CPV) is the founding and ruling communist party of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
1945年3月11日：The Empire of Vietnam is established under Japanese sponsorship.
1945年：August Revolution by the Viet Minh. Emperor Bảo Đại abdicates. Civil conflicts in Vietnam (1945–1949) begins.

1945年9月：Allied forces disarm the Japanese in Indochina after World War II, with British-Indian troops operating south of the 16th parallel and Chinese nationalist forces operating north of the 16th parallel.
1949年7月2日：The State of Vietnam is established within the French Union.
1954年3月13日：Battle of Dien Bien Phu: French troops begin the battle against the Viet Minh in Dien Bien Phu.
1954年3月23日：Battle of Dien Bien Phu: the Viet Minh capture the main airstrip of Dien Bien Phu. The remaining French Army units there are partially isolated.
1954年4月26日：An international conference on Korea and Indo-China opens in Geneva.
1954年5月7日：Battle of Dien Bien Phu ends in a French defeat.

1954年7月21日：The Geneva Conference sends French Union forces to the south, and Viet Minh forces to the north, of a ceasefire line, and calls for elections to decide the government for all of Vietnam by July 1956. Failure to abide by the terms of the agreement leads to the establishment de facto of regimes of North Vietnam and South Vietnam, and the Vietnam War.

1954年8月1日：The First Indochina War ends with the Vietnam People's Army in North Vietnam, the Vietnamese National Army in South Vietnam, the Kingdom of Cambodia in Cambodia, and the Kingdom of Laos in Laos, emerging victorious against the French Army.
1955年10月26日：Ngô Đình Diệm proclaims Vietnam to be a republic with himself as its President (following the State of Vietnam referendum on 23 October) and forms the Army of the Republic of Vietnam.
links: Army of the Republic of Vietnam

items.text: 1955年11月1日：The Vietnam War begins between North Vietnam and South Vietnam; the north is allied with the Viet Cong.

1959年9月26日：First large unit action of the Vietnam War takes place, when two companies of the ARVN 23d Division are ambushed by a well-organized Viet Cong force of several hundred, identified as the "2d Liberation Battalion".
1960年3月6日：Vietnam War: The United States announces that 3,500 American soldiers will be sent to Vietnam.
1961年11月18日：Vietnam War: U.S. President John F. Kennedy sends 18,000 military advisors to South Vietnam.
1961年12月11日：The American involvement in the Vietnam War officially begins, as the first American helicopters arrive in Saigon along with 400 U.S. personnel.
1963年1月2日：Vietnam War: The Viet Cong win their first major victory in the Battle of Ap Bac.

1963年5月8日：Huế Phật Đản shootings: The Army of the Republic of Vietnam opens fire on Buddhists who defy a ban on the flying of the Buddhist flag on Vesak, the birthday of Gautama Buddha, killing 9. Earlier, President Ngô Đình Diệm allowed the flying of the Vatican flag in honour of his brother, Archbishop Ngô Đình Thục, triggering the Buddhist crisis in South Vietnam.

1963年6月3日：Huế chemical attacks: The Army of the Republic of Vietnam rains liquid chemicals on the heads of Buddhist protestors, injuring 67 people. The United States threatens to cut off aid to the regime of Ngô Đình Diệm.
1963年6月11日：Thích Quảng Đức, Vietnamese Buddhist monk (suicide).

1963年7月7日：Double Seven Day scuffle: Secret police loyal to Ngô Đình Nhu, brother of President Ngô Đình Diệm, attack American journalists including Peter Arnett and David Halberstam at a demonstration during the Buddhist crisis in South Vietnam.

1963年8月21日：Xá Lợi Pagoda raids: The Army of the Republic of Vietnam Special Forces loyal to Ngô Đình Nhu, brother of President Ngô Đình Diệm, vandalise Buddhist pagodas across South Vietnam, arresting thousands and leaving an estimated hundreds dead. In the wake of the raids, the Kennedy administration by Cable 243 orders the Embassy of the United States, Saigon to explore alternative leadership in the country, opening the way towards a coup against Diệm.
links: Army of the Republic of Vietnam Special Forces
Embassy of the United States, Saigon

items.text: 1963年11月2日：1963 South Vietnamese coup d'état: Arrest and assassination of Ngo Dinh Diem, the South Vietnamese President.
1963年11月6日：1963 South Vietnamese coup d'état: Coup leader General Dương Văn Minh takes over as leader of South Vietnam.
1964年1月30日：General Nguyễn Khánh leads a bloodless military coup d'état, replacing Dương Văn Minh as Prime Minister of South Vietnam.
1964年5月2日：Vietnam War: Attack on USNS Card – An explosion caused by Viet Cong commandos causes escort carrier USNS Card to sink in the port of Saigon.
1964年7月19日：Vietnam War: At a rally in Saigon, South Vietnamese Prime Minister Nguyễn Khánh calls for expanding the war into North Vietnam.
1964年7月20日：Vietnam War: Viet Cong forces attack a provincial capital, killing 11 South Vietnamese military personnel and 40 civilians (30 of which are children).
1964年7月27日：Vietnam War: The U.S. sends 5,000 more military advisers to South Vietnam, bringing the total number of United States forces in Vietnam to 21,000.
1964年8月2日：Vietnam War: United States destroyer Maddox is attacked in the Gulf of Tonkin. Air support from the carrier USS Ticonderoga sinks one gunboat, while the other two leave the battle.

1964年8月5日：Vietnam War: Operation Pierce Arrow – Aircraft from carriers USS Ticonderoga and USS Constellation bomb North Vietnam in retaliation for strikes against U.S. destroyers in the Gulf of Tonkin.
1964年8月7日：Vietnam War: The United States Congress passes the Gulf of Tonkin Resolution, giving U.S. President Lyndon B. Johnson broad war powers to deal with North Vietnamese attacks on U.S. forces.
1964年8月16日：Vietnam War: In a coup, General Nguyễn Khánh replaces Dương Văn Minh as South Vietnam's chief of state and establishes a new constitution, drafted partly by the U.S. Embassy.
1965年：Vietnam War: Korean People's Army Air Force sent 200 pilots to Vietnam.

1965年3月2日：Vietnam War: Operation Rolling Thunder – The United States Air Force 2nd Air Division, United States Navy and South Vietnam Air Force begin a 3½-year aerial bombardment campaign against North Vietnam.
1965年3月8日：Vietnam War: Some 3,500 United States Marines arrive in Da Nang, South Vietnam, becoming the first American ground combat troops in Vietnam.
1965年4月29日：Australia announces that it is sending an infantry battalion to support the South Vietnam government.
1965年6月10日：Vietnam War – Battle of Đồng Xoài: About 1,500 Viet Cong mount a mortar attack on Đồng Xoài, overrunning its military headquarters and the adjoining militia compound.

1965年7月24日：Vietnam War: Four F-4C Phantoms escorting a bombing raid at Kang Chi are targeted by antiaircraft missiles, in the first such attack against American planes in the war. One is shot down and the other 3 sustain damage.

1965年7月28日：Vietnam War: U.S. President Lyndon B. Johnson announces his order to increase the number of United States troops in South Vietnam from 75,000 to 125,000, and to more than double the number of men drafted per month - from 17,000 to 35,000.

1965年8月18日：Vietnam War – Operation Starlite: 5,500 United States Marines destroy a Viet Cong stronghold on the Van Tuong peninsula in Quảng Ngãi Province, in the first major American ground battle of the war. The Marines were tipped-off by a Viet Cong deserter who said that there was an attack planned against the U.S. base at Chu Lai.
1965年9月20日：Vietnam War: An USAF F-104 Starfighter piloted by Captain Philip Eldon Smith is shot down by a Chinese MiG-19 Farmer. The pilot is held until 15 March 1973.
1965年10月9日：A brigade of South Korean soldiers arrive in South Vietnam.

1965年10月30日：Vietnam War: Near Da Nang, United States Marines repel an intense attack by Viet Cong forces, killing 56 guerrillas. A sketch of Marine positions is found on the dead body of a 13-year-old Vietnamese boy who sold drinks to the Marines the day before.
1965年11月8日：Vietnam War – Operation Hump: The United States Army 173rd Airborne is ambushed by over 1,200 Viet Cong.

1965年11月14日：Vietnam War – Battle of Ia Drang: In the Ia Drang Valley of the Central Highlands in Vietnam, the first major engagement of the war between regular United States and North Vietnamese forces begins.

1965年11月28日：Vietnam War: In response to U.S. President Lyndon B. Johnson's call for "more flags" in Vietnam, Philippines President-elect Ferdinand Marcos announces he will send troops to help fight in South Vietnam.
1965年12月21日：The Soviet Union announces that it has shipped rockets to North Vietnam.
1966年5月15日：The South Vietnamese army besieges Da Nang.
1966年6月29日：Vietnam War: U.S. planes begin bombing Hanoi and Haiphong.
1966年7月4日：North Vietnam declares general mobilization.
1966年7月7日：A Warsaw Pact conference ends with a promise to support North Vietnam.
1966年7月24日：A USAF F-4C Phantom #63-7599 was shot down by a North Vietnamese SAM-2 45 miles (72 km) northeast of Hanoi, in the first loss of a US aircraft to a Vietnamese SAM in the Vietnam War.

1966年8月18日：Vietnam War – Battle of Long Tan: D Company, 6th Battalion of the Royal Australian Regiment, meets and defeats a Viet Cong force estimated to be four times larger, in Phuoc Tuy Province, Republic of Vietnam.
1966年9月16日：In South Vietnam, Thích Trí Quang ends a 100-day hunger strike.
1966年10月9日：Vietnam War: Bình Tai massacre.
1966年10月24日：Negotiations about the Vietnam War begin in Manila, Philippines.
1966年12月6日：Vietnam War: Bình Hòa massacre.
1967年1月6日：Vietnam War: USMC and ARVN troops launch Operation Deckhouse Five in the Mekong Delta.
1967年1月8日：Vietnam War: Operation Cedar Falls starts.
1967年8月7日：Vietnam War: The People's Republic of China agrees to give North Vietnam an undisclosed amount of aid in the form of a grant.

1967年8月21日：Two U.S. Navy jets stray into the airspace of the People's Republic of China following an attack on a target in North Vietnam and are shot down. Lt. Robert J. Flynn, the only survivor, is captured alive and will be held prisoner by China until 1973.
1967年9月3日：Nguyễn Văn Thiệu is elected President of South Vietnam.

1967年：Vietnam War – Operation Swift: The United States Marines launch a search and destroy mission in Quảng Nam and Quảng Tín provinces. The ensuing 4-day battle in Que Son Valley kills 114 Americans and 376 North Vietnamese.
1967年10月17日：Vietnam War: The Battle of Ong Thanh takes place.
1967年10月26日：U.S. Navy pilot John McCain is shot down over North Vietnam and taken prisoner. His capture is confirmed two days later, and he remains a prisoner of war for more than five years.

1967年：Vietnam War – Battle of Dak To: Around Đắk Tô (located about 280 miles north of Saigon near the Cambodian border), heavy casualties are suffered on both sides; U.S. troops narrowly win the battle on 22 November.
1967年12月4日：Vietnam War: U.S. and South Vietnamese forces engage Viet Cong troops in the Mekong Delta (235 of the 300-strong Viet Cong battalion are killed).
1968年1月21日：Vietnam War – Battle of Khe Sanh: One of the most publicized and controversial battles of the war begins, ending on 9 July.
1968年1月30日：Vietnam War: The Tet Offensive begins, as Viet Cong forces launch a series of surprise attacks across South Vietnam.

1968年2月1日：Vietnam War: A Viet Cong officer named Nguyễn Văn Lém is executed by Nguyễn Ngọc Loan, a South Vietnamese National Police Chief. The event is photographed by Eddie Adams. The photo makes headlines around the world, eventually winning the 1969 Pulitzer Prize, and sways U.S. public opinion against the war.
1968年2月12日：Vietnam War: Phong Nhị and Phong Nhất massacre.
links: Phong Nhị and Phong Nhất massacre

items.text: 1968年2月24日：Vietnam War: The Tet Offensive is halted; South Vietnam recaptures Huế.
1968年2月25日：Vietnam War: Hà My massacre.
1968年：Vietnam War: Operation Patrick.
1968年3月7日：Vietnam War: The First Battle of Saigon ends.
1968年：Vietnam War: Battle of Lima Site 85, the largest single ground combat loss of United States Air Force members (12) during the (at this time) secret war later known as the Laotian Civil War.

1968年3月16日：Vietnam War – My Lai massacre: American troops kill scores of civilians. The story will first become public in November 1969 and will help undermine public support for the U.S. efforts in Vietnam.
1968年3月30日：Vietnam War: Operation Cochise Green starts.

1968年7月26日：Vietnam War: South Vietnamese opposition leader Trương Đình Dzu is sentenced to 5 years hard labor, for advocating the formation of a coalition government as a way to move toward an end to the war.
1968年9月23日：Vietnam War: The Tet Offensive comes to an end in South Vietnam.
1968年10月8日：Vietnam War – Operation Sealords: United States and South Vietnamese forces launch a new operation in the Mekong Delta.

1968年10月31日：Vietnam War: Citing progress in the Paris peace talks, U.S. President Lyndon B. Johnson announces to the nation that he has ordered a complete cessation of "all air, naval, and artillery bombardment of North Vietnam" effective 1 November.

1968年11月15日：Vietnam War: Operation Commando Hunt is initiated to interdict men and supplies on the Ho Chi Minh trail, through Laos into South Vietnam. By the end of the operation, 3 million tons of bombs are dropped on Laos, slowing but not seriously disrupting trail operations.
1969年：The Battle of Hamburger Hill, also known as Dong Ap Bia, begins during the Vietnam War.
1969年6月8日：U.S. President Richard Nixon and South Vietnamese President Nguyễn Văn Thiệu meet at Midway Island. Nixon announces that 25,000 U.S. troops will be withdrawn by September.
1969年7月8日：Vietnam War: The very first U.S. troop withdrawals are made.

1969年7月25日：Vietnam War: U.S. President Richard Nixon declares the Nixon Doctrine, stating that the United States now expects its Asian allies to take care of their own military defense. This starts the "Vietnamization" of the war.
1969年9月2日：Ho Chi Minh, the president of the North Vietnam, dies at the age of 79.

1970年9月5日：Vietnam War – Operation Jefferson Glenn: The United States 101st Airborne Division and the South Vietnamese 1st Infantry Division initiate a new operation in Thua Thien Province (the operation ends in October 1971).
1970年10月12日：Vietnam War: U.S. President Richard Nixon announces that the United States will withdraw 40,000 more troops before Christmas.
1970年10月30日：In Vietnam, the worst monsoon to hit the area in six years causes large floods, kills 293, leaves 200,000 homeless and virtually halts the Vietnam War.
1970年11月4日：Vietnam War – Vietnamization: The United States turns control of the air base in the Mekong Delta to South Vietnam.

1970年11月21日：Vietnam War – Operation Ivory Coast: A joint Air Force and Army team raids the Sơn Tây prison camp in an attempt to free American POWs thought to be held there (no Americans are killed, but the prisoners have already moved to another camp; all U.S. POWs are moved to a handful of central prison complexes as a result of this raid).
1971年2月13日：Vietnam War: Backed by American air and artillery support, South Vietnamese troops invade Laos.
1971年8月18日：Vietnam War: Australia and New Zealand decide to withdraw their troops from Vietnam.
1971年10月29日：Vietnam War – Vietnamization: The total number of American troops still in Vietnam drops to a record low of 196,700 (the lowest since January 1966).
1971年11月12日：Vietnam War – Vietnamization: U.S. President Richard M. Nixon sets 1 February 1972, as the deadline for the removal of another 45,000 American troops from Vietnam.
1972年2月24日：North Vietnamese negotiators walk out of the Paris Peace Talks to protest U.S. air raids.
1972年3月30日：Vietnam War: The Easter Offensive begins after North Vietnamese forces cross into the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) of South Vietnam (ends in October 1972)
1972年4月16日：Vietnam War – Nguyen Hue Offensive: Prompted by the North Vietnamese offensive, the United States resumes bombing of Hanoi and Haiphong.
1972年5月8日：U.S. President Richard Nixon orders the mining of Haiphong Harbor in Vietnam.
1972年5月10日：Operation Linebacker and Operation Custom Tailor begin with large-scale bombing operations against North Vietnam by tactical fighter aircraft.
1972年6月8日：Vietnam War: Associated Press photographer Nick Ut takes his Pulitzer Prize-winning photograph of a naked nine-year-old Phan Thi Kim Phuc running down a road after being burned by napalm.
1972年：U.S. actress Jane Fonda tours North Vietnam, during which she is photographed sitting on a North Vietnamese anti-aircraft gun.
1972年10月26日：Following a visit to South Vietnam, U.S. National Security Advisor Henry Kissinger suggests that "peace is at hand."
1972年11月11日：Vietnam War – Vietnamization: The United States Army turns over the massive Long Binh military base to South Vietnam.
1972年11月22日：Vietnam War: The United States loses its first B-52 Stratofortress of the war.
1972年12月25日：The Christmas bombing of North Vietnam causes widespread criticism of the U.S. and President Richard Nixon.
1973年1月15日：Vietnam War: Citing progress in peace negotiations, U.S. President Richard Nixon announces the suspension of offensive action in North Vietnam.
1973年1月27日：U.S. involvement in the Vietnam War ends with the signing of the Paris Peace Accords.
1973年3月29日：The last United States soldier leaves Vietnam.

1973年8月15日：The U.S. bombing of Cambodia ends, officially halting 12 years of combat activity in Southeast Asia according to the Case–Church Amendment-an act that prohibits military operations in Laos, Cambodia, and North and South Vietnam as a follow-up of the Paris Peace Accords.
1974年1月19日：Vietnam War: The battle of the Paracel Islands between People's Republic of China and South Vietnam. This is the most famous and the only major battle involve China in Vietnam War.
1975年1月20日：In Hanoi, North Vietnam, the Politburo approves the final military offensive against South Vietnam.
1975年3月10日：Vietnam War: North Vietnamese troops attack Ban Mê Thuột, South Vietnam, on their way to capturing Saigon.
1975年3月13日：Vietnam War: South Vietnam President Nguyễn Văn Thiệu orders the Central Highlands evacuated. This turns into a mass exodus involving troops and civilians (the Convoy of Tears).
1975年4月4日：Vietnam War: The first military Operation Babylift flight, C5A 80218, crashes 27 minutes after takeoff, killing 138 on board; 176 survive the crash.

1975年4月25日：Vietnam War: As North Vietnamese Army forces close in on the South Vietnamese capital Saigon, the Australian Embassy is closed and evacuated, almost 10 years to the day since the first Australian troop commitment to South Vietnam.

1975年4月29日：Vietnam War: Operation Frequent Wind – Americans and their allies are evacuated from South Vietnam by helicopter. North Vietnam concludes its East Sea Campaign by capturing all of the Spratly Islands that were being held by South Vietnam.

1975年4月30日：The Vietnam War ends with the Fall of Saigon: The Vietnam War concludes as Communist forces from North Vietnam take Saigon, resulting in mass evacuation of the remaining American troops and South Vietnam civilians. As the capital is taken, South Vietnam surrenders unconditionally and is replaced with the temporary Provisional Government.
1975年5月1日：The Cold War between Cambodia and Vietnam begins, which eventually leads to the Cambodian–Vietnamese War.
1976年：President Tôn Đức Thắng (1976–1980) became ruler of Vietnam.
1976年7月2日：The National Assembly proclaims unification of the country as the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
1976年：Fourth National Party Congress. The Vietnamese Workers Party renamed the Vietnam Communist Party.
links: 4th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam

items.text: 1977年9月20日：Admittance to United Nations.
1978年：Admittance to the Comecon.
1978年：25-year "Treaty of Friendship and Cooperation" with the Soviet Union.
1978年12月25日：Vietnam launches a major offensive against the Khmer Rouge of Cambodia.

1979年：The People's Republic of China invades northern Vietnam, launching the Sino-Vietnamese War. The war ended with no border changes on 16 March. Vietnamese government signs treaty with Cambodia regime lifts blockade of the Cambodian coast same day.
1979年：President Tôn Đức Thắng (1976–1980) ended his rule of Vietnam.
1980年：Ruler: President Nguyễn Hữu Thọ (1980–1981)
1982年：Trường Chinh, Chairman of the State Council (1981–1987) became ruler of Vietnam.
1982年3月：Fifth National Party Congress.
links: 5th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam

items.text: 1986年12月：Sixth National Party Congress. Trường Chinh, Chairman of the State Council (1981–1987) ended his rule of Vietnam. Đổi Mới begins.
links: 6th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam

items.text: 1988年：Võ Chí Công, Chairman of the State Council (1987–1992) became ruler of Vietnam.
1988年3月：Johnson South Reef skirmish.
1991年6月：Seventh National Party Congress.
links: 7th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam

items.text: 1991年：Võ Chí Công, Chairman of the State Council (1987–1992) ended his rule of Vietnam.
1991年：Dissolution of the Soviet Union ends the existence of the Soviet Union and aid throughout Vietnam.
1995年：President Lê Đức Anh (1992–1997) became ruler of Vietnam.
1995年7月28日：Admittance to ASEAN.
1996年：Eighth National Party Congress.
links: 8th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam

items.text: 1996年：President Lê Đức Anh (1992–1997) ended his rule of Vietnam.
2001年4月：Ninth National Party Congress.
links: 9th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam

items.text: 2002年：President Trần Đức Lương starts his second term.
2006年4月：Tenth National Party Congress.
links: 10th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam

items.text: 2006年：Trần Đức Lương (1997–2006) resigns as President of Vietnam, replaced by Nguyễn Minh Triết.
2007年：Admittance to World Trade Organization.
2011年1月：Eleventh National Party Congress.
links: 11th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam

items.text: 2011年：President Nguyễn Minh Triết (2006–2011) ends his term, replaced by Trương Tấn Sang.
2013年：Amendment of Constitution. Democratic recommendations are ignored by the National Assembly. The new constitution comes into effect on the first day of next year.

2014年：Hai Yang Shi You 981 standoff: Tensions arises from the Chinese state-owned China National Offshore Oil Corporation moving its Hai Yang Shi You 981 oil platform to waters near the disputed Paracel Islands, resulting in large anti-China protests across Vietnam.
2015年1月1日：Vietnam's new marriage law goes into effect. Same-sex marriages are no longer prohibited, but are not recognized as being legally valid.
2016年1月：Twelfth National Party Congress.
links: 12th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam

items.text: 2016年：President Trương Tấn Sang (2011–2016) ends his term, replaced by Trần Đại Quang.
2016年：2016 Vietnam marine life disaster.
2020年：First year of the COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam.
2021年1月：Thirteenth National Party Congress. Unprecedented third term of the CPV General Secretary Nguyễn Phú Trọng starts.
links: 13th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam

items.text: 2021年：The COVID-19 situations worsen significantly, particularly in Ho Chi Minh City.
2022年：Việt Á scandal, 'Rescue flights' scandal, and other corporate scandals are exposed.
2023年1月：Nguyễn Xuân Phúc resigns as President of Vietnam, replaced by Võ Văn Thưởng.
2024年：Trial of Trương Mỹ Lan and Van Thinh Phat Holdings Group.
2024年3月：Võ Văn Thưởng resigns as President of Vietnam, replaced by Tô Lâm.
2024年7月：CPV General Secretary Nguyễn Phú Trọng dies in his third term. Tô Lâm succeeds.
2024年10月：Tô Lâm resigns as President of Vietnam, replaced by Lương Cường.
2025年7月：Following the merger of administrative units, Vietnam has 34 provincial-level units, comprising 28 provinces and 6 centrally governed cities.
2026年1月：Fourteenth National Party Congress.
links: 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam

items.text: 前597975年－前797975年：The oldest stone tools found in Thailand date to circa between 600,000 and 800,000 years ago, at Ban Mae Tha in Lampang province.

前500000年：The Homo Erectus fossil called Lampang man is dated 500,000 BCE. It was discovered in Hat Pudai Village, Na Seng in Ko Kha district, Lampang, in 1999. Research shows that modern Thais and other Homo Sapiens in Southeast Asia are not related to Lampang man.
前100000年：There are traces of human settlements in Thailand for 100,000 years.

前71975年：The Youngest Toba eruption occurred circa 74,000 years ago. The Toba Supervolcano in North Sumatra produced 439–631 million tons of sulfuric acid. The air-fall of this eruption blanketed Thailand and Mainland Southeast Asia with a layer of 5–10 cm ash.

前23975年－前17975年：The Last Glacial Maximum was the coldest period of the Last Glacial Period between 26,000 and 20,000 years ago. The 3–4 km thick ice sheets in the Northern hemisphere lowered the sea level by about 120 meters. The climate was -6 Celsius colder than present in Thailand (between 12 and 32 °C). There were no ice sheets. There was no seawater in the Gulf of Thailand (max depth 85 m).
前22975年：A skeleton of a woman dating to about 25,000 years ago was unearthed at Moh Khieo Cave in Muang district, Krabi province.
前9675年：The Pleistocene (Last Glacial Period (LGP)) ends around 11,700 years ago (before present).

前9000年：Neolithic culture appears in many parts of Thailand: Spirit Cave (Mae Hong Son) Lang Kamnan Cave and Wang Bhodi (Kanchanaburi), Khok Phanom Di (Chonburi), Khao Rakian (Songkhla), and in Ubon Ratchathani about 9000 BCE.

前2100年：The Ban Chiang culture flourishes. This Bronze Age pre-Thai civilization was discovered in an archeological site situated in the Khorat plateau of Udon Thani province in the northeast of Thailand. The oldest bronze artefacts and grave date to 2100 BCE.
前2050年：Recent archaeological excavations suggests that domesticated rice was introduced to Central Thailand by immigrating rice farming societies about 2050 BCE.
前1975年－前475年：Dugout wooden coffins with human skeletons for the burial ritual of cave people were found at Ong Ba Cave in Kanchanaburi province dated 2,500-4,000 years ago.
前1975年：Artifacts of the earliest agricultural communities in present-day Thailand circa 4,000 years ago.

前1420年：Iron tools and weapons were found in the archeological sites: Non Nok Tha (1420 to 50 BCE), Lopburi Artillery centre (1225 to 700 BCE), Ong Ba Cave (310 to 150 BCE), Ban Don Ta Phet (24 BCE to 276 CE) (see Prehistoric Thailand).
前691年：The semi-legendary Singhanavati Kingdom is founded along the Kok River in the Chiang Rai basin (Northern Thailand). It existed from circa 691 BCE to 638 CE.
前600年：Chinese T’ai migration recorded. Beginning of the migration of Tai people south towards Mainland Southeast Asia. These migrants speak Tai languages.
前550年：Southern Thailand has evidence of rice agriculture from 2500 - 2200 B.P (550 BCE - 250 BCE).
前300年：Indian settlements bring the Hindu religion to the region in Southeast Asia.

前268年－前232年：Buddhism reaches places in the region such as Nakhon Pathom from India as propagated by the Mauryan Emperor Ashoka. He sent monks during his reign to popularize Theravada Buddhism (268-232 BC). This is evident by excavated ruins in the city Nakhon Pathom in Thailand.

545年：An earthquake causes Chiang Saen Lake to submerge the capital city of Singhanavati in Yonok Nahaphan (Chiang Saen District, Chiang Rai). The capital is moved to Vieng Prueksa [th] (Fang District). There is a submerged town "Wiang Nong Lom" (เวียงหนองหล่ม, "drowned town") in a swamp south of the lake.
links: เวียงปรึกษา

items.text: 638年：The Singhanavati Kingdom evolves into the Northern Thai Ngoenyang Kingdom during the fourteen chiefdoms era (545–638).

757年：The first king of the Siamese dynasty is called Phraborom Suriyathep Northai Suwannabophit (Thai: พระบรมสุริยเทพนรไทยสุวรรณบพิตร) according to the record of Simon de la Loubère. His court is in Chaiburi Mahanakhon (Thai: ไชยบุรีมหานคร). Loubère did not know the exact location. His reign begins in 757 CE (1300 Buddhist Era).
links: Pra Poat honne Sourittep pennaratui sonanne bopitra

items.text: 9世紀：In the 9th century, the first Muslim merchants settle in the Malay Peninsula including the area that was the southern part of Siam.

1000年：The Mons from Burma settle in Central Thailand. A monarchy with a unified Thai kingdom called Ayutthaya is established by King Uthong (Ramathibodi I). A series of kings follow who rule what becomes known as Siam.
1150年：The Siamese city-state Suphannabhum is founded circa 1150.
約13世紀：In the 13th century many Tais flee present-day Myanmar and China to escape the Mongol armies of Kublai Khan.
1220年：Sukhothai is taken by the Thais from the Khmers in 1220 and made their capital.

1238年：Khmer power wanes in the region. The Khmer are overthrown by Tai chieftains in Sukhothai. The Khmer rule is abolished and replaced by the Sukhothai Kingdom which is founded by Si Inthrathit in 1238.
1238年－1448年：The Thai-speaking Sukhothai kingdom expands its rule further south to dominate much of modern-day Thailand, before being eclipsed by a rival Thai kingdom of Ayutthaya.

1253年：The Mongol Armies led by Kublai Khan conquer the Kingdom of Nanzhao in southern China in 1253. This causes a mass migration including Tai warriors who consolidate the independent Tai states. Ayutthaya is reinforced by the Tai migrants which ensures Tai supremacy over the Khmer in the Central Plain.
1279年：The rule of King Ramkhamhaeng is established in Sukhothai. Sukhothai is a small local power until its third rule in the year 1279. Sukhothai's power expands into the Malay Peninsula.

1280年－1298年：The reign of King Ramkhamhaeng is marked by major advancements and the inception of a unified Thai identity. This begins with the creation and utilization of the Thai script in 1283 and significant flourishing of the arts. Ram Khamhaeng made major contributions to Thai governance, culture and religion. The people in the Central Plain call themselves "Thai" to distinguish themselves as freed Tai people from others under foreign rule.
1280年：Siamese begin to occupy the northern Malay Peninsula. Negara Sri Dharmaraja and Patani, become Siamese vassals.
1281年：In 1281, the Thai Chiang Rai kingdom is founded and takes over power in northern Thailand.

1282年－1294年：King Ramkhamhaeng of Sukhothai pursues good relations with Kublai Khan and negotiates a treaty of amity with the Yuan dynasty in 1282.Ramkhamhaeng makes a personal visit to China to see Kublai Khan shortly before his death in 1294. The Mongols threaten to destroy Burma and Vietnam, but Sukhothai could prosper at their expense. The Mongols have no concern over Sukhothai and the later Lan Na Kingdom to the north is a buffer state.
1292年：The Thai ruler Mangrai from Mueang Ngoenyang unites several principalities and conquers the Mon Kingdom Haripunjaya in 1292. This is achieved with Tai war parties of the Northern Thai people.
1292年：The Lan Na kingdom is founded at Chiang Mai in 1292. The thriving Lan Na covers a large portion of northern Thailand and Laos which is controlled by King Mangrai.
1296年－1301年：A border dispute between the Lan Na kingdom and the Mongols causes a war in 1296. In 1301, the Mongols carry out an expedition which ends in a Mongol disaster.
1298年－1347年：The period ranging from 1298 to 1357 is marked as the slow decline and fall of the Sukhothai kingdom when the Lo Thai are rising to power in the city of Sukhothai.
1350年：The city of Ayutthaya is founded by Uthong (Ramathibodi I).
1351年：The sakdina system of social hierarchy is established at the beginning of Ayutthaya.
1350年：A Thai monarchy is established under the rule of King Ramathibodi which unifies the Ayutthaya kingdom. A series of kings follow, ruling what was then known as Siam.

1350年：The Ayutthaya kingdom rivals the Sukhothai kingdom and gradually brings Thailand under its control. Ayutthaya becomes a major power in Southeast Asia. Ayutthaya reached its greatest extent around 1600 by ruling over parts of modern-day Cambodia, Laos and Burma (Myanmar).
1390年－1393年：Prince Ramesuan of Ayutthaya conquers Chiang Mai in the north and Angkor the former capital of the Khmer Empire.
1430年－1850年：The Little Ice Age causes modest cooling in the Northern Hemisphere. The climate impact is negligible in Thailand and Southeast Asia.
1431年：A Khmer rebellion against the Suphannaphum-Mon dynasty of Ayutthaya results in a 7-month siege and the Fall of Angkor. This marks the end of the Angkorian period.

1438年：The fall of the Sukhothai kingdom. Sukhothai is virtually deserted. Power shifts to the Ayutthaya Kingdom. the Ayutthaya Kingdom is established on the ruins of the Sukhothai Empire, and it is the start of their rule.
1438年：Suphannabhum was completely annexed by Ayutthaya in 1438.
1448年：King Borommarachathirat II dies in 1448. Prince Ramesuan is crowned King Borommatrailokkanat of Ayutthaya, making a personal union between Sukhothai and Ayutthaya.
1511年：The Portuguese explorer Duarte Fernandes is the first European to arrive in the Ayutthaya Kingdom in 1511. The Portuguese are theorized to have named the kingdom Siam.
1516年：The Portuguese send an envoy to the Thai Court and sign a treaty.

1547年：The Burmese–Siamese War (1547–1549) (aka the Shwehti war) was the first war fought between the Toungoo dynasty of Burma and the Ayutthaya Kingdom of Siam. Notable for the introduction of early modern warfare to the region and the Siamese Queen Suriyothai died in battle on her elephant. The Burmese–Siamese wars continued until the mid 19th century.
1549年2月：The Burmese and siamese agree to a truce which ended the Shwehti war in February 1549.
1549年：First-ever major warfare with the Mon Kingdom of Bago (Burma). The conflicts continue till 1569.

1563年－1564年：Burmese–Siamese War (1563–1564), (aka the War over the White Elephants), the 2nd Siege of Ayutthaya. After an extensive siege of the city of Ayutthaya, the Ayutthaya Kingdom becomes a vassal of the Toungoo dynasty for the first time. This vassal status lasts until 1568.
1567年：The first 2 Christian missionaries travel to Siam and arrive in Ayutthaya in 1567. These are the Dominicans Friar Jeronimo da Cruz and Sebastiao da Canto.
1568年：The Ayutthayans revolt against the Burmese rulers and briefly regain independence.

1568年－1569年：Burmese–Siamese War (1568–1569), (aka the War of the first fall) the 3rd Siege of Ayutthaya. Ayutthaya unsuccessfully attacked the Burmese vassal state Phitsanulok in 1568. The Burmese responded by intervening which resulted in the defeat of Ayutthaya on 2 August 1569. Ayutthaya became a Burmese vassal state again.
1569年：The Burmese capture and destroy Ayutthaya.

1584年－1593年：Burmese–Siamese War (1584–1593) (aka the Nandric War), the Fourth Siege of Ayutthaya. The Ayutthaya Kingdom declares independence in 1584, Burma invades Ayutthaya five times but is driven back each time (Siamese victory).

1590年－1605年：Naresuan becomes the 18th king of Ayutthaya in 1590. He abolishes a period of Burmese suzerainty. Ayuttaya expands rapidly to the detriment of the Burmese and Khmer realms. He also conquers Cambodia and parts of southern Burma.

1593年－1600年：Burmese–Siamese War (1593–1600) (aka the Naresuan War), The first Siamese invasion of Burma. Siam conquers the Tenasserim coastal region to Martaban. Lan Na (Chiang Mai) becomes a vassal of Siam, c. 1602.
1609年－1622年：Burmese–Siamese War (1609–1622), Wars of Nyaungyan restoration. Burma regains Martaban and Tavoy (1613), and Lan Na (1614).
1628年－1655年：Reign of King Prasat Thong. Trading concessions expand and regular trade with China and Europe is established.
1656年－1688年：The reign of King Narai starts in 1656. The influence of the British Empire expands. The reputation of Ayutthaya as a magnificent city and a remarkable royal court spreads in Europe.

1662年－1664年：Burmese–Siamese War (1662–1664), (aka Second Siamese Invasion of Burma). Siam briefly captures the upper Tenasserim coast to Martaban in 1662 before driven back. In 1663, Siam again invades upper Tenasserim coast and Lan Na, capturing Chiang Mai. Siamese forces evacuate Chiang Mai in 1664.
1684年：The first Siamese embassy to France composed of two Siamese ambassadors and Father Bénigne Vachet who left Siam for France on 5 January 1684.
1686年：The second Siamese embassy to France (1686) from Siam (Ayutthaya Kingdom). King Narai sent the embassy led by ambassador Kosa Pan.

1691年：The travel record Du royaume de Siam by French diplomat Simon de la Loubère is published. This is one of the few remaining records of the history and society of the Ayutthaya Kingdom in 1687. Most Thai chronicles were lost during the Burmese sacking of Ayutthaya in 1767.
1733年－1758年：Reign of King Borommakot. It is a period of peace, and of flourishing arts and literature.

1759年－1760年：Burmese–Siamese War (1759–1760) (aka the Alaungpaya's War) the Fifth Siege of Ayutthaya. Burma conquers the Tenasserim coastal region down to the Tavoy–Mergui frontier. Burma besieges the Ayutthaya, but returns home when their King is injured and becomes ill.

1765年－1767年：Burmese–Siamese War (1765–1767) (aka the War of the second fall of Ayutthaya), Burma invades Siam and besieges Ayutthaya. The invading Burmese forces sack the capital Ayutthaya city prior to being expunged by General Taksin. The Ayuthaya Kingdom collapses. Precious Thai historical records about the history of Siam were burned by the Burmese. The Burmese invasion force returned to Burma to defend their homeland against an imposing Chinese invasion of Ava.

1767年－1771年：Taksin's reunification of Siam (1767–1771). The fall of Ayuthaya left Siam divided into 5 separate states—Phimai, Phitsanulok, Sawangburi, Nakhon Si Thammarat, and Thonburi. The state of Thonburi, led by Taksin, prevailed, subjugating its rivals to successfully reunify Siam under the Thonburi Kingdom (1767–1782) by 1770/71. The capital is moved from Ayutthaya to Thonburi, near Bangkok. Phaya Taksin is crowned as King Taksin in 1767.
1768年：Thai control is re-established with the short-lived Thonburi Kingdom observed by King Taksin in 1768.

1774年－1775年：Siamese conquest of Lan Na (1774–1775). The Lan Na kingdom which was under Burmese rule for 2 centuries, is conquered by the Siamese armies of King Taksin of Thonburi. The Siamese take Burmese-held Chiang Mai in January 1775.

1775年：Bangkaeo Campaign (aka the Battle of Bangkaeo). The Burmese commander Maha Thiha Thura sent an expeditionary force to invade Western Siam through the Three Pagodas Pass. The Burmese force in Bangkaeo was encircled and defeated via starvation by the armies of Taksin.

1775年－1776年：Burmese–Siamese War (1775–1776) (aka the Athi Wungyi's War). Lan Na declares independence in 1775 with support of King Taksin. Burma invades Lan Na and Siam. After the death of King Hsinbyushin, the Burmese withdraw from Siam. The Siamese claim Lan Na which ends over 2 centuries of Burmese rule in 1776.
1779年：The city Chiang Mai is captured and the Burmese are expelled. The Emerald Buddha is brought from Vientiane in Laos, to Thonburi in Bangkok.
1782年：King Taksin is toppled by a coup launched by rebels and General Chao Phraya Chakri, who founds a new dynasty centered on Bangkok.

1782年：General Chao Phaya Chakri establishes the Chakri dynasty and assumes the name of Phra Phutthayotfa. He ascends the throne as King Rama I. The country is internationally known as Siam. The capital is moved across the river where Bangkok is founded.
1785年：Wat Phra Kaew, the temple of the Emerald Buddha is completed.

1785年－1786年：Burmese–Siamese War (1785–1786) (aka the Nine Armies' Wars). The first war between the Konbaung dynasty of Burma and the Siamese Rattanakosin Kingdom of the Chakri dynasty. The Burmese invaded with 9 armies consisting of 144,000 soldiers via 5 directions and were soundly defeated.

1786年：Tha Din Daeng campaign (aka the Tha Din Daeng War). A short conflict, occurring in 1786 in Tha Din Daeng, now Kanchanaburi province in western Thailand. The Rattanakosin forces of Phraphutthayotfa Chulalok and Maha Sura Singhanat destroy the Burmese belligerents of King Bodawpaya of the Konbaung Dynasty.
1788年：Tavoy campaign (1788). The Kingdom of Siam fails to reclaim the town of Tavoy and the Tenasserim Coast from the Burmese Konbaung dynasty.
1792年－1794年：Burmese–Siamese War (1792–1794) (aka the Siamese Invasion of Tavoy). Conflict where Siam fails to regain the lower Tenasserim Coast (Tavoy and Mergui).

1797年－1798年：Burmese–Siamese War (1797–1798). Burma invades Lan Na and besieges Chiang Mai. The city was taken, but King Kawila asks for reinforcement from Rama I, which helped them recapture the city.

1802年－1805年：Burmese–Siamese War (1802–1805). The Burmese forces of King Bodawpaya invade Chiang Mai in 1802. The Burmese are repelled by Prince Kawila with Siamese support. The Siamese under King Rama I retaliate and conquer the Burmese city Chiang Saen and the district in 1805.
1802年：The Kingdom of Chiang Mai is founded with the installation of Kawila in December 1802. This was a vassal state of the Rattanakosin Kingdom.

1809年－1812年：Burmese–Siamese War (1809–1812) (aka the Burmese Invasion of Thalang). The Burmese unsuccessfully attempt to capture Junk Ceylon. They are repelled by the Siamese in 1810 and 1812. The Kedah Sultanate helps Siam during the Burmese invasion of Tanjung Salang.
1821年11月：Siamese invasion of Kedah. The Rattanakosin Kingdom invades the Kedah Sultanate in November 1821. It results in a Siamese victory and direct Siamese rule on Kedah.
1822年：First trade treaty with Britain is signed. It was negotiated by John Crawfurd.

1824年－1826年：First Anglo-Burmese War. Conflict mostly between Burma and the United Kingdom. Siam is a nominal British ally. The Royal Siamese Army supports with 20,000 troops. Siam secures the Burney Treaty in 1826.
1826年：Burney Treaty is signed between Siam and the United Kingdom which partitions the northern Malay states between British Malaya and the Rattanakosin Kingdom.
links: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

items.text: 1833年：First American envoy to the Thai Court. The United States and Siam (now Thailand) concluded a commercial treaty in Bangkok.
1833年－1834年：Siamese–Vietnamese War between King Rama III and Emperor Minh Mạng. Vietnam annexes eastern Cambodia (Tây Thành Province) in 1834.
1851年－1868年：Reign of King Mongkut (Rama IV). Mongkut accedes the throne in 1851. He embraces Western innovations and initiates the modernization of Thailand. King Mongkut accedes in 1851.
1855年：Bowring treaty signed between the United Kingdom and Siam.
1863年：French protectorate of Cambodia is established.

1868年－1910年：Reign of King Chulalongkorn (Rama V) begins in 1868. The infrastructure, government, schools, and military are modernized. Employment of Western advisers to modernise Siam's administration and commerce. Railway network developed.
1870年：The Phra Pathommachedi is completed in Nakhon Pathom. Its height is 120 meters and it was the tallest stupa in the world until 1954.
1872年：King Chulalongkorn visits India.
1874年：Front Palace Crisis happens. Anglo-Siamese treaty over Chiang Mai is signed. Edict abolishing slavery is issued.
1885年：Prince Prisdang's memorial on a constitution prepared.
1886年1月1日：After 3 wars the British make Burma a province of British India on 1 January 1886. This ends the Burmese conflicts with Siam.
links: Presidencies and provinces of British India

items.text: 1887年1月：The Bangkok Times is founded in January 1887. It is the longest running English-language newspaper in Bangkok until World War II (30 Sep 1942).
1890年：Privy Purse Bureau established.
1892年：Ministerial council formed.

1893年：1893 Franco-Siamese crisis. French gunboats threaten Bangkok in the Paknam Incident. The French won which lead to substantial territorial concessions east of the Mekong river to the French which now forms most of Laos.
1893年：Interior Ministry founded.
1893年4月11日：The Paknam Railway is the first Siamese railway-line. It was constructed in 1891 and opened to the public by King Rama V on 11 April 1893.
1897年：King Chulalongkorn makes the first visit to Europe.
1901年：Holy Man's Rebellion. Armed rebellion of the Phu Mi Bun religious movement takes place.
1902年：Revolts break out in Phrae and the southern states revolt; Shangha Act passed.
1904年：The Franco-Siamese Treaty of 1904 officially demarcated clear boundaries between French Indochina and Thailand.
1905年：A series of reforms are implemented from 1874 until slavery is abolished by King Chulalongkorn in 1905.
1905年：Conscription edict issued for the Royal Thai Armed Forces.
1908年：Sun Yat-Sen visits Bangkok.
1909年：Anglo-Siamese treaty of 1909 finalizes Siam's border with British Malaya.
1910年：King Vajiravudh (Rama VI) accedes; Chinese strike in Bangkok.
1911年：Sra Pathum Airfield is the first airport in Thailand, established in 1911 at the site of the Sra Pathum Racecourse in Bangkok.
1912年：Plot uncovered in the military.
1913年：Thai Nationality Act passed; Surname Act passed.
1916年：Chulalongkorn University founded.
1917年9月28日：The design of the national flag called Trairanga (thong trai rong, tricolour flag) was adopted on 28 September 1917.
1917年：Siam becomes an ally of the United Kingdom in World War I.
1917年：Siamese contingent established to fight on the Allied side in Europe. The first 'political newspaper' is published.
1920年：Prince Damrong's history book Our Wars with the Burmese (Thai Rop Phama) is first published.
1925年：The Grand Palace in Bangkok is completed. The monarchy of Thailand was permanently settled there from 1782 until 1925. Many new buildings were added by various kings.
1930年7月3日：The first Siamese commercial airline was formed called the Aerial Transport of Siam Company (ATSC) on 3 July 1930.

1932年：The Siamese Revolution is a bloodless coup d’état against the absolute monarchy of King Prajadhipok. It ends centuries of absolute royal rule. A Constitutional monarchy is officially established and democracy with parliamentary government.
1933年：The Boworadet Rebellion, aimed at restoring an absolute monarchy, is put down by the ruling People's Party, a military-bureaucrat alliance.
1937年9月4日：The first two submarines of the Royal Siamese Navy (Matchanu-class) were completed and delivered on 4 September 1937. These were built by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries.
1939年：Siam officially changes its name to Thailand which means “Land of the Free”.
1939年12月10日：The Thai National Anthem in its current form was adopted on 10 December 1939.

1940年10月：Franco-Thai War begins in October 1940. After a sporadic battle between Thai and French forces, culminating in the Thai invasion of Laos and Cambodia in January 1941. Thailand successfully occupies the disputed territories in French Indochina.

1941年5月：Japan uses its influence with Vichy France to obtain concessions for Thailand in May 1941. Thailand annexes the territories Lan Chang Province, Nakhon Champassak Province, Phra Tabong Province, and Phibunsongkhram Province from Laos and Cambodia.

1941年12月8日：Japanese invasion of Thailand on 8 December 1941 during World War II. After negotiations Thailand lets Japanese advance towards the British-controlled Malay Peninsula, Singapore and Burma. Thailand deploys troops to fight on the Japanese side against Allied forces and became a member of the Axis Powers.
1942年：Thailand declares war on Britain and the United States, but the Thai ambassador in Washington refuses to deliver the declaration to the U.S. government.
1943年：Thailand annexes Saharat Thai Doem (Burma), and Sirat Malai (Malaysia), including Saiburi (Kedah State).
1943年：Thai envoy Wan Waithayakon attends the Greater East Asia Conference in Tokyo from 5 to 6 November 1943.
1944年：Thailand takes back the declaration of war against the United States and Britain. After the war, it becomes an ally of the U.S.
1945年：End of World War II. Thailand is compelled to return the territories it has seized from Laos, Cambodia, and Malaya. The exiled King Ananda Mahidol returns.

1946年：In 1946, Thailand agreed to cede the territories regained during Japanese presence in the country as the price for admission to the United Nations. Consequently, all wartime claims against Thailand were dropped and the country received a substantial package of U.S. aid.
1946年：King Ananda is assassinated in a mysterious shooting incident.
1946年：King Bhumibol Adulyadej becomes monarch aged 18. During his 70-year reign, Thailand has 10 coups and 17 constitutions.
1946年8月1日：The Bangkok Post, an English-language daily newspaper published in Bangkok, Thailand, was founded on 1 August 1946.

1947年：Military coup by the royalist-military forces led by the wartime, pro-Japanese leader Plaek Phibunsongkhram. The military retains power until 1973. The royalist-military forces end the People's Party's political role.
1947年："Lèse-majesté" laws against insulting the king, dating back to the days of absolute monarchy, are carried over into a new Criminal Code.
1959年：The first South East Asian Peninsular Games is hosted in Bangkok, Thailand from 12 to 17 December 1959, with more than 527 athletes and officials from 6 countries.
1961年7月31日：The Association of Southeast Asia (ASA) is formed on 31 July 1961 and consisting of Thailand, the Philippines, and Malaya.
1967年8月8日：ASEAN is created on 8 August 1967. Thailand is a founding member with Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines and Singapore. This is the successor of ASA.
1967年：The 4th South East Asian Games is hosted in Bangkok, Thailand on 9–16 December 1967.
1962年：United States sends troops to Thailand during the Vietnam War. Thailand permits the United States to use bases there. Thai troops fight in South Vietnam.

1970年－1974年：1970s peasant revolts in Thailand. Prime Minister Thanom Kittikachorn ignores their pleas to reduce their debt and ensure fair rice prices. The farmer representatives form the Farmers Federation of Thailand (FFT). The Land Rent Control Act (LRCA) is finally enacted in December 1974.

1973年：The 1973 Thai popular uprising in Bangkok has pro-democracy protests. There are bloody clashes between the army and demonstrating students. It ends in a crackdown with 77 casualties, according to official estimates. On 14 October, King Bhumibol intervenes and announces the resignation of the military government. Free elections are held, but the resulting governments lack stability. Political and economic blunders bring down the resulting civilian government just three years later.
1975年：8th South East Asian Games is hosted in Bangkok on 9–16 December 1975.
1976年：The military takes over the government again.

1976年：Two military leaders who were ousted in 1973, return to Thailand. Protests follow and dozens of people are killed on 6 Oct 1973. Later that day is a military coup. The king appoints a new prime minister. The maximum penalty for insulting the monarchy is raised from 7 to 15 years.
1976年－1991年：A period of military-royalist government ensues with some roles for elected politicians.
1978年：New constitution is promulgated.
1980年－1989年：Thailand had the fastest developing economy in the world for about a decade from the late 1980s to the early 1990s. The development rate was 8% from 1985 till 1995.
1985年：13th South East Asian Games is hosted in Bangkok on 8–17 December 1985.
1991年：The 17th military coup since 1932. The civilian Anand Panyarachun is installed as prime minister.
1992年9月：During the elections in September 1992, Chuan Leekpai (leader of the Democrat Party) is chosen as prime minister.

1992年：The Black May demonstrations against another coup. The clash between military forces and civilian demonstrators causes 50 civilian casualties. King Bhumibol subsequently intervenes; a period of democracy follows. The military leaves the government to the civilian politicians.

1993年：In this period, from 1993 to 1997, the country saw unprecedented, exceptional economic growth. The financial boom kept growing with time. Thailand enjoyed fast economic development with sound increments in GDP.
1995年：The government collapses. Banharn Silpa-archa of the Thai Nation Party is elected prime minister.
1995年：Prolonged floods occur in Bangkok for 2 months in 1995. It causes over US$400 million in property damage and slows the economy.
1995年：18th South East Asian Games is hosted in Chiang Mai, Thailand on 9–17 December 1995.
1996年：The population of Thailand passes the 60 million people milestone.
1996年：Banharn government is accused of corruption and resigns. Chavalit Yongchaiyudh of the New Aspiration Party wins the elections.
1997年：The 1997 Asian financial crisis: The Thai Baht currency falls sharply against the dollar, leading to bankruptcies and unemployment. The IMF steps in. Chuan Leekpai becomes prime minister.
1997年3月27日：The HTMS Chakri Naruebet is the first aircraft carrier of Thailand. It was commissioned into the Royal Thai Navy on 27 March 1997.
1997年：Thailand's banking system and economy is in freefall as the Baht loses half of its value.

1998年：Tens of thousands of migrant workers are sent back to their countries of origin. Prime Minister Chuan Leekpai includes the opposition in his administration to push economic reforms through. Thailand follows the established guidelines given by the International Monetary Fund to resuscitate its economy.
1999年10月：The Rama III Bridge is completed. It crosses the Chao Phraya River in Bangkok. It is the longest bridge in Thailand with a length of 2,170 m (7,120 ft).

2000年－2001年：Senators are democratically elected for the Senate for the first time. The populist Thai Rak Thai Party founded by Thaksin Shinawatra, won the national polls for the House of Representatives. Billionaire businessman Thaksin Shinawatra is elected prime minister and forms a coalition government. Within a few years, Thailand is riven by rival demonstrations between Thaksin's Red Shirt supporters and Yellow Shirt opponents, who call Thaksin corrupt and disloyal to the monarchy. These will drag on for a decade.
2002年：Muslim nationalists step up terror operations in Yala, Pattani and Narathiwat provinces (South Thailand insurgency).

2004年：The 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami causes a massive earthquake and tsunami which strikes the west-coast of Southern Thailand and several other countries in Southeast Asia. There were over 8,000 casualties in Thailand and widespread devastation to the infrastructure and the economy.
2004年：In January–March 2004, martial law is imposed in largely-Muslim southern provinces after over 100 casualties in a wave of terrorist attacks which are blamed on ethnic-Malay separatists.
2005年：The Thaksin administration wins a second four-year term in the general elections.
2006年：The Suvarnabhumi Airport in the Bangkok Metropolitan Region officially opened in 2006.
2006年：Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra accuses several army officers of plotting to kill him after police find a car containing bomb-making materials near his house.

2006年：Thaksin is accused for tax evasion. There are months of mass Yellow Shirt protests in Bangkok. In September–October 2006, military leaders stage a bloodless coup which overthrows the Thaksin administration. Meanwhile, Shinawatra is at the UN General Assembly. Retired General Surayud Chulanont is appointed interim prime minister by the military while a new constitution was drafted.
2007年：Martial law is lifted in more than half of the country.
2007年8月：In August 2007, voters approve a new, military-drafted constitution in a referendum.
2007年：During the December elections, the Thaksin-endorsed People's Power Party wins the post-coup elections.
2007年：24th South East Asian Games is hosted in Nakhon Ratchasima, Thailand on 6–15 December 2007.

2008年2月：February 2008, return to civilian rule after the December elections. In a parliamentary vote on 28 January 2008, Samak Sundaravej of the People's Power Party (PPP) is sworn in as prime minister.
2008年：Thai troops shoot two Cambodian soldiers in a firefight on the disputed border, near the Preah Vihear temple.

2008年8月：In August 2008, Thaksin flees to Britain with his family after failing to appear in court to face corruption charges. Thaksin returns to Thailand with his wife, but skips bail before being tried on charges of corruption and debasement. Thaksin was sentenced to two years in jail in absentia.

2008年：Yellow Shirt protestors block the terminals of Bangkok's two international airports for 10 days, causing widespread disruption. They end their occupation after a court dissolves the ruling pro-Thaksin party. A new government led by another party is formed. Abhisit Vejjajiva becomes prime minister.

2010年：In March–May 2010, mass protest of tens of thousands of Thaksin supporters - in trademark red shirts - paralyze central Bangkok with a month-long protest calling for early elections and Prime Minister Abhisit's resignation. Anti-government Red Shirts protests in central Bangkok are quelled by the army in May after two months of violence. It culminates in a crackdown by troops who storm the protesters' barricades which causes 91 casualties.

2011年7月：In July 2011, the pro-Thaksin Pheu Thai Party wins a landslide victory in the elections. Yingluck Shinawatra (sister of Thaksin Shinawatra) becomes the first female prime minister of Thailand. More anti-Thaksin protests follow.

2011年－2012年：2011 Thailand floods are caused by the landfall of Tropical Storm Nock-ten. The impact lasts for 175 days between 25 July 2011 – 16 January 2012. There are 815 deaths and property damage in 65 of Thailand's 77 provinces. The estimated damage costs is 1.425 trillion baht (US$46.5 billion).
2013年：The government cuts the guaranteed price for rice, provoking an angry reaction from farmers and protests in Bangkok.
2013年2月：February 2013, the Government and separatists in Southern Thailand sign a first-ever peace talks deal.

2014年5月：May 2014, the Constitutional Court of Thailand orders Prime Minister Yingluck Shinawatra and several ministers out of office over alleged irregularities in appointment of security adviser. The Thai army with army chief Prayuth Chan-ocha seize power in a coup.
2016年5月4日：The King Power Mahanakhon is recognized as the tallest building in Thailand (314 m) by the CTBUH on 4 May 2016 .
links: List of tallest buildings in Thailand
Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat

items.text: 2016年8月：August 2016, voters approve a new constitution giving the military continuing influence over the country's political life.
2016年10月：October 2016, King Bhumibol Adulyadej, the world's longest reigning monarch, dies at the age of 88 after 70 years on the throne.
2016年12月：In December 2016, Crown Prince Vajiralongkorn is proclaimed king.
2017年4月：April 2017, King Vajiralongkorn signs the new, military-drafted constitution that paves the way for a return to democracy.

2018年：The Tham Luang cave rescue in June and July 2018 had a team of international rescuers save a group of young soccer players and their coach who were trapped in a flooded cave in Northern Thailand. The dramatic rescue mission involved a complex network of divers, engineers, and volunteers, and captured global attention.
2019年3月：March 2019, the general election sees former general Prayut Chan-o-cha returned to power as prime minister. Opposition parties complain that the process was rigged, which Prayuth denies.
2019年11月：November 2019, suspected separatists kill at least 15 people in southern Thailand. This is one of the country's worst terror attacks in years.

2020年：Thailand has a wave of anti-government protests led by young activists calling for democratic reforms and an end to military influence in politics. The protests were met with a crackdown by the authorities, including arrests and charges of lèse-majesté which carries severe penalties in Thailand.

2020年：Court dissolves the opposition Future Forward Party. Its founder Thanathorn Juangroongruangkit denies wrongdoing in separate criminal charges over criticism of the military. This causes student-led protests.
2020年1月13日：COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand. Thailand was the first country to report a case outside China, on 13 January 2020. There were a total of 34,715 deaths.
2021年5月1日：The Sappaya-Sapasathan is completed on 1 May 2021. It is the world's largest parliamentary building with 424,000 m2 of floor space.
2024年：The leader of the Pheu Thai Party, Paetongtarn Shinawatra becomes the 31st prime minister of Thailand.
2025年1月23日：Same-sex marriage is legalized by the House of Representatives, effective 23 January 2025. Thailand is the first country in Southeast Asia and the 38th in the world to legalize it.
2025年3月28日：2025 Myanmar earthquake causes at least 36 deaths and 33 injuries in Bangkok. There are 14,430 reports of building damage to the Bangkok Metropolitan Administration.
約25000年前：Archaeological evidence of Homo sapiens in central Burma.
前11000年：Archaeological evidence suggests that cultures existed in Burma as early as 11,000 BC.
前500年：Iron-working settlements south of present-day Mandalay.
前180年：Beikthano city fortified by Pyu people who had entered the Irrawaddy valley from north; beginning of Pyu city-states
70年：Pyu city of Halin in existence
200年：The Pyu convert to Buddhism (to 400)
7世紀：Mon migrations to Lower Burma from Haribhunjaya and Dvaravati (present-day Thailand) (to 900)
640年3月21日：The Pyu of Sri Ksetra Kingdom launch the Burmese calendar with the start date of 22 March 638.
820年－829年－832年：Pyu city-states (like Hanlin) destroyed by Nanzhao raids
849年12月23日：Pyinbya founds Pagan (Bagan)
約980年：Earliest evidence of Pagan walls
984年：Earliest evidence of Burmese alphabet (according to an 18th-century recast stone inscription)
1004年：Pagan sends embassy to Song court at Bianjing
1035年：Earliest evidence of Burmese alphabet (at the Mahabodhi Temple, India)
1044年8月11日：Anawrahta ascends to Pagan throne
1050年－1059年：Anawrahta founds Pagan Kingdom including, Thaton, near Shan States, North Arakan, Malay Peninsula (to 1060)
1056年：Anawrahta converted to Theravada Buddhism by Shin Arahan
1057年5月17日：Pagan conquers Thaton Kingdom according to the Burmese chronicles
1071年：Anawrahta helps restart Theravada Buddhism in Ceylon
1082年－1084年：Rebellion in Lower Burma by Yamankan
1084年4月21日：Kyansittha becomes king
1090年：Kyansittha builds Ananda Temple
1102年：Earliest inscription of the word Mranma (Myanmar) in Mon script.
1106年：Burmese embassy to Song China
1113年：Myazedi inscription, earliest evidence of a more settled Burmese alphabet
1118年：Pagan restores Letyaminnan to north Arakanese throne
1150年或1151年：Thatbyinnyu Temple by Alaungsithu is complete.
1170年：Affirmation of Burman leadership of Pagan: Burmese becomes the primary written language, replacing Mon and Pyu
1174年：Narapatisithu founds the Royal Burmese Armed Forces, the first known standing army in Burmese history
1180年：Ceylonese raids to Bassein (Pathein)
1180年：Schism develops in Burmese Buddhism; majority of monks shift to Mahavihara school
1190年：The word Mranma first appears in Burmese
1200年：Dhamaavisala Dhammathat code of law compiled
1210年：Kyaukse weir built
1211年8月18日：Sithu II dies and Htilominlo succeeds
1218年：Htilominlo builds Htilominlo Temple, the last of the great temples
1235年7月19日：Kyaswa becomes king of Pagan
1256年5月6日：Narathihapate placed on Pagan throne
1273年：First mention of Mian (for Mranma) in Chinese
1277年4月：The first Mongol invasion begins
1279年4月17日：Thawun Gyi and Thawun Nge found Toungoo (Taungoo) as a frontier outpost
1283年9月22日：Second Mongol campaign begins
1285年：Wareru seizes governorship of Martaban (Mottama)
1286年3月3日：Pagan and Mongol commands sign ceasefire agreement
1286年6月：Burmese embassy led by Shin Ditha Pamauk leaves for Beijing
1287年1月：The Pagan Empire acknowledges suzerainty of the Mongol Empire
1287年1月30日：Wareru declares independence and founds Kingdom of Ramanya
1287年7月1日：King Narathihapate is assassinated
1289年5月30日：Kyawswa becomes king of Pagan
1293年：Wareru receives recognition as a vassal of Sukhothai
1296年：Wareru and Tarabya decisively defeat a major Pagan invasion
1297年3月20日：Kyawswa receives recognition by the Mongol Emperor as a Mongol vassal
1297年12月17日：Kyawswa overthrown and Myinsaing Kingdom founded
1298年：Ramanya receives recognition as a tributary of the Mongols
1299年5月8日：Saw Hnit placed as Myinsaing's puppet king of Pagan
1301年1月15日：Last Mongol invasion begins
1301年4月6日：Mongol forces retreat from Myinsaing
1303年4月4日：Mongols evacuate Tagaung, retreat to Yunnan
1307年：Wareru is assassinated and Hkun Law succeeds the Martaban throne
1310年4月13日：Athinkhaya dies
1311年4月10日：Saw O becomes king of Martaban
1313年2月7日：Thihathu founds Pinya Kingdom
1315年5月15日：Sagaing secession begins
1316年3月26日：Saw Yun's completes fortification of capital Sagaing
1323年：Saw Zein become king of Martaban
1327年2月5日：Tarabya I becomes king of Sagaing
1330年：Martaban defeats Sukhothai; throws off nominal allegiance to Sukhothai
1340年9月1日：Uzana I abdicates Pinya throne
1344年3月29日：Kyawswa I becomes undisputed ruler of Pinya
1350年12月12日：Kyawswa II becomes king of Pinya
1352年2月23日：Thihapate becomes king of Sagaing
1356年：Massive Shan raids into Upper Burma begin (to 1368)
1359年3月19日：Kyawswa II dies and Narathu succeeds Pinya throne
1362年：Binnya U raises the height of the Shwedagon Pagoda to 66 feet
1364年：Byattaba seizes Martaban; Binnya U sets up camp at Donwun
1364年4月：Maw forces sack Sagaing
1364年5月：Maw forces sack Pinya
1364年9月：Thado Minbya takes over Pinya
1365年2月26日：Thado Minbya founds Ava Kingdom
1367年9月5日：Swa Saw Ke becomes king of Ava
1369年：Byattaba drives Binnya U out to Pegu (Bago)
1370年：Shan state of Kale becomes tributary of Ava
1373年：North Arakan asks for a Burmese regent
1383年：Princess Maha Dewi becomes regent of Hanthawaddy Pegu
1384年1月4日：Razadarit becomes king of Pegu
1385年：Forty Years' War between Ava and Hanthawaddy Pegu begins
1389年：Razadarit consolidates all three Mon-speaking regions in Lower Burma
1400年4月：Tarabya becomes king of Ava
1400年11月25日：Minkhaung I becomes king of Ava
1406年：Arakan vassal to Ava or Hanthawaddy Pegu (To Ava: 1406–1407, 1412–1413; To Pegu 1407–1412; 1413–1422/(1430?) (to 1430)
1406年：Ava conquers Shan States of Mohnyin, Mogaung, Hsipaw
1415年3月13日：Minye Kyawswa killed in action
1430年11月16日：Min Saw Mon founds city of Mrauk-U
1437年：Mrauk-U conquers Thandwe, unifying the entire Arakan coast for the first time
1459年：Mrauk-U conquers Chittagong
1446年：Chinese invade Upper Burma, demanding surrender of a runaway Shan chief. His dead body was given up. Chinese records say events occurred in 1448–1449
1450年：Binnya Kyan increases the height of the Shwedagon Pagoda to 302 feet
1450年：Rise of early Burmese vernacular literature
1480年：Multiple rebellions by its vassals against Ava's rule. Prome, Yamethin and Mohnyin break away (to 1490)
1482年：Thado Minsaw successfully breaks away from Ava, founds Prome Kingdom
1485年：Mingyi Nyo becomes ruler of Toungoo; stays loyal to Ava
1501年4月7日：Narapati II becomes king of Ava
1502年：Ava cedes Kyaukse to Toungoo to buy its loyalty, and cedes Shwebo District to Mohnyin
1510年10月16日：Toungoo declares independence from Ava
1527年3月13日：Confederation of Shan States conquers Ava, and installs Thohanbwa as vassal king
1530年11月24日：Tabinshwehti becomes king of Toungoo
1534年：Toungoo–Hanthawaddy War (1534–41) begins
1538年：Toungoo forces capture Pegu; Toungoo–Ava War (1538–45) begins
1539年：Pegu made capital of Toungoo Kingdom
1541年5月：Toungoo forces capture Martaban
1545年10月12日：Toungoo forces invades Arakan
1547年1月30日：Min Bin and Tabinshwehti agree to a truce
1547年11月：First Burmese invasion of Siam begins
1549年2月：Burmese and Siamese commands agree to a truce
1550年4月30日：Tabinshwehti is assassinated
1551年1月11日：Bayinnaung takes Toungoo
1555年1月22日：Bayinnaung captures Ava, and annexes Upper Burma
1557年：Bayinnaung annexes cis-Salween Shan States; abolishes animal sacrifice at Popa Hill and human sacrifice at Shan Hills
1558年4月2日：Bayinnaung annexes Lan Na
1563年4月：Bayinnaung captures farther Shan States (Kengtung and Chinese Shan states)
1564年2月18日：The Ayutthaya Kingdom becomes Burmese vassal following the Burmese–Siamese War (1563–64)
1565年1月2日：Burmese forces capture Vientiane, capital of Lan Xang
1568年5月12日：Pegu learns of Siamese rebellion
1569年8月2日：Burmese–Siamese War (1568–69) restores Burmese rule in Siam
1574年12月6日：Burmese forces capture Vientiane
1581年10月10日：Bayinnaung dies, and his eldest son Nanda succeeds
1584年5月3日：Siam declares independence
1584年－1595年：Repeated Burmese invasions fail to reconquer Siam. Siam regains Tenasserim coast up to Mawlamyaing
1597年：All regions of the kingdom now in revolt

1599年：Fall of First Toungoo Empire after Pegu sacked by the Arakanese and Toungoo (city) forces. Siam captures the entire Tenasserim coast to Martaban. Arakanese capture delta ports; appoint Portuguese mercenary de Brito governor of Syriam
1599年：Siamese invasions take Martaban (1600) and Lan Na (1602) (to 1605)
1600年：Nyaungyan restores central rule to Upper Burma and Shan States (to 1606)
1603年：De Brito at Syriam declares independence from Arakan, repels Arakanese attacks (to 1605)
1609年：Portuguese mercenary Tibao captures Sandwip in East Bengal, northernmost Arakanese territory
1613年3月29日：Anaukpetlun captures Portuguese Syriam
1614年12月：Anaukpetlun recaptures the Tenasserim coast down to Tavoy, and all of Lan Na
1617年：Min Khamaung recovers Sandwip. Beginning of Arakanese raids on Dakha
1619年：English East India Company sends a representative to Pegu
1625年：Arakanese sack Dakha
1627年：English and Dutch East India companies open branches in Burma
1635年：Capital moved to Ava from Pegu
1638年：Thalun's revenue inquest
1660年：Arakanese use coined currency
1658年：Yongli Emperor of Ming China given refuge at Sagaing
1659年－1661年：Renegade Ming forces occupy near Shan states and attack Ava
1662年1月15日：Surrender of the Yongli Emperor to Qing forces
1662年：Siamese invasion of Lan Na and Tenasserim repelled (to 1664)
1666年1月：Mogul Empire defeats Arakan and captures Chittagong Province
1677年：English and Dutch East India companies close branches in Burma
1683年：Dutch East India Company closes its branch in Arakan
1688年：French East India Company opens a branch in Syriam
1709年：English open a branch in Syriam
1724年：Meiteis raid Upper Burma (to 1749)
1727年10月：Lan Na revolts; defeats Ava's attacks (1727–1728) and (1731–1732)
1735年：China annexes northern Shan States (present-day Kachin State, northern Shan State, and trans-Salween Shan State)
1740年11月29日：The Mon of Lower Burma break away, found Restored Hanthawaddy Kingdom

1740年：Restored Hanthawaddy gradually pushes upcountry and captures Ava, ending the Tougnoo dynasty. The Siamese move up their control up the Tenasserim coast, taking Tavoy and then Martaban by 1751 (to March 1752)
1752年2月29日：Alaungpaya founds the Konbaung dynasty
1752年3月23日：Toungoo dynasty falls
1752年4月20日：Konbaung-Hanthawaddy War begins
1753年4月26日：English seize Negrais
1755年5月5日：Alaungpaya captures Dagon, having conquered the Irrawaddy delta in April
1756年7月25日：Alaungpaya captures French-defended Syriam.
1756年：Alaungpaya sends a punitive expedition to Manipur
1757年5月6日：Pegu captured; end of Restored Hanthawaddy
1758年11月：Konbaung armies overrun Manipur, reassert Burmese authority in northern Shan States which had been annexed by the Chinese in the 1730s (to 1759)
1759年10月6日：English driven out at Negrais
1760年5月：Burmese invasion of Siam falls short; regains the Tenasserim coast to Tavoy
1763年1月：Lanna rebellion put down
1765年：Burmese armies capture Laotian states of Luang Prabang and Vientiane
1765年3月：Hsinbyushin puts down a rebellion in Manipur
1765年7月23日：Capital moved to Ava
1765年8月23日：Start of Burmese–Siamese War (1765–67)
1765年12月：Start of Chinese invasions (1765–69) of Burma
1767年4月7日：Burmese armies sack Ayutthaya; end of Ayutthaya Kingdom
1768年：Burmese armies withdrawn from Siam and redeployed to the Chinese front. Burmese defenses against the Chinese invasions held. Siam recaptures all of its territories (except Tenasserim) (to 1770)
1769年12月22日：End of Sino-Burmese War
1770年1月：Rebellion in Manipur put down
1775年1月15日：Lan Na (Chiang Mai) revolts, seeks and receives Siamese help.
1775年4月：Hsinbyushin raises the Shwedagon Pagoda to its present height
1775年11月：Another Burmese invasion of Siam fails; Southern Lan Na becomes Siamese vassal (to 1776)
1778年12月：Laotian states (Luang Prabang and Vientiane) stop paying tribute, switch sides to Siam
1783年5月13日：Capital moved to Amarapura
1785年1月2日：Konbaung armies capture Mrauk U, ending five centuries of Arakanese independence
