links: Battle of San Juan del Monte

items.text: 1896年9月12日：Thirteen Filipinos were executed in Plaza de Armas in the town of Cavite.
1896年10月3日：Rizal arrives at Barcelona
1896年10月4日：Rizal is imprisoned in Montjuich by order of Capt. Gen. Despujo
1896年10月6日：Rizal returns to Manila as a prisoner
1896年10月31日：A new group of the Katipunan is formed in Cavite headed by Emilio Aguinaldo

1896年10月31日：Emilio Aguinaldo issues his manifestos in Kawit, Cavite, declaring the aim of the revolution and announcing the formation of a central revolutionary committee for the municipal government.
1896年11月11日：Filipino forces, under Emilio Aguinaldo, defeat the Spaniards in a battle in Kawit, Cavite.
1896年11月13日：Rizal arrives in Manila and is incarcerated in Fort Santiago
1896年11月20日：Rizal is interrogated for charges against the Spanish Colonial Government
1896年12月13日：Camilo Polavieja becomes acting Governor-General (1896–1897)
1896年12月30日：Rizal is executed at Bagumbayan.
1897年1月1日：Some 3,000 Filipino fighters die in an attack by the Spanish soldiers against revolutionaries under Gen. Eusebio Roque in Pandi, Bulacan.
1897年1月4日：Eleven of the 15 Filipinos of Bicol were executed at the Luneta in Manila
1897年1月11日：Thirteen La Liga Filipina members are executed at Luneta, Manila.
1897年2月6日：Katipunan leader Roman Basa and eight members are executed in Bagumbayan.
1897年2月17日：Battle of Zapote Bridge

1897年3月22日：The Katipunan creates a revolutionary government and holds its election, during Tejeros Convention in Cavite, said to be the first election ever held in country's electoral history. Emilio Aguinaldo is elected as president.
1897年3月23日：Nineteen Filipinos of Kalibo, Aklan were executed
1897年4月15日：José de Lachambre becomes acting Governor-General (1897)
1897年4月18日：Dissenters from the Tejeros Convention election results concluded the Naic Military Agreement
1897年4月23日：Fernando Primo de Rivera appointed Governor-General (1897–1898)
1897年4月29日：Katipuneros arrest Andres Bonifacio and his brothers Procopio and Ciriaco on orders of Aguinaldo with sedition and treason before a military court of the Katipunan.
1897年5月8日：The Katipunan convicts and sentences Bonifacio brothers to death
1897年5月10日：Andres Bonifacio and his brothers are executed at Mt. Buntis, Maragondon, Cavite.
1897年5月31日：Aguinaldo establishes a Philippine republican government in Biak-na-Bato, San Miguel, Bulacan.
1897年8月10日：Aguinaldo begins negotiating with the Spaniards colonial government in Manila with Pedro Paterno as representative.
1897年8月15日：A 7.9 intensity estimated earthquake hits Luzon's northwest coast
1897年11月1日：Constitution of Biak-na-Bato is promulgated by the revolutionaries, including Aguinaldo.
1897年12月14日：Pact of Biak-na-Bato, between Filipinos (Aguinaldo) and Spaniards (Gov. Primo de Rivera), signed.
1897年12月27日：Aguinaldo is self-exiled to Hong Kong following the Pact of Biak-na-Bato
1898年：The only issue of Katipunan#Kalayaan, the official organ of the Katipunan, is published.
1898年：The American Soldier and The Soldier's Letter are published; first English language newspapers.
1898年：Official Gazette is established by the civil government.
1898年2月8日：The Katipunan is revived by Emilio Jacinto and Feliciano Jocson
1898年3月25日：A revolutionary government in Candon, Ilocos Sur is established by Don Isabelo Abaya as he starts Cry of Candon.
1898年4月3日：Pantaleon Villegas (Leon Kilat) leads a battle against Spanish forces in present-day Cebu City; said to be the start of the revolution in Cebu province.
1898年4月11日：Basilio Augustín appointed Governor-General (1898)
1898年4月14日：Local Katipunan members under Ildefonso Moreno conduct an uprising against Spanish colonizers in Daet town.
1898年4月17日：A provisional government is established by Gen. Francisco Macabulos, with its own constitution signed; lasts about a month.
1898年4月24日：Aguinaldo meets American Consul, Mr. Pratt, at Singapore.
1898年4月26日：Aguinaldo goes to Hong Kong.
1898年4月26日：The US declares war on Spain.
1898年5月1日：Commodore George Dewey attacks Manila
1898年5月19日：Aguinaldo and his companions return to Cavite Province from exile in Hong Kong.
1898年5月24日：Aguinaldo proclaims a dictatorial government and issues two decrees which show his trust and reliance in US protection
1898年5月28日：Filipino revolutionaries defeat the Spanish forces in a battle in Alapan, Imus, Cavite, with the first unfurling of the Philippine flag.
1898年6月12日：Philippine Independence from Spain is declared by Filipino revolutionaries, led by Pres. Aguinaldo, in Kawit, Cavite.
1898年6月23日：Aguinaldo changes the dictatorial government to revolutionary government.
1898年6月27日：Over 50 Spanish soldiers begin to hide themselves at a church in Baler town, in what would be their last stand in the country against the revolutionaries.
1898年7月15日：Aguinaldo creates a cabinet
1898年7月15日：The Malolos Congress in established
1898年7月17日：US reinforcements and troops arrive in the Philippines.
1898年7月22日：Pangasinan Province is liberated from the Spanish.
1898年7月24日：Fermín Jáudenes becomes acting Governor-General (1898)
1898年8月13日：Francisco Rizzo becomes acting Governor-General (1898)
1898年8月13日：Wesley Merritt appointed Military Governor (1898)
1898年8月14日：The Spanish surrender to the U.S., which took Manila.
1898年8月22日：Revolutionary government headquarters is transferred from Bacoor, Cavite to Malolos, Bulacan through a decree issued by Pres. Aguinaldo.
1898年8月29日：Elwell S. Otis appointed Military Governor (1898–1900)
1898年9月：Diego de los Ríos becomes acting Governor-General (1898)
1898年9月15日：Delegates of what would be known as the Malolos Congress convene at Barasoain Church in Malolos, Bulacan to draft a Constitution for the country.
1898年9月29日：The Malolos Congress meets and elects its officers; ratifies the Declaration of Independence proclaimed on June.
1898年9月29日：El Horado de la Revolucion, the official publication of the Malolos Congress, publishes its first issue.
1898年10月11日：The Manila Times is founded by Thomas Cowan and publishes its first issue; the country's oldest running broadsheet; its first incarnation lasted 32 years.
1898年10月15日：The American is published by Franklyn Brooks; second English language daily paper.
1898年10月19日：Universidad Literaria de Filipinas is established in Malolos, Bulacan through a presidential decree.
1898年10月24日：Enrique Mendiola founds a college school for boys, the Burgos Institute, in Malolos, Bulacan.
1898年10月25日：Establishment of Academia Militar, country's first military training school that lasted for less than a year.
1898年11月5日：A revolutionary movement under Gen. Aniceto Lacson and Gen. Juan Araneta proclaims the Republic of Negros in Bago town.
1898年11月7日：Revolutionary forces promulgates a constitution for the Republic of Negros and declare Gen. Lacson as president.

1898年11月17日：Provisional revolutionary government of the Visayas is organized in Santa Barbara town upon liberation of the majority of Iloilo province, with Roque Lopez elected president; Cry of Santa Barbara occurs.
1898年11月22日：Town of San Jose in Antique is captured from Spanish forces by revolutionaries under Leandro Fullon, who established a provincial government.
1898年11月29日：Malolos Congress approves its draft Constitution.
1898年12月10日：Spain and the U.S. sign the Treaty of Paris. Article III provides for the cession of the Philippines to the U.S. by Spain and the payment of 20 million dollars to Spain by the US.
1898年12月21日：US president McKinley issues the Benevolent Assimilation Proclamation
1898年12月23日：Pres. Aguinaldo signs the Malolos Constitution.
1898年12月24日：Gov. Gen. de los Rios surrenders the town of Iloilo to revolutionary forces under Gen. Martin Delgado.
1899年1月20日：U.S. Pres. McKinley appoints the first Philippine Commission, known as the Schurman Commission
1899年1月21日：The Malolos Constitution is promulgated by Aguinaldo.

1899年1月23日：The Malolos Republic (First Republic) government, Asia's first republic, is inaugurated at Barasoain Church in Malolos, Bulacan; Emilio Aguinaldo takes his oath of office as the first president of the Philippines.
links: List of presidents of the Philippines

items.text: 1899年2月4日：Hostilities break out between the Filipino and U.S. forces.
1899年2月6日：The US Senate ratifies the Treaty of Paris with Spain
1899年3月3日：La Justicia, Cebu province's first Filipino-owned newspaper, publishes its first issue.
1899年3月4日：The Schurman Commission arrives in Manila
1899年4月23日：Filipino forces under Gen. Gregorio del Pilar defeated the Americans in an encounter in Quingua (now Plaridel), Bulacan.
1899年5月6日：Aguinaldo creates a new cabinet
1899年5月6日：The country's first municipal election is held in Baliuag, Bulacan.
1899年5月12日：Filipino troops, led by Emilio Aguinaldo, recapture the Calumpit and Baliwag towns from the Americans.
1899年5月18日：General Vicente Alvarez establishes the Republic of Zamboanga.
1899年5月20日：Aguinaldo's moves face opposition from Apolinario Mabini and Antonio Luna
1899年6月2日：Siege of Baler ends after 11 months, with 35 surviving Spanish soldiers surrendered.
1899年6月5日：Antonio Luna killed
1899年10月11日：Pres. Aguinaldo moves the seat of government from San Isidro, Nueva Ecija to Tarlac Province.
1899年12月2日：Gregorio Del Pilar killed in the Battle of Tirad Pass.
1899年12月4日：An American base is attacked by the Filipinos in Vigan, Ilocos Sur.
1890年－1899年：Dr. Jose Rizal.
1890年－1899年：Marcelo H. del Pilar, one of the leaders of the Propaganda Movement in Spain.
1890年－1899年：The single known extant photograph of Andres Bonifacio, the founder of Katipunan and leader of the Philippine Revolution.
1890年－1899年：General Emilio Aguinaldo, First president of the Philippines.
1890年－1899年：The original front cover of Noli Me Tángere.
1890年－1899年：The Malolos Congress.

1890年－1899年：The Three Stars and a Sun design was formally unfurled during the Proclamation of Philippine Independence and the flag of the First Philippine Republic, on June 12, 1898, by President Aguinaldo.
1890年－1899年：Marching Filipino soldiers during the inauguration of the First Philippine Republic in Malolos on January 23, 1899.
1890年－1899年：The soldiers of Philippine Revolutionary Army.
1890年－1899年：Antonio Luna, Regarded as one of the fiercest generals of his time, he succeeded Artemio Ricarte as Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces of the Philippines.
1890年－1899年：General Gregorio del Pilar and his troops in Pampanga, around 1898 (Philippine–American War).
1900年1月21日：The Schurman Commission returns to the U.S.
1900年2月2日：Manila Bulletin is founded as a shipping journal by Carson Taylor, an American, and publishes its first issue.
1900年3月16日：U.S. Pres. McKinley appoints the second Philippine Commission, known as the Taft Commission
1900年3月：American forces capture Bohol.
1900年4月：Battle of Cagayan de Misamis
1900年4月：Siege of Catubig
1900年5月5日：Arthur MacArthur, Jr appointed Military Governor (1900–1901)
1900年5月：Battle of Agusan Hill
1900年6月：Battle of Makahambus Hill
1900年6月3日：The Taft Commission arrives in Manila
1900年7月31日：Filipino revolutionaries defeat American troops in a battle in Boac, Marinduque, said to be the first recorded armed encounter between two forces.
1900年8月20日：Pres. Aguinaldo orders the start of attack against American forces in northern Luzon.
1900年9月：Battle of Pulang Lupa
1900年9月：Battle of Mabitac
1900年12月23日：Partido Liberal established
1901年3月2日：The Army Appropriation Act, also known as the Spooner Amendment, is passed by the US Senate.
1901年3月23日：Pres. Aguinaldo is captured by US authorities in Palanan town.
1901年4月1日：Aguinaldo takes an oath of allegiance to the US.
1901年4月15日：Gov. Taft inaugurates the provincial government of Capiz. (Phil. Commission Act No. 115)
1901年6月11日：Establishment of Rizal Province by the second Philippine Commission, upon unification of then provinces of Manila and Morong. (Act No. 137)
1901年6月17日：El Colegio de San Beda established
1901年7月1日：End of insurrection declared
1901年7月4日：Adna Chaffee appointed as the last US Military Governor (1901–1902)
1901年7月4日：A civil government is established in the Philippines with William Howard Taft as the first Civil Governor (1901–1904)
1901年7月18日：The US organizes the Philippine Constabulary
1901年8月28日：Silliman Institute, later known as Silliman University, is established as the first American university in the Philippines.
1901年9月：The first Filipino members of the second Philippine Commission are appointed
1901年9月28日：Guerillas, headed by the Filipino Captain Eugenio Daza, attack the U.S. military barracks in Balangiga, Samar; Americans' "worst single defeat."
1901年9月29日：Balangiga massacre occurs
1901年10月20日：A U.S. Marine battalion arrives on Samar to conduct the March across Samar operation
1901年10月29日：The president of the United States creates the position of provincial vice governor in the country, under the Spooner Amendment.
1901年11月4日：The Philippine Commission enacts the Sedition Act
1901年12月14日：An earthquake estimated of magnitude 7.8 shakes Lucena City.
1902年1月：The first labor union of The Country, Union de Litografose Impresores de Filipinas, is organized.
1902年1月21日：The Philippine Commission calls for the organization of Public Schools in the Philippines.
1902年3月30日：The US Marines leave Balangiga
1902年4月16日：General Miguel Malvar surrenders to the US forces
1902年5月：Governor Taft negotiates with Pope Leo XIII the sale of the friar lands in the Philippines
1902年5月2日：Macario Sakay establishes a second Tagalog Republic.
1902年6月：Mindoro and Lubang islands are annexed to Marinduque province.
1902年7月1日：The Philippine Organic Act was enacted.
1902年7月1日：Cooper Act is passed by the US Senate. Philippine Assembly is established
1902年7月4日：Americans proclaim the end of the Philippine–American War, however fighting continues
1902年8月3日：The foundation of Iglesia Filipina Independiente separated from Roman Catholic Church was proclaimed by the Union Obrera Democratica with Gregorio Aglipay as the 1st Obispo Maximo
1902年9月17日：Pope Leo XIII formally bestows a Pontifical title on the University of Santo Tomas
1902年11月10日：Marinduque province is annexed to Tayabas province (now Quezon). (Act No. 499)
1902年11月12日：Bandolerism Act passed by the Philippine Commission. All armed resistance against US rule are considered banditry
1903年：Governor Taft enunciates the policy of The Philippines for the Filipinos
1903年5月1日：Thousands of members of the Union Obrera Democratica Filipina, led by Dominador Gomez, stage a massive rally aiming for workers' rights as well as a public holiday for May 1.
1903年6月1日：Establishment of the Moro Province, consisting of the districts of Jolo, Lanao, Cotabato, Davao and Zamboanga.
1904年2月1日：Luke Edward Wright appointed as Civil Governor (1904–1905)

1904年10月19日：The Manila Business School was founded and started its operation (later as the Philippine School of Commerce, 1908, then as the Philippine College of Commerce, 1952, and now the Polytechnic University of the Philippines).
1904年11月16日：Iwahig Prison and Penal Farm is established in Palawan, country's oldest and largest open prison.
1905年11月3日：Henry Clay Ide appointed as Civil Governor (1905–1906)
1906年5月27日：Establishment of Culion Leper Colony in Culion Island in Palawan.
1906年9月20日：James Francis Smith appointed as Civil Governor (1906–1909)
1906年12月3日：St. Scholastica's College in Manila is established by the Missionary Benedictine Sisters of Tutzing.
1907年6月3日：Centro Escolar University established as Centro Escolar de Señoritas.
1907年6月30日：First congressional elections held
1907年9月13日：Macario Sakay is executed by hanging, ending his Tagalog Republic.
1907年10月7日：The Pontifical Coronation of Our Lady of La Naval de Manila
1907年10月10日：A law (Act No. 1761) that restricts and regulates the use and sale of dangerous drugs is signed.
1908年6月18日：The University of the Philippines is established in Manila.
1908年8月29日：Philippines Free Press is founded by Judge W.A. Kincaid and publishes its first issue in magazine format.
1909年3月6日：Present-day University of the Philippines Los Baños in Laguna is established, first autonomous UP campus.
links: University of the Philippines Los Baños

items.text: 1900年－1909年：Macario Sakay, the unofficial President of the Tagalog Republic.
1900年－1909年：First Philippine Assembly.
1911年1月27日：Mt Taal erupts, and kills 1,334 people
1911年6月16日：De La Salle University-Manila is founded as De La Salle College by the Brothers of Christian Schools.
1912年：A silent movie about Jose Rizal is the first Filipino movie introduced in the Philippines.
1913年6月：Battle of Bud Bagsak
1913年9月1日：Newton W. Gilbert appointed as acting Civil Governor (1913)
1913年10月6日：Francis Burton Harrison appointed as Civil Governor (1913–1921)
1914年7月27日：Iglesia ni Cristo (largest independent church in Asia) is registered to the government.
1916年10月16日：The Jones Act is passed establishing an all-Filipino legislature
1916年10月16日：Manuel Quezon elected Senate President while Sergio Osmeña is elected as House Speaker of the House of Representatives of the Commonwealth of the Philippines
1917年1月11日：The first cabinet of Filipinos under the US regime is organized.
1917年3月9日：Provincehood of Abra (Act No. 2683)

1917年3月10日：An Act Amending the Administrative Code (Act No. 2711) reorganizes the territories in the Philippines, consisting of: Forty-two organized provinces: Abra, Albay, Antique, Bataan, Batanes, Batangas, Bohol, Bulacan, Cagayan, Camarines Norte, Camarines Sur, Capiz, Cavite, Cebu, Ilocos Norte, Ilocos Sur, Iloilo, Isabela, Laguna, La Union, Leyte, Marinduque, Masbate, Mindoro, Oriental Misamis, Occidental Misamis, Mountain Province, Nueva Ecija, Nueva Vizcaya, Occidental Negros, Oriental Negros, Pangasinan, Pampanga, Palawan, Rizal, Romblon, Samar, Sorsogon, Surigao, Tarlac, Tayabas and Zambales. Provinces under Department of Mindanao and Sulu: Agusan, Bukidnon, Cotabato, Davao, Lanao, Sulu, and Zamboanga. City of Manila, with separate jurisdiction.
1919年9月19日：The silent film Dalagang Bukid by José Nepomuceno was released, the first film to be produced locally.
1920年：Mountain Province is established by American colonial government.
1920年2月21日：Provincehood of Marinduque (Act No. 2880), separating from Tayabas.
1920年8月：Philippines Herald is established by Manuel L. Quezon and former Manila Times journalists; first pro-Filipino nationalist newspaper.
1920年12月15日：Provincehood of Masbate (Act No. 2934), former sub-province independent from Sorsogon.
1921年3月5日：Charles Yeater appointed as acting Civil Governor (1921)
1921年10月14日：Leonard Wood appointed as Civil Governor (1921–1927)
1922年：Mrs. Redgrave pioneers the radio broadcasting from Nichols Field, only for a test broadcast.
1922年6月：Henry Hermann, owner of an electrical supply company, begins operating three radio stations in Manila and Pasay, also for their test broadcasts.

1924年10月4日：Radio Corporation of the Philippines (RCP) acquires radio station KZKZ, which begins its broadcast by Hermann earlier that year, replacing experimental stations; broadcast ceased in 1925 upon merger of Far Eastern Radio with RCP.
1927年8月7日：Eugene Allen Gilmore appointed as acting Civil Governor (1927)
1927年12月27日：Henry L. Stimson appointed as Civil Governor (1927–1929)

1929年：RCP operates its first radio station outside Manila, also first provincial station in the country, with KZRC (Radio Cebu) in Cebu, experimental station originally a relay station of KZRM in Manila.
1929年2月23日：Eugene Allen Gilmore appointed as acting Civil Governor (1929)
1929年7月8日：Dwight F. Davis appointed as Civil Governor (1929–1932)
1929年11月2日：Old Misamis is divided into the new provinces of Misamis Occidental and Misamis Oriental. (Act No. 3537; amended by Act No. 3777 on November 28, 1930).
1930年11月7日：Partido Komunista ng Pilipinas (PKP, Communist Party of the Philippines) is formally established by Crisanto Evangelista at Tondo, Manila.
1932年1月9日：George C. Butte appointed as acting Civil Governor (1932)
1932年1月21日：Davao Prison and Penal Farm in present-day Davao del Norte is established (Act No. 3732); country's first penal settlement.
1932年2月29日：Theodore Roosevelt Jr. appointed as Civil Governor (1932–1933)
1932年10月26日：The Communist Party of the Philippines is declared illegal by the Supreme Court
1933年7月15日：Frank Murphy appointed as the last Civil Governor of the Philippines (1933–1935)
1933年10月29日：Partido Sakdal formed.
1933年12月7日：Governor-General Frank Murphy granted the Right of Suffrage to the Filipino women.
1934年3月24日：The Tydings-McDuffie Law, known as the Philippine Independence Law, is approved by U.S. President Roosevelt.
1934年5月7日：A pearl, which would be one of the world's largest, is found in Palawan.
1934年7月10日：202 delegates are elected to the Constitutional Convention in accordance with the Tydings-McDuffie Act
1934年7月30日：The Philippine Constitutional Convention is inaugurated
1934年11月3日：Bannawag, Ilocos region's weekly vernacular magazine, established.
1935年2月8日：The Constitutional Convention creates a new constitution
1935年2月15日：The Philippine Constitution is signed
1935年5月2日：Sakdalista uprising against the Philippine Constabulary fails with at least 60 members dead.
1935年5月14日：The Philippine electorate ratifies the Constitution in a referendum
1935年9月17日：Manuel Quezon elected president in the first Philippine presidential elections
1935年11月15日：The Philippine Commonwealth is inaugurated
1935年11月15日：The Office of Civil Governor is abolished
1935年12月21日：The National Defense Act of 1935 that created the Armed Forces of the Philippines was signed.
1936年3月25日：President Manuel L. Quezon issued Executive Order No. 23 which provided for the technical description and specifications of the Philippine national flag.
1936年10月31日：The Boy Scouts of the Philippines was established.
1937年：The 33rd International Eucharistic Congress was held in Rizal Park, Manila; first in Asia.
1937年11月9日：The Institute of National Language recommends Tagalog as the basis of the country's national language.
1939年7月15日：KZRH, established by H. E. Heacock Company under Samuel Caches, goes on air; country's oldest existing radio station, renamed PIAM during the Japanese era and now DZRH.
1941年1月1日：Provincehood of Romblon (Commonwealth Act No. 38)
1941年3月15日：Philippine Airlines starts operations with its maiden flight between Makati and Baguio cities.
1941年11月11日：Manuel Quezon re-elected as President
1941年12月8日：Start of the Japanese invasion of the Philippines following Pearl Harbor attack.
1941年12月10日：Japanese planes attack Sangley Point in Cavite.
1941年12月17日：Wenceslao Vinzons organizes a citizen's army to fight Japanese forces in Camarines Norte.
1941年12月20日：President Quezon, his family and the war cabinet move to Corregidor Island
1941年12月26日：General MacArthur declares Manila an open city
1941年12月28日：Filipino and US armies retreat to Bataan
1941年12月30日：Pres. Quezon and Vice Pres. Osmeña take their oath of office for their second term in Corregidor Island, Cavite.
links: Second inauguration of Manuel L. Quezon

items.text: 1942年1月2日：Japanese troops enters Manila
1942年1月3日：Masaharu Homma appointed as Japanese Military Governor (1942)
1942年1月3日：General Masaharu Homma declares the end of American Rule in the Philippines
1942年1月3日：Martial Law declared
1942年1月13日：All forms of opposition against the Japanese forces declared subject to death penalty
1942年1月23日：An executive committee, composed of Filipinos, is formed by General Homma as a conduit of the military administration's policies and requirements.
1942年2月17日：The Japanese Military Government issues an order adopting the Japanese educational system in The Country
1942年2月20日：President Quezon and the war cabinet leave for the US
1942年3月11日：General MacArthur leaves for Australia to take command of the South Western Pacific Area
1942年3月13日：The Commonwealth government is moved to the US
1942年3月25日：Hukbong Bayan Laban sa Hapon (Hukbalahap, People's Anti-Japanese Army) is organized in Cabiao, Nueva Ecija.
1942年4月：A pro-US resistance movement is organized, mainly to provide data to the US on enemy positions
1942年4月9日：Battle of Bataan: Bataan, under US commander Gen. Edward King, is the last province that surrenders to the Japanese armies.
1942年5月6日：Corregidor Island falls to Japanese forces.
1942年6月8日：Shizuichi Tanaka appointed as Japanese Military Governor (1942–1943)
1942年6月14日：The Commonwealth of the Philippines becomes a member of the United Nations
1942年12月30日：The Kalibapi is organized by the Japanese
1943年5月28日：Shigenori Kuroda appointed as Japanese Military Governor (1943–1942)
1943年6月20日：Japanese Premier Hideki Tojo nominates an all Filipino 20 member Preparatory Commission for Philippine Independence
1943年9月4日：The Philippine Preparatory Commission for Independence drafts a new Constitution which provides for a unicameral national assembly
1943年9月20日：The 108 delegates to the National Assembly are chosen by the members of the Preparatory Commission for Philippine Independence.
1943年9月：Jose P. Laurel elected President of the Philippines by the National Assembly
1943年10月14日：The puppet government is inaugurated. Laurel takes his oath of office
1943年11月：The Philippine economy collapses, the shortage of rice becomes serious.
1943年11月10日：U.S. Congress approves a resolution allowing Pres. Quezon to serve beyond the designated period, nine days after his term expires.
1944年5月：The puppet government inaugurates the Green Revolution Movement.
1944年8月1日：Death of Pres. Quezon; Vice Pres. Sergio Osmena then assumes the Office of the President of the Commonwealth of the Philippines.
1944年9月21日：US forces raids Manila
1944年9月26日：Tomoyuki Yamashita appointed as Japanese Military Governor (1944–1945)
1944年10月20日：Gen. MacArthur lands in Palo, Leyte, accompanied by Pres. Osmeña and U.S. troops.
1944年10月23日：Gen. Douglas MacArthur reestablishes the Commonwealth government of the Philippines in Tacloban, Leyte, with Sergio Osmeña as its president.
1944年10月24日：Battle of Leyte Gulf: Battle of Sibuyan Sea
1944年12月8日：Pro-Japanese Philippine generals Pio Duran and Benigno Ramos organize the Makapilis
1945年1月9日：U.S. troops led by Gen. MacArthur land on the shores of Pangasinan via Lingayen Gulf in an attempt to liberate the country from the Japanese.
1945年1月30日：Raid at Cabanatuan: 121 American soldiers and 800 Filipino guerrillas free 813 American Prisoners of war from the Japanese-held camp in the city of Cabanatuan in the Philippines.
1945年：Battle of Bataan (1945)
1945年：Battle of Baguio
1945年2月：Raid at Los Baños
1945年2月4日：US troops enter Manila
1945年2月22日：Hukbalahap troop leaders arrested by the US forces
1945年2月24日：The Battle of Manila ends. The Japanese surrender to the combined US and Filipino troops
1945年2月27日：MacArthur hands over Malacanang Palace to Osmena.
1945年：Battle for Cebu City
1945年：Battle of the Visayas
1945年3月：Corregidor Island is reoccupied by the Americans.
1945年3月3日：Battle of Manila (1945): The US and Filipino troops recaptured Manila.
1945年3月18日：Town of Panay in Capiz and the province of Romblon are liberated from the Japanese forces.
1945年3月19日：Filipino and American forces defeat the Japanese in a battle occurred in Bacsil Ridge in San Fernando, La Union.
1945年3月22日：The families of pro-Japanese President Laurel and Speaker Aquino leave the country for Japan to seek refuge
1945年3月24日：Town of San Fernando in La Union is liberated from the Japanese forces.
1945年4月22日：Palawan is liberated from Japanese invaders.
1945年4月27日：Baguio is liberated from Japanese forces.
1945年：Filipino and U.S. forces defeat the Japanese in a battle occurred in Balete Pass (now Dalton Pass) in Santa Fe, Nueva Vizcaya.
1945年6月5日：The Congress elected in 1941 convenes for the first time
1945年6月14日：Filipino soldiers, with the Americans, defeat the Japanese under Gen. Tomoyuki Yamashita in a battle in Tagudin, Ilocos Sur; considered as their greatest victory in World War II.
1945年7月5日：General MacArthur announces the liberation of the Philippines
1945年8月15日：The Empire of Japan accepts defeat
1945年8月17日：Pres. Laurel issues an Executive Proclamation putting an end to the Second Philippine Republic, thus ending to his term as President of the Philippines.

1945年9月2日：The final official Japanese Instrument of Surrender is accepted by the Supreme Allied Commander, General Douglas MacArthur, and Fleet Admiral Chester W. Nimitz for the United States, and delegates from Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, China, and others from a Japanese delegation led by Mamoru Shigemitsu, on board the American battleship USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay.
1945年9月2日：Japanese general Tomoyuki Yamashita surrenders to Filipino and American forces at Kiangan, Ifugao.
1945年9月12日：Jose P. Laurel is arrested by the US army
1945年9月26日：Provincehood of Catanduanes (Commonwealth Act No. 687), former sub-province independent from Albay.
1945年10月24日：The United Nations is founded by ratification of its Charter, by 29 nations.
1945年12月：Manuel Roxas separates from the Nacionalista Party of Sergio Osmena Sr and joins the Liberal Party
1946年2月23日：Tomoyuki Yamashita is executed by hanging at Los Baños, Laguna prison camp for the war crimes.
1946年4月23日：Manuel Roxas wins in the last presidential election under the Commonwealth

1946年4月：U.S. Pres. Harry Truman signs into law the Philippine Trade Act (Bell Trade Act) of 1946, continuing free trade relations between the U.S. and the Philippines, and imposing tariffs; Tydings Rehabilitation Act passed.
1946年6月13日：Bolinao Electronics Corporation (BEC) is established by James Lindenberg; later Alto Broadcasting System (ABS) and the forerunner of ABS–CBN.
1946年7月：Hukbong Mapaglaya ng Bayan (HMB) is organized in Candaba, Pampanga.
1946年7月：Congress votes to accept the Bell Trade Act.
1946年7月4日：The United States recognizes the Independence of the Republic of the Philippines.
1946年7月4日：Manuel Roxas becomes the first president of the Third Republic.
1946年9月：Congress passes an amendment that revises Constitution, allowing the Americans parity rights.
1946年9月30日：The Amended Tenancy Act is promulgated.
1947年1月：Rehabilitation Finance Corporation (RFC), later Development Bank of the Philippines, begins its operations.
1947年1月28日：President Roxas issues an amnesty proclamation to collaborators
1947年3月：An amendment in the 1935 Constitution granting parity rights to the Americans is ratified in a plebiscite.
1947年3月：The Military Assistance Act is signed by U.S. Ambassador Paul McNutt and Pres. Roxas.
1947年3月6日：HUKBALAHAP declared illegal
1947年3月14日：The Treaty of General Relations between Philippines and United States, the Military Bases Agreement, is signed; would be effective until 1991.
1947年9月8日：The Philippine representative to the Far Eastern Commission, Carlos P. Romulo, signs the Japanese Peace Treaty
1947年10月12日：Corregidor Island in Cavite is turned over to the Philippines.
1947年10月16日：Turtle Islands, now in Tawi-Tawi, is placed under country's jurisdiction.
1947年11月：First post-war elections held for local officials and senators.
1948年1月：Pres. Roxas issues a general pardon for all those with collaboration cases and pending cases in the People's Court.
1948年3月：Hukbong Mapagpalaya ng Bayan and Pambansang Kaisahan ng mga Magbubukid (PKM) are declared illegal organizations by Pres. Roxas.
1948年4月15日：Death of Pres. Roxas; Vice Pres. Elpidio Quirino assumes the Office of President.
1948年6月：Pres. Quirino issues an amnesty proclamation given to the surrendered members of Hukbalahap and PKM.
1948年7月：Newly formed Quezon City is declared capital of the Philippines by Pres. Quirino. (Republic Act No. 333)
1948年8月：Huk leaders under Luis Taruc go underground to continue the resistance against the government following failed truce negotiations.

1948年10月1日：Pres. Quirino releases the result of the country's first official postwar census, taken and compiled by the Bureau of the Census and Statistics, showing the population after its independence from the U.S. at 19.2 million.
1948年11月：PKP renews armed struggle following failed truce negotiations with the government.
1948年12月：Quirino administration imposes import control, a law that would be effective on the first day of 1949.
1949年1月：Establishment and inauguration of Central Bank of the Philippines.

1949年4月28日：Former First Lady Aurora Aragon–Quezon (widow of Pres. Manuel Quezon), with her eldest daughter, and Quezon City Mayor Ponciano Bernardo, are among those killed in an ambush allegedly by the Hukbalahap in Bongabon, Nueva Ecija.
1949年11月：Pres. Quirino reelected.
1949年11月：A month-long rebellion occurred in Batangas.
1940年－1949年：Manuel L. Quezon was the First President of Commonwealth of the Philippines, the father of Philippine Language.
1940年－1949年：Masaharu Homma
1940年－1949年：The Philippine Constabulary
1950年2月：UST pioneers the television broadcast, only for experimental purposes.
1950年6月：The Philippines joins the Korean War, sending over 7,000 troops under the United Nations command.
1950年6月15日：Old Mindoro is divided into the new provinces of Mindoro Occidental and Mindoro Oriental. (Republic Act No. 505)
1950年10月：Twenty-three high-ranking PKP and Huk Politburo members are captured in a series of raids led by Secy. Magsaysay in Manila.
1950年10月：Pres. Quirino suspends the privilege of writ of habeas corpus regarding detention of suspected communists.
1951年3月6日：Fort Santiago was declared a National Shrine.
1951年5月：Suspected PKP members are penalized by the Court of First Instance, with six given death sentences and nine given life sentences.
1951年：Armed Forces of the Philippines launches offensives against Huks in Laguna and Pampanga.
1951年8月：National Movement for Free Elections (NAMFREL) is established
links: National Citizens' Movement for Free Elections

items.text: 1951年8月30日：The Mutual Defense Treaty between Philippines and United States was signed.

1951年10月8日：Nicasio "Asiong" Salonga, branded as Tondo's public enemy No. 1 and the kingpin of Manila, was shot and killed by Ernesto Reyes, a henchman of his rival and also notorious gang leader Carlos "Totoy Golem" Capistrano.
1952年：Armed Forces launches Operation Four Roses in Nueva Ecija in the search for Huk strongholds in Sierra Madre mountains.
1952年6月6日：Old Zamboanga is divided into the new provinces of Zamboanga del Norte and Zamboanga del Sur. (Republic Act No. 711)
1953年6月：Magna Carta for Labor is signed into law. (Republic Act No. 875)
1953年10月23日：DZAQ-TV Channel 3, now Channel 2, of ABS, then owned by presidential brother Antonio Quirino, airs its country's first official television broadcast from Manila.
1953年11月10日：Ramon Magsaysay is elected President of the Republic of the Philippines
1954年：Social Security Act is passed in Congress.
1954年5月：Huk Supremo Luis Taruc surrenders to Pres. Magsaysay, prompting an end of the eight-year Huk rebellion.
1954年5月22日：Cityhood of Trece Martires, Cavite (Republic Act No. 981)
1954年7月21日：The Southeast Asia Collective Defense Treaty is signed in Manila, creating the South East Asian Treaty Organization (SEATO)
1954年8月：Agricultural Tenancy Act of 1954 passed.
1954年9月：Southeast Asian Treaty Organization (SEATO) is established in Manila, with the Philippines as one of its eight members.

1954年12月15日：Laurel-Langley Agreement: An agreement between the Philippines and the U.S., regarding provisions of the Philippine Trade Act of 1946, is signed by Sen. Jose P. Laurel and Secy. James M. Langley.
1955年9月：Laurel-Langley Agreement is ratified by the U.S. and Philippine governments, to be effective on the first day of 1956.
1956年4月25日：Provincehood of Aklan (Republic Act No. 1414), separating from Capiz.
1956年5月：Rizal Bill is passed into law amid opposition from Catholic Church.
1957年2月24日：ABS is acquired by Eugenio Lopez Sr. of CBN, of which they later merged into ABS–CBN with two television stations later being operated.
1957年3月17日：Death of Pres. Magsaysay, one among the 25 killed in a plane crash in Cebu; Vice-Pres. Carlos P. Garcia assumes the presidency.
1957年6月：Anti-Subversion Act passed. (Republic Act No. 1700)
1957年7月：U.S. Congress ratifies a law (Republic Act No. 85-81) granting the Philippines possession of the documents regarding the revolution.
1957年11月14日：Carlos P. Garcia elected President of the Republic of the Philippines
1958年3月22日：Xavier University-Ateneo de Cagayan is elevated by the Department of Education to university rank, becoming the Mindanao's first private and Catholic university.
1958年8月28日："Filipino First" policy is officially promulgated by the National Economic Council (Resolution No. 204).
1959年5月22日：Old Lanao is divided into the new provinces of Lanao del Norte and Lanao del Sur. (Republic Act No. 2228); inaugurated, July 4.
1959年5月22日：RA 2227 created the province of Southern Leyte, separating from Leyte.
1959年7月18日：10th World Scout Jamboree is held at Mt. Makiling in Los Baños, Laguna.

1959年：An agreement between Foreign Affairs Secy. Felixberto Serrano and Amb. Charles Bohlen is signed, following series of conferences, in which duration of lease of the American military bases is reduced from 99 to 25 years.
1959年10月：U.S. authorities turns over Olongapo City to the Philippine government.
1950年－1959年：Ramon Magsaysay, the Man of Mass.
1960年：International Rice Research Institute is established in Los Baños, Laguna.
1960年3月：Archbishop Rufino Santos is the first Filipino to achieve the rank of Cardinal.
1960年6月19日：Republic Act No. 2786 divided old Surigao into the new provinces of Surigao del Norte and Surigao del Sur.
1961年1月18日：Baguio experiences cold at 6.3-degree Celsius, the country's lowest temperature ever recorded.
1961年11月7日：Diosdado Macapagal elected President of the Republic of the Philippines.
1962年1月：Philippine Constabulary Rangers conduct a siege of the Central Bank building to oust its governor, Dominador Aytona, due to "midnight appointments" of his own.
1962年1月：Pres. Macapagal lifts exchange and import controls in his campaign for free enterprise.
1962年5月12日：Commemoration of Independence Day is officially changed by Pres. Macapagal, from July 4 to June 12 (Proclamation No. 28); to be first celebrated on that day of that same year.
1962年6月22日：Pres. Macapagal's government, with the United Kingdom, files a communication regarding country's claim of North Borneo (Sabah), now in Malaysia.
1962年9月：Electrification Administration Act (Republic Act No. 2717) is implemented through an executive order issued by Pres. Macapagal.
1963年7月28日：Twenty-four members of the Philippine contingent for the 11th World Scout Jamboree in Greece are among the 60 deaths in a plane crash into the Indian Ocean.
1963年7月：Pres. Macapagal, Sukarno (Indonesia), and Tungku Abdul Rahman (Federation of Malaya) sign the Manila Accord, an agreement for Maphilindo.
1963年8月8日：Agricultural Land Reform Code (Republic Act No. 3844) is signed into law by Pres. Macapagal.
1964年5月：Partido Komunista ng Pilipinas secretary-general Jesus Lava is captured in Sampaloc, Manila.
1964年8月：Congress ratifies an executive order issued by Pres. Macapagal that changes the date of celebration of the nation's Independence Day, by virtue of Republic Act No. 4166.
1964年8月14日：Miss Philippines Gemma Cruz was crowned Miss International 1964, the first Filipino to win the title.
1964年11月：Kabataang Makabayan (KM) is formed by Jose Maria Sison, with himself elected as its chairman.
1965年6月19日：Republic Act No. 4221 divided old Samar into the new provinces of Western Samar, Northern Samar, and Eastern Samar.
1965年9月：Taal Volcano in Batangas erupts, killing around 2,000 and damaging villages.
1965年11月9日：Ferdinand Marcos elected President of the Republic of the Philippines.
1966年：Asian Development Bank establishes its new headquarters in Manila.
1966年2月：Philippine-American Assembly is held in Davao.
1966年6月18日：Old Mountain Province is divided into the new provinces of Benguet, Mountain Province, Kalinga-Apayao and Ifugao. (Republic Act No. 4695)
1966年6月18日：Republic Act No. 4669 created the province of Camiguin, separating from Misamis Oriental.
1966年6月18日：Republic Act No. 4849 created the province of South Cotabato, separating from Empire Province of Cotabato.
1966年7月：Pres. Marcos signs the controversial Vietnam Aid Law.
1966年7月：The mayor of Candaba, Pampanga, also the president of the Anti-Huk Mayors League in the province, is killed in an ambush, an incident which was attributed to the Huks.
1966年8月：Congress approves the appropriation for the Philippine Civil Action Group (Philcag) to be sent to Vietnam.
1966年9月：The first batch of the battalion of the Philcag leaves the Philippines for South Vietnam.
1966年9月：An agreement is signed by U.S. secretary of state Dean Rusk and Foreign Affairs Secy. Narciso Ramos, reducing the lease of military bases from 99 to 25 years, thus to expire in 1991.
1966年10月：Marcos administration hosts the Manila Summit with 6 countries.
1967年1月：Two buses carrying pilgrims collide and fall off a ravine south of Manila, killing more than 115 in what would be the country's worst road accident.
1967年2月：Movement for the Advancement of Nationalism (MAN) is formed by nationalists from various sectors.
1967年5月8日：Old Davao is divided into the new provinces of Davao del Norte, Davao del Sur, and Davao Oriental. (Republic Act No. 4867)
1967年5月21日：A demonstration conducted by Lapiang Malaya, a peasant religious sect, ends in a violent dispersal attempt by the Philippine Constabulary in Pasay, killing 33.
1967年6月17日：Republic Act No. 4979 divided old Agusan into the new provinces of Agusan del Norte and Agusan del Sur.
1967年8月8日：Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) is formed in Bangkok, Thailand, with the Philippines as one of the five founding members.
1968年：First provincial television stations are established in Cebu, Bacolod, and Dagupan, all operated by ABS–CBN.
1968年3月18日：Jabidah massacre: A group of trainees of a Muslim special forces unit, part of a controversial operation, are allegedly killed in Corregidor.
1968年8月2日：1968 Casiguran earthquake and the collapse of Ruby Tower

1968年9月：Pres. Marcos signs into law a bill defining country's territorial waters in compliance with the United Nations and claiming Sabah as part of the country's territory, amidst protest from the Malaysians.
1968年9月：Pres. Marcos pardons 166 prisoners, including former Huk leader Luis Taruc.
1968年12月26日：Communist Party of the Philippines (CPP; then called CPP–Marxist–Leninist-Mao Tse-tung Thought or CPP–MLMTT) is reestablished by Jose Maria Sison and his colleagues in Pangasinan.
1969年3月29日：New People's Army (NPA) is formally organized in Tarlac by Bernabe Buscayno (Kumander Dante) of PKP as the military arm of the CPP, upon merger with Jose Maria Sison's army.
1969年5月11日：Tuguegarao City, Cagayan experienced heat at 42.2 degrees Celsius, the country's highest temperature ever recorded.
1969年7月19日：Miss Philippines Gloria Diaz was crowned Miss Universe 1969.
1969年11月11日：Marcos re-elected President of the Republic of the Philippines (second term).
1970年：Typhoon Patsy (Yoling) is the most devastating typhoon to hit the country at that time.

1970年：First Quarter Storm January 26 – It begins when protesting students confronted Pres. Marcos after his Presidential Address in the Old Legislative Building, Manila. January 30 – Battle of Mendiola occurs. February 18 & 26 – People's Congresses held in Plaza Miranda. March 3 – People's March is organized, route is from Welcome Rotonda to Liwasang Bonifacio.
1970年4月：Major rallies and riots held, protesting oil prices and fare costs.
1970年6月27日：Pres. Marcos publicly endorses the Barrio Self-Defense Units, later Civilian Home Defense Forces.
1970年11月17日：Elections for 315 members of a Constitutional Convention held.
1970年11月27日：Pope Paul VI makes his first papal visit in the Philippines, but survived an assassination attempt by Benjamín Mendoza y Amor Flores at Manila International Airport.
links: List of pastoral visits of Pope Paul VI outside Italy

items.text: 1970年12月29日：Members of the New People's Army, led by Lt. Victor Corpuz, raid the armory of the Philippine Military Academy.
1971年：Moro National Liberation Front is established by Nur Misuari.
1971年2月：Diliman commune
1971年6月：Manili massacre
1971年6月1日：The Constitutional Convention assembles to rewrite the 1935 Constitution. The Convention elects former Pres. Carlos Garcia as its head.
1971年6月14日：Death of Carlos Garcia, former Philippine president; another former president Diosdado Macapagal succeeds as the president of the Constitutional Convention.
1971年8月21日：Plaza Miranda is bombed during the Liberal Party's election campaign, seriously injuring some opposition personalities.
1971年8月22日：Pres. Marcos suspends the Writ of Habeas Corpus following the Plaza Miranda bombing.
1971年9月：U.S. operations in Sangley Point Naval Base terminated.
1971年9月10日：Provincehood of Quirino (Republic Act No. 6394), former sub-province independent from Nueva Vizcaya.
1971年9月17日：Provincehood of Siquijor (Republic Act No. 6398), former sub-province independent from Negros Oriental.
1971年10月10日：Leonardo "Nardong Putik" Manecio, one of the most notorious gangsters and dubbed as Cavite's public enemy No. 1 was killed in Imus in a highway shootout with NBI agents.
1971年11月：Philippine Senate election, 1971
1972年：Suspicious bombing incidents increase all over the country. The MNLF launches its campaign for the independence of the Muslim provinces.
1972年：Parliamentary form of government is approved by the Constitutional Convention.
1972年1月：Pres. Marcos restores the Writ of Habeas Corpus
1972年6月：Daily Express is established; Martial Law era newspaper later sequestered by Aquino government.
1972年8月：Quasha decision: Supreme Court decides on American ownership rights.
1972年9月13日：Sen. Ninoy Aquino exposes Oplan Sagittarius, a top-secret plan to place the capital under military control.
1972年9月21日：Pres. Marcos signs the Martial Law edict (Proclamation No. 1081) to be imposed nationwide; at that time not publicly announced.
1972年9月22日：Defense Minister Juan Ponce Enrile survives a staged assassination attempt.
1972年9月22日：Pres. Marcos announces that he had placed the entire country under martial law, with the earlier "ambush" as a pretext.
1972年9月22日：Media establishments and wire agencies are ordered to be closed.
1972年9月22日：Sen. Aquino arrested.
1972年9月23日：The implementation of martial law is officially announced.

1972年9月23日：Public utilities as well as media outlets, except some including newspaper Daily Express and television and radio stations of Kanlaon Broadcasting System, are shut down and seized by the government.
1972年9月23日：Media and opposition figures, including three other senators, are arrested.
1972年9月26日：The whole country is proclaimed a land reform area and an Agrarian Reform Program is decreed.
1972年9月26日：The first major armed defiance of martial law takes place in Lanao del Sur
1972年10月：Land reform program issued (Presidential Decree 27)
1972年10月22日：The battle between the MNLF and the government troops ends with the latter regaining control of the city.
1972年11月29日：The Constitutional Convention passes the new Constitution of the Philippines.
1972年12月：First Lady Imelda Marcos survives an assassination attempt.
1973年：Misuari leaves The Country for Libya to solicit armed support from Muslim countries for the war in Mindanao.
1973年：A plebiscite referendum is held among the citizens' assemblies to ratify the new Constitution, which would become effective.
1973年1月15日：Chinese drug lord Lim Seng is executed by firing squad in public in Fort Bonifacio for drug trafficking.
1973年1月17日：Pres. Marcos declares the approval of the 1973 Constitution, orders Congress padlocked.
1973年3月1日：Philippine News Agency established
1973年3月31日：Supreme Court upholds the validity of the 1973 Constitution.
1973年4月：The National Democratic Front (NDF), the united front organization of the Communist Party of the Philippines, is formally organized.
1973年5月：Masagana 99 program launched
1973年7月2日：San Juanico Bridge, connecting Samar and Leyte islands, is inaugurated.
1973年7月21日：Miss Philippines Margarita Moran was crowned Miss Universe 1973.
1973年7月27日：Marcos' term as president extended by virtue of a referendum, which was later proven as a hoax
1973年9月27日：Provincehood of Tawi-Tawi (Presidential Decree No. 302), separating from Sulu.
1973年11月22日：Old Cotabato is divided into the new provinces of North Cotabato (later renamed Cotabato, 1984), Maguindanao, and Sultan Kudarat. (PD 341)
1973年12月27日：Provincehood of Basilan (PD 356)
1974年2月：Jolo is occupied and burned by Muslim forces.
1974年2月27日：Presidential appointments to local elective positions declared legal by virtue of another referendum
1974年3月11日：Japanese Lt. Hiroo Onoda formally surrenders in a ceremony held in Malacañang Palace after staying for years in the Lubang Island.
1974年6月：First Filipino All-Muslim Congress held in Marawi City.
1974年7月：Parity rights amendment as stated in 1955 Laurel–Langley Trade Act expired.
1974年7月21日：Miss Universe 1974, its 23rd pageant, was held in Manila.
1974年9月：Jose Diokno is ordered by Pres. Marcos to be released.
1974年9月：Barangay status is reorganized and Sep 21 is declared Barangay Day (Presidential Decree 557).
1974年9月17日：Supreme Court upholds the declaration of martial law and dismisses petitions regarding habeas corpus.
1974年10月：Secretary-general of the old communist party Felicisimo Macapagal signs a memorandum of cooperation with the President's efforts.
1974年12月24日：A classified wire revealing the so-called Rolex 12 is submitted by the American Embassy in Manila to the Secretary of State in Washington, D.C.
1975年2月：Primitivo Mijares defects from the government.
1975年2月：Third referendum, asking for continuation of exercising the presidential powers, held.
links: 1975 Philippine executive and legislative powers referendum

items.text: 1975年4月4日：Ninoy Aquino starts his hunger strike for his refusal to recognize military court's jurisdiction on charges against him.
1975年4月9日：Philippine Basketball Association founded
1975年6月：Diplomatic relations with People's Republic of China formalized.
1975年6月：Primitivo Mijares testifies in the U.S. Congress on the alleged corruption and abuses of the government.
1975年10月2日：Thrilla in Manila
1975年11月1日：Pres. Marcos issues Presidential Decree No. 824, establishing Metro Manila and creating the Metropolitan Manila Commission (MMC).
1976年1月4日：New people's Army Spokesman Satur Ocampo arrested
1976年8月17日：An earthquake of 7.8 magnitude and a following tsunami (flood wave) hit Mindanao, killing an estimated 8,000 people on and off the coast.
1976年8月26日：Kumander Dante of the New People's Army arrested
1976年10月16日：Martial Law allowed to extend by virtue of a plebiscite
1976年12月23日：Tripoli Agreement is signed between the Philippine Government and the secessionist group Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) in Tripoli, Libya.
1977年1月20日：The Armed Forces of the Philippines enters into a ceasefire agreement with the MNLF.
1977年3月4日：President Marcos issues a decree creating the autonomous Bangsamoro Islamic Government
1977年8月：Pres. Marcos announces amnesty for persons found guilty of subversion.
1977年8月22日：Imposition of curfew hours lifted
1977年9月2日：Archimedes Trajano found dead, murdered
1977年10月：Eugenio Lopez Jr. and Sergio Osmeña III escaped from detention in Fort Bonifacio and flee to the United States.
1977年11月10日：CPP head Jose Maria Sison arrested
1977年11月25日：The military court finds Ninoy Aquino, Bernabe Buscayno and Victor Corpuz guilty of their charges and sentences them to death by firing squad; but sentence never imposed.
1977年12月16日：A referendum is held, the result of which again empowers the president to continue in office, and to become prime minister as well.
1978年4月7日：Members of the Interim Batasang Pambansa are elected.
1978年6月：Inauguration of Interim Batasang Pambansa with Pres. Marcos as its prime minister.

1978年9月21日：Tadhana (1978), the first feature-length animated film in the Philippines premiered one time at the local television on GMA 7, RPN 9, and IBC 13 to commemorate the anniversary of Martial Law in 1978.
1978年10月5日：Jesus is Lord Church led by Eddie Villanueva, a former activist and professor was established.
1979年1月：U.S. military bases agreement amended.
1979年4月10日：President Ferdinand Marcos issues Presidential Decree No. 1616 creating the Intramuros Administration
1979年5月：Regional assembly elections held in Mindanao.
1979年：United Nations Conference on Trade and Development is held in the Philippine International Convention Center.
1979年7月30日：Eat Bulaga!, the longest running noon-time variety show in the Philippines, premiered on RPN. It was also aired on ABS-CBN from 1989 to 1995 and on GMA Network since 1995.
1979年8月13日：Aurora province was established by Batas Pambansa Blg. 7.
1979年10月31日：Project Gintong Alay, a national sports program was commenced.
1979年11月：Construction of a nuclear-power plant in Bataan is ordered to be stopped.
1979年12月：Ninoy Aquino is released from detention for the first time after given a furlough.
1980年：The Philippines' first local elections under the martial law era is held amid wide boycotts.
1980年4月22日：MV Don Juan and oil tanker MT Tacloban City collide in Tablas Strait off Mindoro, killing 176.
1980年5月：Kilusang Mayo Uno (KMU) organized
1980年5月：Pres. Marcos allows Ninoy Aquino to flee to the U.S. for his medical treatment.
1981年1月17日：Martial law lifted (Proclamation 2045)
1981年：Pope John Paul II visited the Philippines for his first papal visit.
1981年4月7日：Executive Committee is created by a constitutional amendment as ratified in a plebiscite.
1981年6月16日：1981 Philippine general election and referendum (Ferdinand Marcos re-elected to a third term).
1981年6月30日：Inauguration of Pres. Marcos; Finance Minister Cesar Virata is elected Prime Minister by the Batasang Pambansa
1981年11月17日：Accident during the construction of the Manila Film Center, 169 were killed.
1982年：Reform the Armed Forces Movement (RAM) formed
1982年1月：International Film Festival is held in the Manila Film Center.
1982年4月：United Nationalist Democratic Opposition formed.
1982年5月：Barangay elections held for the first time.
1982年12月：Newspapers We Forum and Malaya are shut down by the President for engaging in "black propaganda."
1983年8月21日：Sen. Benigno Aquino Jr. is assassinated at then Manila International Airport.
1983年8月31日：Approximately seven million people attends funeral procession of Ninoy Aquino which turned into a rally, the longest and largest in history.
1983年11月21日：Martyrdom of Good Shepherd Sisters
1984年1月27日：Executive Committee is abolished and the Office of the Vice President is restored through a constitutional amendment as ratified in a plebiscite.
1984年2月："Tarlac to Tarmac" march is staged by opposition and coalition groups.
1984年5月14日：1984 Philippine parliamentary election
1984年7月：National Assembly covenes; Prime Minister Virata reconfirmed; Nicanor Yniguez elected Speaker.
1984年8月19日：El Shaddai DWXI Prayer Partners Foundation International, Inc. led by Bro. Mike Z. Velarde, a geological engineer and movie producer was established.
1984年9月1日：Typhoon Nitang struck the Philippines. It killed 1,492 people and 1,856 more were injured. Roughly 1.6 million people were affected in the country.
1984年11月14日：Mayor Cesar Climaco assassinated
1984年12月1日：Manila LRT Line 1 opened as the Southeast Asia's first rail line.
links: Manila Light Rail Transit System Line 1

items.text: 1980年－1989年：Ferdinand Marcos: The tenth President of the Philippines, The longest-term held in office.
1980年－1989年：Corazon Aquino: The 11th President of the Philippines, The First-women held in office.
1990年：Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao is officially created.

1990年3月4日：Hotel Delfino in Tuguegarao, Cagayan is seized by suspended Gov. Rodolfo Aguinaldo and his armed men of 200, followed by a gunfight intending to kill them, with a checkpoint shootout, where 14 found dead and 10 injured.
1990年6月：U.S. Peace Corps removed 261 volunteers from the country amid Communist threats.

1990年7月16日：Luzon earthquake: An earthquake with a surface wave magnitude of 7.8, whose epicenter was recorded in Nueva Ecija, hits Northern and Central Luzon, affecting Cabanatuan, Dagupan, and Baguio cities, and parts of Nueva Ecija and Pangasinan provinces, causing a death toll of an estimated 1,621 and estimated damages worth ₱15 billion; produces a 125-km long ground rupture stretching from the municipalities of Dingalan to Cuyapo; strongest and costliest in the island since 1970.
1990年9月：Sixteen military members are convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment regarding the 1983 assassination of Sen. Aquino.
1990年：A raid is staged by mutinying soldiers on an army base in Mindanao on the dawn of 4th; Brig. Gen. Danilo Lim and 21 others capitulate to the government on the 6th.
1990年：Col. Alexander Noble stages a coup in Mindanao and seizes two military garrisons in Cagayan de Oro and Butuan cities.
1990年11月12日：Typhoon Mike (Ruping) hits Visayas, affecting Cebu City, Bacolod, and other key cities.
1991年1月29日：Merger of the Philippine Constabulary with the Integrated National Police to form the Philippine National Police.

1991年：Pinatubo eruption: Series of major eruptions from the dormant Mount Pinatubo, the most explosive occurred on the 15th, and worsened by Typhoon Yunya (Diding) causing massive lahar flows, affecting densely populated areas of Zambales, Tarlac and Pampanga; killing 847 people; total damages at least ₱12 billion; the second largest volcanic eruption of the 20th century.

1991年9月16日：Senate votes, 12–11, to reject a Treaty of Friendship, Peace and Cooperation between the U.S. and Philippines, an agreement for renewal of American military bases in the Philippines in exchange for aid, forcing them to leave the country.
1991年10月10日：The Local Government Code is signed into law.
1991年11月：Former First Lady Imelda Marcos returns to the country to face charges against her.
1991年11月：U.S. closes and surrenders Clark Air Base.
1991年：Tropical Storm Uring lashes into Eastern Visayas, leaving 8,000 people dead as a result of widespread flooding in the coastal city of Ormoc, Leyte.
1991年：Terrorist group Abu Sayyaf is founded by Abdurajak Janjalani, separated from the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) in which he was a former member.
1992年1月：Former First Lady Marcos is arrested and later released on charges regarding her accounts in Switzerland.
1992年3月16日：Provincehood of Sarangani (Republic Act No. 7228), separating from South Cotabato.
1992年5月11日：1992 Philippine general election, the first under the 1987 Constitution (Fidel V. Ramos and Joseph E. Estrada are elected president and vice president, respectively.)
1992年5月11日：Biliran province was established through RA 7160.
1992年5月22日：Guimaras province was established through RA 7160.
1992年9月30日：U.S. forces leave Subic Bay Naval Base upon its turn over to the Philippines.

1992年11月24日：Subic Bay Naval Base closes as it is turned over to the local government, with a last batch of American soldiers finally leaving Naval Air Station Cubi Point and returning to the U.S., ending its military presence in the country.
1992年：Pres. Ramos signs the Anti-Subversion Act of 1992.
1993年7月2日：A floating pagoda sinks in the annual Bocaue River Festival in Bocaue, Bulacan, 279 devotees drown.
1993年9月：Marcos funeral: Remains of former Pres. Marcos return in the country upon permission from the government; are interred later in his hometown of Batac.
1993年9月24日：Former First Lady Imelda Marcos is found by Sandiganbayan guilty of corruption and sentenced to 18–24 years in prison.
1993年12月：Numerous bomb attacks in Davao City, targeting a church and two mosques, kill at least two and injure 150.
1993年：Pres. Ramos signs Republic Act 7659 reinstating capital punishment for selected crimes, which is banned in the 1987 Constitution.
1994年1月：The government and the Moro National Liberation Front sign a ceasefire agreement, aiming to end guerrilla war.
1994年3月29日：The Philippines first makes its connection to the Internet, with Philippine Network Foundation connects to the United States' Sprint via a 64 kbit/s link.
1994年6月：A5-day conference on East Timor held in Manila ends with an agreement to form a coalition for then Indonesian territory.

1994年7月：Abu Sayyaf group massacres 15 Christian civilians in Basilan and holds 19 others hostage; most of the captives are freed later following a rescue mission, while Lamitan parish priest Fr. Cirilo Nacorda is freed on August after being turned over by the group to the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF).
1994年10月：Series of terror attacks of the MILF in parts of Cotabato result in the death of 50 people from both the rebel and government sides and displace thousands from four municipalities.
1994年11月15日：Mindoro earthquake
1994年12月2日：Singaporean freighter Kota Suria and ferry MV Cebu City collides in Manila Bay, killing about 140.

1994年12月11日：Abomb explodes on board a Philippine Airlines plane during a test run as part of the Bojinka plot, a planned attack for the assassination of Pope John Paul II during his 1995 visit, killing a passenger.
1994年：Abu Sayyaf launches a series of bombings in Zamboanga City, killing 71.
1995年1月：Bojinka plot is discovered following a chemical fire in an apartment in Manila.
1995年：Pope John Paul II visits the Philippines and presides over the country's first World Youth Day in Manila.

1995年2月：Philippine Navy sights ships and structures being built, all by the Chinese, in Mischief Reef (Panganiban Reef) in the South China Sea off Palawan; causing Manila to file legal diplomatic actions against Beijing over continuous occupation of the Kalayaan Island Group, and further resistance between the Philippines and China.
1995年2月14日：Old Kalinga-Apayao is divided into separate provinces of Kalinga and Apayao. (Republic Act No. 7878)
1995年4月3日：Abu Sayyaf rebels raid Ipil town, wherein they burn the town center and kill 53 people.
1995年4月30日：President Ramos inaugurated the opening of Subic International Airport (formerly a United States military base). This indicates growth after the removal of military bases in the country.
1995年5月17日：Kuratong Baleleng case
1995年10月31日：Super Typhoon Rosing
1995年11月27日：The construction of the Skyway project was initiated, the biggest infrastructure project in the country that was intended to ease the flow of traffic in Metro Manila.
1996年3月18日：Fire razes Ozone Disco Bar in Quezon City, killing more than 158, including students.
1996年3月24日：Marcopper mining disaster in Marinduque occurs; one of the largest mining disasters in history.

1996年9月2日：The Final Peace Agreement between the Philippine Government and the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF), led by Nur Misuari, is signed at the Malacañan Palace; implementing the 1976 Tripoli Agreement.
1996年：8th Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Summit was held in Subic.
1997年7月：Asian financial crisis hits the country; causes decreasing economic growth in the Philippines.
1997年10月29日：Pres. Ramos signs Indigenous Peoples' Rights Act (Republic Act No. 8371), with the creation of National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP).
1998年1月30日：Provincehood of Compostela Valley (Republic Act No. 8470), separating from Davao del Norte.
1998年2月2日：A Cebu Pacific plane hits Mt. Sumagaya in Claveria, Misamis Oriental, killing 104 on board.
1998年5月11日：1998 Philippine general election (Joseph Estrada is elected)
1998年6月12日：Celebrations for Centennial of Philippine Independence begins, with 2-day activities held.
1998年：Dry spell felt in 16 regions amid country's four-year growth, with ₱9 billion worth of agricultural damages.
1998年9月18日：Passenger ferry Princess of the Orient sinks off Fortune Island during a typhoon, killing 150.
1998年：Abu Sayyaf founder Abdurajak Janjalani dies in a police encounter.

1999年2月5日：Rape convict Leo Echegaray is executed by lethal injection at the New Bilibid Prison in Muntinlupa; the first Filipino to be meted the death penalty since its reinstatement in 1993; yet the country's first public execution since 1976, and also of that method.
1999年5月：New Visiting Forces Agreement (VFA) with the United States is ratified by the Senate, returning American military presence in the country.
1999年8月3日：About 60 people died and 378 houses buried when a massive landslide, caused by Typhoon Olga (Ising), occurs in Cherry Hills subdivision in Antipolo, Rizal.
1990年－1999年：The eruption column of Mount Pinatubo on June 12, 1991, three days before the climactic eruption.
2000年1月4日：Convicted rapist Alex Bartolome becomes the last person to be executed in the country. Capital punishment is abolished in 2006 under the presidency of Gloria Macapagal Arroyo.
2000年3月15日：Pres. Estrada's government declares an "all-out-war" against the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF).
links: 2000 Philippine campaign against the Moro Islamic Liberation Front

items.text: 2000年4月19日：An Air Philippines plane crashes in the hills of Island Garden City of Samal, Davao del Norte, killing all 131 on board; the worst aviation disaster in country's history.
2000年4月12日：Cargo vessel Annahada sinks off Jolo Island, killing 159.
2000年4月23日：Twenty-one foreigners are abducted by Abu Sayyaf extremists from Sipadan Island, Malaysia and are later brought to Jolo Island; hostage crisis lasts five months.
2000年5月：A computer virus is released by a student, damaging around 45 million computers worldwide.
2000年5月25日：A Philippine Airlines plane is hijacked by an armed man, who later died in a failed jump attempt.

2000年7月9日：Fall of Camp Abubakar: Camp Abubakar in Maguindanao is captured by the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) from the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), as part of a campaign against Moro insurgency in Mindanao.
links: 2000 Philippine campaign against the Moro Islamic Liberation Front

items.text: 2000年7月10日：More than 200 people are killed in a trash slide in Payatas, Quezon City.
2000年11月13日：Pres. Estrada is the first incumbent president to be impeached by House of Representatives on accusations regarding jueteng money;
links: House of Representatives of the Philippines

items.text: 2000年12月7日：The Senate formally initiates the impeachment trial against Pres. Estrada presided by Chief Justice Hilario Davide Jr.
links: Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of the Philippines

items.text: 2000年12月30日：Rizal Day bombings: Series of terrorist bombings occur in Metro Manila, with 22 fatalities and more than 120 injuries.

2001年：EDSA II Revolution ousts Pres. Estrada; Vice-Pres. Gloria Macapagal Arroyo becomes the 14th president of the Philippines. January 16 – Prosecutors of the trial walk out after senators voted, 11–10, not to open the second envelope containing the documents of evidences against Pres. Estrada, regarding his supposed link to a bank account purportedly containing kickbacks from an illegal numbers game; crowd start to gather in the People Power Shrine and conduct the mass rallies, calling for his resignation. January 17 – Impeachment trial aborted. January 19 – High-ranking military and police officials, including Defense Secy. Orlando Mercado, AFP Chief of Staff Gen. Angelo Reyes and PNP Chief Dir. Gen. Panfilo Lacson, withdraw from the Estrada administration. January 20 – Pres. Estrada resigns and leaves Malacañang. Vice-Pres. Macapagal Arroyo is sworn into office by Chief Justice Davide at Our Lady of EDSA Shrine in Mandaluyong; thus, the nation's second woman President.
links: List of presidents of the Philippines
Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of the Philippines

items.text: 2001年3月：Moro Islamic Liberation Front declares ceasefire with the government.
2001年4月25日：Former Pres. Estrada, charged with plunder while in office, and his son Jinggoy are arrested following an arrest warrant issued by Sandiganbayan with their co-accused.
2001年：EDSA III: Supporters of former Pres. Estrada stage protest following his arrest, ending in a violent dispersal and riots on the 1st, killing four.

2001年5月27日：Dos Palmas Resort kidnappings: Twenty hotel staff and guests, mostly tourists, are seized by the Islamist terrorist group Abu Sayyaf members from the Dos Palmas Resort in Honda Bay, Palawan; hostage crisis lasts for more than 12 months.

2001年：Lamitan Siege: Abu Sayyaf takes a church and a hospital in Lamitan, Basilan hostage, with captives brought from Palawan, wherein four of them are reportedly escaped, and 20 more people; terrorists escape military operation.
2001年11月：A rebellion in Sulu and Zamboanga City, staged by several MNLF commanders loyal to Nur Misuari, is suppressed by AFP.
2001年：Another plebiscite is held in ARMM (by virtue of RA 9054) for its expansion, resulting in inclusion of Basilan province and Marawi City.
2002年2月26日：Former Pres. Estrada admits signing ₱500 million Jose Velarde bank account in Equitable-PCI Bank.
2002年3月5日：Mindanao earthquake

2002年6月7日：A rescue operation for the remaining Abu Sayyaf captives, held since 2001, is launched by the Special Forces of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) in an area in Zamboanga del Norte, with a gun battle resulting in the deaths of Martin Burnham and Ediborah Yap; only Gracia Burnham survived.
2002年6月21日：Death of Abu Sabaya, leader of Abu Sayyaf.
2002年8月：Abu Sayyaf kidnaps six Filipino members of a Christian group, two of them later beheaded.
2002年10月：Series of bombings, allegedly by the Abu Sayyaf, take place in Manila and Zamboanga cities.
2003年2月11日：Government soldiers' attempt to disband a terrorist kidnap group "Pentagon Gang" results in a 3-day encounter that killed about 135 MILF fighters in their base near Pikit town.
2003年7月27日：Oakwood mutiny: Magdalo Group, led by Army Capt. Gerardo Gambala and LtSG. Antonio Trillanes IV, takes a mutiny at Oakwood Premier apartments in Makati.
2004年2月27日：SuperFerry 14 is bombed by then Jemaah Islamiyah-linked Abu Sayyaf, then sinks near Manila Bay, killing 116; deadliest terrorist attack in Philippine history.
2004年5月10日：2004 Philippine general election (incumbent Pres. Gloria Macapagal Arroyo elected to a six-year term)
2004年11月16日：Hacienda Luisita massacre takes place, 14 people die in clashes with police.

2004年：Cyclones Muifa (Unding), Merbok (Violeta), Winnie and Nanmadol (Yoyong) hit the country, affecting million people, causing massive fatalities and damages. In November, a tropical depression (Winnie) kills more than 1,500 people, causes damages of estimated ₱679 million (US$15.8 million). Cyclone Nanmadol (Yoyong) strikes the country, killing 70 people.

2005年2月14日：Valentine's Day bombings: Three explosions occur in the cities of Makati, Davao, and General Santos, resulting to, in total, 8 deaths and at least 90 injuries; Abu Sayyaf claims responsibility for the attacks.

2005年6月6日：Hello Garci scandal (Legitimacy of declared election winners questioned): Audio recordings, containing a conversation believed to be between Pres. Macapagal Arroyo and Election Commissioner Virgilio Garcillano, are released by media to the public, revealing the allegations of cheating in 2004 national elections.
2005年9月6日：Congress rejects impeachment complaints against Pres. Macapagal Arroyo in what would be the longest Lower House session in country's history.
2005年11月：Reformed Value Added Tax Act (also called Expanded VAT) is implemented, after being delayed for months, as a solution to the government's fiscal crisis.
2006年2月17日：A landslide from an entire mountainside occurs in Guinsaugon village in Southern Leyte, following continuous heavy rains and an earthquake, causing damages and 1,126 deaths.
2006年2月24日：Pres. Macapagal Arroyo places the entire country under state of emergency (Proclamation 1017) in response to coup rumours.
links: 2006 state of emergency in the Philippines

items.text: 2006年5月18日：Mountaineer Leo Oracion reached the summit of Mount Everest via the Nepalese side.
2006年6月24日：Pres. Macapagal Arroyo signs Republic Act 9346 abolishing capital punishment in the country.
2006年8月11日：Vessel M/T Solar I sinks off the coast of Guimaras, resulting to an oil spill, causing widespread environmental damage.
2006年9月28日：Typhoon Xangsane (Milenyo) struck Luzon, killing at least 200 and causing agricultural damages.
2006年10月2日：Provincehood of Dinagat Islands (Republic Act No. 9355), separating from Surigao del Norte.

2006年：Typhoon Durian (Reming) kills at least 720 people, with damages at US$130 million; triggers a massive landslide from the Mayon volcano in Legazpi City on the 30th, causing additional 800–1,000 casualties.
2006年12月4日：Makati Regional Trial Court convicts American serviceman LCpl. Daniel Smith and acquits three co-accused for their involvement in the 2005 Subic rape case.
2006年：Death of Khadaffy Janjalani, Abu Sayyaf leader.
2007年3月：Rep. Satur Ocampo is arrested and charged with murder allegedly committed on a purge of suspected spies in the CPP–NPA occurred then, later released.
2007年3月：The Permanent Peoples' Tribunal in The Hague finds the Arroyo administration responsible for unsolved killings and disappearances in the country.
2007年4月20日：A contract is signed by the Philippine and Chinese governments for a proposed National Broadband Network, which was later found to be corrupted.

2007年7月11日：Fourteen Marine soldiers are found beheaded following an encounter between government forces and Islamic rebels Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) and, allegedly, Abu Sayyaf, in Tipo-Tipo, Basilan.
2007年8月28日：Exiled Communist Party of the Philippines founding chairman Jose Maria Sison is arrested at Utrecht, Netherlands.
2007年9月12日：Sandiganbayan and the Office of the Ombudsman convicts former Pres. Estrada for plunder and sentences him to reclusion perpetua, but acquits him and his co-accused on other charges.
links: Office of the Ombudsman of the Philippines

items.text: 2007年10月19日：An explosion at Glorietta mall in Makati kills 11 and injures at least 100.
2007年10月26日：Former Pres. Joseph Estrada is pardoned and freed from jail after his trial.
2007年11月29日：The Armed Forces lays siege to The Peninsula Manila following a mutiny staged by soldiers.
2007年12月6日：Fourteen Abu Sayyaf members are convicted by the Pasig Regional Trial Court regarding the 2001 kidnapping incident in Palawan.
2007年：MNLF leader Nur Misuari is arrested in Malaysia following rebellion charges filed against him.
2008年2月8日：Jun Lozada testifies before the Philippine Senate in connection with the National Broadband Network contract deal.

2008年3月6日：Several Congress members call for an investigation into a joint oil exploration agreement on 2004 between the Philippines, China, and Vietnam over the disputed Spratly Islands, claiming it unconstitutional.
2008年3月11日：Former First Lady Imelda Marcos is acquitted by a Manila trial court of 32 counts of illegal money transfers.

2008年3月17日：The United States Supreme Court hears oral arguments on a certiorari petition filed by the government, invoking sovereign immunity regarding the enforcement against former Pres. Marcos' estate.
links: Supreme Court of the United States

items.text: 2008年：Typhoon Fengshen (Frank) makes landfall in Samar on the 20th; devastates Central Visayas; kills at least 557 people and affects more than 99,600 families in some regions, with damages at ₱4.37 billion (US$101.2 million).

2008年6月21日：Passenger ferry MV Princess of the Stars capsizes and sinks off San Fernando, Romblon in Sibuyan Island during a typhoon, 814 of its total number of passengers and crew are either dead or missing.
2008年8月25日：Peace talks between the government and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front collapse after the memorandum of Agreement on Ancestral Domain is declared by the Supreme Court unconstitutional.
2008年10月：Euro Generals scandal
2008年：CARPER (CARP Extension with Reforms) Act is passed, reforming CARP and extending it until 2014.
2009年1月15日：Three International Committee of the Red Cross volunteers are kidnapped by the rebel group Abu Sayyaf
links: International Committee of the Red Cross

items.text: 2009年3月：Philippine Archipelagic Baselines Act (Republic Act 9522) is signed into law by Pres. Macapagal Arroyo, ensuring international recognition of the country's territorial boundaries.
2009年4月23日：Court of Appeals acquits LCpl. Daniel Smith in connection with Subic rape case, reversing the 2006 decision, ordering his release.
links: Court of Appeals of the Philippines

items.text: 2009年9月26日：Typhoon Ketsana (Ondoy) is the most devastating typhoon to hit the country since Typhoon Patsy (Yoling), affecting Manila, with damages of $1.09 billion and 747 fatalities.
2009年10月：Typhoon Parma (Pepeng) hits the country, affecting millions of people, causing $617 million in damages and 500 fatalities.

2009年11月23日：Maguindanao massacre: Fifty-eight people being part of a convoy, including clan members and 32 journalists, are killed and buried in a mass grave in Ampatuan town by an estimated 100 gunmen belonging to a victims' political rival; single deadliest attack against journalists in world history.
2009年12月4日：Pres. Macapagal Arroyo places Maguindanao under a state of martial law in connection with the murder incident; lifts it eight days later.
2009年：MNLF leader Nur Misuari is acquitted in connection to the 2001 rebellion.
2000年－2009年：Joseph Estrada is the first president to be impeached by the House of Representatives
links: House of Representatives of the Philippines

items.text: 2000年－2009年：Gloria Macapagal Arroyo, the 14th President of the Philippines.
2000年－2009年：Location of Oakwood Premiere and the Manila Peninsula Hotel in Makati. These hotels had become the location of the Magdalo mutiny of 2003 and 2007, respectively
2000年－2009年：MV Princess of the Stars which had capsized on June 21, 2008, at the height of Typhoon Frank.
2010年5月10日：The 2010 Philippine general elections, also the first national computerized election in the Philippine history, took place. (Benigno Aquino III is elected president)
2010年8月23日：A hostage-taking incident at the Quirino Grandstand ends in a gunfight that killed a perpetrator and eight hostages.
2010年：Typhoon Juan, officially as Typhoon Megi, hits northeastern Luzon at Sierra Madre, creating widespread damage over Luzon.
2011年7月26日：Supreme Court declares creation of a Truth Commission (Executive Order No. 1) unconstitutional.
2011年11月11日：Puerto Princesa Underground River is named as one of the world's New7Wonders of Nature.

2011年11月18日：Electoral sabotage charges are filed by Comelec against former Pres. Macapagal Arroyo, arrested on the same day, and the co-accused at the Pasay Regional Trial Court in connection to allegations of electoral fraud.
2011年12月：Tropical Storm Washi (Sendong) causes flash floods, leaving 1,080 people dead and affecting Cagayan de Oro and Iligan cities.
2012年2月：An earthquake with 6.9 magnitude hits Visayas islands causing damages.
2012年4月：An attempt of the Philippine Navy to detain Chinese fishermen caught on the Scarborough Shoal is blocked by China, escalating a diplomatic standoff over the area.
2012年4月24日：Supreme Court votes to distribute Hacienda Luisita lands to its farmers.
2012年5月29日：Senators vote, 20–3, to convict Chief Justice Corona guilty in the second article of the impeachment case regarding alleged undisclosed wealth, removing him from office.
links: Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of the Philippines
Articles of Impeachment against Chief Justice Renato Corona

items.text: 2012年9月：Cybercrime Prevention Act (Republic Act 10175) is signed into law by Pres. Aquino.

2012年10月15日：The Framework Agreement on the Bangsamoro is signed by the Philippine Government and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), aiming to end war in the southern Philippines and also for the creation of a new autonomous political entity, Bangsamoro, replacing the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao.
2012年10月21日：Canonization of Pedro Calungsod as second Filipino saint
2012年12月3日：Typhoon Bopha (Pablo) makes landfall on Mindanao, affecting Compostela Valley and Davao Oriental, with more than 600 fatalities and damages estimated at more than US$1 billion.
2012年12月21日：Reproductive Health Bill (Republic Act 10354) is signed into law by Pres. Aquino.
