links: Responsible Parenthood and Reproductive Health Act of 2012

items.text: 2013年5月15日：The Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2013, commonly known as K–12 program was signed.
2013年7月27日：The United Federated States of Bangsamoro Republik (UFSBR) declares its independence from the Philippines
2013年8月16日：Passenger ship MV St. Thomas Aquinas and cargo ship Sulpicio Express Siete collide in Cebu Strait, killing 115.
2013年9月：MNLF commander Ustadz Habier Malik launches an attack on Zamboanga City, leaving more than 200 people dead.
2013年9月28日：The UFSBR ceases to exists as it is defeated in the Zamboanga City crisis.

2013年10月15日：A magnitude 7.2 earthquake, whose released energy is found equivalent to 32 Hiroshima bombs, strikes Bohol province, affecting Central Visayas, with 222 people died; the country's deadliest earthquake since 1990.
2013年10月28日：Davao Occidental was founded, separating from Davao del Sur; country's 81st province.

2013年11月8日：Super Typhoon Haiyan (Yolanda) landfalls in Visayas and devastates the country, whose winds caused storm surges that severely flooded Eastern and Central Visayan coasts, with Samar (Guiuan town) and Leyte (Tacloban City) among the most affected; death toll of at least 6,300; majority of about 11 million people reportedly affected are left homeless; one of the strongest tropical cyclones to hit the country, and the deadliest typhoon on record.
2014年3月27日：The Comprehensive Agreement on the Bangsamoro was signed.
2014年3月30日：Philippine government files a memorandum in the United Nations arbitration court regarding the shoals and reefs in the South China Sea.
2014年5月23日：The Philippines and Indonesia signed a maritime treaty that draws the boundary of the two countries' overlapping Exclusive Economic Zone in Mindanao and Celebes seas.
2014年7月21日：Philippine Arena is inaugurated in Bocaue, Bulacan, the "largest mixed-use indoor theater."
2014年7月27日：Philippines marks a milestone in its population growth identifying the birth of a baby girl in a Manila hospital as the 100 millionth Filipino.
2014年9月10日：President Aquino III lead the handover of the draft of the Bangsamoro Basic Law to the Senate and House leaders in a historical turnover ceremony at the Malacañang.
2014年12月8日：Vigan City, Ilocos Sur is chosen as one of the world's New7Wonders Cities.
2014年：Enhanced Defense Cooperation Agreement (EDCA) signed, maintaining rotational American military presence in the country.
2015年：Papal visit of Pope Francis in the Philippines, with a special Mass held at the Tacloban airport on the 17th.
links: Pope Francis' visit to the Philippines

items.text: 2015年1月25日：Mamasapano clash: An encounter between police commandos and the MILF occurs in a police operation in Mamasapano, Maguindanao (now in Maguindanao del Sur), aiming to capture international terrorist Marwan; leading to, in total, 74 deaths including 44 PNP–SAF officers
2015年2月25日：The AFP declared its all-out offensive campaign against the MILF break away group, the Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters.
2015年4月14日：Death of Ameril Umbra Kato, the founding leader of the Bangsamoro Islamic Freedom Fighters.
2015年5月29日：Pres. Aquino signs Executive Order 183, creating the Negros Island Region.
2015年6月28日：Death of Kumander Parago, the top commander of the New People's Army.
2015年10月18日：Typhoon Koppu (Lando) hits northern and central Luzon, creating widespread damage and floods over Luzon.
2015年12月1日：LCpl. Joseph Scott Pemberton is convicted by the court for the death of a transgender in 2014.
2015年：Pia Alonzo Wurtzbach is crowned Miss Universe 2015 in Las Vegas, Nevada; the country's first title after 42 years.
2016年1月：Supreme Court declares the EDCA as constitutional.
2016年2月10日：The National Mapping and Resource Information Authority announces that it has documented more than 400 additional islands.
links: National Mapping and Resource Information Authority

items.text: 2016年3月23日：Diwata-1 was launched to the International Space Station aboard the Cygnus spacecraft on a supply mission.
2016年4月9日：Twenty-three soldiers and Abu Sayyaf bandits, including a Moroccan jihadist, are killed in a gunfight between government troops and a terrorist group in Tipo-Tipo, Basilan.
2016年5月9日：2016 Philippine general election (Rodrigo Duterte is elected as the first President from Mindanao)
2016年7月1日：An intensified nationwide anti-drug campaign is launched by President Rodrigo Duterte.
2016年7月12日：The Permanent Court of Arbitration rules in favor of the Philippines against China over territorial disputes in the South China Sea.
links: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea

items.text: 2016年7月19日：The Supreme Court acquits former president Gloria Macapagal Arroyo of her plunder case regarding the alleged misuse of funds for the PCSO in an 11–4 ruling.
2016年7月23日：President Duterte signs an executive order for the implementation of the Freedom of Information (FOI).
2016年8月1日：Launch of the 911 emergency number and 8888 civil service complaint hotline
2016年10月19日：Typhoon Haima (Lawin). Typhoon signal number 5 raised for the first time.
2016年11月18日：The controversial burial of Ferdinand Marcos at the Libingan ng mga Bayani
2017年1月5日：Death of Mohammad Jaafar Maguid, the leader of Ansar Al-Khilafah Philippines.
2017年1月11日：Pres. Duterte signed an executive order mandating universal access to modern family planning tools.

2017年2月5日：President Rodrigo Duterte designates the Communist Party of the Philippines-New Peoples Army (CPP-NPA) as a terrorist organization following attacks and kidnappings of soldiers by NPA members amid the imposed ceasefire between the government and the communist rebels.

2017年2月24日：Arrest of Leila de Lima for violations of Republic Act 9165, (Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002) related to her alleged involvement in the New Bilibid Prison drug trafficking scandal.
links: New Bilibid Prison drug trafficking scandal

items.text: 2017年2月28日：Philippines' signing of the Paris Agreement on Climate Change.
2017年5月16日：Pres. Rodrigo Duterte signed Executive Order No. 25, that renamed Benham Rise to Philippine Rise.
2017年5月16日：Pres. Rodrigo Duterte signed Executive Order No. 26, that ordered a nationwide smoking ban.
2017年5月23日：Pres. Duterte declares a 60-day martial law in Mindanao (via Proclamation No. 216) following clashes between government forces and the Maute group in Marawi City.
2017年7月22日：Congress votes to extend martial law in Mindanao until the end of 2017 as siege in Marawi City continues.
2017年10月16日：Abu Sayyaf leader Isnilon Hapilon and Maute group leader Omar Maute are killed by government troops in an assault.
2017年10月17日：Pres. Duterte declares the liberation of Marawi City, with more than a thousand reportedly killed in the battle.

2018年7月26日：The Bangsamoro Organic Law is signed into law by President Rodrigo Duterte, effectively abolishing the Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao and providing for the basic structure of government for the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao.
links: Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao

items.text: 2010年－2019年：Benigno Aquino III, the 15th President of the Philippines.
2010年－2019年：Territorial disputes in the South China Sea
links: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea

items.text: 2010年－2019年：Renato Corona is the first Chief Justice to be impeached by the House of Representatives.
2010年－2019年：The Zamboanga City Hall where the MNLF intended to hoist the Bangsamoro Republik flag in the height of Zamboanga City crisis.
2010年－2019年：Typhoon Haiyan also known as Yolanda was the strongest typhoon in the Philippines.

2010年－2019年：Diwata-1 also known as PHL-Microsat-1 is a Philippine microsatellite launched to the International Space Station (ISS) on March 23, 2016, and was deployed into orbit from the ISS on April 27, 2016. It is the first Philippine microsatellite and the first satellite built and designed by Filipinos.
2010年－2019年：Rodrigo Duterte, the 16th President of the Philippines.
2010年－2019年：The Permanent Court of Arbitration ruled in favor of the Philippines against China over territorial disputes in the South China Sea.
2010年－2019年：A building in Marawi is set ablaze by air strikes carried out by the Philippine Air Force.
2020年3月16日：The island of Luzon placed under Enhanced Community Quarantine in response to the growing pandemic of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) in the country.
2020年7月3日：The Anti-Terrorism Act of 2020 is signed into law by President Rodrigo Duterte, giving more surveillance powers to government forces to curb terror threats and acts.
2021年6月23日：The Anti-Terrorism Council designates the National Democratic Front (NDF) as a terrorist organization, citing it as an "integral and inseparable part" of the CPP-NPA.
2021年7月26日：Hidilyn Diaz wins a gold medal at the Women's 55 kg event for weightlifting in Tokyo, Japan during the 2020 Tokyo Olympics. It is the Philippines' first Olympic gold medal.
links: Weightlifting at the 2016 Summer Olympics – Women's 53 kg

items.text: 2022年5月9日：The 2022 Philippine general election are held, marking the first majority win since the establishment of the Fifth Republic in 1987, the first presidential ticket to win together since 2004, and the return of the Marcos family to power since the People Power Revolution. (Bongbong Marcos is elected as President alongside his running mate, Sara Duterte, as Vice President)

2025年3月11日：Former president Rodrigo Duterte is arrested at Ninoy Aquino International Airport for an International Criminal Court warrant that charged him with crimes against humanity in relation to the Philippine drug war. He was then sent to the Hague to face trial.
2025年9月4日：Widespread demonstrations against corruption begin over the mismanagement of government funds in flood control projects. The protests are a part of wider Gen Z protests across Asia.
links: Flood control projects scandal in the Philippines

items.text: 1025年：The region was invaded and occupied by Rajendra Chola of the Chola empire in India, although there has been no record of them visiting the island itself.
1299年：According to the Malay Annals, the Kingdom of Singapura was founded by Sang Nila Utama, a prince of Srivijaya. The kingdom existed till 1398.
1320年：The Mongol court sends a mission to obtain elephants from Long Ya Men (or Dragon's Tooth Strait), believed to be Keppel Harbour.
1330年：The Chinese traveller Wang Dayuan visits Temasek and records an attack by Siam, recording it down alongside Long Ya Men and Ban Zu.
1398年：Parameswara, the last Srivijayan prince, flees from Temasek.
1414年：Temasek becomes part of the Sultanate of Malacca established by Parameswara.
1511年8月15日：Malacca fell and was sacked by Afonso de Albuquerque of Portuguese Empire. See Portuguese Malacca.
1613年：Portuguese burn down the trading outpost at the mouth of Singapore River.
1641年1月14日：Fall of Portuguese Malacca to Dutch.
1819年1月29日：Sir Stamford Raffles arrives in Singapore with William Farquhar to establish a trading post for the British East India Company.
1819年2月6日：The treaty is signed between Sultan Hussein of Johor, Temenggong Abdul Rahman and Sir Stamford Raffles.
1819年2月6日：William Farquhar is installed as the first Resident of the settlement.
1821年：Singapore General Hospital was established.
1822年：Raffles drafts the Raffles Plan of Singapore to reorganise the island.
1823年5月27日：Dr John Crawfurd appointed as second Resident of the settlement.
1823年6月5日：Raffles Institution is founded by Sir Stamford Raffles.
1824年3月17日：The Anglo-Dutch Treaty is signed between Great Britain and the Netherlands.
1824年8月2日：Singapore becomes a British colony.
1826年：Singapore becomes part of the British colony of Straits Settlements under the rule of the East India Company, together with Malacca and Penang.
1826年11月27日：Robert Fullerton was installed as the first Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1830年：Singapore comes under the Presidency of Bengal in India.
1830年11月12日：Robert Ibbetson was appointed as the second Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1832年12月：Singapore becomes the centre of government of the Straits Settlements.
1833年12月7日：Kenneth Murchison was appointed as the third Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1834年8月1日：Singapore Free School was established.
1836年11月18日：Sir Samuel George Bonham was appointed as the fourth Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1842年：St. Margaret's Girls School was founded by Maria Tarn Dyer, the first and oldest all-girls school in Singapore.
1843年：Thomas Dunman, the first full-time police chief of Singapore, improves the police force as well as the pay and working hours of policemen.
1843年1月：Singapore became ruled directly from the British East India Company.
1843年8月：William John Butterworth was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1844年3月4日：Raffles Girls' School was established at Bras Basah Road.
1844年7月25日：The Tan Tock Seng Hospital begins operation.
1845年7月15日：The Straits Times was established as The Straits Times and Singapore Journal of Commerce.
1852年：A new deep harbour called New Harbour, later known as Keppel Harbour, is built.
1852年7月22日：St Joseph's Institution [as St John's Institution] was established at Bras Basah Road.
1854年：Convent of the Holy Infant Jesus (CHIJ) was established.
1855年3月21日：Edmund Augustus Blundell was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements upon the retirement of William John Butterworth.
1858年：Singapore is placed under the hierarchy of the Government of India (Calcutta), remaining as part of the Straits Settlements.
1858年3月8日：Commercial Square is renamed Raffles Place.
1859年8月6日：Major General Sir Orfeur Cavenagh was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1859年：The Singapore Botanic Gardens was founded.
1862年9月8日：Saint Andrews School was founded at Chin Chew Street.
1867年3月16日：Major General Sir Harry St. George Ord was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1867年4月1日：Straits Settlements become a crown colony of British Empire.
1867年4月1日：The Legislative Council of the Straits Settlements was formed.
links: Legislative Council of the Straits Settlements

items.text: 1869年11月17日：The Suez Canal opens, and Singapore enjoys the increase in trade.
1873年11月4日：Sir Andrew Clarke was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements upon the retirement of Sir Harry St. George Ord.
1875年5月8日：Sir William Jervois was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1876年：Victoria School was established in Kampong Glam.
1877年4月3日：Major General Edward Archibald Harbord Anson was appointed as the Acting Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1877年5月3日：The Chinese Protectorate is set up, and William Pickering was the first Protector appointed.
1877年8月：Sir William Cleaver Francis Robinson was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1879年2月10日：Major General Edward Archibald Harbord Anson was appointed as the Acting Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1880年5月16日：Sir Frederick Weld was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1885年：Gan Eng Seng School was established at Telok Ayer Street.
1886年3月1日：Anglo-Chinese School was established at Amoy Street.
1887年7月25日：Methodist Girls' School was established at Short Street.
1887年10月17日：Sir Cecil Clementi Smith was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1887年12月1日：The Raffles Hotel was established.
1888年：Henry Ridley becomes the first scientific director of the Singapore Botanic Gardens.
1888年：The Singapore Fire Brigade was formed.
1892年：The Tanjong Pagar Police Station opens, and many Sikh policemen were recruited.
1892年：Holy Innocents' High School was established.
1893年8月30日：William Edward Maxwell was appointed as the Acting Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1894年2月1日：Sir Charles Bullen Hugh Mitchell was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1899年7月1日：Singapore Chinese Girls' School was established at 52 Hill Street.
1899年12月7日：Sir Charles Bullen Hugh Mitchell died while in the office as Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1899年12月7日：James Alexander Swettenham was appointed as the Acting Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1901年1月1日：Singapore-Kranji Railway officially opened to the public.
1901年11月5日：Sir Frank Swettenham was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1904年4月16日：Sir John Anderson was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1905年6月1日：Singapore change its time zone to GMT+07:00 from the original GMT+6hr 55m 25s.
1906年11月18日：Tao Nan School was established.
1906年：The Nanyang branch of Tongmenghui was set up in Singapore.
1910年3月12日：Anderson Bridge was official opened by Governor Sir John Anderson.
1911年9月2日：Sir Arthur Young was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1913年7月1日：The Singapore Harbour board was set up.
1915年：The Singapore Mutiny occurred as British Muslim Indian sepoys rose up against the British.
1917年8月15日：Nanyang Girls' High School was established by Tan Chor Nam and Teo Eng Hock, partially due to Dr Sun Yat Sen's belief in education for girls, in Dhoby Ghaut.

1917年6月14日：Nan Hua High School [as Nam Wah Girls' School] established by Mr Xiong Shangfu, its campus in Coleman Street, and it was once a base for the Japanese soldiers during the Japanese occupation.
1919年3月21日：The Chinese High School established by Tan Kah Kee at 15 Niven Road.
1920年2月17日：Sir Laurence Guillemard was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1923年：Singapore starts constructing the main British naval base in East Asia.
1924年6月28日：Singapore-Johor Causeway officially opens.
1927年6月3日：Sir Hugh Clifford was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1927年11月7日：St James Power Station was officially opened by governor Sir Hugh Clifford.
1929年：Singapore Police Academy was established at Mount Pleasant Road.
1930年2月5日：Sir Cecil Clementi was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1932年1月15日：Tanjong Pagar Railway Station commenced operation.
1932年：Jalan Besar Stadium open to the public.
1933年1月1日：Singapore change its time zone to GMT+07:20.
1933年1月16日：CHIJ Saint Nicholas Girls' School, Singapore's only bilingual and bicultural IJ school, was founded.
1934年11月9日：Sir Shenton Thomas was appointed as the Governor of the Straits Settlements.
1935年：Catholic High School was established.
1937年6月12日：Kallang Airport was opened.
1938年：British Military Hospital, predecessor of Alexandra Hospital was established.
1938年：Singapore completes the main British naval base, which is the largest drydock and third largest floating dock in the world.
1939年1月24日：Chung Cheng High School (Main) was established in Kim Yam Road.
1940年7月：British Military Hospital at Alexandra Road was officially open.
1941年9月1日：Singapore change its time zone to GMT+07:30.

1941年：In an extensive three-pronged attack, Japan opens hostilities with the countries that opposed the Axis powers and their colonies. First air raid on Singapore at 4:15 am. The Imperial Japanese Army invades Malaya.
1941年12月10日：The British battleship HMS Prince of Wales and battlecruiser HMS Repulse are sunk by Japanese bombers.
1941年12月16日：Second air raid on Singapore, at night. Only RAF Tengah is attacked.
1941年12月25日：A lone Japanese aircraft drops propaganda pamphlets on Singapore Island.
1941年12月29日：Second Japanese air raid on Singapore City (and third on the island), at night. Nightly raids commence.
1941年12月30日：The Overseas Chinese Mobilization Council is set up in Singapore, led by Tan Kah Kee.
1942年1月12日：First major daylight air raid on Singapore. Henceforth, the island is bombed everyday up to the British surrender (with the exception of 19 January).
1942年1月31日：Malaya falls to the Japanese and the Causeway is blown up to delay Japan's advancement to Singapore.
1942年2月1日：The siege of Singapore begins. The Japanese in Johor Bahru begin shelling the island daily in addition to daily aerial bombing.
1942年2月8日：The Japanese cross the Straits of Johor by inflatable boats and landed in Singapore during the Battle of Singapore.
1942年2月11日：The Japanese and Allied soldiers fight fiercely at Bukit Timah.
1942年2月13日：The Malay regiment, led by Lt. Adnan bin Saidi, fight bravely against the Japanese at Pasir Panjang Ridge in the Battle of Pasir Panjang.
1942年2月14日：The Japanese have captured most of Singapore, and most of the population is crammed into the city centre.
1942年2月15日：The British surrenders and the Japanese occupation of Singapore starts. Singapore is renamed Syonan-to (Light of the South Island).
1942年2月15日：Singapore change its time zone to GMT+09:00 to be the same as Japan.
1942年：The Japanese military police, the Kempeitai kills an estimated 25,000 to 50,000 people during Sook Ching Massacre.
1943年9月27日：Operation Jaywick occurred. Seven Japanese ships are bombed at Clifford Pier.
1943年10月10日：The Japanese initiate the Double Tenth Incident in response to Operation Jaywick, by launching a fierce crackdown on anti-Japanese elements and Allied prisoners-of-war in Singapore.
1944年3月27日：Lim Bo Seng is captured by the Japanese, and dies after 3 months of torture.
1945年8月14日：Japan surrenders, and there is anomie and looting for nearly a month when the British do not return immediately.
1945年9月5日：The British return to Singapore after the end of World War II and begin the British Military Administration of the Straits Settlements under the command of Lord Louis Mountbatten.
1945年9月12日：Singapore revert its time zone back to the pre-war time of GMT+07:30.
1946年4月1日：The Straits Settlements is dissolved and Singapore becomes a separate crown colony.
1946年4月1日：The Legislative Council of the Colony of Singapore was formed.
1946年4月1日：Sir Franklin Charles Gimson was appointed as the Governor of the Singapore.
1947年：A large number of strikes occur causing stoppages in public transport, public services and the harbour.
1947年5月：Severe food shortage leads to record-low rice ration, causing malnutrition, disease and outbreak of crime and violence.
1948年：20 March

1948年6月24日：Rubber plantations and tin mines in Malaya are destroyed by communists, and the British declares the state of Emergency over Singapore and Malaya. The emergency was officially lifted on 31 July 1960 by the Malayan government.
1949年：The University of Malaya is formed following the merger of Raffles College and King Edward Medical College.
1950年：The Maria Hertogh riots occur. 18 people are killed.
1951年4月10日：The number of elected seats is increased to 9 in the second election.
1952年3月20日：Wilfred Lawson Blythe was appointed as the Acting Governor of the Singapore.
1952年4月21日：Sir John Fearns Nicoll was appointed as the Governor of the Singapore.
1953年：Rendel Commission is appointed to make recommendations for Singapore's self-government.
1954年5月13日：Chinese school students demonstrate against the British due to the National Service proposal. See Anti-National Service Riots
1955年：2 April
1955年5月12日：Four people are killed during the Hock Lee bus riots.
1955年6月2日：William Goode was appointed as the Acting Governor of the Singapore.
1955年6月30日：Sir Robert Black was appointed as the Governor of the Singapore.
1955年8月20日：Kallang Airport ceased operation. Paya Lebar Airport started operation.
1956年1月9日：Anglican High School was founded by the Chinese speaking congregations of the Anglican Churches in Singapore.
1956年6月7日：David Marshall appeals to the United Kingdom for full self-government, but resigns when he fails. Lim Yew Hock takes over as Chief Minister.
1956年10月10日：Riots by pro-communist Chinese school students occur when government closes down a student union on 24 September 1956.
1956年10月14日：Dunman High School (formally known as Singapore Government Chinese Middle School), became the first Chinese secondary school established by the government.
1957年：Cedar Girls' Secondary School was founded.
1957年12月9日：Sir William Goode was appointed as the Governor of the Singapore.
1959年：March
1959年5月30日：3rd general elections (limited self-government) held. People's Action Party wins 43 of 51 seats and Lee Kuan Yew became the first Prime Minister.
1959年6月3日：A celebration is held at the Padang for Singapore gaining full self-government.
1959年6月3日：Sir William Goode becomes the Yang di-Pertuan Negara of Singapore.
1959年12月3日：The national anthem Majulah Singapura, written by Zubir Said, is presented.
1959年12月3日：Encik Yusof bin Ishak becomes the Yang di-Pertuan Negara of Singapore.
1960年2月1日：The Housing and Development Board is set up.
1960年9月8日：Tan Howe Liang became Singapore's first Olympic medalist. He finished second among 35 competitors in the lightweight category in weightlifting at the 1960 games held in Rome, Italy.
1961年5月25日：The Bukit Ho Swee fire kills four people and destroys 2,200 attap houses.
1961年5月27日：Tunku Abdul Rahman, the Prime Minister of Malaya, proposes a merger between Singapore, Malaya, Sabah and Sarawak.
1962年9月1日：A referendum is held in Singapore to vote on merger with Malaysia.
1963年2月2日：During Operation Coldstore, 107 left-wing politicians and trade unionists are arrested by Internal Security Department
1963年7月9日：The Malaysia Agreement is signed between leaders of Malaya, Singapore, Sabah and Sarawak.
1963年8月31日：In this Malaysia Solidarity Day, Lee Kuan Yew declares de facto Independence for Singapore.
1963年9月16日：Malaysia is formed. Indonesia carries out its konfrontasi campaign.
1963年9月16日：Encik Yusof bin Ishak becomes the Yang di-Pertuan Negara of Singapura.
1963年9月21日：The PAP wins the 1963 State Elections, defeating the Barisan Sosialis and UMNO.
1964年4月25日：The PAP wins one seat in the Malaysian Federal Election. UMNO is outraged.
1964年7月21日：An ethnic riot between various Malays and Chinese, on Prophet Muhammad's birthday, 23 people are killed.
1965年3月10日：Indonesian saboteurs carry out the MacDonald House bombing, killing three people.
1965年5月：Lee Kuan Yew begins campaigning for a Malaysian Malaysia
1965年8月7日：Singapore and Malaysia sign the separation agreement.
1965年8月9日：The Malaysian Parliament votes to expel Singapore from the Federation; Singapore becomes independent after separating from Malaysia.
1965年9月21日：Singapore is admitted into the United Nations as the 117th member.
1965年10月15日：Singapore becomes the 23rd member of the Commonwealth of Nations.
1965年12月22日：Constitutional Amendment Act is passed and Encik Yusof bin Ishak becomes the first President of Singapore.
1966年8月3日：Singapore became the 104th member of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank.
1966年8月24日：The first daily recitation of the pledge of allegiance before the national flag was taken by 500,000 students at all 529 government and aided schools.
1967年：The Civilian Memorial is unveiled at the Kranji War Cemetery
1967年3月14日：The National Service bill is passed in the parliament.
1967年：Registrations for national service begins at the Central Manpower Base.
1967年6月12日：The issue of the first Singapore dollar.
1967年8月8日：Singapore joined the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) as one of the founding members.
1967年8月17日：The first batch of the army is drafted for national service.
1968年1月：Britain announces its intention to withdraw its armed forces from Singapore.
1968年4月19日：The PAP wins all seats in the 1968 General Election, which is boycotted by Barisan Sosialis.
1968年：National Archives was established.
1969年1月20日：The National Junior College, Singapore's first junior college was established.
1969年5月31日：The 1969 race riots of Singapore broke out after growing tension of the 13 May incident in Malaysia spilled over to Singapore.
1970年11月23日：Encik Yusof bin Ishak, first President of Singapore died while in office.
1971年1月2日：Dr Benjamin Henry Sheares becomes the second President of Singapore.
1971年10月31日：The last British military forces withdraws from Singapore.
1972年9月2日：The PAP wins the 1972 General Election.
1972年10月1日：The Singapore Airlines is formed.
1973年2月4日：The first Chingay parade is held in Singapore.
1973年7月14日：The Presidential Council for Minority Rights is set up to ensure minority would not be discriminated.
1973年7月21日：The construction of the National Stadium is completed and open in Kallang.
1974年1月15日：Hwa Chong Junior College, Singapore's first government-aided junior college was established.
1974年1月31日：Laju incident: Japanese Red Army bombs petroleum tanks at Pulau Bukom and hijacks a ferry boat.
1974年3月：The construction of Jurong Town Hall is completed.
1976年12月23日：The PAP wins all 69 seats in the 1976 General Election.
1976年：St James Power Station was decommissioned and its operations is taken over by Pasir Panjang and Jurong power stations.
1978年10月12日：Spyros disaster, was a major industrial disaster which claimed 76 lives.
1979年6月1日：First National Courtesy Campaign was launched.
1979年：Singapore becomes the world's second busiest port in terms of shipping tonnage.
1980年12月23日：The PAP wins all 75 seats in the 1980 General Election.
1981年5月12日：Dr Benjamin Henry Sheares (second President of Singapore) died while in office.
1981年7月1日：Paya Lebar Airport ceased operation and Singapore Changi Airport starts operation.
1981年10月23日：C V Devan Nair becomes the third President of Singapore.
1981年10月31日：Workers' Party of Singapore's Joshua Benjamin Jeyaretnam elected into Parliament, breaking a 16 years PAP monopoly of the House.
1982年1月1日：Singapore change its time zone to UTC+08:00.
1982年：The Civil Defence Programme are launched.
1983年1月29日：(Singapore Cable Car disaster) Eniwetok, a Panamanian-registered oil rig, hits the Singapore Cable Car system, sending two cabins plunging into the sea and killing seven people.
1984年8月22日：Non-Constituency Member of Parliament was introduced.

1984年12月22日：The PAP wins the 1984 General Election while two members of the opposition parties are elected as members of parliament. Three PAP women MPs are also elected, ending a 16 years absence of women representation in Parliament.
1985年3月28日：C V Devan Nair stepped down as the third President of Singapore.
1985年9月2日：Wee Kim Wee becomes the fourth President of Singapore.
1985年：Singapore went into its first ever recession which was induced by government policies.
1986年3月15日：Collapse of Hotel New World, killing 33 people and injuring 17 others.
1987年5月21日：16 people were arrested during Operation Spectrum and detained under the Internal Security Act. Another six were arrested on 20 June.
1988年9月3日：The PAP wins the 1988 General Election and group representation constituencies (GRC)s are introduced.
1990年7月6日：The East–West Line of the Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) is completed.
1990年11月22日：Singapore Changi Airport Terminal 2 begins operation.
1990年11月28日：Goh Chok Tong becomes the second Prime Minister of Singapore.
1991年3月26日：Four Pakistanis hijack Singapore Airlines Flight 117 and demand the release of Pakistan Peoples Party members from Pakistani jails.
1991年3月27日：Members of the Singapore Special Operations Force storm into Singapore Airlines Flight 117, killing all hijackers and freeing all passengers and crew members.
1991年8月31日：General elections are held. The result is a victory for the PAP, which wins 77 out of 81 seats.
1993年8月：National Archives of Singapore was formed.
1993年9月1日：Ong Teng Cheong becomes the first elected President and fifth President of Singapore.
1994年5月5日：American teenager Michael P. Fay is convicted and caned for vandalism.
1996年：The parliament passes the Maintenance of Parents law, a private member's bill introduced by Nominated Member of Parliament Woon Cheong Ming Walter.
1997年1月2日：PAP led by Goh Chok Tong wins a total of 81 out of 83 seats in the 1997 general election.
1997年12月19日：Silkair Flight 185 crashes into Musi River near Palembang, Sumatra, killing all 104 people on board.
1998年1月15日：Singapore and United States announces agreement for US ships to use a planned $35 million naval base from 2000.

1998年9月："The Singapore Story", the first volume of Lee Kuan Yew's memoirs is published. (Li, Guangyao; Lee, Kuan Yew (1998). The Singapore Story: Memoirs of Lee Kuan Yew. Prentice-Hall. ISBN 978-0130208033.)
1999年9月1日：S. R. Nathan becomes the sixth President of Singapore.
1999年：Singapore slips into recession during the 1997 Asian financial crisis.
2000年9月1日：Speakers' Corner is launched at Hong Lim Park.
2000年10月31日：Singapore Airlines Flight 006 crashes during take-off in Chiang Kai Shek International Airport, killing 83 people.

2000年："From Third World to First, The Singapore Story 1965-2000" the second volume of Lee Kuan Yew's memoirs is published. (From Third World to First, The Singapore Story 1965-2000. 3 August 1998. ISBN 978-9812049841.)
2001年：Economic recession in Singapore. (to 2003)
2001年1月：A pipeline feeding gas to Singapore from Indonesia's Natuna field in South China Sea opens.
2001年11月3日：The PAP wins 82 of 84 seats in the 2001 General Election.
2001年12月9日：15 suspected militants of Jemaah Islamiah are arrested for alleged bomb plot.
2001年12月27日：Tropical Storm Vamei, a rare tropic storm that occurs only once in 100 to 400 years, hits Singapore.
2002年1月13日：Singapore and Japan sign the Japan-Singapore Economic Agreement.
2002年10月12日：The Esplanade – Theatres on the Bay officially opened as Singapore's major performing arts centre.
2003年：SARS virus outbreak in Singapore.
2003年5月6日：Singapore and United States sign the United States-Singapore Free Trade Agreement (USS-FTA).
2003年10月29日：A major research center Biopolis opens.
2004年4月20日：A section of Nicoll Highway collapses, killing 4 people.
2004年8月12日：Lee Hsien Loong, Lee Kuan Yew's son becomes the third Prime Minister.
2004年12月：National Service was reduced from two and half years to two years.
2005年1月15日：Singapore and Malaysia settle dispute over land reclamation work.
2005年4月18日：The government approves the plan to legalise casino-gambling and build two Integrated Resorts.

2005年7月8日：In the aftermath of 7 July 2005 – London bombings, Transport Minister Yeo Cheow Tong announces plan to set up a new Police MRT Unit to enhance the security of Singapore's public transport. (CNA) Archived 25 July 2009 at the Wayback Machine
2005年8月17日：S R Nathan returns for his second term as President, following a walkover in the 2005 Singapore presidential election.
2005年8月27日：White Elephant Incident at Buangkok MRT station.
2005年12月31日：Singapore Police Academy ceased operational. Home Team Academy replaces the Police Academy and went operational on the following day at Old Choa Chu Kang Road.
2006年5月6日：The PAP, led by Lee Hsien Loong, wins 82 of 84 seats in the General Election.
2006年3月26日：Singapore Changi Airport opens the Budget Terminal.
2007年5月20日：The Marina Bay Floating Platform was opened.
2007年6月30日：The Former National Stadium was closed for re-construction.
2008年1月9日：Singapore Changi Airport opens its third passenger terminal.
2008年2月21日：The International Olympic Committee (IOC) awards the Youth Olympic Games hosting rights to Singapore ahead of Moscow by a vote of 53 to 44.
2008年2月27日：Jemiah Islamiah terrorist head Mas Selamat bin Kastari escapes from prison.
2008年9月：Singapore slips into recession due to the 2008 financial crisis. World economies hit badly; banks around the world collapse.
2008年10月16日：Singapore government guarantees all local and foreign currency fixed deposits with a $150 billion pool due to the 2008 financial crisis, joining governments around the world.
2010年：The 2010 Summer Youth Olympics were held.

2011年5月7日：PAP loses its grip on Aljunied Group Representation Constituency to the Workers' Party in the General Election. This is the first time an opposition party has captured a GRC since the inception of this scheme in 1988.
2011年5月28日：Universal Studios Singapore held its grand opening.
2011年7月1日：Tanjong Pagar Railway Station ceased operation and to be reserved as the Singapore Railway Museum.

2011年8月27日：Singaporeans, for the first time since the establishment of Presidential Election, will be voting for the next President after the 6th President of Singapore – SR Nathan stepped down on 31 August 2011. The candidates involves in this election includes – Dr Tan Keng Yam Tony, Mr Tan Jee Say, Mr Tan Kin Lian and Dr. Tan Cheng Bock.
2011年9月1日：Dr Tan Keng Yam Tony is sworn as the seventh President of Singapore.
2012年9月25日：Singapore Changi Airport closes The Budget Terminal to make way for the construction of future Singapore Changi Airport Terminal 4.

2013年2月16日：More than 3000 Singaporeans gathered at the Speakers' Corner, Singapore at Hong Lim Park for a non-partisan protest against the government's Population White Paper which projected a possible 6.9 million people in Singapore by 2030.
2013年6月24日：Haze in Singapore reaches 401 PSI, the worst in Singapore history.
2013年12月8日：The 2013 Little India riot took place after a fatal accident occurred at the junction of Race Course Road and Hampshire Road in Little India, Singapore.
2014年1月12日：Beginning construction of the new Thomson–East Coast MRT line (Thomson stretch) consisting of 31 new stations (including 7 interchanges).
2014年6月30日：The new National Stadium re-opened to the public after re-construction.
2015年3月23日：Lee Kuan Yew passes away. Singapore enters a one-week mourning period.
2015年6月30日：Ng Teng Fong General Hospital commences operation.
2015年7月22日：Jurong Community Hospital commences operation.
2015年8月9日：Singapore turns 50.
2015年9月11日：The PAP wins 83 of 89 seats in the 2015 General Election.
2016年7月21日：Beginning construction of the new Thomson–East Coast MRT line (East Coast stretch).
2016年8月22日：S R Nathan passes away. Singapore enters a one-week mourning period.
2017年2月11日：Nearly 300 year old Tembusu tree at Singapore Botanic Gardens falls, killing one and injured 4 others.
2017年4月17日：Othman Wok passes away. Singapore enters a one-week mourning period.
2017年：Halimah Yacob is elected as the first female president and eighth President of Singapore.
2017年10月31日：Singapore Changi Airport opens its fourth passenger terminal.
2018年6月12日：Singapore hosted the Singapore Summit, a summit meeting between North Korea and United States leaders.
2018年8月18日：Sengkang General Hospital opened to public.
2018年11月19日：A new passenger terminal in Seletar Airport opened, replacing the old building.
2019年1月28日：Singapore celebrates the 200th Anniversary of the foundation of modern Singapore by Stamford Raffles.
2019年4月17日：Jewel Changi Airport opens after a week-long preview.
2020年1月23日：The first COVID-19 case in Singapore was confirmed involving a 66-year-old Chinese national from Wuhan.
2020年7月10日：The PAP wins 83 of 93 seats in the 2020 General Election.
2022年4月1日：Singapore transition to the phase of Living with COVID-19 endemic.
2023年5月：The CPIB of Singapore investigates Ministers K. Shanmugam and Vivian Balakrishnan after accusations regarding their Ridout Road state-owned bungalows rentals.
2023年6月5日：Raffles Institution celebrates its bicentennial (200th year).
2023年：Minister of Transport S. Iswaran and tycoon Ong Beng Seng is arrested as part of a CPIB probe.

2023年7月17日：Speaker of Parliament Tan Chuan-Jin and MP for Tampines GRC (Tampines East) Cheng Li Hui simultaneously resign due to "propriety and personal conduct". Investigations into the matter confirmed that both were having an extramarital affair.

2023年7月19日：MP for Aljunied GRC (Serangoon) Leon Perera and Nicole Seah resign from office due to a leaked video showing an inappropriate exchange between the two. Later it was found that they were having an extramarital affair.
2023年9月14日：Tharman Shanmugaratnam is sworn in as Singapore’s ninth President of Singapore. He is the first non-Chinese presidential candidate to win in a contested presidential election in Singapore.

2024年1月18日：S. Iswaran resigns as Minister for Transport, Member of Parliament for West Coast GRC, and from People's Action Party after being charged with 27 counts relating to bribery and corruption by the CPIB. Chee Hong Tat succeeds Iswaran as Transport Minister.
2024年2月28日：Ahmed Salim becomes the first death row offender executed for murder in Singapore since 2019. The Bangladeshi painter was convicted for killing his Indonesian ex-girlfriend in 2018.
2024年3月2日：Former Raffles Institution headmaster and historian Eugene Wijeysingha, died at age 90.
2024年4月2日：Swimmer Joseph Schooling, who won Singapore's first ever Olympic gold medal, retires from swimming at 28.

2024年4月15日：Lee Hsien Loong announces his resignation as the 3rd Prime Minister of Singapore effective on 15 May 2024. Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Lawrence Wong will assume the position of the 4th Prime Minister of Singapore.
2024年4月22日：A six-car collision at the junction of Tampines Avenue 1 and 4 results in the death of two Malay Singaporeans: 17-year-old Temasek Junior College student and a 57-year-old woman.
2024年5月15日：Lawrence Wong is sworn in as the fourth Prime Minister of Singapore, succeeding Lee Hsien Loong.

2024年5月21日：Singapore Airlines Flight 321, flying from London to Singapore makes an emergency landing at Bangkok's Suvarnabhumi Airport after experiencing severe air turbulence over the Bay of Bengal, resulting in one death and at least 71 injured.

2024年6月14日：An accident involving a Dutch-flagged dredger and a stationary Singapore-flagged bunker vessel occurs at the Pasir Panjang terminal, causing an oil spill that forces the closure of three beaches in Sentosa Island.
1556年：A group of Dominican friars established the village of Lifau.
1600年：Portugal opened a trade route with East Timor.
1702年：The territory officially became a Portuguese colony, taking the name Portuguese Timor.
1769年：The capital was moved to Dili.
1859年：The border between Portuguese Timor and the Dutch East Indies was formally decided.
1910年：Beginning of the Great Rebellion
1912年：The rebellion was quashed with Portuguese troops from its colonies in Mozambique and Macau, resulting in the deaths of three thousand people.
1913年：The Portuguese and Dutch agreed to a formal division of the island.
1916年：A definitive border between Portuguese and Dutch territories was drawn in the Hague.
1941年：Portuguese Timor was occupied by Australian and Dutch forces.
1974年：Carnation Revolution: A revolution installed a new government.
1975年：Indonesian invasion of East Timor: Indonesia invaded East Timor.
1976年：Indonesian occupation of East Timor: Indonesia declared East Timor its 27th province.
1991年：Santa Cruz massacre: Pro-independence demonstrators in the Santa Cruz cemetery are shot.
1996年：The Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Carlos Filipe Ximenes Belo and José Ramos-Horta for their ongoing efforts to peacefully end the occupation.
1999年：East Timor Special Autonomy Referendum: A referendum resulted in 78% in favour of independence from Indonesia.
1999年：The International Force for East Timor (INTERFET) arrived to address an ongoing humanitarian and security crisis.
1999年：East Timor under United Nations administration (UNTAET).
2002年：Timor-Leste became an independent nation.
2005年：Timor-Leste joined the ASEAN Regional Forum, as a part of the country's bid for accession to ASEAN as a whole.
2006年：2006 East Timorese crisis: A national crisis that included a coup attempt swept the nation.
249年：Beginning of agriculture in South Africa.
300年：Early Iron Age communities are established in the northern and eastern regions of Southern Africa.
500年：A group of Bantu-speaking tribes migrate southwards and reach present-day KwaZulu-Natal.
696年：The Lemba people interact with Arab traders.
1400年：Founding of the capital settlement of Kweneng by the Sotho-Tswana people in what is now the Suikerbosrand Nature Reserve, south of Johannesburg.
1488年：The Portuguese explorer Bartolomeu Dias becomes the first European to reach the Cape of Good Hope.
1497年：The Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama circumnavigates the Cape of Good Hope and discovers Natal on Christmas Eve.
1501年：Portuguese navigator Pêro de Ataíde left an account of losing much of his fleet in a storm at the Post Office Tree.
1503年：The Portuguese explorer António de Saldanha reaches Table Bay and explores Table Mountain.1575 map of the Southern African coastline from Cape of Good Hope to Inhambane

1510年：At Table Bay, the Khoikhoi come to blows with the Portuguese. Portuguese explorer Francisco de Almeida and 64 Portuguese sailors are killed. This becomes the first military encounter between Europeans and indigenous South Africa people.
1575年：The Portuguese cartographer Manuel de Mesquita Perestrelo makes a first attempt to map the coast of South Africa.
1580年：Sir Francis Drake circumnavigates the Cape of Good Hope.

1647年：The Dutch ship Nieuwe Haerlem runs aground at the Cape of Good Hope. Under the leadership of Leendert Janszen, the stranded Dutch seamen stay at the Cape for a year. After their return to the Netherlands, Leendert Janszen and Matthijs Proot are commissioned by the Dutch East India Company (VOC) to write a report on their findings on the feasibility of the Cape as a refreshment station.

1649年：Leendert Janszen and Matthijs Proot submit their Remonstrantie, which describes their positive findings of the Cape of Good Hope. Jan van Riebeeck, who was on the ship that rescued the two, was asked to comment on the Remonstrantie and responded positively. The Gentlemen Seventeen, the board of the VOC, then decide that a refreshment station should be established at the Cape.
1652年：Jan van Riebeeck founded the Cape Town refreshment station on behalf of the VOC. Beginnings of the Dutch Cape Colony.
1652年：Bernert Willemsz Wijlant is the first white child born in South Africa.
1652年：The Company's Garden opens as South Africa's oldest garden.
1655年：Beginnings of maize and viticulture in South Africa.
1657年：The first European farmers arrive in Rondebosch.
1658年：The first slaves are deposited in the Cape Colony by the Dutch. Some of them being the first Muslims in South Africa.
1659年：The First Khoikhoi-Dutch War breaks out. (Then still called strandlopers by the Dutch)
1660年：Van Riebeeck's Hedge of indigenous wild almond is planted.
1663年：The Prince Edward Islands are discovered.
1664年：This is the first recorded crossing of Sir Lowry's Pass into the interior.
1665年：Foundation of the Dutch Reformed Church of South Africa.
links: Dutch Reformed Church in South Africa

items.text: 1666年：Start of construction on Castle of Good Hope.
1673年：The Second Khoikhoi–Dutch War breaks out. (After their click language, the strandlopers are now called the racial term, hottentots).
1679年：Governor Simon van der Stel founds Stellenbosch.
1682年：The Tuynhuys is built which would later become the Cape Town office of the President of South Africa.
1685年：Cape Governor Simon van der Stel gives settlers land near the Boschendal farm.
1685年：Groot Constantia is built; becoming the oldest colonial manor house in South Africa.
1687年：Paarl is established as the third-oldest town in South Africa.
1688年：The first Huguenots arrive in the Cape Colony and found Franschhoek.
1701年：Koopmans-de Wet House is built; becoming the oldest house museum in South Africa.
1706年：The Free Burgher Adam Tas files a complaint against Governor Willem Adriaan van der Stel and is imprisoned.
1713年：A smallpox epidemic strikes the Cape Colony; many khoikhoi die from this.
1751年：Governor Hendrik Swellengrebel founds Swellendam.
1755年：A second smallpox epidemic strikes the Cape Colony.
1761年：Governor Rijk Tulbagh establishes South Africa's first library.
1767年：A third smallpox epidemic strikes the Cape Colony.
1773年：Cape farmer Wolraad Woltemade drowns after rescuing 14 castaways.
1779年：The First of the Xhosa Wars breaks out between the Dutch and the Xhosa.
1779年：Dutch explorer Robert Jacob Gordon names the Orange River after the House of Orange-Nassau.
1780年：The Great Fish River is designated as the boundary of the Cape Colony.
1781年：A French fleet prevents the British conquest of the Cape Colony.
1784年：The Griqua cross the Gariep (Orange River) to the north under the leadership of Captain Cornelius Kok I.
1786年：The founding of Graaff-Reinet.
1789年：The Second of the Xhosa Wars breaks out.
1789年：The Merino sheep is imported to the Cape Colony.
1792年：Johan Isaac Rhenius opens a post office in a room next to the pantry at the Castle of Good Hope. This was the start of what becomes the South African Post Office.
1794年：The Auwal Mosque is founded in Bo-Kaap. It is South Africa's first mosque.

1795年：The United Kingdom captures the Cape Colony from the Netherlands in the Battle of Muizenberg. The Republic of Graaff-Reinet and Republic of Swellendam rebel but are annexed by the British Cape Colony.
1799年：The London Missionary Society sends missionaries to South Africa.
1799年：The Third of the Xhosa Wars breaks out.
1803年：Peace of Amiens. The United Kingdom transfers the Cape Colony back to the Netherlands.
1804年：Governor Jacob Abraham Uitenhage de Mist founds Uitenhage.
1806年：The United Kingdom conquers the Cape Colony from the Netherlands in the Battle of Blaauwberg, this time definitively.
1807年：The slave trade to South Africa is abolished, but slavery remains legal.
1808年：The first-ever recorded cricket match in South Africa takes place.
links: History of cricket in South Africa to 1918

items.text: 1809年：The Hottentot Proclamation is a decree by the 2nd Earl of Caledon aimed at restricting the mobility of Khoikhoi in the Cape Colony.
links: Du Pré Alexander, 2nd Earl of Caledon

items.text: 1810年：The Khoikhoi woman Saartjie Baartman is exhibited in London out of interest of her physique.
1811年：The Fourth of the Xhosa Wars breaks out.
1812年：Founding of Cradock and Grahamstown.
1813年：The Griqua found Griqualand West.
1815年：Rebellious Boers revolt against the British government at Slagtersnek, but are defeated.
1816年：Five of the Slagtersnek insurgents are hanged in dramatic circumstances.
1816年：Shaka founds the Zulu Kingdom.
1818年：The Mthethwa king Dingiswayo is killed by the Ndwandwe king Zwide. The power vacuum is filled by the Zulu king Shaka.
1818年：The Fifth of the Xhosa Wars breaks out.
1819年：The Zulus defeat the Ndwandwe in the Ndwandwe–Zulu War.
1820年：Beginning of the Mfecane.
1820年：The Griqua captain Adam Kok II leaves Griqualand West and is succeeded by Andries Waterboer of the San. The Bergenaars split off from the Griqua.
1820年：Thousands of 1820s British settlers arrive in the Cape Colony.
1820年：Founding of Port Elizabeth.
1820年：The South African Astronomical Observatory is established as the Royal Observatory, Cape of Good Hope.
links: Royal Observatory, Cape of Good Hope

items.text: 1822年：Founding of Lesotho by Moshoeshoe I.
1822年：The Dutch language is abolished in the civil service and court of the Cape Colony.

1823年：Lieutenant Mzilikazi refuses to give up his loot to the Zulu king Shaka. He flees with his followers over the Drakensberg and conquers the Transvaal. Expansion of the Mfecane and rise of the Northern Ndebele people.
1823年：The Oorlam people, led by Jonker Afrikaner, leave for south-west Africa.
1823年：The missionary John Philip founds Philippolis, the first European settlement of the Transorangia.
1824年：Founding of Port Natal, later called Durban.
1824年：The Zulu king Shaka comes into contact with the white settlers.
1824年：The South African Commercial Advertiser starts publication in Cape Town as South Africa's first independent newspaper.
1825年：The South African pound is introduced in the Cape Colony.
1825年：The Iziko South African Museum is founded. It moved to the company's Garden in 1897.
1828年：The Zulu king Shaka is killed by his half-brother Dingane, who succeeds him as king.
1829年：The University of Cape Town is founded as the South African College.
1830年：Afrikaans is first written in Arabic.
1832年：The Matabele king Mzilikazi is driven west by Dingane.
1834年：Abolition of slavery in the Cape Colony.
1834年：The Sixth of the Xhosa Wars breaks out.
1835年：The Great Trek begins. The Voortrekkers Louis Tregardt and Hans van Rensburg leave the Cape Colony with their followers.
1835年：Founding of British Kaffraria.
1836年：More Voortrekkers leave the Cape Colony. Mzilikazi sends his army against them, but is defeated at the Battle of Vegkop.
1836年：The Voortrekkers led by Hans van Rensburg are murdered in what is now Mozambique.
1837年：Mzilikazi is driven out of the Transvaal by the Voortrekkers led by Hendrik Potgieter. He founds the Kingdom of Mthwakazi in modern-day Zimbabwe.
1838年：The Voortrekker Piet Retief is murdered by the Zulu king Dingane; 532 of Retief's followers are killed in the Weenen massacre.
1838年：The Voortrekker Piet Uys is killed in the Battle of Italeni.
1838年：The Voortrekker Andries Pretorius avenges Retief at the Battle of Blood River, devastatingly defeating the Zulus.
1838年：The Voortrekker Hendrik Potgieter founds Potchefstroom.
1838年：First National Bank opens as the Eastern triocrees Province Bank in Grahamstown.
1839年：The Voortrekkers found the Natalia Republic and Pietermaritzburg.
1840年：The Voortrekkers support a successful coup by Mpande, the half-brother of the Zulu king Dingane. Dingane flees and is killed. Andries Pretorius crowns Mpande as Zulu king.
1841年：The explorer David Livingstone arrives in Cape Town.
1842年：The United Kingdom conquers the Natalia Republic. Many Voortrekkers leave Natal.
1843年：The Port Elizabeth Cricket Club is founded, making it the oldest cricket club in South Africa.
1844年：The Republic of Natalia is renamed the British Natal Colony.
1844年：The Voortrekker Hendrik Potgieter founds the Winburg-Potchefstroom Republic.
1845年：The Voortrekker Hendrik Potgieter founds Ohrigstad.
1845年：Old Mutual is founded as a mutual insurance company by John Fairbairn, together with others including Saul Solomon.
1845年：The Arderne Gardens is established.
1846年：Founding of Bloemfontein.
1846年：The Seventh of the Xhosa Wars breaks out.
1848年：The Transorangia is renamed the British Orange River Sovereignty. The Winburg-Potchefstroom Republic ceases to exist.
1848年：Governor Harry Smith, 1st Baronet defeats Andries Pretorius at the Battle of Boomplaats. Pretorius flees to the Transvaal with his followers.
1849年：The first Volksraad of Transvaal unites.
1849年：Founding of Lydenburg.
1849年：Anti-convict demonstrations take place to prevent the Cape Colony becoming a penal colony.
1850年：The Eight of the Xhosa Wars breaks out.
1850年：Founding of Rustenburg.
1850年：The first railway line opens in Durban.
1852年：The United Kingdom recognises the independence of the Zuid-Afrikaansche Republiek (ZAR) at the Zandrivier Convention.
1852年：The Griekwa captain Andries Waterboer dies and is succeeded by his son Nicolaas Waterboer.
1852年：The Voortrekker Hendrik Potgieter dies and is succeeded by his son Piet Potgieter.
1853年：The Voortrekker Andries Pretorius dies and is succeeded by his son Marthinus Wessel Pretorius.
1853年：The Parliament of the Cape of Good Hope is opened at Tuynhuys.
links: Parliament of the Cape of Good Hope

items.text: 1854年：The United Kingdom recognises the independence of the Orange Free State at the Orange River Convention.

1854年：After the murder of dozens of Boers, the ZAR launches a punitive expedition against the Southern Ndebele king Makapan. Piet Potgieter and over 2000 Southern Ndebele are killed in the Siege of Makapans Cave.
1855年：Founding of Pretoria, named after Andries Pretorius.
1856年：An apocalyptic prophecy by the Xhosa girl Nongqawuse leads to the starvation of some 40 000 Xhosa.
1856年：The first constitution of the ZAR is approved by the Volksraad, but not accepted by all inhabitants.
1856年：The Republic of Lydenburg splits from the ZAR.
1857年：Marthinus Wessel Pretorius is elected as the first State President of the ZAR.
links: State President of the South African Republic

items.text: 1857年：The Republic of Zoutpansberg splits from the ZAR.
1857年：The Cape Argus daily newspaper is founded.
1858年：The final constitution of the ZAR is approved by the Volksraad.
1858年：The Republic of Zoutpansberg rejoins with the ZAR.
1858年：The First Basotho War breaks out between the Orange Free State and the Basotho.
1859年：Establishment of the Reformed Church in South Africa.
1860年：Pretoria replaces Potchefstroom as the capital of the ZAR.
1860年：The Republic of Lydenburg rejoins with the ZAR.
1860年：La Rochelle Girls' High School, together with Rhenish Girls' High School, open as the oldest girls' schools in South Africa.
1860年：Indian indentured labourers are transported on the ship Truro from Madras to Durban.
1861年：The Griqua leave the Orange Free State under the leadership of Captain Adam Kok III.
1862年：The Griqua captain Adam Kok III founds Griqualand East.
1864年：End of the Transvaal Civil War.
1864年：Johannes Henricus Brand is elected State President of the Orange Free State.
links: State President of the Orange Free State

items.text: 1865年：The Second Basotho War breaks out.
1866年：British Kaffraria is annexed by the Cape Colony.
1866年：Founding of East London.
1866年：The Eureka Diamond is found in Griqualand West.
1866年：Stellenbosch University has its origins in the opening of the Stellenbosch Gymnasium.
1867年：The Third Basotho War breaks out.
1867年：Schoemansdal is burnt down by the Venda.
1867年：Mining starts with the discovery of a diamond on the banks of the Orange River.
1868年：Lesotho is renamed British Basutoland.
1868年：The Basters, led by Captain Hermanus van Wyk, leave for Rehoboth in south-west Africa.
1868年：Paarl Boys' High School opens.
1870年：Griqualand West is annexed by the United Kingdom. The founding of New Rush, later Kimberley. The diamond fields are claimed by the Griqua, the Orange Free State, the ZAR and the Cape Colony.
1870年：Start of the first major diamond rush, and formation of the short-lived Diggers' Republic in Barkly West.

1871年：The diamond fields are assigned to the Griqua by Governor Robert William Keate of the Colony of Natal. As a result, Marthinus Wessel Pretorius resigns as State President of the ZAR. Cecil Rhodes leaves for Kimberley.
1872年：Thomas François Burgers is elected State President of the ZAR.
1872年：John Molteno is appointed the first Prime Minister of the Cape Colony.
links: Prime Minister of the Cape Colony

items.text: 1872年：The Zulu king Mpande dies and is succeeded by his son Cetshwayo.
1873年：The University of South Africa is founded as the University of the Cape of Good Hope.
links: University of the Cape of Good Hope

items.text: 1873年：Pilgrim's Rest becomes the second of the Transvaal gold fields and attracts a rush of prospectors.
1874年：Start of the Dorsland Trek through the Kalahari Desert.
1874年：KwaZulu-Natal National Botanical Garden is established.
1875年：The Houses of Parliament are built in Cape Town.
1875年：Establishment of the Genootskap van Regte Afrikaners; a society to promote the Afrikaans language.
1876年：Sekhukhune defeats the Transvaal army. The ZAR is in disarray.
1876年：The first tunnel of the Hex River Tunnels reaches Worcester.
1877年：Sir Theophilus Shepstone proclaims the ZAR as the British Transvaal Colony.
1877年：Paul Kruger's first peaceful attempt to restore ZAR independence fails.
1877年：The Ninth of the Xhosa Wars breaks out.
1877年：Molteno Dam begins construction to supply Cape Town with water.
1878年：Walvis Bay and the Penguin Islands are annexed by the Cape Colony.
1878年：Paul Kruger's second peaceful attempt to restore ZAR independence fails.
1878年：The last of the quagga in the Orange Free State become extinct in the wild.

1879年：The Anglo-Zulu War breaks out between the United Kingdom and the Zulus. The war is won by the United Kingdom, although they suffer a crushing defeat at the Battle of Isandlwana. The United Kingdom conquers Zululand, and the area is absorbed into the Colony of Natal.
1879年：Griqualand East is fully annexed into the Cape Colony.
1879年：Founding of the Afrikanerbond.
1880年：Cecil Rhodes founds De Beers Mining Company.
1880年：Griqualand West is annexed by the Cape Colony.
1880年：The Boers of the Transvaal revolt at Paardekraal. A triumvirate consisting of Paul Kruger, Marthinus Wessel Pretorius and Piet Joubert restore the ZAR at Heidelberg .
1880年：The First Boer War breaks out between the ZAR and the United Kingdom.
1881年：The ZAR defeats the United Kingdom at the Battle of Majuba Hill. The Pretoria Convention ends the First Boer War in favour of the ZAR.
1881年：South Africa's first stock exchange, the Kimberley Royal Stock Exchange opens on 2 February.
1882年：Founding of the Republic of Stellaland and State of Goshen.
1882年：Kimberly becomes the first city in the Southern Hemisphere and the second in the world to integrate electric street lights into its infrastructure.
1882年：Dutch is recognised as an official language of the Cape Colony.
1883年：Paul Kruger is elected State President of the ZAR.
1883年：Unification of the Republic of Stellaland and the neighbouring State of Goshen to form the United States of Stellaland.
1884年：The London Convention revises the Pretoria Convention.
1884年：Founding of the Nieuwe Republiek.
1885年：Bechuanaland is annexed by the British Empire. Stellaland and Goshen are annexed and added to Bechuanaland.
1886年：Gold is discovered at Witwatersrand.
1886年：Founding of Johannesburg, which is overrun by foreign miners (uitlanders).
1886年：Founding of Klein Vrystaat.
1887年：Zululand is annexed by the Natal Colony.
1887年：Establishment of the Nederlandsch-Zuid-Afrikaansche Spoorwegmaatschappij (NZASM) railway company in the ZAR.
1887年：The Johannesburg Stock Exchange is established with 68 companies.
1888年：Paul Kruger is elected state president of the ZAR for the second time.
1888年：Francis William Reitz is elected State President of the Orange Free State.
1888年：Nieuwe Republiek is annexed by the ZAR.
1888年：Nedbank is founded as the Nederlandsche Bank en Credietvereeniging voor Zuid-Afrika ("Dutch Bank and Credit Union for South Africa")
1889年：South Africa becomes the third test-playing nation when it plays against England at Port Elizabeth.
1890年：Cecil Rhodes is appointed Prime Minister of the Cape Colony.
1891年：Klein Vrystaat is annexed by the ZAR.
1892年：The Franchise and Ballot Act is passed by Cecil Rhodes to disenfranchise black Africans; it triples the wealth requirement to vote. A precursor act to Apartheid that followed.
1893年：Paul Kruger is elected for the third time as state president of the ZAR.
1893年：Gandhi arrives in Durban.
1893年：The Excelsior Diamond is discovered at the Jagersfontein Mine. It is the largest in the world until the 1905 discovery of the Cullinan Diamond.
1894年：Swaziland is annexed by the ZAR.
1894年：The Glen Grey Act is passed, thus beginning the segregation of races.
1895年：Marthinus Theunis Steyn is elected state president of the Orange Free State.
1895年：The railway line from Pretoria to Lourenço Marques (Maputo) is officially opened and operated by the NZASM.
1895年：The Jameson Raid begins. Leander Starr Jameson, commanded by Cecil Rhodes, invades the ZAR.

1895年：The Graaff Electric Lighting Works at the site of the Molteno Dam, becomes the first hydro-electric plant in South Africa, the first power plant in Cape Town, and the second electric power plant in South Africa.
1895年：Groenkloof Nature Reserve is the first game sanctuary in Africa.
1895年：The Jubilee Diamond is discovered.

1896年：The Jameson Raid is crushed and Jameson is imprisoned. A telegram congratulating State President Paul Kruger from Kaiser Wilhelm II of Germany causes a scandal. Cecil Rhodes steps down as Prime Minister.
1896年：The South African School of Mines is established, which would later become the University of the Witwatersrand and the University of Pretoria.
1898年：Paul Kruger is elected state president of the ZAR for the fourth time.
1898年：Paul Kruger lays the foundations for the Sabie Game Reserve, which later became Kruger National Park.

1899年：Negotiations at the Bloemfontein Conference between State President Paul Kruger and Cape Colony Governor Alfred Milner fail. The Second Boer War breaks out between the ZAR, the Orange Free State and the United Kingdom.

1900年：The Orange Free State and the ZAR are conquered by the United Kingdom, but the Bittereinders refuse to give up the fight. The United Kingdom uses the scorched earth tactic of burning down farms and imprisoning Boer women and children in concentration camps. State President Paul Kruger leaves for Europe.
1901年：Emily Hobhouse sounds the alarm about the concentration camps of the Boer War.

1902年：The Treaty of Vereeniging ends the Second Boer War. The ZAR and the Orange Free State are annexed by the United Kingdom. The ZAR is renamed the British Transvaal Colony and the Orange Free State the British Orange River Colony.
1903年：The Union Observatory opens in Johannesburg. It's known for the discovery of Proxima Centauri by Robert Innes in 1915, and 6,000 double stars.
1905年：The Cullinan Diamond is discovered, the largest gem-quality rough diamond ever found.
1904年：63 000 Chinese miners arrive in the Transvaal Colony.
1906年：Start of the first 24-hour weather forecasts in South Africa by Harry Edwin Wood.
1907年：The Transvaal Colony and the Orange River Colony are given self-governance. Abraham Fischer becomes the first (and only) Prime Minister of the Orange River Colony.
1908年：Reggie Walker becomes South Africa's first-ever Olympic medallist at the 1908 Summer Olympics, and the youngest ever male champion in the Olympics 100-metre.

1910年：The Cape Colony, Natal Colony, Transvaal Colony and Orange River Colony are together renamed the four provinces of the Union of South Africa and granted Dominion status. Louis Botha becomes the first Prime Minister of South Africa.
1910年：Founding of the South African Party.
1910年：Construction of the Union Buildings begins.
1912年：Founding of the African National Congress (ANC).
1912年：The Union Defence Force is established.
1912年：Establishment of the Union Observatory.
1913年：Founding of the National Party.

1913年：The Natives Land Act is enacted, regulating the acquisition of land by black South Africans. It defined less than one-tenth of South Africa as Black "reserves" from which they were allowed purchase or lease of land. Land outside of this was prohibited.
1913年：The first significant miners' strike occurs.
1914年：World War I breaks out and South Africa declares war on Germany. A revolt by Boer veterans is put down by the South African Army.
links: Military history of South Africa during World War I

items.text: 1915年：South Africa captures German South West Africa from Germany.
1915年：Proxima Centauri (the closest star to the Sun) is discovered at the Union Observatory by Robert Innes.
1916年：The Native Trust and Land Act is passed.
1918年：Establishment of the Afrikaner Broederbond which is credited with the conception of Apartheid.
1919年：South West Africa becomes a South African administered mandate.
1919年：Prime Minister Louis Botha dies and is succeeded by Jan Smuts as the second Prime Minister of South Africa.
1919年：Sol Plaatje becomes the first black South African to write a novel in English – Mhudi.
1921年：Founding of the South African Communist Party.
1921年：The South African Reserve Bank is established.
1922年：The Rand Rebellion by white miners in Witwatersrand is crushed by the South African Army, killing 153.
1922年：The University of the Witwatersrand is granted full university status.
1922年：Rhodesian colonists reject admitting Rhodesia as a fifth province of the Union.
1923年：Introduction of the Natives (Urban Areas) Act, meant to segregate the population.
1923年：Eskom is founded.
1923年：Hartbeespoort Dam is opened.
1923年：Radio broadcasting begins.
1924年：J. B. M. Hertzog is elected third Prime Minister of South Africa.
1925年：Afrikaans is recognised by the South African government as a distinct language and equates it as a variety of Dutch.
links: Official Languages of the Union Act, 1925

items.text: 1926年：Kruger National Park is established as South Africa's first national park.
1928年：The new flag of South Africa based on the Prinsenvlag is introduced.
1930年：White women are allowed the right to vote in the Women's Enfranchisement Act.
1930年：The Transvaal University College changes its name to the University of Pretoria and is established separately.
1934年：The Status of the Union Act, 1934 is passed. It declares the Union of South Africa to be a "sovereign independent state" and explicitly adopts the Statute of Westminster into South African law.
1934年：The South African Party and National Party merge to form the United Party.
1938年：The Coelacanth is discovered by Marjorie Courtenay-Latimer living off the coast of South Africa at the Chalumna River.
1939年：World War II breaks out. Against the wishes of Prime Minister J. B. M. Hertzog, South Africa declares war on Germany. Hertzog resigns and Jan Smuts is re-elected Prime Minister of South Africa.
links: Military history of South Africa during World War II

items.text: 1941年：South African troops fight against Nazi Germany in Ethiopia.

1942年：The Imperial Military Hospital, Baragwanath is opened during WWII. Later becoming the Chris Hani Baragwanath Hospital; the largest hospital in Africa and one of the largest hospitals in the world.
1945年：The Council for Scientific and Industrial Research is established.
links: Council for Scientific and Industrial Research

items.text: 1946年：The Native Laws Commission (Fagan Commission) recommends relaxation of restrictions on black South Africans living and working in urban areas.
1948年：The Sauer Commission (a response to the Fagan Commission) recommends segregation should continue and be implemented across all social and economic areas of life.
1948年：South Africa annexes the Prince Edward Islands.
1948年：D. F. Malan is elected Prime Minister of South Africa.
1948年：Start of Apartheid after the 1948 South African general election.
1948年：The Atomic Energy Board is established.
1949年：The Voortrekker Monument is unveiled in Pretoria.
1949年：The Prohibition of Mixed Marriages Act is passed.
1950年：The first of the Group Areas Act laws passes, codifying racial segregation.
1952年：Van Riebeeck's Day celebrates the 300th anniversary of the Dutch presence in South Africa.
1952年：Jan Smuts International Airport (now known as O. R. Tambo International Airport) is opened to become Africa's second busiest airport.
links: List of busiest airports in Africa

items.text: 1952年：Defiance Campaign against Unjust Laws is the first "large-scale, multi-racial political mobilisation against apartheid laws under a common leadership."
1954年：The Tomlinson Commission reports on the economic viability of the native reserves (later formed into the bantustans).
1955年：The Freedom Charter is adopted by the Congress Alliance.
1956年：The Women's March is a protest against the introduction of Apartheid pass laws in 1952.
1956年：The Treason Trial takes place.
1957年：Die Stem van Suid-Afrika is introduced as the national anthem of South Africa.
1957年：The Protea is South Africa's first production car.
1958年：Hendrik Verwoerd is elected Prime Minister of South Africa.
1958年：The Pan-African Congress splits from the ANC.
1960年：Protests in Sharpeville leads to the killing of 69 people by the South African Police.
1960年：Prime Minister Hendrik Verwoerd is injured in a failed assassination attempt.
1960年：Human rights activist Albert Luthuli wins the Nobel Peace Prize.
1960年：437 miners are killed in the Coalbrook mining disaster.
1961年：The Union of South Africa leaves the British Commonwealth and becomes a republic.
1961年：Introduction of the South African Rand as the currency.
1961年：Creation of Umkhonto we Sizwe, the military wing of the ANC.
1961年：FIFA suspends South Africa.
1962年：The United Nations passes Resolution 1761 calling for a boycott of South Africa. The country is no longer allowed to participate in the Olympic Games.
1964年：Nelson Mandela makes his I Am Prepared to Die speech in the Rivonia Trial. He is sentenced to life imprisonment to serve on Robben Island.
1964年：The Tsitsikamma Marine Protected Area is declared as South Africa's first Marine Protected Area
links: Marine protected areas of South Africa

items.text: 1965年：The nuclear research reactor SAFARI-1 comes online at Pelindaba. It is now used in the production of molybdenum-99.
1966年：Start of the South African Border War.
1966年：Prime Minister Hendrik Verwoerd is assassinated by Dimitri Tsafendas.
1966年：BJ Vorster is elected Prime Minister of South Africa
1967年：The first ever successful heart transplant is performed by cardiac surgeon Christiaan Barnard.
1971年：The Standard Encyclopaedia of Southern Africa is published.
1973年：The Carlton Centre opens as the tallest skyscraper in the Southern Hemisphere.
1975年：Creation of the Inkatha Freedom Party.
1975年：South Africa invade Angola in Operation Savannah.
1976年：The Soweto uprising begins in response to the introduction of Afrikaans as the medium of instruction in black schools.

1976年：New Zealand plays rugby matches against South Africa regardless of the international boycott. Because New Zealand is not suspended by the International Olympic Committee, 28 countries boycotted the 1976 Summer Olympics.
links: New Zealand national rugby union team

items.text: 1976年：South Africa's (and Africa's) first and only nuclear power station Koeberg Nuclear Power Station begins construction.
1976年：Television in South Africa is introduced.
1977年：Human rights activist Steve Biko dies after being brutally beaten by the South African Police.
1977年：Creation of the Progressive Federal Party.
1979年：South Africa runs its first nuclear weapons test.
1981年：Project Coast, a clandestine chemical and biological weapons programme, is instituted by the South African Defence Force.
1982年：Founding of the Conservative Party.
1982年：South Africa builds its first operational nuclear weapon (code-named Hobo and later called Cabot) with a yield of 6 kilotons of TNT.
1983年：First diagnosis of AIDS in South Africa.
1983年：Dutch is no longer one of South Africa’s official languages.
1983年：The Bloukrans Bridge is opened as the highest concrete arch in Africa. It is the site of the world's highest commercial bridge bungee jumping, Bloukrans Bridge Bungy.
1984年：P. W. Botha is elected State President of South Africa.
1984年：Archbishop Desmond Tutu wins the Nobel Peace Prize for his peaceful opposition to Apartheid.
1984年：Reactor Unit 1 of the Koeberg Nuclear Power Station is synchronised to the grid.
1985年：State President P. W. Botha gives his Rubicon speech in which he refuses to change his position regarding the Apartheid system, including the release of Mandela.
1985年：Reactor Unit 2 of the Koeberg Nuclear Power Station is synchronised to the grid.
1986年：P. W. Botha declares a state of emergency over South Africa after the United States introduces the Comprehensive Anti-Apartheid Act.
1986年：The Lesotho Highlands Water Project is realised.
1988年：The first South African IP address is granted to Rhodes University.
1989年：State President P. W. Botha suffers a stroke and resigns. F. W. de Klerk is elected State President of South Africa.
1989年：Founding of the Democratic Party.
1989年：South Africa ends its nuclear weapons programme and dismantles six fully completed nuclear weapons.
links: South Africa and weapons of mass destruction

items.text: 1990年：Following negotiations to end apartheid in South Africa, State President F. W. de Klerk announces reforms in Apartheid policy. The ban on the African National Congress is lifted and Nelson Mandela is released.
links: Negotiations to end apartheid in South Africa

items.text: 1990年：The mandate of South West Africa becomes independent as the Republic of Namibia.
1990年：The .za namespace is introduced.
1990年：First flight of the Denel Rooivalk attack helicopter.
1991年：Passing of the Abolition of Racially Based Land Measures Act which repealed many of the apartheid laws that imposed race-based restrictions on land ownership and land use.
links: Abolition of Racially Based Land Measures Act

items.text: 1992年：The white people of South Africa approve of De Klerk's reforms in a referendum.
1992年：45 people are killed in the Boipatong Massacre, an attack committed by supporters of the Inkatha Freedom Party.
1992年：28 protestors demanding Ciskei be reincorporated into South Africa (and 1 soldier) are killed in the Bisho massacre.
1993年：Nelson Mandela and F. W. de Klerk receive the Nobel Peace Prize.
1993年：Communist politician Chris Hani is murdered by a far-right extremist.
1993年：The Interim Constitution is put into law.
1994年：South Africa's first general election takes place. Nelson Mandela is elected President of South Africa.
1994年：The Bantustans are dissolved. President Lucas Mangope of the bantustan Bophuthatswana rebels and is supported by the Afrikaner Weerstandsbeweging, but is deposed by the South African Army.
1994年：South Africa is divided into nine provinces.
1994年：The new Flag of South Africa is introduced.
1994年：Walvis Bay is handed over to Namibia.
1994年：Founding of the Freedom Front Plus party.
1994年：South Africa rejoins the Commonwealth as a republic.
1994年：Freedom Day is first celebrated.
1995年：Establishment of the South African Truth and Reconciliation Commission. Desmond Tutu becomes chairman.
1995年：South Africa host and win the 1995 Rugby World Cup.
1995年：The Constitutional Court abolishes the death penalty.
1996年：The official languages of the Republic are described as Sepedi, Sesotho, Setswana, siSwati, Tshivenda, Xitsonga, Afrikaans, English, isiNdebele, isiXhosa and isiZulu.
1996年：SANAE IV is built as an Antarctic research base.
1997年：The final Constitution of South Africa becomes effective.
1997年：The new National anthem of South Africa is introduced.
1998年：Table Mountain National Park is established.
1998年：The Proteas win the 1998 ICC KnockOut Trophy.
1999年：Thabo Mbeki is elected President of South Africa.
1999年：iSimangaliso Wetland Park is listed as a World Heritage Site.
links: List of World Heritage Sites in South Africa

items.text: 1999年：SUNSAT becomes the first launched South African satellite.
1999年：South Africa becomes a full G20 member.
1999年：Calls for investigation into large-scale government corruption with the South African Arms Deal.
2000年：Adoption of the new Coat of arms of South Africa.
links: Coat of arms of South Africa

items.text: 2000年：Creation of the Democratic Alliance.
2000年：The Maloti-Drakensberg Park is added as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
2000年：The Institute for Justice and Reconciliation, the successor to the Truth and Reconciliation Commission, is established.
2002年：Mark Shuttleworth becomes the first South African to travel to space as a space tourist; and the first African from an independent country to travel to space.
2003年：The South African National Antarctic Programme is formed.
2004年：Eskom announces that a Pebble bed modular reactor will be built at Koeberg (this is later abandoned).

2005年：The Vredefort impact structure (created by one the largest ever asteroids (20 to 25 kilometres in diameter) to strike the Earth, 2.023 billion years ago) is added to the list of UNESCO World Heritage Sites for its geologic interest.
2005年：The Southern African Large Telescope (SALT) opens as the largest optical telescope in the Southern Hemisphere.
links: List of largest optical reflecting telescopes

items.text: 2007年：South Africa wins the 2007 Rugby World Cup in France.
2008年：President Thabo Mbeki loses the power struggle over the ANC to Jacob Zuma and resigns. His supporters establish the Congress of the People.
links: Congress of the People (South African political party)

items.text: 2008年：Xenophobic attacks against immigrants kill 62 people.
2009年：Jacob Zuma is elected President of South Africa.
2009年：The Spy Tapes Scandal implicates Jacob Zuma in corruption relating to the Arms Deal.
2009年：Mandela Day is launched worldwide to celebrate the idea that each individual has the power to transform the world.
2010年：South Africa hosts the 2010 FIFA World Cup.
2010年：South Africa joins BRICS as its fifth member.
2012年：Table Mountain is named as one of the New 7 Wonders of Nature.
2013年：Creation of the Economic Freedom Fighters.
2013年：Nelson Mandela dies at the age of 95.
2014年：Cape Town becomes World Design Capital.
2015年：Demonstrations take place against the preservation of the statue of Cecil Rhodes at the University of Cape Town.
