2016年：Wayde van Niekerk becomes the men's world record holder of the 400 metres at the Olympics with a time of 43.03 seconds.
2016年：The Centre for High Performance Computing launches the Lengau supercomputer cluster.
links: Centre for High Performance Computing SA

items.text: 2017年：The Garden Route is added to UNESCO's World Network of Biosphere Reserves.
2017年：The Zeitz Museum of Contemporary Art Africa is opened as the largest museum of contemporary art from Africa.
links: Zeitz Museum of Contemporary Art Africa

items.text: 2018年：President Zuma, accused of corruption, resigns under pressure from the ANC. The party elects Cyril Ramaphosa as his successor.
2018年：The Judicial Commission of Inquiry into Allegations of State Capture, Corruption and Fraud in the Public Sector including Organs of State (Zondo Commission) is underway.
2019年：South Africa wins the 2019 Rugby World Cup in Japan.
2020年：The COVID-19 pandemic spreads to South Africa, with the first confirmed case announced on 5 March.
2020年：The Meerkat National Park is proclaimed. It will house the Square Kilometre Array, MeerKAT and HERA telescopes.
2021年：Former president Jacob Zuma is imprisoned in contempt of court.
2021年：The Zuma riots, a wave of civil unrest occurs in KwaZulu-Natal and Gauteng, killing 354 people.
2022年：The final of the three-part report of the Judicial Commission of Inquiry into State Capture is published.
2022年：Severe floods across KwaZulu-Natal leave at least 435 people dead.
2022年：Banyana Banyana win the Women's Africa Cup of Nations.
links: South Africa women's national soccer team

items.text: 2023年：South Africa experiences a cholera outbreak.
2023年：The 15th BRICS summit is held in South Africa, expanding its membership.
2023年：The Public Protector Busisiwe Mkhwebane is impeached.
2023年：South Africa wins the 2023 Rugby World Cup in France.
2023年：South African Sign Language becomes the twelfth official language.
2024年：South Africa presents its case at the International Court of Justice, accusing Israel of genocidal conduct in the Gaza Strip.
2024年：The National Health Insurance Act is signed into law.
2024年：The 2024 South African general election takes place and Cyril Ramaphosa is re-elected as president of a landmark national unity government.
2025年：The first G20 summit on the African continent is held in Johannesburg as South Africa assumes the presidency.
2025年：The Proteas win the ICC World Test Championship.
約前73000年：Humans settle in present-day Botswana.
約1000年：Ancestors of the Kalanga people and the Sotho-Tswana peoples migrate to present-day Botswana.
約1400年：Ancestors of the Kgalagadi people and Yeyi people migrate to present-day Botswana.
約1450年：The Kingdom of Butua is established by the Chibundule dynasty of the Kalanga people.
約1500年：Ancestors of the Tswana people, Subia people, Birwa people, and Pedi people migrate to present-day Botswana.
約1650年：Ancestors of the Kwena people migrate to present-day Botswana.
約1680年：Nichasike overthrows the Chinbundule dynasty and seizes power in the Kingdom of Butua.
約1730年：The Ngwaketse people split from the Kwena people.
約1750年：The Ngwato people split from the Kwena people.
約1795年：The Tawana people split from the Ngwato people.
1824年：July – Robert Moffat of the London Missionary Society makes contact with the Ngwaketse people.
1825年：Sebetwane of the Kololo people leads attacks against the Kwena and Ngwaketse peoples.
1826年：28 August – Sebego I of the Ngwaketse people defeats the Kololo people at Dithubaruba.
約1828年：The Kingdom of Butua defeats the Ngwato people at Matopos.
1835年：The Kololo people defeat the Tawana people.
1841年：July – David Livingstone of the London Missionary Society begins missionary work among the Tswana people.
1842年：The Northern Ndebele people of present-day Zimbabwe attack the Kwena people, Kgafela Kgatla, and Ngwato people. Macheng, heir to the Ngwato chiefdom, is taken prisoner.
1844年：The Ngwato people use firearms to repel the Northern Ndebele people at Shoshong.
1844年：Two rival groups emerge among the Ngwaketse people after the death of Sebego I.
1848年：1 October – David Livingstone baptises Sechele I of the Kwena people, who becomes head of the local church.
1852年：The Batswana–Boer War begins.
1852年：The Tlôkwa people, Lete people, Hurutshe people, Mmanaana Kgatla, and Rolong people migrate to present-day Botswana.
1852年：30 August – The Kwena people repel an invasion by the Transvaal Republic in the Battle of Dimawe.
1853年：January – Transvaal and the Kwena people come to a peace agreement. The Kwena people carry out guerrilla warfare for another three years.
1853年：June – The Ngwaketse people rejoin under the joint leadership of Gaseitsiwe and Senthufe.
1857年：Gaseitsiwe overthrows Senthufe and takes control of the Ngwaketse people.
1857年：16 July – Lutheran missionaries begin evangelising to the Kwena people.
1857年：November – Robert Moffat negotiates the release of Macheng. Sechele I makes him kgosi of the Ngwato people.
1859年：April – Sechele I has Macheng overthrown and makes Sekgoma I the kgosi of the Ngwato people.
1863年：March – The Ngwato people repel another attack by the Northern Ndebele people at Shoshong.
1866年：May – Macheng is reinstated as kgosi of the Ngwato people replacing Sekgoma I.
1867年：4 December – The Tati Goldfields are discovered by Karl Mauch, causing a gold rush over the next two years.
1870年：April – Transvaal military leader Harklaas Malan captures Kgamanyane, kgosi of the Kgafela Kgatla, and publicly whips him.
1870年：November – The Kgatla people join the Kwena people under the rule of Sechele I.
1871年：May – Mochudi is founded when the Kgatla people migrate to the Kingdom of Kwena.
1872年：29 August – Macheng is banished from Shoshong in an effort organised by Khama III.
1873年：January – Sekgoma I returns as kgosi of the Ngwato people.
1873年：January – A schism occurs between brothers Khama III, a Christian, and Kgamane, who joined and renounced Christianity. Khama III flees to Serowe.
1875年：Khama III overthrows Sekgoma I and becomes kgosi of the Ngwato people.
1875年：11 August – The Kgafela people win the first battle of the Kwena–Kgafela War against the Kwena people in Mochudi.
1875年：November – The Kwena people win a battle against the Kgatla people in Thamaga.
1876年：July – The Kwena people win a battle against the Kgatla people in Molepolole.
1876年：August – In response to the Dorsland Trek, Khama III requests British protection of the region.
1877年：The Dorsland Trek migrates through present-day Botswana.
1881年：November – Ikaneng leads the Lete people in repelling an invasion.
1883年：The Kwena–Kgafela War ends. The Rolong, Ngwaketse, Kwena, and Kgatla peoples form a defense pact.
1884年：The Tawana people repel an invasion of Khutiyabasadi by the Northern Ndebele people.
1885年：27 January – The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland declares a protectorate over the Tswana people during the Berlin Conference, creating the Bechuanaland Protectorate.
links: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

items.text: 1887年：May – The Ngwato people and British police expel the Seleka people from Ngwapa to Transvaal.
1889年：5 February – Tswana leaders denounce Khama III's decision to invite British rule.
1889年：October – The British South Africa Company is granted a charter that will allow operation in the Bechuanaland Protectorate.
1890年：The United Kingdom places the Bechuanaland Protectorate under the Foreign Jurisdictions Act.
1890年：The United Kingdom extends the Bechuanaland Protectorate to the Chobe River.
1891年：9 May – Sekgoma Letsholathebe becomes regent of the Tswana people in place of Khama III.
1892年：January – The first of the Ngwato people enrol at Lovedale College.
1892年：September – Sechele I dies. He is succeeded as kgosi of the Kwena people by Sebele I.
1892年：September – Kgosi Mosinyi II of the Kaa people dies, causing a succession crisis.
1893年：October – The British South Africa Company, British police, and the Ngwato people attack and conquer the Northern Ndebele people.
1894年：January – Sekgoma Letsholathebe leads an attack on the Caprivi Strip to steal slaves and cattle.
1894年：October – The United Kingdom reorganises territorial allotment in the Bechuanaland Protectorate to favour Khama III.

1895年：The United Kingdom splits the Bechuanaland Protectorate, merging the southern British Bechuanaland with Cape Colony, which would become present-day South Africa. Tswana chiefs and British missionaries form a coalition to speak against further absorption of Tswana tribes into Cape colony.
1896年：The 1890s African rinderpest epizootic reaches the Bechuanaland Protectorate, killing 90% of the protectorate's cattle and causing a years-long famine.
1897年：Francistown is founded.
1897年：October – Khama III exiles his heir, Sekgoma Khama.
1897年：19 October – The Mahikeng–Bulawayo Railroad finishes construction.
1898年：Samuel Moroka leads his followers to settle in Tati.
1899年：The borders of Batswana reserves are defined.
1899年：April – The United Kingdom imposes a hut tax on the protectorate.
1899年：25 November – The Kgafela Kgatla win a battle against Boers at Derdepoort at the beginning of the Second Boer War.
1901年：27 April – Koranta ea Becoana is founded as the first Batswana-owned newspaper.
1903年：The capital of the Mangwato tribe moves from Phalatswe to Serowe.
1903年：The Herero people and the Nama people begin migrating to the protectorate from German South West Africa to escape the Herero and Namaqua genocide.
1905年：29 March – Tiger Kloof Native Institution opens as a secondary school.
1906年：12 June – The protectorate's resident commissioner overthrows and imprisons regent Tawana kgosi Sekgoma Letsholathebe.
1909年：Several Tswana tribes are made part of the newly formed Union of South Africa. The United Kingdom confirms that the Bechuanaland Protectorate will not be merged into the union.
1909年：Rudolf Pöch produces the first film recording of present-day Botswana.
1910年：1 July – Ngwaketse kgosi Bathoen I dies.
1911年：23 January – Kwena kgosi Sebele I dies, causing a succession crisis.
1911年：April – Sekgoma Letsholathebe is released from prison.
1914年：The protectorate joins World War I with the United Kingdom, sending soldiers to France, East Africa, and Namibia.
1915年：Maun is founded as the capital of the Batawana tribe.
1915年：Bobonong is founded as the capital of the Birwa tribe.
1915年：Thousands of the Rolong people migrate from South Africa to Tati.
1916年：May – The Kwena Tribal Council is formed to govern the Kwena people.
1916年：18 June – Moeapitso kills his brother Seepapitso II.
1916年：November – The resident commissioner disbands the Kwena Tribal Council.
1918年：The Spanish flu reaches the Bechuanaland Protectorate.
1918年：12 February – Kwena kgosi Sechele II dies. He is succeeded by Sebele II.
1919年：July – The Native Advisory Council is established.
1920年：2 March – The European Advisory Council is established.
1920年：24 December – The Birwa people are expelled from the Tuli Block and sent to Bobonong.
1923年：21 February – Mangwato kgosi Khama III dies.
1926年：19 January – Tshekedi Khama becomes regent kgosi of the Mangwato tribe.
1928年：April – Bathoen II becomes kgosi of the Ngwaketse tribe.
1929年：November – Molefi becomes kgosi of the Kgafela Kgatla, replacing regent Isang Pilane.
1930年：Charles Rey is appointed resident commissioner of the protectorate.
1931年：7 May – Charles Rey overthrows Kwena kgosi Sebele II and banishes him to Ghanzi.
1933年：8 April – Kgosi Gobuamang surrenders to the British.
1933年：August – Charles Rey suspends Ngwato regent Tshekedi Khama after he has a European flogged.
1936年：30 October – Charles Rey suspends Kgafela Kgatla kgosi Molefi and reinstates regent Isang Pilane.
1937年：Charles Rey ends his tenure as resident commissioner. He is replaced by Charles Arden-Clarke.
1939年：The protectorate enters World War II, with 10,000 Batswana serving in the African Auxiliary Pioneer Corps.
1941年：Kgafela Kgatla regent Isang Pilane dies.
1942年：Kgafela Kgatla regent Mmusi joins the African Auxiliary Pioneer Corps, and the Zion Christian Church establishes a ruling council over Kgafela Kgatla.
1944年：Naledi Ya Batswana begins publication through government subsidies.
1945年：Moremi III is suspended as kgosi of the Tawana people.
1945年：Molefi is restored as kgosi of Kgafela Kgatla.
1946年：Tawana kgosi Moremi III dies.
1947年：February – Elizabeth Pulane Moremi is appointed as the Tawana regent.
1947年：September – The Ngwato people attack the village led by John Nswazwi, forcing him to flee the protectorate.
1948年：Seretse Khama, heir to the Mangwato tribe, controversially marries Ruth Williams, a white British woman. The United Kingdom banishes Khama from the Bechuanaland Protectorate.
1949年：25 June – The Mangwato tribe endorses the marriage of Seretse Khama and Ruth Williams during a kgotla. Regent Tshekedi Khama, who did not wish to endorse the marriage, leaves the tribe.
1949年：6 December – The Bechuanaland Protectorate takes direct control over the Ngwato tribe rather than allowing Sertse Khama to rule.
1951年：20 September – Tawana secretary Leetile Disang Raditladi is escorted out of Ngamiland by gunmen.
1952年：The Bamangwato National Congress forms to represent Seretse Khama. Riots take place in protest of his exile.
1952年：11 September – A 6.1 magnitude earthquake occurs in Botswana.
1952年：11 October – A 6.7 magnitude earthquake occurs in Botswana.
1953年：13 May – Rasebolai Kgamane is placed in charge of the Ngwato Reserve.

1956年：Seretse Khama is permitted to return to Botswana after renouncing his claim to the Ngwato tribe. Seretse Khama and Tshekedi Khama both renounce their claims in favour of creating the Ngwato Tribal Council that limits the kgosi. Similar councils were adopted by other tribes soon afterward.
1956年：9 October – Rasebolai Kgamane becomes the Ngwato kgosi.
1957年：September – Elections are held to create democratic local councils.
1958年：The first tarred road in Botswana is paved in Lobatse.
1958年：British advisory councils request the creation of a legislature for the protectorate.
1959年：Copper mines are created in the Bechuanaland Protectorate.
1959年：April – The Bechuanaland Protectorate Federal Party is established by Leetile Disang Raditladi.
1959年：2 June – Bamangwato Concessions Limited is founded by Tshekedi Khama and Rhodesian Selection Trust.
1959年：June – Tshekedi Khama dies.
1960年：6 December – The Bechuanaland People's Party is founded by Mpho and K. T. Motsete.
1961年：A provisional constitution comes into effect for the Bechuanaland Protectorate. Seretse Khama is appointed to the executive council.
1961年：The Central Kalahari Game Reserve is established.
1962年：The Bechuanaland Democratic Party is founded by Seretse Khama.
1963年：A constitutional conference is held to begin drafting the Constitution of Botswana.
1963年：August – Construction begins at Gaborone to create a new capital.
1965年：The National Development Bank of Botswana is established.
1965年：February – The capital of the Bechuanaland Protectorate is moved from Mafikeng, South Africa, to Gaborone.
1965年：1 March – The Bechuanaland Democratic Party wins most contests in the 1965 Bechuanaland general election.
1965年：9 March – Seretse Khama is made prime minister and the Bechuanaland Protectorate is granted self-governance.
1965年：September – The Botswana National Front is founded by Kenneth Koma.
1966年：30 September – The Bechuanaland Protectorate is granted independence as Botswana. Seretse Khama is chosen as the first president of Botswana by the National Assembly.
1966年：17 October – Botswana is admitted to the United Nations.
1966年：The Botswana National Stadium opens.
1967年：July – Diamonds are discovered in Orapa.
1967年：29 September – The Mineral Rights in Tribal Territories Act and the Mines and Minerals Act grant the government control over mining.
links: Mineral Rights in Tribal Territories Act

items.text: 1968年：The Tribal Land Act is passed, moving power over land allocation from the kgosis to land boards.
1969年：Bathoen II leaves the Botswana Democratic Party and resigns his status as kgosi of the Ngwaketse to join the Botswana National Front.
1969年：23 June – The Debswana mining company is established.
1969年：18 October – The first national election of Botswana is held. The Botswana Democratic Party is challenged by the Botswana National Front but maintains its majority.
1969年：December – Selebi-Phikwe is founded.
1970年：The Botswana Development Corporation is established.
1970年：January – The power to allocate tribal land is transferred from the kgosis to independent land boards under the Tribal Land Act.
1971年：1 July – The Orapa diamond mine is established.
1974年：26 October – The 1974 Botswana general election is held. The Botswana Democratic Party maintains its majority.
1975年：The Selebi-Phikwe mine opens.
1975年：The Tribal Grazing Lands Policy is established.
1976年：Kimberlite diamonds are discovered in Jwaneng.
1976年：23 August – The Bank of Botswana is established. The Botswana pula replaces the South African rand as Botswana's official currency.
1977年：January – The United Nations passes a resolution demanding that Rhodesian forces end their hostilities along the Botswana–Rhodesia border.
1977年：15 April – The Botswana Defence Force is established.
1979年：13 April – The Gaborone–Francistown Highway is completed.
1979年：20 October – The 1979 Botswana general election is held. The Botswana Democratic Party maintains its majority.
1980年：Botswana co-founds the Southern African Development Coordination Conference.
1980年：13 July – Seretse Khama dies. He is succeeded as president by Quett Masire.
1981年：A drought in Southern Africa begins, destroying approximately 75% of crops in Botswana. It will continue until 1987.
1982年：The Financial Assistance Policy is implemented to provide grants for businesses.
1982年：February – The Jwaneng diamond mine is established.
1982年：June – The Botswana Progressive Union is founded.
1982年：September – The University of Botswana is founded.
1983年：3 January – Vice President Lenyeletse Seretse dies. Peter Mmusi becomes vice president.
1983年：A labour law is passed limiting the right to unionise.
links: Trade Unions and Employers' Organizations Act 1983

items.text: 1984年：The Sir Seretse Khama International Airport opens.
1984年：May – The Public Service Act allows civil servants to operate in the private sector.
1984年：8 September – The 1984 Botswana general election is held. The Botswana Democratic Party maintains its majority.
1985年：HIV is first identified in Botswana, beginning the nation's HIV epidemic.

1985年：14 June – South African soldiers invade Botswana and attack the headquarters of a South African anti-apartheid group in Gabarone. 12 people are killed, and the action is condemned in a resolution by the United Nations.
1986年：17 April – Botswana's first women's rights group, Emang Basadi, is established.
1987年：A referendum is held to form a Supervisor of Elections. It passes with 78.1% of the vote.
1987年：The university is closed for several months in response to student protests against police misconduct.
1987年：May – Morupule Electric Power Station is established.
1987年：1 October – Botswana Railways is established.
1987年：November – The constitution is amended so that only citizens of Botswana can serve as president.
1989年：Free secondary education is made available in Botswana.
1989年：7 October – The 1989 Botswana general election is held. The Botswana Democratic Party maintains its majority.
1990年：Namibia is established as an independent country to the west of Botswana, giving the country another route to the ocean beside South Africa.
1991年：Sowa Soda Ash Works is established.
1991年：12,000 public sector employees are removed from their positions for engaging in strike action.
1992年：March – Peter Mmusi steps down as vice president amid scandal. He is replaced by Festus Mogae.
1992年：3 July – A ruling is made in favour of Unity Dow in Attorney General of Botswana v. Unity Dow.
links: Attorney General of Botswana v. Unity Dow

items.text: 1993年：The Pula Fund, a sovereign wealth fund, is established.
1993年：The human rights group Ditshwanelo is founded.
1994年：Apartheid in neighbouring South Africa ends.
1994年：11 July – The Directorate on Corruption and Economic Crime is established following several corruption scandals.
links: Directorate on Corruption and Economic Crime

items.text: 1994年：15 October – The 1994 Botswana general election is held. The Botswana Democratic Party maintains its majority.
1994年：6 November – The Murder of Segametsi Mogomotsi as part of a ritual killing prompts riots.
1990年－1999年：mid-1990s – The government of Botswana adopts a policy of forced displacement against the San people.
1995年：16 February – The parliament building and downtown Gaborone are attacked by students.
1996年：Universal pensions are established.
1997年：The Vision 2016 economic plan is launched.
1997年：Botho University is founded.
1997年：April – Omang national identity cards are introduced.

1997年：October – A referendum is held to create the Independent Electoral Commission, to lower the voting age to 18, to set term limits on the presidency, and to allow automatic succession of the vice president in the event of a presidential vacancy. All three motions pass.
1998年：31 March – President Quett Masire retires. He is succeeded as president by Festus Mogae.
1998年：20 June – The Botswana Congress Party is founded by Michael Dingake.
1998年：13 July – Ian Khama becomes vice president.
1998年：September – Botswana joins South Africa in an invasion of Lesotho to quell a military insurrection.
links: Southern African Development Community intervention in Lesotho

items.text: 1998年：The LGBT rights group LEGABIBO is founded.
1999年：17 May – Yarona FM becomes the first private radio station in Botswana.
1999年：September – A state of emergency is declared for six days following issues with voter registration.

1999年：16 October – The 1999 Botswana general election is held. The Botswana Democratic Party maintains its majority. The Botswana Congress Party had acquired seats from members that left the Botswana National Front, but it loses most of these seats.
1999年：13 December – The International Court of Justice rules that Botswana, not Namibia, has jurisdiction over Sedudu Island.
2000年：February – Extensive flooding begins, displacing 60,000 people.
2000年：May – The Kgalagadi Transfrontier Park is established as a joint project between Botswana and South Africa.
2000年：31 July – Botswana Television is established.
2000年：The Balopi Commission is established.
2001年：April – The Botswana Federation of Trade Unions is established.
2001年：August – The San people are ordered to leave the Central Kalahari Game Reserve.
2001年：December – Tsodilo becomes a World Heritage Site.
2001年：A referendum is held to enact various judicial reforms. All seven motions pass.
2001年：Ngamiland District and Chobe District merge to form North-West District.
2002年：February – Botswana begins forcibly evicting the San people from the Central Kalahari Game Reserve.
2002年：March – A court case challenging the removal of the San people is dismissed.
2002年：July – Botswana adopts a value-added tax.
2002年：October – Botswana and South Africa jointly establish a reservation for the Khomani San and Mier peoples.
2003年：The Serowe Stadium opens.
2003年：September – Botswana begins construction of a border fence along the border with Zimbabwe to prevent illegal immigration.
2003年：October – The Botswana Democratic Party begins holding primary elections for the first time.
2004年：August – A strike among diamond miners ends with approximately one thousand workers losing their jobs when a court determines that the strike was illegal.
2004年：30 October – The 2004 Botswana general election is held. The Botswana Democratic Party maintains its majority.
2005年：September – Women are permitted to enlist in the Botswana Defence Force.
2005年：October – The government of Botswana expels all but 250 of the San people from the Central Kalahari Game Reserve.
2005年：The Three Dikgosi Monument is inaugurated.
2006年：December – The courts find that the forced displacement of the San people is unconstitutional.
2007年：Uranium deposits are discovered in Botswana.
2008年：The Public Service Act of 2008 allows the creation of the labour union BOFEPUSU.
2008年：March – The Diamond Trading Company Botswana is established.
2008年：April – Ian Khama becomes President of Botswana.
2009年：16 October – The 2009 Botswana general election is held. The Botswana Democratic Party maintains its majority.
2010年：The Botswana Movement for Democracy splits from the Botswana Democratic Party.
2010年：The first annual Gaborone Marathon is held.
2010年：July – The Basarwa people are ordered to cease drilling for water.
2011年：BOFEPUSU leads a strike among public employees. The government grants a 3% raise rather than the requested 16% raise.
2011年：January – The order enforcing a ban on water drilling against the Basarwa people is overturned by an appeals court.
2012年：June – Botswana is connected to Fiber-optic Internet.
2012年：9 August – Botswana wins its first Olympic medal when Nijel Amos wins a silver in the men's 800 metres.
links: Athletics at the 2012 Summer Olympics – Men's 800 metres

items.text: 2012年：9 August – The Diamond Trading Center is established.
2012年：16 October – The Botswana High Court affirms that women have the right to inherit property.
2012年：The Umbrella for Democratic Change alliance of political parties is founded.
2013年：1 April – The Botswana Communications Regulatory Authority is established.
2013年：November – De Beers relocates its headquarters from London to Gaborone.
2014年：January – A ban on hunting is implemented.
2014年：July – Opposition leader Gomolemo Motswaledi is killed in a car crash, prompting theories that the government was involved.
2014年：24 October – The 2014 Botswana general election is held. The Botswana Democratic Party maintains its majority but fails to get a majority of the popular vote for the first time in its history.
2014年：November – Mokgweetsi Masisi is appointed vice president.
2014年：14 November – LEGABIBO wins legal recognition.
2015年：November – The Lesedi La Rona is discovered at the Karowe mine.
2016年：April – The High Court rules that same-sex marriage is legal.
2016年：The Selebi-Phikwe mine enters into a receivership.
2017年：A United Kingdom, a British biopic of Sertse Khama and Ruth Williams, popularises their story with an international release.
2017年：3 April – A 6.5 magnitude earthquake occurs in the Central District.
2017年：October – The Alliance for Progressives splits from the Botswana Movement for Democracy.
2018年：April – Mokgweetsi Masisi becomes President of Botswna.
2019年：The Botswana Patriotic Front splits from the Botswana Democratic Party to support former president Ian Khama.
2019年：The 2019 Botswana general election is held. The Botswana Democratic Party maintains its majority.
2020年：27 July – The Rediscover Botswana domestic tourism campaign is launched to limit economic effects of COVID-19.
2020年：4 November – Anti-poaching forces kill four men on the Botswana–Namibia border, causing a diplomatic incident between the countries.

前3300年－前700年：East African Pastoral neolithic culture spreads. Key features include pastoralism as a means of food production and the construction of stone cairns at burial sites: Savanna Pastoral Neolithic Elmenteitan culture

前3000年－前1000年：Cushitic speakers settle across East Africa. Eburran hunter gatherers, who have occupied the area around the Ol Doinyo Eburru volcano complex near Lake Nakuru for nearly 10,000 years, gradually adopt domestic animals.
前3000年－前2300年：Lothagam North Pillar Site: East Africa's earliest and largest monumental cemetery.
前3000年－前2000年：The Kansyore culture becomes East Africa's earliest ceramic producing group of hunter gatherers. This culture was located at Gogo falls in Migori county near Lake Victoria.

前1000年－1000年：Bantu Groups migrate into Kenya bringing with them iron age technology. The Urewe culture, one of Africa's oldest iron smelting centres, settle in the great lakes region including western Kenya. Other groups settle in Southern Kenya

1000年－1500年：Emergence of the Swahili City States. The earliest gravestone found at Gedi Ruins dates to the earlier part of this period. The oldest Swahili texts in existence date to this period. They are written in old Swahili script (Swahili-Arabic alphabet) based on Arabic letters.

1100年－1400年：Hyrax Hill in Nakuru is settled by the Sirikwa. Oral histories recall the settlement of Shungwaya found north of the Tana River. Several coastal and central Kenyan Bantu groups are said to have migrated from this settlement due to pressure from Oromo speaking groups.
1418年：Chinese Admiral Zheng He visits Malindi. Some of his ships are reported to have sunk near Lamu Island. Recent genetic tests done on local inhabitants confirmed Chinese ancestry
1490年－1517年：Southern Luo people migrate into Western Kenya from present day Uganda.

1498年4月：Vasco da Gama travels to Mombasa and Malindi. Attacks on merchant ships led to a hostile reception in Mombasa. In Malindi the reception was friendlier. He established trade relations, erects a pillar and hires a guide to travel to India.
1500年－1900年：Thimlich Ohinga and other dry-stone walled enclosures in the Lake Victoria Basin are built.
1500年－1940年：The Kayas - Mijikenda fortified settlements are built then abandoned. Now revered as sacred sites, they are a UNESCO world heritage site.
1505年：The Portuguese Empire establishes a presence in Mombasa Most old Swahili texts dating to this period and earlier are destroyed.
1506年：Portuguese naval commander Tristão da Cunha is sent to conquer Socotra and establish control of Indian Ocean trade. He leads a blockade of Lamu which capitulates to Portuguese control.
1593年：Fort Jesus is built in Mombasa to solidify Portuguese hegemony
1698年：Omani Arabs capture Fort Jesus and Zanzibar. Arab traders settle in Zanzibar and Pemba. The slave trade grows exponentially with a large slave market based at Zanzibar.
1700年－1900年：Complex water furrows for irrigation are constructed by the Marakwet to facilitate intensive agriculture. Clan owned and communal, these irrigation systems are still in use.
1728年：One of the oldest surviving manuscripts in Swahili, an epic poem titled Utenzi wa Tambuka (The story of Tambuka), is written at the Royal Court of Pate Sultanate.

1840年：Sultan Seyyid Said, ruler of the Omani empire moves his capital to Zanzibar. The growth of clove plantations drives demand for slaves. Slave caravan routes into the interior of Kenya reach as far as the foothills of Mount Kenya, Lake Victoria and past Lake Baringo into Samburu country.
1846年8月25日：The first Christian mission is founded by Johann Ludwig Krapf in Rabai. Many freed slaves rescued by the British Navy are settled here.
1850年：East and Central Africa is mapped by European explorers.

1874年：Frere Town settlement in Mombasa is established. This is another settlement for freed slaves rescued by the British Navy. Despite pressure from the British to stop the East African slave trade, it continues to persist.
1875年－1884年：The peak of the slave plantation economy in East Africa. 43,000 – 47,000 slaves are present on the Kenyan coast (44 percent of the local population)
1884年－1885年：The Berlin Conference is convened by Otto Von Bismack. Britain stakes claims in what is today Kenya and Uganda.

1890年：Nabongo Mumia establishes diplomatic relations with Captain Frederick Lugard of the Imperial British East Africa Company (IBEAC), initiating the Wanga Kingdom's alliance with the British by providing safe passage, porters, supplies, and military support for British expeditions, while the British in turn supported Wanga authority and regional security during the establishment of colonial administration in pre-colonial Kenya.
1890年－1906年：The Nandi resistance against colonial rule is led by Koitalel Arap Samoei
1894年－1895年：Active military and political cooperation of Wanga Kingdom with the British begins in conquering adversary communities of the Wanga
1895年－1902年：Wanga Kingdom begin leading and assisting in British colonial conquest of western Kenya and neighboring regions.

1895年：Following the financial ruin of the Imperial British East African Company which administered the territory that is now Uganda and Kenya, the British Government steps in by proclaiming the Uganda protectorate and the British East African protectorate to maintain its sphere of influence. Significant numbers of South Asians migrate into modern Kenya. Through Indian Ocean trade, there has been an Indian presence on the East African Coast since antiquity.

1898年：The Tsavo Man-eaters, two male lions, terrorise workers involved in the construction of the Uganda railway, halting construction for several months. This saga is depicted in the 1996 film, The Ghost and the Darkness
1901年1月22日：Queen Victoria dies, Edward VII is Kenya's new monarch

1902年：The southern areas of the eastern portion of Uganda Protectorate are transferred to East Africa Protectorate Nabongo Mumia declines an invitation to travel to Britain for the coronation of King Edward VII after advice from his fellow Muslim advisers at Mombasa.
links: Coronation of Edward VII and Alexandra

items.text: 1903年：The Ugandan Railway is completed
1905年：Nairobi is established as the capital of the British East African Protectorate

1909年：Slavery is abolished in East Africa Witchcraft is illegal in East Africa Nabongo Mumia is appointed Paramount Chief of Sub-District No. 1 by the colonial administration, with administrative authority under both the East Africa Protectorate and the Uganda Protectorate. The territories placed under his jurisdiction encompass much of the Wanga Kingdom and extended from present-day Naivasha in Kenya to Jinja in present-day Uganda. The appointment over an expansive administrative region consolidates the Wanga Kingdom's position as a leading political, economic, military and administrative centre in Kenya. The appointment recognizes his alliance with the British colonial administration, expands his authority over numerous communities, and further consolidating the Wanga Kingdom as one of as one of the principal African administrative authorities in colonial Kenya.
links: List of kingdoms and empires in African history

items.text: 1911年5月6日：Edward VII dies, George V becomes the new monarch
1912年－1915年：Mekatilili Wa Menza leads the Giriama people in a rebellion against colonial authorities.
1914年：Kenya participates in the first world war. Approximately 11,000 British and 95,000 Africans were killed in the east African campaign with 45,000 of these Africans coming from Kenya

1920年：The British East African Protectorate is transformed to the Kenya Colony Young Kikuyu Association is started by Harry Thuku. Advocating for African suffrage, he was inspired to start a nationalist movement. Thuku renamed his organisation the East African Association, as he was striving for multi-ethnic membership. He included the local Indian community and reached out to other tribes. The colonial government accused Thuku of sedition, arrested him and detained him until 1930. Kikuyu Central Association is formed Led by Joseph Keng'ethe and Jesse Kariuki. Johnstone (later Jomo) Kenyatta was the secretary and editor of the associations' publication Mugwithania (The unifier). Sir Edward Northey becomes the first Kenyan ruler (governor)

1921年：The Piny Owacho (Voice of the People) movement in Kavirondo culminates in a large mass meeting advocating for land rights, fairer taxes and fairer treatment by the colonial authorities. Archdeacon W. E. Owen, an Anglican missionary and prominent advocate for African affairs, starts the Kavirondo Taxpayers Welfare Association.
1924年：The British Empire cedes part of Jubaland to the Italian Somaliland

1926年：The second portion of Uganda Protectorate is transferred to Kenya. This constitutes largely the present-day Turkana County The office of Paramount Chief of Sub-District No. 1 held by Nabongo Mumia is redesignated by the colonial administration as Paramount Chief of North Kavirondo following the reorganization of local administration. North Kavirondo encompasses territories that today form much of Western Kenya

1930年：Vittorio Merlo Pick, an Italian missionary, observes and records a traditional Kikuyu poem 150 stanzas long narrated through the use of a memory device and rattle gourd, the Gicandi. Most pre-colonial history in East and Central Africa was recorded orally. The best known memory device from this region still in use is the Lukasa memory board from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

1935年：Makhan Singh pioneers the trade union movement in Kenya by starting Labour trade union of Kenya. He organised the Railway workers strike in 1939 which was heavily suppressed by the colonial government.
1936年：George V dies, Edward VIII becomes the colony's new monarch until December 1936 when he abdicated. His younger brother George VI ascends the throne

1939年－1945年：Kenya participates in the second world war. African World war II veterans such as Bildad Kaggia, Fred Kubai and Stanley Mathenge would become central figures in the anti-colonial struggle.
1944年：Kenya African Study Union is founded by Harry Thuku

1945年－1950年：Benga music, a popular genre that originated in Kenya is born. Starting as a blend of Luo traditional string music, Congolese guitar picking styles and Cuban rumba, Benga becomes one of the most popular Kenyan and Pan-African musical genres.

1947年：Jomo Kenyatta is new president of Kenya African Union (KAU) Despite Nabongo Mumia's removal as Paramount Chief in 1926,he retains considerable prestige and influence within administrative colonial Kenya; Jomo Kenyatta reportedly approaches him to discuss Kenya's decolonization, but Mumia regards independence as premature and declines to support Kenyatta's position.

1949年：Nabongo Mumia dies at about the age of 100, marking the end of the Wanga Kingdom's prominence as a principal African administrative authority in Kenya under British colonial rule. Governor Philip Mitchell attends the funeral. Following Nabongo Mumia's death, the British colonial government declined to recognize a royal successor to the Paramount Chieftainship,effectively dismantling the political institution of the Wanga Kingdom favoring bureaucratic rule over hereditary cheftainship.

1952年：George VI dies, Elizabeth II ascends the throne while on a royal tour in Kenya Jomo Kenyatta visits Kisumu in an effort to gain nationwide support for KAU. This visit inspires Oginga Odinga, the Ker (Chief) of the Luo Union, to join KAU. Multiracial pattern of quotas allowed Mau Mau Uprising begins Members of the Forty group, a militant group of World War II veterans including Bildad Kaggia, form part of the core leadership of the uprising.
1952年10月21日：The Kapenguria six, core leaders of the Kenya African Union are arrested. They include Jomo Kenyatta, Paul Ngei, Kungu Karumba, Bildad Kaggia, Fred Kubai and Achieng Oneko
1953年4月8日：Jomo Kenyatta is jailed

1953年－1960年：Tom Mboya emerges to become a key figure in the anti-colonial struggle. Through the trade union movement (Kenya Federation of Labour), he gains local and international admiration and respect, becoming the first Kenyan to feature on the cover of Time magazine.
1956年10月21日：Dedan Kimathi, a key leader of the Mau Mau uprising is captured. This effectively event marks the defeat of the Mau Mau.
1957年：The first election for African members of the legislative council (MLC) is held. Oginga Odinga and Tom Mboya are elected. Daniel arap Moi is the only previously nominated MLC who gets elected.

1958年6月25日：Oginga Odinga calls for the release of Jomo Kenyatta at a Legislative council debate. He endures months of persecution for taking this stand. It then becomes the rallying call for the African nationalist movement.

1959年－1963年：The Kennedy Airlift scholarship program is started by Tom Mboya and William X Scheinman to address the shortfall of skilled African labour in soon to be independent Kenya. Nobel Prize winner Wangarĩ Maathai, Barack Obama Sr. and George Saitoti are amongst the beneficiaries of these airlifts. The program lasts until 1963. Over 800 students from East Africa benefit from this program.

1959年3月6日：The colonial government attempts to crush Tom Mboya's Nairobi People's Convention Party. This is the most organised and effective political party in Kenya at a time when national African parties are banned. Mboya's home is raided by the police and over 40 party members are arrested and sent to their tribal homes. This is the biggest round up since the Mau Mau emergency.

1959年5月：Tom Mboya is honoured by Martin Luther King and the Southern Christian Leadership Conference (SCLC). Martin Luther King affirms the connection between the American civil rights movement and the African Liberation Movement. Tom Mboya and Martin Luther King share a podium at a civil rights rally held in Washington DC.
1960年：The Nairobi People's Convention Party merges with the Kenya Independence Movement and Kenya African Union to form the Kenya African National Union (KANU) Mau Mau Uprising ends

1960年－1963年：The Lancaster House Conferences are held in London to discuss Kenya's independence and constitutional framework. Thurgood Marshall, American Lawyer and civil rights activist, is consulted by Mboya and Odinga to help draft the first constitution.

1960年－1989年：Kenya and the Cold War. The pan-continental wave of African nationalism attracts Cold War interests. For Kenya, this peaks between 1963 and 1969 when a proxy cold war plays out in local politics.
1961年8月21日：Jomo Kenyatta is released
1961年9月：Bildad Kaggia is released from prison.
1962年：KANU–KADU coalition government is formed
1963年－1967年：The Shifta War. This was a war of Secession between the Northern Frontier District Liberation Movement and Kenyan government.

1963年12月12日：Kenya becomes a sovereign state but remains a member of the commonwealth realm Jomo Kenyatta becomes Kenya's first Prime Minister and head of government serving Elizabeth II Malcolm MacDonald becomes Kenya's last Colonial governor
1964年：UNESCO's General History of Africa is launched aiming to tackle ignorance of Africa's history. Kenyan historian Bethwell Allan Ogot plays a key role in its production.

1964年10月20日：Malcolm X attends the Kenyatta Day parade in Nairobi. The American Civil rights leader first visited Kenya in 1959. Earlier in the year, Malcolm X attended the OAU meeting in Cairo to convince African states to raise the question of persecution of African Americans at the United Nations.
1964年12月12日：Kenya becomes a republic with Jomo Kenyatta as the first President of Kenya

1965年1月28日：The Kenyatta government sends the Kenya Army to Meru district, where Mau Mau fighters are gathered under the leadership of Field Marshall Mwariama and Field Marshall Baimungi. These last Mau Mau leaders had been insisting that they should get land and be absorbed into the civil service and Kenya Army. Both leaders and several Mau Mau fighters are killed
1965年2月24日：Anti-colonial activist and socialist politician, Pio Gama Pinto is assassinated. This is independent Kenya's first political assassination.

1966年：Bildad Kaggia and Oginga Odinga accuse the Kenyatta government of pursuing corrupt land distribution policies that did not favour the poor and the landless. Kenya's vice president, Oginga Odinga, leaves the ruling party KANU and starts a left leaning party, the Kenya People's Union. 29 members of parliament including Kaggia defect from KANU to KPU.

1966年：The 'Little general election' is held. These by-elections are called following the defection of 29 members of KANU to establish the Kenya People's Union. Outside Nyanza Province, most KPU candidates, including Bildad Kaggia, lose in this election.

1966年7月：A security Act is passed in Parliament that permits the government to carry out detention without trial. This act is used against KPU members who are arrested in round up a few weeks later. Those arrested include Ochola Mak'Anyengo (Secretary-General of the Kenya Petroleum Oil Workers Union), Oluande Koduol (Oginga Odinga's private secretary) and Peter Ooko (Secretary general of the East African Common Services Civil Servants Union)
1967年：East African Community formed Kenyan pro-divisions founded

1968年：Richard Leakey leads a preliminary search of Koobi Fora. This archaeological site yields a wealth of stone tools and hominin fossils that shape the understanding of human evolution and development. Naftali Temu wins the 10,000 metres race at the 1968 Summer Olympics in Mexico City becoming Kenya's first gold medalist.
1969年7月5日：Tom Mboya, widely considered as heir apparent to Kenyatta, is assassinated.

1969年10月25日：The Kisumu massacre occurs. Two days later, all KPU leaders are arrested and detained without trial and KPU is banned. Oginga Odinga is placed under house arrest. Kenya becomes a de facto one party state.

1970年：The International Centre of Insect Physiology and Ecology (ICIPE) is started by Kenyan entomologist, Thomas Odhiambo. Through the years he becomes known for his research on Insect physiology and non-chemical methods of agricultural insect control
links: International Centre of Insect Physiology and Ecology

items.text: 1971年：Oginga Odinga is released from house arrest

1972年6月5日：United Nations Environmental Program is founded with its headquarters in Nairobi. Kenyan scientist Reuben Olembo plays a key role in starting it and becomes the deputy executive director. He later becomes the assistant UN secretary general (1994-1998).
1973年：The Lokiriama Peace Accord is signed by Turkana people and Matheniki of Uganda Lufthansa Flight 540 crashes
1974年10月14日：General elections are held in Kenya. Former KPU members including Odinga are prevented from running for office.
1975年3月：Josiah Mwangi Kariuki, a popular left leaning politician and gadfly critical of the Kenyatta government is assassinated.

1977年：Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o, renowned Kenyan writer is detained without trial. His play Ngaahika Ndeenda (I Will Marry When I Want) provokes government authorities to arrest him. Continuous harassment after his release in 1978 forces him into exile from 1982 until 2002. East Africa's first woman to receive a PhD, Wangarĩ Maathai starts the Green Belt Movement. This organisation aims to mobilise the community to conserve the environment and reduce poverty. Rhamu incident occurs
1978年：Jomo Kenyatta dies Daniel arap Moi becomes new Kenyan President
1980年：Garissa massacre takes place

1982年：Oginga Odinga attempts to start a new political party. Section 2a of the Kenyan constitution is amended making Kenya a de jure one party state therefore preventing his efforts. A coup attempt by Kenya Air Force soldiers in August, led by Hezekiah Ochuka is foiled. Oginga Odinga is expelled from KANU and imprisoned for several months. The General Service Unit is formed

1984年：The first case of HIV is recorded in Kenya. Despite evidence to the contrary prominent leaders are initially in denial of the extent of HIV in Kenya. By 1994, the Ministry of Health would estimate that 200,000 people died of AIDS Wagalla massacre occurs, committed by Kenyan troops

1986年：Documentary series The Africans: A Triple Heritage premiers on the BBC and PBS in the United States. The series is produced by one of Africa's most prominent public intellectuals, Prof. Ali Mazrui. He was born in Mombasa; a member of the prominent Mazrui family.
1987年：Barack Obama visits Kenya for the first time to meet his father's family. Kenya hosts the All African Games

1990年2月13日：The body of Robert Ouko, the Kenyan Foreign Minister, is found. Initial police reports stated that his death was a suicide but forensic evidence suggests that he was murdered. Public pressure forces President Daniel arap Moi to involve Scotland Yard in the investigation.

1990年7月：The Saba Saba protests – pro-democracy uprisings – engulf the country. Kenneth Matiba and Raila Odinga are amongst the many opposition leaders arrested and detained without trial. Nelson Mandela visits Kenya with the intention of visiting the grave of Dedan Kimathi. His request is turned down by government authorities. Dedan Kimathi was buried in an unmarked grave in Kamiti Maximum Prison after his execution in 1957. His grave site would not be identified until 2019.

1991年：Local and International Pressure mounts leading to the repealing of section 2a of the constitution. Kenya becomes a multiparty state. The Forum for Restoration of Democracy (FORD), an opposition political party led by Oginga Odinga, Kenneth Matiba and Martin Shikuku is formed.
links: Forum for the Restoration of Democracy

items.text: 1992年8月：The Forum for Restoration of Democracy (FORD) splits up following internal wrangling into FORD-Asili, FORD-Kenya and FORD-People.
links: Forum for the Restoration of Democracy

items.text: 1992年12月29日：The 1992 Kenyan general elections are held. This is Kenya's first presidential multiparty election. This election is marred by irregularities and targeted ethnic violence in Rift Valley Province. President Daniel arap Moi retains his seat.
1994年1月20日：Oginga Odinga dies.
1996年：Professor Leah T. Marangu is appointed as the Vice Chancellor of Africa Nazarene University (ANU). She becomes the first Kenyan woman to head a University

1997年1月：Kenyan hip hop group Kalamashaka release the hit song "Tafsiri Hii" produced by Tedd Josiah. Their modern hip hop style combined with Swahili lyrics to give a message of hope despite the social and political issues bedevilling Kenya inspires a generation of urban youth and local talent.

1997年7月7日：The Saba Saba anniversary confrontation leaves 10 people dead and several injured at the hands of government authorities. The run-up to the 1997 election is marred by violence against the opposition

1997年12月29日：President Daniel arap Moi is elected again in Kenya's second presidential multiparty election. These elections attract widespread criticism over irregularities and ethnic clashes. Mwai Kibaki and Raila Odinga (Oginga Odinga's son) are his main challengers.
1998年8月7日：The US Embassy bombings in Nairobi, Kenya's capital and Dar es Salaam in Tanzania leave 224 people dead and over 4000 people injured. Al-Qaeda and the Egyptian Islamic Jihad are implicated.
2000年：President Daniel arap Moi sets up the Constitution of Kenya Review Commission. Yash Pal Ghai is installed as the chairman. This is Kenya's first major constitutional reform since independence.

2002年：Kenyan author Binyavanga Wainaina wins the 2002 Caine Prize for his short story "Discovering Home". Shortly afterwards he starts the literary magazine, Kwani?(So what?) which launches the careers of several writers including Yvonne Adhiambo Owuor (winner of the 2003 Caine Prize) and Uwem Akpan (Nigerian author, winner of the Commonwealth Writers' Prize).

2002年11月28日：The 2002 Mombasa attacks occur. Paradise Hotel and an Arkia airline owned flight are attacked. Both are Israeli owned. The attack on the airline fails but 13 people are killed and 80 are injured at the hotel.

2002年12月27日：The 2002 general election is held. 62% of voters reject KANU's presidential candidate, Uhuru Kenyatta (Jomo Kenyatta's son), voting in the National Rainbow Coalition (NARC) into power. Mwai Kibaki becomes President of Kenya. Daniel arap Moi, the longest serving president in Kenya's history, steps down from power.
2003年9月14日：Dr. Crispin Mbai, the head of a key and contentious committee in Kenya's constitutional reforms is murdered. Many perceive this as a political murder
2004年10月8日：Wangarĩ Maathai becomes the first African woman and first environmentalist to win the Nobel Peace Prize.

2005年2月7日：John Githongo, journalist and whistle-blower, resigns from his position as Permanent Secretary for Governance and Ethics. He later names top politicians involved in the Anglo-leasing scandal, a government procurement scam. Following threats to his life he moves to the UK in exile.

2005年9月：Kimani Maruge, the oldest elementary school student in the Guinness book of World Records, addresses the 2005 United Nations world summit in New York City on the importance of free primary education. A former Mau Mau fighter, he took the opportunity to enrol in primary school after Kenya started free primary education in 2003. His story was told in the 2010 biographical film, The First Grader.

2005年11月21日：The 2005 Kenyan constitutional referendum is held. Widely perceived as a referendum against President Mwai Kibaki, 57% of voters reject the draft constitution. Two days later, Kibaki dismisses his entire cabinet.

2006年：The Murumbi gallery opens at the Kenya National Archives. Joseph Murumbi, former Kenyan Vice President, was one of the worlds foremost collectors of African artefacts and historical documents. He sold his collection to the Kenyan government in 1977.

2007年：Prof. Miriam Were, a prominent public health expert and HIV/AIDS researcher, receives the Queen Elizabeth II Gold Medal for Outstanding contributions to International Public Health and Supporting the Health Needs of Disadvantaged people. Despite downward trends in the national prevalence of HIV in Kenya, in 2007, approximately 1,400,000 persons are living with HIV.

2007年3月：Safaricom and Vodafone launch M-Pesa, a mobile phone based money transfer system, following successful trials in Thika in 2006. By 2019, this service will have 42 million active customers over 7 countries. Millions of people with limited access to banking services, through their mobile phones, gain access to financial services.

2007年12月27日：The 2007 general elections are held. The campaign and election period are heavily polarised along ethnic lines. The results are contested by the Orange Democratic Movement, led by Raila Odinga as the Party of National Unity led by Mwai Kibaki is declared victorious. The post-election crisis of 2007–2008 begins shortly after the election. At least 1,133 people are killed and more than 600,000 are displaced
2008年11月6日：President Kibaki declares this day a public holiday following the election of Barack Obama to become the first African American president of the United States.
2009年：the UN Secretary general Kofi Annan handed names of the main suspects of the 2007 Post-election violence to the International Criminal Court

2010年3月：Entrepreneur and blogger Erik Hersman starts iHub, an innovation hub and hacker space. This quickly becomes a central pillar of the Silicon Savannah (the Kenyan tech scene). Between 2010 and 2019, 170 companies are formed out of iHub.

2010年3月：The Kenyan music group Just a Band releases Kenya's first viral music video – Ha He – which tells the exploits of Makmende, referencing blaxploitation and kung fu motifs. The viral response highlights the uptake and penetration of technology and social media in Kenya
2010年8月4日：Kenya holds a constitutional referendum. 68.6% of voters approve the new constitution

2010年12月：Six prominent Kenyans are accused of crimes against humanity by the prosecutor of the International Criminal Court in The Hague, Luis Moreno Ocampo. Education Minister William Ruto, Finance Minister Uhuru Kenyatta, Industrialization Minister Henry Kosgey, secretary to the cabinet Francis Kirimi Muthaura, former police chief Mohammed Hussein Ali and radio executive Joshua Arap Sang
2012年1月23日：The Pre-trial chamber of the ICC confirms charges against Kenyatta, Muthaura, Ruto and Sang.
2012年：First LGBT pride event held in Kenyan US embassy George Saitoti and Orwa Ojode are killed in a helicopter crash
links: List of diplomatic missions of the United States

items.text: 2012年3月：Anglo-Irish firm, Tullow Oil, discovers oil in Northern Kenya. President Kibaki calls the find a major breakthrough
2012年8月9日：In what was dubbed "The Greatest 800 Meter Race Ever", David Rudisha wins the gold medal in the 2012 London olympics 800m race and breaks the world record.

2013年9月：The Westgate terror attack. Four gunmen kill over 60 people and injure approximately 200 in an attack on an upscale mall, Westgate shopping mall. Al-Shabaab claim responsibility for the attack in retaliation for Kenya's incursion into Somalia in 2011 - Operation Linda Nchi.
2013年：Uhuru Kenyatta is voted in as the fourth President of Kenya with William Ruto as his deputy president following the 2013 Kenyan General Elections
2014年3月2日：Lupita Nyong'o wins the Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress at the 86th Academy Awards for her role in 12 Years a Slave. She becomes the first African to win an Oscar.
links: Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress

items.text: 2014年10月：Kenya rebases its economy increasing in GDP size by 25.3 per cent. Newly classified as a middle-income country, Kenya becomes Africa's ninth largest economy, up from 12th.
2014年12月：The prosecutor of the International Criminal Court in The Hague, Fatou Bensouda withdraws charges against President Kenyatta due to lack of evidence.
2015年4月2日：The Garissa University College attack occurs. Gunmen claiming to be from Al-Shabaab kill 148 people and injure over 70. This is the second most deadly terrorist attack on Kenyan soil.

2015年6月28日：Business Insider features Mubarak Muyika, Kenyan technology entrepreneur and founder of Zagace, among its global list of Top young entrepreneurs around the world dubbed the "Mark Zuckerbergs" of their respective countries. Later that year, Forbes Africa names him to its 30 Under 30 list, reflecting the growing international recognition of Kenya's technology sector.

2016年4月：The International Criminal Court drops its case against the deputy president of Kenya, William Ruto A Huruma building in Nairobi collapses. 52 people are killed and several injured. The high demand for Housing in Nairobi leads to some developers bypassing safety regulations. The Kenya rugby sevens team beats Fiji to win their first Sevens World Series title
2016年9月：Mark Zuckerberg visits iHub

2017年8月8日：The 2017 Kenyan general elections are held. Nine days prior to the election, Chris Msando, the head of IT at the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission is found murdered. The election is highly contested with allegations of rigging. The incumbent, Jubilee Party candidate Uhuru Kenyatta, is declared winner but the results are challenged in the Supreme Court by Raila Odinga, leader of the Orange Democratic Movement Afterwards, protests erupt in Nairobi, Western Kenya and the Coastal region. The police response is lethal. Over the next weeks after the election, at least 12 people are killed and over a hundred injured. Police operations include door to door crackdowns in areas not involved in the protests. The tragic death of 6 month old Samantha Pendo ignites an uproar over police brutality.
2017年9月20日：The Supreme Court annuls the election results. Fresh elections are called for within 60 days.

2017年10月26日：The second 2017 presidential election is held. Raila Odinga refuses to participate in these elections citing uncorrected issues within the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission. Kenyatta is declared winner with 98% of the vote with a voter turn-out of 39%.

2018年1月30日：Amidst a media black-out, Raila Odinga is sworn in as the "People's President" in an effort to persuade Uhuru Kenyatta to come to the negotiation table. Kenyan lawyer Miguna Miguna officiates the ceremony. He is deported in February following treason related charges and the legality of his citizenship is brought to question.

2018年3月：An investigative report reveals that Cambridge Analytica, a data analytics firm, played a critical role in President Uhuru Kenyatta's two campaigns, in 2013 and 2017. After months of political uncertainty, Uhuru Kenyatta and Raila Odinga make peace with "the Handshake". Raila Odinga is later appointed as the African Union's High representative for Infrastructural Development.

2018年5月：Wanuri Kahiu's film, Rafiki, receives a standing ovation at the 2018 Cannes Film Festival. The Kenya Film Classification Board bans this film for its subject matter. This is the first Kenyan film to screen at the Cannes Film Festival

2019年：The DusitD2 complex which hosts an upscale hotel and several other offices is attacked. 21 people are killed and several injured. Al-Shabaab claims responsibility for the attack stating that it was a response to US President Donald Trump's decision to recognise Jerusalem as the capital of Israel
2019年3月23日：Kenyan science teacher and Franciscan Friar, Peter Tabichi, wins the Global Teacher Prize.

2019年10月：US-based Kenyan scientist and inventor, Prof. Benson Edagwa is named the Emerging Innovator of the year at the University of Nebraska Medical Center for his work on developing long acting Antiretroviral treatments for HIV.
2020年3月13日：Kenya confirms first COVID-19 infection.
2022年8月9日：The 2022 Kenyan general elections are held in which William Ruto was elected as the 5th president of Kenya with Rigathi Gachagua as the deputy president.
1178年－1195年：Suleiman Hassan (c. 1178–1195), conquers the rival nation of Sofala.

1400年－1500年：The ancestors of the Iraqw are credited as the builders of the Iron Age settlement at Engaruka in Northern Tanzania. Complex irrigation systems supporting intensive agriculture supported an estimated peak population of 40,000. It is recognised as the largest abandoned system of irrigated agricultural fields and terraces in sub-Saharan Africa.
1410年：Kilwa's ruler makes a recorded pilgrimage to Mecca.
1498年2月25日：The Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama is the first known European to reach the East African coast, landing at Kilimane, where he stayed for 32 days.
1505年7月24日：Sack of Kilwa by the Portuguese Empire marking an end to the Kilwan golden age in the Swahili coast.
1505年8月：Captain John Homere, part of Francisco de Almeida's fleet, captures the archipelago of Zanzibar, making it part of the Portuguese Empire.
1698年：Zanzibar falls under the control of the Sultan of Oman.
1698年：Oman's conquest of Kilwa leds the Yao to flee to Mozambique island.
1700年：Over 100,000 slaves pass through Zanzibar as part of the Arab slave trade.
1700年：The founding of the Chagga states of Kilimanjaro.
1776年：Kilwa was reviving and becomes East Africa's largest slave port with the Yao returning from Mozambique as slave taders. The enslaved were sold to the French colonies of the Mascarene islands.
1776年：Smallpox plagues southern Tanzania.
1819年：The Shambaa Kingdom enters a golden age under Kimweri ye Nyambai's reign.
1820年：Famine in Ukerewe.
1822年：United Kingdom signs the Moresby Treaty with Sultan Seyyid Said to begin the abolition of slavery in Zanzibar.
links: Said bin Sultan, Sultan of Muscat and Oman

items.text: 1840年12月：Omani Sultan Seyyid Said moves his capital to Zanzibar City.
1842年：Ngoni king Mputa Maseko arrives and settles in Songea. While Zwangendaba settles in Ufipa.
1843年：The last Sultan of Kilwa is deported to Oman.
1848年5月11日：German missionary Johannes Rebmann, accompanied by Johann Ludwig Krapf, become the first Europeans to report seeing Mount Kilimanjaro.
1850年：The Zigua burn Saadani to the ground.
1850年：Swahili is spoken widely among the Gogo and Sagara.
1855年：King Muyigumba conqueres the northern and central Hehe chiefdoms into a unified Hehe state.
1856年：Sultan Seyyid Said dies at sea and is succeeded by his sons Thuwaini bin Said, in Muscat and Oman and Majid bin Said, in Zanzibar.
links: Thuwaini bin Said, Sultan of Muscat and Oman

items.text: 1857年6月26日：British explorers Richard Burton and John Speke travel from Zanzibar to the East African coast and begin their exploration of continental East Africa.
1857年：Maize is grown in the Pangani Valley.
1858年2月13日：Burton and Speke reach Lake Tanganyika, the first known Europeans to do so.
1860年：King Mirambo of the Nyamwezi rises to power.
1861年4月2日：Zanzibar and Oman are split into two separate principalities with Majid bin Said becoming the first Sultan of Zanzibar.

1863年：Songea's king Mputa Maseko is killed by dissident Ndendeuli who flees east to the Kilombero valley and recreates Ngoni style military state forming the Mbunga people, forcing the Pogoro to flee eat to the Mahenge plateau.
1863年：The French Holy Ghost Father established their first church in Zanzibar and move it to Bagamoyo in 1868.
1869年：The Kiva rebellion, where Bondei rebel against the Shambaa Kingdom's rule.
1870年：Islam becomes the major religion among the Zigua and Bondei.
1873年：Zanzibari Sultan Barghash bin Said stops the export of slaves over the sea.
1874年：Civil war in the Shambaa Kingdom turns Pangani into a rival slave port to Bagamoyo and Kilwa.
1875年：Bagamoyo pays tribute to the Zaramo fearing attack.
1875年：The Mbugu of Gare kill a Kilindi royal in rebellion.
1876年：Barghash bin Said closes Zanzibar's slave market.
1876年：Kilwa's biggest export switches from slaves to wild rubber.
1878年：The Hehe and Ngoni go to war with the Invasion of Mshope by the Hehe.
1880年：Fipa King Kapufi of Nkasi hires an Arab Prime minister in his court.
1881年：The Pare at Mbaga attack a slave trader settlement of Kisiwani.
1882年：The Ngoni and Hehe end their war with Bena partitioned amongst them as a buffer.
1882年：King Songea Mbano of the Ngoni raids the eastern stateless peoples like the Ngindo, Makonde and Mwera forcing them to flee further eastwards leaving empty land.

1884年3月28日：The Society for German Colonization is formed by Karl Peters in order to acquire German colonial territories in overseas countries. Peters signs treaties with several native chieftains on the mainland opposite Zanzibar.
1884年11月23日：The Germans led by Peters land at Saadani and start the invasion reaching the Ngulu mountains and signing a sham treaty with Chief Mafungu Biniani of Ngulu .
1884年12月2日：Mirambo of the Nyamwezi empire dies.
1885年3月3日：The German government announces its intention to establish a protectorate in East Africa.
1885年4月2日：The German East Africa Company is formed by Karl Peters to govern German East Africa.

1886年11月1日：An agreement is reached between Britain and Germany designating a 10-mile (16 km) wide strip of land along the coast as being controlled by Sultan Barghash bin Said, along with Zanzibar, Pemba, and Mafia. The area that is to become Tanganyika is assigned to Germany while the area to become Kenya is assigned to Britain.
1887年5月25日：The Germans occupy Dar es Salaam.
1887年：The Zaramo attack two German stations in Dar es Salaam .
1888年4月：The German East Africa Company leases the coastal strip opposite Zanzibar from Sultan Khalifah bin Said for 50 years.
1888年：The Zigua boycott a station in Old Korogwe.
1888年9月：Tanga is bombed by German warships.
1889年6月：Germans capture Saadani after fierce fighting Bwana Heri flees inland .
1889年7月：Germans capture Pangani after heavy shelling from the sea.
1889年12月15日：Germans hang Abushiri .
1890年7月1日：The Heligoland–Zanzibar Treaty makes Zanzibar and Pemba a British protectorate.
1890年8月1日：The Sultan of Zanzibar signs an anti-slavery decree.
1890年5月1日：Germans bombard Kilwa for three days into submission.
1891年2月：The Battle of Kibosho.
1891年11月：Mangi Rindi dies.
1896年8月27日：The Anglo-Zanzibar War is fought between Zanzibar and the United Kingdom. It lasted approximately 38 minutes and is the shortest war in history.
1896年11月：The Germans and Chagga sack Meru.
1897年4月5日：Sultan Hamoud bin Mohammed issues a decree making slavery illegal in Zanzibar.
1897年：Mangi Sina dies.
1898年7月19日：Following years of resistance, Chief Mkwawa of the Hehe is cornered by German soldiers and commits suicide in lieu of capture.
1898年：Katukamoto of Urambo, who was held accountable for the murder of an askari, was imprisoned. Following this event, the remnants of Mirambo's empire were systematically dismantled.
1900年3月2日：Great Hanging at Old Moshi was a mass execution of 19 Chagga and Meru leaders together with their noblemen by German colonial officers.
1905年7月：The Maji Maji Rebellion starts as a violent resistance to colonial rule in Tanganyika.
1907年8月：The Maji Maji Rebellion ends, leaving between 200,000 and 300,000 rebels dead.
1914年8月8日：The East African Campaign of the First World War begins.
1914年11月3日：The Battle of Tanga, the first major military engagement of the First World War, takes place. (to 5 November)
1916年9月4日：Dar es Salaam is occupied by troops from the United Kingdom and South Africa.
1919年6月28日：Following the First World War, the Treaty of Versailles divides German East Africa, with the United Kingdom acquiring the largest section which it names the Tanganyika Territory.
1920年：Sir Horace Byatt is appointed the first governor of Tanganyika.
1920年1月10日：The British mandate over Tanganyika comes into force.
1929年：The Tanganyika African Association is founded by members of the Tanganyika Territory African Civil Service association.
1946年12月13日：British mandate over Tanganyika is converted to a United Nations Trusteeship.
1954年6月9日：Germany returns the skull of Hehe chief Mkwawa (died 1898) to Tanzania and it is put on display near Iringa.
1954年7月7日：Julius Nyerere forms the Tanganyika African National Union (TANU) and becomes its first president.
1961年10月：The University College, Dar es Salaam is established as one of three constituent colleges of the University of East Africa, with 14 law students.
1961年12月9日：Tanganyikan independence; Julius Nyerere as Prime Minister.
1961年12月14日：Tanganyika becomes a member of the United Nations.
1962年1月22日：Julius Nyerere resigns as Prime Minister and is succeeded by Rashidi Kawawa.
1962年12月9日：Tanganyika becomes a republic with Julius Nyerere as its first president.
1963年12月16日：Zanzibar becomes a member of the United Nations.
1963年12月19日：Zanzibar receives independence from the United Kingdom, becoming a constitutional monarchy.
1964年1月12日：The Zanzibar Revolution by local Africans overthrows the Sultan of Zanzibar and his primarily Arab government. Sheikh Abeid Karume becomes the first President of Zanzibar.
1964年4月26日：The Republic of Tanganyika and the Republic of Zanzibar and Pemba unite to form the United Republic of Tanganyika and Zanzibar.
1964年11月1日：The United Republic of Tanganyika and Zanzibar changes its name to the United Republic of Tanzania.
1965年9月21日：President Nyerere is returned to power in a one-party election.
1965年10月1日：Nyerere is sworn in for his second presidential term.
1967年2月5日：President Nyerere issues the Arusha Declaration, outlining the principles of Ujamaa.
1969年9月24日：The Arusha Agreement is signed between the European Union and the East African states of Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda.
1970年7月1日：Tanzania's first university, the University of Dar es Salaam is founded from the split of the University of East Africa into three national universities.
1971年1月1日：The Arusha Agreement is enacted.
1972年4月7日：Vice President Abeid Karume is assassinated in Zanzibar Town.
1972年4月11日：Aboud Jumbe becomes the second President of Zanzibar and Vice President of Tanzania.
1976年：Archaeologist Mary Leakey and her team discover homoinid fossil footprints at Laetoli, south of the Olduvai Gorge.
1977年2月5日：Tanganyika African National Union (TANU) and Zanzibar's Afro-Shirazi Party merge to become Chama Cha Mapinduzi (CCM).
1977年4月18日：The border between Tanzania and Kenya is closed.
1977年4月25日：The constitution of Tanzania is adopted.
1978年10月27日：Ugandan forces under Idi Amin invade Tanzania, starting the Uganda–Tanzania War, also known as the Liberation War.
1979年4月11日：Tanzanian troops capture the Ugandan capital of Kampala, heralding the end of the Uganda–Tanzania War and Amin's regime.
1983年：Tanzania's first AIDS diagnosis is made in Bukoba district, Kagera Region.
1983年11月17日：The Tanzania–Kenya border reopens.
1984年1月31日：Ali Hassan Mwinyi is sworn in as the third President of Zanzibar and Vice President of Tanzania.
1985年11月5日：Julius Nyerere retires and Ali Hassan Mwinyi becomes the second President of Tanzania. Mwinyi is succeeded as vice president by Joseph Sinde Warioba.
1990年10月：Ali Hassan Mwinyi wins a single-party election with 95.5% of the vote and is sworn in for a second presidential term.
1992年5月28日：The Civic United Front is formed.
1995年10月29日：Tanzania holds its first multi-party election.
1995年11月23日：Benjamin Mkapa is sworn in as the third President of Tanzania.
1973年2月：The Tanzanian parliament moves from Dar es Salaam to the new capital of Dodoma.
1998年8月7日：The United States embassies in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania and Nairobi, Kenya are simultaneously bombed.
1999年10月14日：Julius Nyerere dies of leukaemia in London.
1999年11月30日：The East African Community Treaty between Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda is signed in Arusha.
2000年7月7日：The East African Community Treaty comes into force.
2000年10月29日：Benjamin Mkapa is re-elected as President of Tanzania, with 72 percent of the vote.
2001年1月28日：Demonstrators in Zanzibar protesting the 2000 elections, clash with police and 32 people are killed.
2001年7月5日：Ali Mohamed Shein becomes Vice President of Tanzania.
2001年12月：The government controversially decides to spend £28m on a new air traffic control system.
2002年6月24日：The Igandu train disaster kills more than 200 people and is Tanzania's worst train crash.
2002年7月：Mkapa's government is criticized for purchasing a £15m presidential jet shortly before reaching an agreement with the UK for £270m in aid.
2003年12月：The Kipunji, a new species of monkey, is found in Tanzania—the first new African monkey species since 1974. It is also independently discovered in July 2004.
2005年12月14日：General elections are held. Anna Senkoro of the Progressive Party of Tanzania–Maendeleo is the first woman in Tanzania to run for president.
2005年12月21日：Jakaya Kikwete is sworn in as the fourth President of Tanzania.
2005年12月30日：Edward Lowassa is sworn is as Prime Minister.
2006年5月11日：Scientists announce that the Kipunji monkey found in 2003 belongs to a new genus of African monkey—the first to be discovered since 1923.
2006年8月9日：$642m of Tanzania's debt is cancelled by the African Development Bank.
2008年2月6日：A parliamentary committee reports on corruption within the cabinet.
2008年2月7日：Prime Minister Edward Lowassa and two other ministers resign following the report on corruption. President Kikwete dissolves the cabinet.
2021年3月17日：John Magufuli, President of Tanzania, dies.
2021年3月19日：Samia Suluhu Hassan is sworn in as Tanzania's first female President.
17世紀：Tutsi king Ruganzu Ndori comes to prominence.
1858年：The area is visited by British explorer John Hanning Speke, the first European to do so.

1884年3月28日：The Society for German Colonization is formed by Karl Peters in order to acquire German colonial territories in overseas countries. Peters signs treaties with several native chieftains on the mainland opposite Zanzibar.
1884年8月：Rwanda becomes a German protectorate.
1885年4月2日：The German East Africa Company is formed by Karl Peters to govern German East Africa.
1899年：Rwanda is incorporated into German East Africa.
1901年2月23日：A boundary is agreed between German East Africa and Nyasaland.
1916年：Rwanda is occupied by Belgian forces.
1922年7月20日：Rwanda-Urundi are joined as a League of Nations mandate, governed by Belgium.
1933年：All citizens in Rwanda-Urundi are issued with an identity card defining their ethnicity.
1943年：Famine affects the region.
1945年：Rwanda-Urundi becomes a United Nations Trust Territory.
1957年：The Hutu Manifesto is published.
1959年7月24日：Mwami Mutara III dies.
1959年9月3日：The Union Nationale Rwandaise (UNAR) party is formed.
1959年11月1日：Politician Dominique Mbonyumutwa is beaten by members of UNAR, leading to a violent backlash that kills thousands of Tutsis.
1960年：An election is held.
1961年：Rwandans vote to abolish the Tutsi monarchy.
1961年1月28日：Dominique Mbonyumutwa becomes provisional President of Rwanda.
1962年7月1日：Belgium grants Rwanda independence.
1962年10月26日：Grégoire Kayibanda becomes the first elected President of Rwanda.
1963年：Following a Tutsi guerilla attack from Burundi, an anti-Tutsi backlash kills thousands.
1973年7月5日：Grégoire Kayibanda is overthrown in a military coup d'état. Juvénal Habyarimana becomes the third President of Rwanda.
1985年12月26日：American naturalist Dian Fossey is murdered in her Rwandan cabin.
1990年10月1日：The Tutsi Rwandan Patriotic Front (RPF) makes an attack from Uganda, starting the Rwandan Civil War.
1993年8月4日：The Arusha Accords are signed between President Habyarimana and leaders of the RPF in Arusha, Tanzania, ending the Rwandan Civil War.
1994年4月6日：President Habyarimana and Burundian President Cyprien Ntaryamira are assassinated as their aircraft is shot down approaching Kigali. This incident sparks the Rwandan genocide.
links: Assassination of Juvénal Habyarimana and Cyprien Ntaryamira

items.text: 1994年4月8日：Théodore Sindikubwabo becomes interim President of Rwanda.
1994年7月3日：The RPF takes control of Kigali.
1994年7月19日：The RPF forms a provisional government and Pasteur Bizimungu becomes President of Rwanda.
1994年8月21日：The RPF controls the whole of Rwanda.
1994年11月8日：The International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda is established.
2000年3月24日：Paul Kagame is selected as interim President of Rwanda.
2000年4月22日：Paul Kagame is sworn in as the fourth President of Rwanda.
2006年1月："Rwanda's 12 provinces are replaced by a smaller number of regions with the aim of creating Decentralised administrative areas."
2007年4月6日：Former president Pasteur Bizimungu is released from prison after three years of a fifteen-year sentence, pardoned by President Kagame.
2009年：Rwanda becomes part of the Commonwealth of Nations.
1858年：The area was visited by British explorer John Hanning Speke, who became the first European to do so.
links: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

items.text: 1903年：Burundi came under the control of Germany.
1922年7月20日：Burundi and Rwanda were joined into the League of Nations mandate of Ruanda-Urundi, governed by Belgium.
1962年7月1日：Burundi received independence from Belgium.
1965年1月15日：Prime Minister Pierre Ngendandumwe was assassinated by a Rwandan Tutsi.
1966年11月28日：Michel Micombero became the first President of Burundi.
1972年4月27日：Burundi genocide (1972): A rebellion broke out which led to a genocide against Hutus.
1976年11月2日：Jean-Baptiste Bagaza assumed the Presidency of Burundi in a bloodless coup d'état.
1987年9月3日：1987 Burundian coup d'état: Bagaza was deposed while in Canada.
1987年10月2日：Pierre Buyoya was sworn in as President of Burundi.
1992年3月：Burundi adopted a new constitution.
1993年6月2日：Burundian presidential election, 1993: The Hutu Melchior Ndadaye won the election.
1993年10月21日：Burundi Civil War: Ndadaye was assassinated by Tutsi extremists, starting a genocide against Tutsis and a civil war.
1994年2月5日：Cyprien Ntaryamira took office as President of Burundi.
1994年4月6日：Assassination of Juvénal Habyarimana and Cyprien Ntaryamira: Ntaryamira and Rwandan President Juvénal Habyarimana were shot down as their aircraft approached Kigali.
links: Assassination of Juvénal Habyarimana and Cyprien Ntaryamira

items.text: 1994年4月8日：Sylvestre Ntibantunganya was named interim President.
1994年4月25日：An attempted military coup was averted.
1994年9月30日：Ntibantunganya was elected President by a new Convention of Government.
1995年3月11日：Mines and Energy Minister Ernest Kabushemeye was eaten by cannibals in Bujumbura.
1996年7月21日：Hutu rebels attacked a refugee camp in the country, killing more than three hundred people.
1996年7月25日：1996 Burundian coup d'état: Buyoya returned to power.
2004年5月：The United Nations Operation in Burundi was established.
2005年8月19日：Burundian presidential election, 2005: Sole candidate Pierre Nkurunziza was elected President of Burundi.
2007年2月：The United Nations shut down its peacekeeping operations in Burundi.
2019年2月：The Burundian parliament votes to move the capital from Bujumbura to Gitega.
約975年：Ibn Selim al-Aswani visits the Christian kingdoms of Makuria and Alodia, recording a comprehensive geopolitical and economic account of the Nubian courts.
