789年：Mauregatus dies and is succeeded by Bermudo I of Asturias, nephew of Alfonso I.
791年：Bermudo I is defeated at the Battle of the Burbia River and abdicates.
791年9月14日：Alfonso II is proclaimed King a second time.
796年6月12日：Al-Hakam I becomes Emir of Córdoba.
798年：Alfonso II sacks Lisbon.
822年5月21日：Abd ar-Rahman II becomes Emir of Córdoba. He would engage in nearly continuous warfare against Alfonso II of Asturias.
839年或840年：Abd ar-Rahman II sent an embassy under al-Ghazal to Constantinople to sign a pact with the Byzantine Empire against the Abbasids.

842年：Alfonso II dies and is succeeded by Ramiro I of Asturias. Because Ramiro I was not in the capital, Nepotian of Asturias, with the support of some members the nobility, usurped the throne but quickly lost militarily against Ramiro I's allies upon his return.
844年：First Viking raid of Lisbon, who occupied the city for 13 days. The governor of Lisbon, Wahballah ibn Hazm, wrote about the attack to the Emir.
848年：William of Septimania requests Abd ar-Rahman II in his struggle against Charles the Bald.

850年2月1日：Ramiro I dies and is succeeded by his son Ordoño I of Asturias, becoming the first king of Asturias to ascend the throne without election by nobility (in contrast to the Visigothic tradition).

850年：While during most Islamic rule Christians were considered part of the Dhimmi, and thus allowed to exist and worship in private, the Emirs of Córdoba would execute 48 Christians between 850 and 859, known collectively as the Martyrs of Córdoba. The Martyrs included at least two Mozarabs born in present-day Portugal: Sisenandus of Beja (patron saint of Beja) and a priest named Elias, also from Beja, executed with two of his students.
852年：Muhammad I becomes Emir of Córdoba.

868年：Ibn Marwan al-Jilliqi, a Muwallad of (what is now) Northern Portugal descent, led a group of Muwallad and Mozarabic rebels against Muhammad I. He was granted Badajoz from the Emir but maintained resistance against the Emir's rule until his death in 889.
868年：Vímara Peres was made count of Portugal by Alfonso III of Asturias, king of Asturias, after conquering from the Emirate of Córdoba the Atlantic coast between the Minho and Douro rivers.
873年：Vímara died. He was succeeded as count of Portugal by his son Lucídio Vimaranes.
876年：The Berber Banu Dānis, who had settled many places in modern-day Portugal, lose Coimbra to Alfonso III of Asturias.
878年：Hermenegildo Gutiérrez, who took part in the Reconquista defeating Muslim troops in Porto and Coimbra, becomes count of Coimbra.
886年：Al-Mundhir becomes Emir of Córdoba.
888年：Abdullah becomes Emir of Córdoba. He would face rebellions from the Banu Dānis, who considered him to have usurped the throne from his half-brother Al-Mundhir.
895年：Hermenegildo defeats the Galician noble Witiza who had taken up arms against the king of Asturia.
909年：Alfonso III of Asturias is deposed by his sons yet also proclaimed Emperor.
910年：Alfonso III of Asturias dies and his kingdom is divided among his sons into the dependent kingdoms of Astúrias, León and Galicia.
910年：Ordoño II becomes King of Galicia with the support of the Count of Portugal.
911年：Count Hermenegildo Guterres of Coimbra, dies and his son Arias Mendes becomes Count of Coimbra.
912年：Abd al-Rahman III becomes the Umayyad Emir of Córdoba.
913年：An expedition commanded by Ordoño II, then vassal king of Galicia, into Muslim territory takes Évora from the Muslims.
914年：Ordoño II of Galicia, becomes King of León, after the death of his brother García I of León.
914年：The capital city of the Kingdom of Asturias is moved from Oviedo to León, from now on Kingdom of León.
916年：Ordoño II of León is defeated by the Emir Abd al-Rahman III in Valdejunquera.
918年：Battle of Talavera where Muslims under Abd al-Rahman III defeat the Christians.
918年：Pope John X recognises the orthodoxy and legitimacy of the Visigothic Liturgy maintained in the Mozarabic rite.
924年：Fruela II becomes King of León.
925年：Sancho Ordonhes, son of Ordoño II of León, becomes vassal king of Galicia until 929.
925年：Alfonso IV becomes King of León.
925年：Ramiro II, son of Ordoño II of León, was the first to bear the title King of Portuguese Land.
926年：Ramiro II takes residency in the city of Viseu.
926年：Mendo I Gonçalves, (son of Count Gonzalo Betotez of Galicia) marries Mumadona Dias (daughter of count Diogo Fernandes and Onega) and becomes Count of Portugal.

926年：The Umayyad Emir Abd al-Rahman III, faced with the threat of invasion by the Fatimids, proclaims himself Caliph of Córdoba. Under the reign of Abd al-Rahman III Muslim Al-Andalus reaches its greatest height before its slow decline over the next four centuries.
928年：Gonçalo Moniz, grandson of Count Arias Mendes of Coimbra, becomes Count of Coimbra.
929年：Abd al-Rahman III proclaims himself Caliph in Córdoba and transforms the Emirate of Córdoba into an independent caliphate no longer under even theoretical control from Baghdad.
930年：Ramiro II leaves his residency in Viseu.
931年：Ramiro II becomes King of León.
938年：First document where the word Portugal is written in its present form.
946年：The county of Castile becomes independent.
950年：Countess Mumadona Dias of Portugal divides amongst her sons her the vast domains, upon the death of her husband Count Mendo I Gonçalves.
950年：Gonçalo I Mendes, son of Mumadona Dias and Mendo I Gonçalves, becomes Count of Portugal.
950年：Ordoño III becomes King of León.
951年：Abd al-Rahman III signs a peace treaty with Ordoño III in order to focus on dealing with the Fatimid Caliphate.
953年：Big [[Moorish|Moorish]] incursion in Galicia.
955年：Ordoño III of León attacks Lisbon.
956年：Sancho I becomes King of León.
958年：Sancho I of León is deposed and Ordoño IV becomes King of León. Sancho I asks his grandmother, Toda of Pamplona, to aid him in recovering the throne.
959年：Countess Mumadona Dias donates vast estates to the Monastery of St. Mamede in Guimarães.
959年：Sancho I, accompanied by Toda of Pamplona, seeks an alliance with Abd al-Rahman III in order to overthrow Ordoño IV.
960年：Sancho I of León is reinstated as King of León, after the Pamplonian-Muslim army captures Léon. Ordoño IV fled to the Asturias.
961年：Al-Hakam II becomes Umayyad Caliph of Córdoba.
962年：Count Gonçalo I Mendes of Portugal rebels against Sancho I of León.
966年：Count Gonçalo Moniz of Coimbra rebels against Sancho I of León.
966年：Vikings raid Galicia and kill the bishop of Santiago de Compostela in battle, but his successor St. Rudesind rallies the local forces and kills the Viking King Gundered.
967年：Ramiro III becomes King of León.
968年：Countess Mumadona Dias dies.
971年：Another minor Viking raid in Galicia.

976年：Caliph Al-Hakam II dies, and Al-Mansur Ibn Abi Aamir (nicknamed al-Manṣūr) takes over in the name of his protégé Hisham II, becoming a military dictator usurping caliphal powers and launching a big number of offensive campaigns against the Christians.
981年：Count Gonçalo Moniz of Coimbra dies.
982年：Bermudo II becomes King of León, having been acclaimed by the Counts of Galicia and anointed in Santiago de Compostela.
987年：Al-Mansur Ibn Abi Aamir lays waste to Coimbra.

987年：Al-Mansur Ibn Abi Aamir seizes the castles north of the Douro River, and arrives at the city of Santiago de Compostela. The city had been evacuated and Al-Mansur burns it to the ground and destroys the Church of Santiago.
987年：Count Gonçalo I Mendes takes the personal title Magnus Dux Portucalensium (Grand-Duke of Portucale) and rebels against King Bermudo II of León, being defeated.
999年：Alfonso V becomes King of León.
999年：Mendo II Gonçalves, son (or grandson?) of Gonçalo I Mendes and Tuta, becomes Count of Portugal.
1002年：Al-Mansur Ibn Abi Aamir dies in the village of Salem due to natural causes. His son, Abd al-Malik al-Muzaffar, takes his place in being the de facto ruler of al-Andalus (officially Hajib).
1003年：Moors lay waste to the city of León.
1008年：Vikings raid Galicia, killing Count Mendo II Gonçalves of Portucal.
1008年：Alvito Nunes, of a collateral line but also descent of Vímara Peres, married to Countess Tudadomna, becomes Count of Portucal.
1008年：Abd al-Malik al Muzaffar dies of natural causes and is replaced by his brother, Abd al-Rahman Sanchuelo.

1009年2月：The Fitna of al-Andalus begins with the assassination of Abd al-Rahman Sanchuelo, the deposition of Hisham II, and rise to power of Muhammad II of Córdoba, who led the coup. This would open a period of great chaos in the al-Andalus, with significant fragmentation and in-fighting between Muslim forces.
1009年：Sulaiman al-Mustain, leading the Berber forces in Córdoba, successful deposes Mohammed II and becomes Caliph of Córdoba.
1009年：The Taifa (independent Moorish kingdom) of Badajoz becomes independent of the Caliph of Córdoba and governs the territory between Coimbra and North Alentejo.
1010年：Hisham II is restored as Umayyad Caliph of Córdoba by slave troops of the Caliphate under al-Wahdid.
1012年：Sulaiman al-Mustain is restored as Umayyad Caliph of Córdoba by the Berber armies.

1013年：Caliphate of Córdoba begins to break up. Berber troops take Córdoba with much plundering and destruction and kill the deposed Hisham II. Many Taifas (independent Moorish kingdoms) begin to spring up.
1016年：Norman invaders ascend the Minho river and destroy Tuy in Galicia.
1017年：Nuno I Alvites, son of Alvito Nunes and Tudadomna, becomes Count of Portugal. He marries Ilduara Mendes, daughter of Mendo II Gonçalves and Tuta.
1018年：The Taifa of the Algarve becomes independent.

items.text: 1021年：Abd-ar-Rahman IV becomes Umayyad Caliph of Córdoba.
1022年：Abd-ar-Rahman V becomes Umayyad Caliph of Córdoba.
1022年：The Taifa (independent Moorish kingdom) of Lisbon emerges.
1023年：Muhammad III becomes Umayyad Caliph of Córdoba.
1025年：Abu al-Qasim Muhammad ibn Abbad, Abbadid Emir of Seville, captures two castles at Alafões to the north-west of Viseu.
1027年：Hisham III becomes Umayyad Caliph of Córdoba.
1028年：Mendo III Nunes, son of Nuno I Alvites and Ilduara Mendes, becomes Count of Portugal.
1028年8月7日：Alfonso V, king of Asturias and León, lays siege to the Muslim town of Viseu but is killed by a bolt from the walls.
1028年：Bermudo III, becomes King of León.
1031年：Sancho III of Navarre declares war on Bermudo III of León. Navarre, sometimes assisted by Galician rebels and Normans, ravages the lands around Lugo in Galicia.
1031年：The Cordoban elite abolishes the caliphate and established an independent state, the Taifa of Córdoba. This would bring an end to the Fitna of al-Andalus.
1033年：The Taifa (independent Moorish kingdom) of Mértola becomes independent.
1034年：The Leonese destroy a raiding force under Ismail ibn Abbad of Seville. Ismail ibn Abbad flees to Lisbon.
1034年：Gonçalo Trastemires – a Portuguese frontiersman – captures Montemor castle on the Mondego river.
1034年：Sancho the Great of Navarre had incorporated Aragon, Sobrarbe, Barcelona, as well as Asturias, León and Castile, and he proclaims himself Rex Hispaniarum ("King of all Spains").
1034年：The Taifa of Lisbon ceases to exist, being annexed by the Taifa of Badajoz.
1035年：Sancho III of Navarre, Aragon and Castile dies and distributes his lands among his three sons; Castile and Aragon become kingdoms.
1035年：Bermudo III of León defeats the Moors in César, in the Aveiro region.

1037年：Ferdinand of Castile, son of Sancho III of Navarre, acquires the Kingdom of León in the Battle of Tamarón. The first Castilian king, Ferdinand I, defeats and kills his father-in-law, Bermudo III of León, thus inheriting his kingdom. With Bermudo III's death, the Astur-Leonese dynasty ends and is replaced by the Jiménez dynasty.
1039年：Ferdinand I of Castille-León proclaims himself Emperor of all Hispania.
1040年：The Taifa of Silves becomes independent.
1044年：Abbad III al-Mu'tamid, son of the Abbadid Emir of Seville Abbad II al-Mu'tadid, retakes Mértola, since 1033 an independent Taifa.
1050年：Count Mendo III Nunes of Portugal is killed in battle sometime during this period.
1050年：Nuno II Mendes, son of Count Mendo III Nunes, becomes Count of Portugal.
1051年：The Taifa of the Algarve is annexed by the Taifa of Seville. Abu al-Qasim ibn Qasi, governor of Silves and who had aided Afonso I of Portugal against the Almohads, is beheaded.

1056年：The Almoravides (al-Murabitun) Dynasty begins its rise to power. Taking the name "those who line up in defence of the faith", this is a group of fundamentalist Berber Muslims who would rule North Africa and Islamic Iberia until 1147.
1057年：Ferdinand I of Castille-León conquers Lamego to the Moors.

1058年：Emir Al-Muzaffar al-Aftas (Abu Bekr Muhammad al-Mudaffar – Modafar I of Badajoz, Aftid dynasty) pays the Christians to leave Badajoz, but not before Viseu being conquered by Ferdinand I of Castile-León.
1060年：Council (Ecumenical Synod) of Santiago de Compostela. (to 1063)
1063年：Ferdinand I of Castile-León divides his kingdom among his sons. Galicia is allotted to his son Garcia.
1063年：The Taifa of Silves is annexed by the Taifa of Seville.

1064年：Ferdinand I of León-Castile besieges Muslim Coimbra from 20 January until 9 July . The Muslim governor who surrendered is allowed to leave with his family, but 5,000 inhabitants are taken captive, and all Muslims are forced out of Portuguese territory across the Mondego river.
1064年：The Mozarabic (Christian) general Sisnando Davides, who led the siege of Coimbra, becomes Count of Coimbra.
1064年：The Hispanic calendar is adopted.
1065年：Independence of the Kingdom of Galicia and Portugal is proclaimed under the rule of Garcia II of Galicia.
1070年：Count Nuno II Mendes of Portugal rises against King Garcia II of Galicia.

1071年：Garcia II of Galicia became the first to use the title King of Portugal, when he defeated, in the Battle of Pedroso (near Braga), Count Nuno II Mendes, last count of Portugal of the Vímara Peres House.

1072年：Loss of independence of the Kingdom of Galicia and Portugal, forcibly reannexed by Garcia's brother king Alfonso VI of Castile. From that time on Galicia remained part of the Kingdoms of Castile and León, although under differing degrees of self-government. Even if it did not last for very long, the Kingdom set the stage for future Portuguese independence under Henry, Count of Portugal.
1077年：Alfonso VI of Castile and León proclaims himself Emperor of all Spains.
1080年：Coimbra is again a diocese.
1080年：Count Sisnando Davides of Coimbra takes part in the invasion of Granada.
1085年：The Order of Cluny is established in Portugal. (to 1096)

1086年：Several Muslim Emirs (namely Abbad III al-Mu'tamid) ask the Almoravids leader Yusuf ibn Tashfin for help against Alfonso VI of Castile. In this year Yusuf ibn Tashfin passed the straits to Algeciras and inflicted a severe defeat on the Christians at the Battle of az-Zallaqah (North of Badajoz). He was debarred from following up his victory by trouble in North Africa which he had to settle in person.

1086年：Raymond of Burgundy, son of William I, Count of Burgundy, comes to Iberia for the 1st time to fight against the Moors, bringing with him his younger cousin Henry of Burgundy, grandson of Robert I, Duke of Burgundy.
1090年：Almoravid Yusuf ibn Tashfin return to Iberia and conquers all the Taifas.
1090年：Raymond of Burgundy and Henry of Burgundy come to Iberia for the 2nd time.
1091年：Count Sisnando Davides of Coimbra dies.
1091年：Alfonso VI of Castile gives her daughter Urraca of Castile in marriage to Raymond of Burgundy together with the fiefdom of Galicia.
1091年：The Taifa of Mértola falls to the Almoravids.

1093年：Raymond of Burgundy and Henry of Burgundy sign a treaty whereby Henry promises to recognise Raymond as king upon the death of Alfonso VI of Castile, receiving in exchange the Kingdom of Toledo or of Portugal.
1094年：Alfonso VI of Castile grants Raymond of Burgundy the government of Portugal and Coimbra.
1094年：Henry of Burgundy marries Alfonso VI of Castile's illegitimate daughter Teresa of León.
1094年：Almoravid Sir ibn Abi Bakr takes Badajoz and Lisbon. Fall of the Taifa of Badajoz.
1095年：Establishment of the 2nd County of Portugal (Condado Portucalense), by Count Henry of Burgundy.
1095年：The Almoravids take Santarém.
1097年：Yusuf ibn Tashfin assumes the title of Amir al Muslimin (Prince of the Muslims).
1102年：Diego Gemírez, Bishop of Santiago de Compostela, uses force to carry off the relics of St. Victor and St. Fructuosus of Dumes from Braga – recently reinstated as a Metropolitan See.
1103年：In the absence of Henry, Count of Portugal in Rome or Jerusalem, Theresa, Countess of Portugal, aided by Soeiro Mendes, governs Portugal.

1105年：The Almohads, founded by Ibn Tumart, began as a religious movement to rid Islam of impurities. Most specifically, the Almohades were opposed to anthropomorphisms which had slipped into Iberian Islam. Ibn Tumart's successor, Abd al-Mu'min, turned the movement against non-Muslims, specifically Jews and Christians. Sweeping across North Africa and into Muslim Iberia, the Almohads initiate riots and persecutions of both Muslims and non-Muslims. In some towns Jews and Christians are given the choice of conversion, exile, or death.
1107年：Count Raymond of Burgundy dies. The Kingdom of Galicia passes on to his son Alfonso Raimúndez.
1109年7月1日：Alfonso VI of Castile and León dies. Urraca of Castile, Count Raymond of Burgundy's widow, is his only surviving legitimate child and marries King Alfonso I of Aragon.
1109年7月25日：Afonso Henriques, son of Henry, Count of Portugal, is born in the city of Guimarães.
1110年：Henry, Count of Portugal unsuccessfully besieges King Alfonso I of Aragon in Penafiel.
1110年：Urraca of Castile distances herself from her husband Alfonso I of Aragon accusing him of being abusive and infertile.
1110年：Henry, Count of Portugal makes common party with Alfonso I of Aragon against Urraca of Castile.
1111年：Almoravids led by Sir ibn Abi Bakr occupy Lisbon and Santarém in the west. These cities were occupied by the Almoravids in 1094–95 this suggests a fluctuating border in Portugal.
1111年：Conference of Palencia, where Urraca of Castile divides her estates with Henry, Count of Portugal and his wife and her sister Theresa.
1111年：Urraca of Castile makes peace with her husband Alfonso I of Aragon, even though they remain separated.
1111年：Henry, Count of Portugal, believing Urraca of Castile has betrayed him, besieges her and her husband Alfonso I of Aragon in Sahagún, aided by Urraca's son Alfonso Raimúndez.
1111年：Henry, Count of Portugal grants city rights and privileges to Coimbra and captures Santarém from the Moors.
1111年：Alfonso Raimúndez, Raymond of Burgundy and Urraca of Castile's son, is proclaimed King of Castile and León as Alfonso VII. This is not recognised.

1112年：Henry, Count of Portugal dies. His son Afonso Henriques inherits the County of Portugal, but, being too young, it is his mother, Theresa, Countess of Portugal, that governs the county after her husband's death with the title of Regina (Queen). Santarém recaptured by the Moors.
1114年：The marriage between Urraca of Castile and Alfonso I of Aragon is annulled.
1114年：The Taifa of Beja and Évora becomes independent.
1116年：The armies of Theresa, Countess of Portugal battle against the armies of Urraca of Castile.
1117年：Almoravids under Emir Ali ibn Yusuf himself take Coimbra, but abandon the city after a few days.
1120年：Afonso Henriques takes sides with the Bishop of Braga against his mother Theresa, Countess of Portugal and her lover, the Count Fernando Peres de Trava of Galicia
1120年：The armies of Theresa, Countess of Portugal battle against the armies of Urraca of Castile.

1121年：Alfonso Raimúndez comes into Portugal in a mission of sovereignty with his mother Urraca of Castile. Their armies capture Theresa, Countess of Portugal at Lanhoso, that accepts to go free and hold the County of Portugal as a fief of the Kingdom of León.
1122年：Afonso Henriques, aged 14, makes himself a Knight on his own account in the Cathedral of Zamora.
1126年：Urraca of Castile dies. Her son Alfonso Raimúndez finally becomes King Alfonso VII of Castile and León.
1127年：Theresa, Countess of Portugal donates Vimieiro to the Order of Cluny

1127年：The Kingdom of León invades Portugal and besieges Guimarães. The Portuguese Knight Egas Moniz de Ribadouro manages to make King Alfonso VII of Castile and León accept promises' of Portuguese fealty.
1128年：Theresa, Countess of Portugal donates Soure to the Knights Templar.

1128年7月24日：Count Afonso Henriques defeats his mother, Theresa, Countess of Portugal, in the Battle of São Mamede (near Guimarães) and becomes sole ruler (Dux – Duke) after demands for independence from the county's people, church and nobles.
1129年4月6日：Afonso Henriques proclaims himself Prince of Portugal.
1130年：Prince Afonso Henriques invades Galicia.
1130年：Prince Afonso Henriques' mother, Theresa, Countess of Portugal, dies in Galicia.
1130年：The Knights Hospitaller install themselves in Portugal.
1135年：Prince Afonso Henriques conquers Leiria from the Moors.
1135年：King Alfonso VII of Castile and León is proclaimed Imperator totius Hispaniae.
1137年：Battle of Arcos de Valdevez
1137年：Peace treaty of Tui, whereby Prince Afonso Henriques acknowledges himself as vassal to King Alfonso VII of Castile and León, through the possession of Astorga.
1137年：Prince Afonso I of Portugal tries and fails to conquer Lisbon from the Moors.
1137年：The Moors retake Leiria.
1139年：King Afonso I of Portugal assembles the first assembly of the estates-general of Portugal at Lamego, where he was given the Crown from the Bishop of Braga, to confirm the independence.
1139年：King Afonso I of Portugal retakes Leiria from the Moors.

1139年7月25日：Independence of Portugal from the Kingdom of León declared after the Battle of Ourique against the Almoravids led by Ali ibn Yusuf: Prince Afonso Henriques becomes Afonso I, King of Portugal.
links: The establishment of the monarchy in Portugal

items.text: 1140年：The Knights Hospitaller receive lands and privileges from King Afonso I of Portugal.
1140年：Portuguese victory in the Battle of Valdevez against Leonese and Castilian forces.
1140年：King Afonso I of Portugal tries and fails to conquer Lisbon from the Moors.
1140年：The Moors retake Leiria.
1142年：King Afonso I of Portugal retakes Leiria from the Moors and the town receives its foral (compilation of feudal rights) to stimulate the colonisation of the area.

1143年：Treaty of Zamora: Alfonso VII of León and Castille recognises the Kingdom of Portugal in the presence of King Afonso I of Portugal, witnessed by the papal representative, the Cardinal Guido de Vico, at the Cathedral of Zamora. Both kings promise durable peace between their kingdoms.
1143年：King Afonso I of Portugal declares himself vassal to Pope Innocent II, placing the Kingdom of Portugal and himself under the protection of Saint Peter and the Holy See.

1144年：The Muridun ("Disciples") under Abul-Qasim Ahmad ibn al-Husayn al-Qasi rebel in the Algarve. Ibn al-Mundhir takes Silves in his name and the governor of Beja, Sidray ibn Wazir, also supports him. Ibn al-Mundhir and Sidray ibn Wazir kill the garrison of Monchique castle, and 70 men take Mértola by surprise (12 Aug). Soon after the Andalusian governor of Niebla, Yusuf ibn Ahmad al-Bitruji declares for the Muridun. The Almoravid Yahya ibn Ali ibn Ghaniya drives the Muridun back from Seville, and subsequently Sidray ibn Wazir splits off from the other Muridun.
1144年：The Taifa of Mértola and of Silves again become independent.
1144年：The Order of Cistercians installs itself in Portugal, at Tarouca.
1145年：The Taifa of Badajoz again becomes independent and conquers the Taifa of Mértola.
1146年：The Taifa of Mértola gains independence from Badajoz.
1146年：King Afonso I of Portugal marries Mafalda of Savoy, daughter of Amadeus III, Count of Savoy and Maurienne.
links: Mafalda of Savoy, Queen of Portugal

items.text: 1147年：The towns of Almada and Palmela, just south of Lisbon, are taken from the Moors.
1147年：King Afonso I of Portugal orders the construction of the church and monastery of Church of São Vicente de Fora (St. Vincent outside the Walls), in Lisbon, in honour of St. Vincent the Deacon.
links: Monastery of São Vicente de Fora

items.text: 1147年3月15日：King Afonso I of Portugal takes Santarém in a surprise attack.

1147年5月19日：A fleet of almost 200 ships of crusaders (Second Crusade) leaves from Dartmouth in England, consisting of Flemish, Frisian, Norman, English, Scottish, and some German crusaders. The fleet was commanded by Arnold III of Aerschot (nephew of Godfrey of Louvain) Christian of Ghistelles, Henry Glanville (constable of Suffolk), Simon of Dover, Andrew of London, and Saher of Archelle.
1147年6月16日：The crusaders fleet arrives at the northern city of Porto, and are convinced by the bishop, Pedro II Pitões, to continue to Lisbon.
links: Pedro II Pitões, Bishop of Porto

items.text: 1147年7月1日：The Siege of Lisbon begins, after the armies of King Afonso I of Portugal were joined by the crusaders.

1147年10月21日：The Moorish rulers of Lisbon agree to surrender to King Afonso I of Portugal, basically due to the hunger that was felt inside the city walls. The terms of surrender indicated that the Muslim garrison of the city would be allowed to flee.

1147年10月25日：The city of Lisbon opens its doors to the Christian armies. As soon as the Christians enter the city the terms of surrender were broken. Many Muslims were killed, and the city was thoroughly plundered before King Afonso I of Portugal finally was able to stop the onslaught.

1148年：Some of the crusaders that had helped King Afonso I of Portugal conquer Lisbon settle in the newly captured city, and Gilbert of Hastings is elected bishop of the renovated Diocese of Lisbon, but most of the crusaders' fleet continues to the east.
1149年：A new Berber dynasty, the Almohad, led by Emir Abd al-Mu'min al-Kumi conquers North Africa to the Almoravids and soon invades the Iberian Peninsula.
1150年：The Taifas of Badajoz and of Beja and Évora are taken by the Almohads.
1151年：King Afonso I of Portugal tries and fails to take Alcácer do Sal from the Moors.
1151年：The Taifa of Mértola is taken by the Almohads.
1152年：The Cistercians build the Monastery of St. John in Tarouca.
1153年：The Cistercians build the Monastery of Alcobaça.
1154年：Sancho, son of King Afonso I of Portugal and future King of Portugal is born.
1155年：The Taifa of Silves is taken by the Almohads.
1158年：King Afonso I of Portugal conquers Alcácer do Sal from the Moors.
1159年：The Castle of Cera (in Tomar) is donated to the Knights Templar.
1159年：Évora and Beja, in the southern province of Alentejo, are taken from the Moors.
1160年：The city of Tomar is founded by Gualdim Pais.
1161年：Évora, Beja and Alcácer do Sal are retaken by the Moors.
1162年：King Afonso I of Portugal retakes Beja from the Moors.
1163年：The Almohad Caliph Abd al-Mu'min al-Kumi dies and is succeeded by Abu Ya'qub Yusuf I.
1165年：The Portuguese armies, led by Gerald the Fearless, retake Évora from the Moors.
1165年：Negotiations between Portugal and León result in the marriage of Princess Urraca of Portugal, King Afonso I's daughter, with King Ferdinand II of León.
1166年：The Portuguese armies take Serpa and Moura (in Alentejo) from the Moors.
1168年：Portuguese frontiersman Gerald the Fearless goes into the territory of Badajoz.
1169年：King Afonso I of Portugal grants the Knights Templar one third of all they conquer to the Moors in Alentejo.
1169年：Gerald the Fearless seizes Badajoz from the Almohads.

1169年：King Afonso I of Portugal is wounded by a fall from his horse in Badajoz, and is captured by the competing forces of King Ferdinand II of León. As ransom King Afonso I was obliged to surrender almost all the conquests he had made in Galicia in the previous years as well as Badajoz, that the Leonese gave back to the Almohads as a vassal territory.
1170年：The Almohads transfer their capital to Seville.
1174年：The Crown of Aragon recognises Portugal as independent.
1175年：Beja recaptured by Almohads.

1179年：Pope Alexander III, in the Papal bull Manifestis Probatum, recognises Afonso I as King and Portugal as an independent country with the right to conquer lands from the Moors. With this papal blessing, Portugal was at last secured as a country and safe from any Leonese or Castilian attempts of annexation.
1179年：King Ferdinand II of León repudiates his wife, Urraca of Portugal, King Afonso I's daughter.
1184年：The Portuguese defeat the Almohads at Santarém.
1184年：Yusuf I, Almohad Caliph, dies and is succeeded by Abu Yusuf Ya'qub al-Mansur.
1185年：Sancho I of Portugal becomes King of Portugal.

1185年：Sancho I of Portugal founds several new towns and villages and takes great care in populating remote areas in the northern Christian regions of Portugal, notably with Flemings and Burgundians. (to 1212)
1185年12月6日：King Afonso I of Portugal dies.
1199年：The Almohad Caliph Abu Yusuf Ya'qub al-Mansur dies and is succeeded by Muhammad an-Nasir.
1211年：Afonso II of Portugal becomes king.

1212年：Culmination of the Reconquista. Christians, amongst them the troops of King Afonso II of Portugal, defeat Almohads (Caliph Muhammad an-Nasir) at the Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa. The Christians had 60–100,000 infantry and 10,000 cavalry, and had troops from Western Europe, Castile, Navarre, Aragon, León and Portugal, Military Orders (Knights Templar, Knights Hospitaller, Santiago, Cavatrava), and urban Militias.
links: Battle of Las Navas de Tolosa

items.text: 1213年：Abu Ya'qub Yusuf II becomes Almohad Caliph.
1214年6月27日：The Will of Afonso II of Portugal is written, one of the oldest known documents written in Galician–Portuguese.
links: Will of Afonso II of Portugal

items.text: 1217年：Siege of Alcácer do Sal. City captured by the Portuguese.
1223年：Sancho II of Portugal becomes king.
1236年：Portugal captures most of the Algarve.
1246年：Pope Innocent IV declares Sancho II an heretic and orders his removal of the throne.
1247年：Afonso III of Portugal becomes king; Sancho II is exiled to Toledo.
1254年：First official reunion of the Cortes, the kingdom's general assembly.
1255年：The city of Lisbon becomes the capital-city of Portugal.
1272年：Afonso III conquers Faro from the Moors, thus removing all Muslim communities from Portuguese soil and ending the Portuguese Reconquista.
1276年：John XXI becomes the first and only Portuguese Pope (died 1277).
1279年：Dinis of Portugal becomes king.
1290年3月1日：Creation of the Estudo Geral (General Study) in Coimbra, the first Portuguese University, with the Faculties of Arts, Canons, Laws and Medicine, and later confirmed by Pope Nicholas IV.
1297年：Dinis signs the Treaty of Alcanizes with Ferdinand IV of Castile to define the borders between Portugal and Castile.
1308年：First Portuguese commercial treaty, signed with England.
1308年：The General Study is transferred to Coimbra.
1319年－1324年：Civil War between D. Dinis and D. Afonso IV (Sotto Mayor Pizarro 1997, p. 190, Vol. I)
1325年：Afonso IV of Portugal becomes king.
1341年：Portugal raids the Canary Islands.
1355年：Inês de Castro is killed by royal order; begins civil war between Afonso IV and his heir Pedro.
1357年：Pedro I of Portugal becomes king; Inês de Castro is removed from her grave and crowned Queen of Portugal.
1367年：Fernando I of Portugal becomes king.
1372年7月10日：Portugal signs the Treaty of Tagilde with the United Kingdom.
1373年6月16日：Portugal signs the Anglo-Portuguese Treaty with England.
1383年：Civil war and political anarchy: 1383-1385 Crisis. (to 1385)
1385年4月：João I of Portugal acclaimed king by the Portuguese; Castilians do not accept this claim.
1385年8月14日：Battle of Aljubarrota: João I defeats the Castilians and secures the throne.

1386年5月9日：Treaty of Windsor, an alliance between England and Portugal, the oldest Portuguese diplomatic agreement and the oldest diplomatic alliance in the world still in force. As a result, in 1387, Joao I marries, Phillipa, daughter of John of Gaunt, third son of King Edward III of England
1394年：Henry the Navigator, son of king João I of Portugal, is born.
1415年：João I conquers the city of Ceuta in northern Africa.
1419年：Madeira Islands discovered by João Gonçalves Zarco and Tristão Vaz Teixeira.
1427年：Azores Islands discovered by Diogo Silves.
1433年：Duarte of Portugal becomes king.
1434年：Gil Eanes crosses the Bojador Cape: exploration of the African coast begins.
1438年：Afonso V of Portugal becomes king.
1446年或1447年：Afonso V enacts the Alfonsine Ordinances, the first code of law of the Kingdom of Portugal. It established a legal hierarchy between Portuguese royal laws, Roman law and Canon law.
links: Canon law of the Catholic Church

items.text: 1456年：Discovery of Cape Verde islands. (Settled 1462.)
1470年：Discovery of São Tomé island.
1471年：Discovery of Príncipe island.
1481年：João II of Portugal becomes king.
1483年：João II executes Fernando, the third Duke of Braganza, and Diogo, the Duke of Viseu, putting an end to high nobility conspiracies.
1484年：Diogo Cão discovers the Congo River.
1491年：Bartolomeu Dias becomes the first European to cross the Cape of Good Hope.
1494年：The Treaty of Tordesillas signed between Spain and Portugal, dividing the colonisable world in two halves.
1495年：Manuel I of Portugal becomes king.
1498年：Vasco da Gama reaches India through navigation around Africa.
1500年：Diogo Dias discovered an island they named after St Lawrence after the saint on whose feast day they had first sighted the island later known as Madagascar.
1500年：Manuel I orders expulsion or conversion of the Portuguese Jews.
1500年：Gaspar Corte-Real made his first voyage to Newfoundland, formerly known as Terras Corte-Real.
1500年4月22日：Pedro Álvares Cabral discovers Brazil.
1502年5月：Miguel Corte-Real set out for New England in search of his brother, Gaspar.
1502年：João da Nova discovered Ascension Island.
1502年：Cortes in Lisbon.
1503年7月30日：On his return from the East, Estêvão da Gama discovered Saint Helena Island.
1505年：Francisco de Almeida "the Great" appointed 1st Viceroy of India, arriving in Cochin in the same year at the head of the 7th Portuguese Indian Armada.
1506年：Tristão da Cunha discovered the island that bears his name. Portuguese sailors landed on Madagascar.

1506年4月19日：In the Lisbon Massacre, a crowd of churchgoers attack and kill people who they suspected to be Jews. The pogrom killed between 500 and 4,000 people. King Manuel I orders the participants of the pogrom to be summarily executed, executing around 500 rioters, and São Domingos Abbey was closed down for 8 years.
1509年：The Gulf of Bengal crossed by Diogo Lopes de Sequeira. On the crossing he also reached Malacca.
1509年：Francisco de Almeida becomes the first Portuguese to arrive in Bombay by sea, seeking to avenge the death of his son.

1509年2月3日：At the naval Battle of Diu, Francisco de Almeida inflicts a decisive victory on the Mamlûk Burji Sultanate of Egypt, the Zamorin of Calicut, and the Sultan of Gujarat, marking the beginning of European dominance over Asian seas that would last until the Second World War.
1510年11月25日：Conquest of Goa by Afonso de Albuquerque, Governor of India.
1511年8月15日：Conquest of Malacca by Afonso de Albuquerque.
1512年：António de Abreu reaches Timor island and the Banda Islands, Ambon Island and Seram. Francisco Serrão reaches the Maluku Islands.
1512年：King Manuel issues the Manueline Ordinances, superseding the Alfonsine Ordinances of the XVth century.
1513年：The first European trading ship to touch the coasts of China, under Jorge Álvares and Rafael Perestrello later in the same year.
1515年4月1日：Afonso de Albuquerque captures the Kingdom of Hormuz.

1517年：Fernão Pires de Andrade and Tomé Pires were chosen by Manuel I of Portugal to sail to China to formally open relations between the Portuguese Empire and the Ming Dynasty during the reign of the Zhengde Emperor.
1517年4月12日：The Siege of Jeddah takes place, marking the beginning of a series of Ottoman–Portuguese confrontations.
1521年12月13日：João III of Portugal becomes king.
1521年：António Correia captures Bahrain, which is under Portuguese rule until 1602.
1525年：Cortes in Torres Novas, requiring the King to assemble the Cortes at least once every 10 years.
1526年：Jorge de Meneses reaches New Guinea for the first time.
1535年：Cortes in Évora, declaring Prince Manuel, as the heir. Prince Manuel would die 2 years later, at age 5.
1536年1月27日：Fernão de Oliveira publishes his Grammatica da lingoagem portuguesa, the first Grammar of the Portuguese language.
1537年：After moving back and forth between Lisbon and Coimbra in the last two centuries, the General Study is definitely established in the latter.
1543年：Portuguese explorers Fernão Mendes Pinto, Francisco Zeimoto and António Mota are the first Europeans to land in Japan.
1544年：Cortes at Almeirim.
1557年：Macau given to Portugal by the Emperor of China as a reward for services rendered against the pirates who infested the South China Sea.
1557年6月11日：Sebastião of Portugal (aged 3) becomes king with Catherine of Austria, his grandmother, as regent.
links: Catherine of Austria, Queen of Portugal

items.text: 1558年2月12日：Catherine of Austria resigns from the role of regent, in favor of Cardinal Henrique.
1562年：Cortes at Lisbon.
1563年12月4日：Council of Trent, prompted by the Protestant Reformation, ends its last session. It was attended by the Portuguese Archbishop of Braga, Bartholomew of Braga.
1566年：The last of the medieval Councils of Braga takes place, in which Bartholomew attempts to apply the reforms of the Council of Trent.
1568年：King Sebastião of Portugal comes of age and takes control of government.
1569年4月：The Big Plague [PT], a bubonic plague epidemic in Portugal. In Lisbon, at the peak, around 700 people die per day.
1569年：Ōmura Sumitada issues a permit opening Nagasaki to Portuguese traders.
1570年4月7日：Luís de Camões returns to Lisbon from the Orient.
1570年12月28日：Goa, in Portuguese India, is attacked by a coalition of Indian forces, but these are defeated by Portuguese Vice-Roy Luís de Ataíde, Count of Atouguia, in the Siege of Goa.
links: Luís de Ataíde, 3rd Count of Atouguia

items.text: 1572年：The first edition of the epic poem The Lusiads is published.
1578年8月4日：Portuguese troops utterly defeated in Africa, in the battle of Alcácer Quibir; king Sebastião disappears in the battle never to be seen again.
1578年8月4日：Cardinal Henrique I of Portugal becomes king.
1579年4月1日：Cortes in Lisbon assembled by Cardinal Henrique to resolve controversy on the succession to the late Sebastian.
1580年1月11日：Cortes in Almeirim to ratify Henry's right to appoint Philip II of Spain as his successor.
1580年1月31日：King Cardinal Henrique I of Portugal dies.
1580年6月10日：Death of Luís de Camões, Portugal's national poet.
1580年7月24日：Anthony of Portugal, the Prior of Crato, is acclaimed King of Portugal in Santarém.
1580年8月25日：Battle of Alcântara between Portuguese and Spanish forces. Spain wins.
1580年8月27日：The Fortress of St. Julian, in Lisbon, surrenders to the Spanish.
1580年10月25日：Spanish forces capture Porto.
1581年3月25日：Philip II of Spain is acclaimed in the Cortes of Tomar as King Philip I of Portugal in a personal union of the Crowns. Portugal loses de facto independence to Spain.
1581年：Anthony of Portugal, the Prior of Crato, takes refuge in England.
1581年：The Azores refuse to recognise Philip I of Portugal as King.
1582年7月26日：The Spanish Fleet of Santa Cruz defeats the Portuguese-French Fleet of Strozzi in the Azores in the Battle of Vila Franca do Campo.
links: Battle of Vila Franca do Campo

items.text: 1582年10月：Introduction of the Gregorian Calendar in Portugal, the 4th of October is followed by the 15th. The colonies will adopt the calendar later, as a result of delays in communication.
1583年：Cortes in Lisbon, to ratify Philip, Prince of Asturias, as the heir to the throne.
1583年：King Philip I of Portugal departs for Madrid and leaves the government of Portugal with Portuguese trustees.
1583年8月2日：The Azores are submitted in the Conquest of the Azores naval battle.
1583年：Francis Drake attacks the Portuguese colony of Brazil.
1589年5月26日：Anthony of Portugal, the Prior of Crato, attacks Lisbon with aid of the English Armada, but with no success.
1589年：In the Azores Voyage of 1589, England sacks the Azores in the context of the Anglo-Spanish War.
1595年8月26日：Anthony of Portugal, the Prior of Crato, dies in Paris.
1595年：King Philip I issues the Philippine Ordinances [pt], replacing the Manueline Ordinances.
1598年9月13日：King Philip dies and Philip III of Spain becomes Philip II of Portugal.
1603年2月25日：Three Dutch ships seize Santa Catarina, leading to a scandal that would start the Dutch–Portuguese War.
1621年：Philip IV of Spain becomes Philip III of Portugal.
1622年：In the context of the Dutch–Portuguese War, the two forces engage in the Battle of Macau. Portugal won.
1638年：Battle of Goa takes place, in the context of the Dutch-Portuguese war. Portugal won.

1640年12月1日：A small group of conspirators storms the Palace in Lisbon and deposes the Vicereine of Portugal, Margaret of Savoy. The Duke of Bragança, head of the senior family of the Portuguese nobility (and descended from a bastard of João I), accepts the throne as Dom João IV of Portugal, despite deep personal reluctance, by popular acclaim and at the urging of his wife. His entire reign will be dominated by the struggle to maintain independence from Spain. Francisco de Lucena, secretary to the governing council of Portugal for the past 36 years and thus the most experienced bureaucrat in the country, smoothly changes his loyalties and becomes chief minister of the restored monarchy.
links: Margaret of Savoy, Vicereine of Portugal

items.text: 1641年：The Portuguese Inquisition attempts to derail the national restoration by giving its support to a counter-revolution mounted by a duke, a marquis, three earls and an archbishop. The plot fails, quelled by Francisco de Lucena, who has the ringleaders executed, but it initiates a 28-year-long war against Spain punctuated by frequent internal threats to the stability of the new regime. Meanwhile, the Dutch renew their attack on Angola and capture the most extensive Portuguese slaving grounds in Africa, including the Angolan port of Luanda. The Portuguese garrison flees upriver while trying to decide whether to declare continuing loyalty to the Habsburgs, accept Dutch rule or declare for João IV. They choose the House of Bragança and appeal to the Portuguese colony of Brazil for help in fending off African and Dutch attacks on their enclave. Salvador de Sá, leader of Rio de Janeiro, persuaded by the Jesuits in Brazil, also declares for King João and responds to the Angolan appeal.
1644年：Elvas withstands a nine-day siege by Spanish troops.
1648年：The Portuguese from Brazil under Salvador de Sá land in Angola, expel the Dutch and restore the African colony to Portugal.

1654年：Anglo-Portuguese treaty between João IV and Oliver Cromwell signed at Westminster. João agrees to prevent the molestation of the traders of the English Protector; they are allowed to use their own bible and bury their dead according to Protestant rites on Catholic soil. The Portuguese in Brazil drive the Dutch out of the great plantation colonies of the north-east, re-establishing the territorial integrity of Portugal's South American empire.

1656年：Death of João IV after a reign of 15 years. His Queen now reigns as Regent for their son, Afonso VI of Portugal. She seeks an accommodation with Spain. Portugal loses control of Colombo in Portuguese Ceylon when it is captured by the Dutch.

1659年：The Treaty of the Pyrenees ends Spain's long war with France, and Spanish troops are freed once more to suppress the Portuguese 'rebellion'. The Spaniards besiege Monção and are driven off by the Countess of Castelo Melhor.

1660年：On the restoration of Charles II in Britain, the Queen-Regent re-negotiates the treaty of 1654. Portugal is allowed to recruit soldiers and horses in England for the fight against Spain; and to seek out 4,000 fighting men in Scotland and Ireland and charter 24 English ships to carry them. The expeditionary force is to be issued with English weapons on arrival in Portugal and guaranteed religious freedom of worship.

1661年：Catarina da Bragança, sister of Afonso VI, marries Charles II of Great Britain on 31 May. She brings to London a dowry of 2,000,000 gold pieces, the practice of drinking afternoon tea, and England is given colonial toe-holds in the Portuguese Empire at Tangier and Bombay, per the Marriage Treaty. Servicing the wedding debt burdens the Portuguese exchequer for the next half-century, and this marriage with a Protestant monarch is deeply unpopular with that section of the Portuguese nobility which favours alliance with France.

1662年：In a palace coup d’etat in Lisbon a restive younger faction of the nobility, supported by the young Afonso VI, overthrows the Queen Regent and installs the 26-year-old Count of Castelo Melhor as 'dictator' to prosecute the war with Spain. The adolescent king is married to a French princess and the young dictator models his government on the royal absolutism of the Bourbon dynasty. Opposition to this pro-French absolutism (from the King's sister the Queen of England, and his younger brother Prince Pedro) is swept aside, and Castelo Melhor initiates the final, successful phase of the Portuguese war of restoration with the aid of the Franco-German Marshal Schomberg, who brilliantly commands an international mercenary army against the Spanish forces.

1665年6月17日：Portugal is victorious at the decisive Battle of Montes Claros, in which António Luís de Menezes defeats the Spanish army under the Prince of Parma; Spain ceases to make war, but peace will not be signed for another three years.
links: António Luís de Meneses, 1st Marquis of Marialva

items.text: 1667年：Castelo Melhor and his Francophile party are overthrown in a new palace revolution. Prince Pedro, leader of the Anglophile party, becomes Regent for Afonso VI, who is declared incapable of governing and removed to the Azores. The French alliance is rejected, though Pedro shores up his political position by marrying his brother's estranged Queen. Castelo Melhor flees into exile (ironically, to England).

1668年：Peace treaty with Spain ends nearly 30 years of war. Portugal keeps all his possessions and territory with the exception of Ceuta in Morocco, which is ceded to Spain. Portugal remains economically weak, however, agriculturally undeveloped and dependent on British grain and trade goods generally, especially woven cloth. The Count of Ericeira, economic adviser to the Prince Regent, advocates the development of a native textile industry modelled on Flemish lines. 'Factories' are established at Covilhã with easy access to flocks of sheep and clean mountain water, but are highly unpopular with both town consumers and traditional weavers. Meanwhile, Portuguese attempts to develop a silk industry are fiercely resisted by the French, who wish to monopolise that market.
1683年：Death of Afonso VI. Pedro II of Portugal becomes king.
1690年：Suicide of Luís de Meneses, Count of Ericeira.
1692年：Great drought disrupts Portuguese silk production.
1697年：Discovery of gold in the interior of São Paulo province, Brazil.
1700年：Brazil now producing 50,000 ounces of gold per year.

1703年：Sir John Methuen negotiates a Military Treaty with Portugal on 16 May, giving Britain an entry to Portugal at a time when the Bourbon dynastic alliance of France and Spain appears to threaten English access to the Continent. This is followed on 27 December by the commercial Methuen Treaty, signed to stimulate trade with Britain. This (which lasts until 1810) opens up new markets for Portuguese wine but helps to destroy the native textile industry by letting in British cloth at preferential rates. The fashion for Portuguese wine in Britain (which has banned the import of French wine due to the War of the Spanish Succession, which will last until 1714) makes the wine trade so profitable and competitive that over the next 40 years inferior wines, often adulterated and artificially coloured are passed off as the genuine article – giving 'port' a bad name.
1705年：Brazil is now producing 600,000 ounces of gold per year. For the second time in its history, Portugal controls one of the greatest gold-producing sources in the world.

1706年：João V of Portugal becomes king. He presides over a great flowering of Portuguese art and culture underpinned by the fabulous wealth provided by Brazilian gold. Social and economic reform are neglected for the next 40 years, and the pious King indulges in a penchant for fabulously expensive building. The Portuguese royal family is now the wealthiest in Europe and João V even considers moving his throne and court to Rio de Janeiro. The taxation of the Brazilian trade brings in an enormous personal revenue to the monarch and he is able to construct an absolutist regime similar to that of the French Kings, concentrating on pomp and ceremony at court. There is however no attention to the impoverished national agriculture, inadequate transport, neglected merchant navy and minimal industrial development of the country since corn and cloth can easily be exported, foreign ships can be hired and 'every problem in Portugal can be solved by the King's gift of a little basket of gold coins bearing his effigy'. Meanwhile, the Brazilian gold rush continues and civil war breaks out between the mining camps of Portuguese immigrants lately come to the north of the country and the Paulistas of southern Brazil who discovered the gold in the first place.

1716年：As a result of Portugal's political importance and the extensive global jurisdiction of the Metropolitan Archdiocese of Lisbon, Pope Clement XI grants the titular Archbishop the title of Patriarchate of Lisbon and the privilege of wearing a Triple Tiara. Later, the Pope agrees to made the Patriarchate a cardinal at the first consistory following his appointment. Tomás de Almeida is appointed 1st Patriarch of Lisbon, becoming a cardinal in 1737.

1717年：Beginning of construction of the great palace-monastery of Mafra, which João V vowed on the birth of his heir, and which he intends as a rival to the Escorial. The elegance of the suites and courtyards are matched by the costliness of the furnishings in more than 1,000 rooms. The scale of the buildings and formal gardens is stupendous in relation to the impoverished countryside around it. However the roped gangs of forced labourers and the military regiment which controls them provides local employment throughout a generation, particularly in the servicing of the 7,000 carts and wagons and feeding of draught animals.
1732年：Disaster at Elvas: lightning strikes the gunpowder magazine in the castle. The explosion and fire kill 1500 people and destroy 823 houses.
1735年：Completion of the palace-monastery at Mafra.

1742年：João V orders the construction in Rome of the Capela de São João Baptista for installation in the Igreja de São Roque to honour his patron saint and to requite the Pope, whom he has persuaded to confer a patriarchate on Lisbon. For its size, this is reckoned the most expensive building ever constructed. Designed by the papal architect Vanvitelli, and using the most costly materials available including ivory, agate, porphyry and lapis lazuli, the chapel is erected in the Vatican in order that the Pope may celebrate Mass in it before it is dismantled and shipped to Portugal.

1750年：Death of João V. His son José I of Portugal becomes king. His powerful chief minister, Sebastião de Melo, Marquis of Pombal, embarks on a programme of reform to drag Portugal into the 18th century.
links: Sebastião de Melo, Marquis of Pombal

items.text: 1752年：Building of the Rococo palace of Queluz.

1755年：The Great earthquake of Portugal is the most shattering natural phenomenon of the Age of Enlightenment. Striking at 9.30 am on All Saints' Day (1 November), it destroys much of Lisbon and many towns in parts of the Alentejo and Algarve (Faro, Lagos and Albufeira are devastated). In Lisbon, three major shocks within ten minutes, a host of rapidly spreading fires touched off by the candles of a hundred church altars, and a vast tsunami that engulfs the seafront, leave 40,000 dead out of a total population of 270,000. The Alfama district of the old city is largely untouched owing to its situation on a rocky massif, as is Belém. The Customs House is flooded and the India House and the English Factory destroyed, so that no trade can legitimately be conducted. The King proves himself able in crisis management and his illegitimate half-brothers, the royal dukes, organise defence, security, the burying of the dead and the continuance of religious observance. The disaster is described by Voltaire in Candide. Rebuilding begins immediately under the vigorous direction of Pombal, who now consolidates his position as Portugal's enlightened despot and leading statesman. It is decided to reconstruct Lisbon as the finest city in Europe, on the grid plan already adopted in the leading cities of Spanish America.
1759年1月13日：The Duke of Aveiro together with members of the Távora family are executed for high-treason and attempted regicide by orders of the Marquis of Pombal.
1762年：Spanish invasion of Portugal stopped with the help of Great Britain. (to 1763)
1769年：The Lisbon Stock Exchange is created.
1777年：Maria I of Portugal becomes Queen regnant. The King consort is her husband and uncle, Pedro III of Portugal. Pombal is dismissed.
1787年：Pinto Revolt in Goa against Portuguese rule.
1792年：João assumes royal responsibilities due to the declining mental health of his mother, Maria I of Portugal.
1799年：João officially becomes prince regent
1807年10月22日：Portugal signs the Secret Convention on the Transfer of the Portuguese monarchy to Brazil with the UK.
links: Secret Convention on the Transfer of the Portuguese monarchy to Brazil

items.text: 1807年：Napoleon Bonaparte, Emperor of the French, invades Portugal and the Portuguese Royal Family is transferred to the colony of Brazil, where it becomes the centre of the Portuguese Empire.
links: Transfer of the Portuguese Court to Brazil

items.text: 1808年：Insurrection against Napoleon's general, Junot and landing of Arthur Wellesley (later Duke of Wellington) to defeat the French at the Battle of Vimeiro. Beginning of the Peninsular War.
1808年8月30日：After being defeated at Vimeiro, the French forces sign the Convention of Cintra, ending the first French invasion of Portugal.
1809年2月3日：The Second French invasion of Portugal begins, this time crossing the border at Minho.
1809年5月12日：The French are defeated in the Second Battle of Porto, bringing an end to the second French invasion of Portugal.
1809年9月：In the Battle of the Tiger's Mouth, Chinese pirates led by Zheng Yi Sao skirmish with the Portuguese fleet.
1809年11月3日：The Lines of Torres Vedras start being built.
1810年：French attack in 1810 led by Masséna repulsed at the Lines of Torres Vedras.
1813年6月21日：The Battle of Vitoria takes place, in the context of the War of the Sixth Coalition. Portugal, together with Spain and the UK, defeat the French forces.
1815年：The colony of Brazil is elevated to the status of kingdom. Portugal changes the official name from Kingdom of Portugal and the Algarves to United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves.
links: United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves

items.text: 1816年：João VI of Portugal becomes king. Portugal is governed by a Regency council headed by Marshal Beresford, head of the Portuguese army in the Peninsular War.

1820年：Liberal Revolution of 1820 against the British-led Regency of William Carr Beresford begins in Porto on 24 August. The Regency's troops decline to act against their countrymen and on 15 September declare for King, Cortes and Constitution. A provisional government is established on 1 October to oversee elections to the Cortes.
1820年：The first ever parliamentary elections in Portugal take place, with the 1820 Portuguese legislative election who elected the Constituent Cortes of 1820.
1821年1月26日：The Constituent Cortes hold their first meeting.
1821年3月9日：The Constituent Cortes adopts a liberal parliamentary constitution (ratified 1822), inspired by the recent liberal advances in Spain, notably the 1812 Constitution of Cadiz.

1821年：Metropolitan Portugal demands the return of João VI to Lisbon. João VI advises his son, Pedro, to declare the independence of Brazil and become its emperor, to ensure its continued rule by the Bragança dynasty.

1821年7月4日：João VI lands in Portugal, but only after consenting to the restrictions on his power proposed by the Cortes and agreeing to accept the new constitution. His wife Queen Carlota Joaquina and younger son Dom Miguel refuse to do so and become the focus of a reactionary movement.
1821年10月1日：João VI swears allegiance to the Portuguese Constitution of 1822.
1822年1月9日：Prince Pedro declared that he would not comply with the orders of the Portuguese Cortes that demanded his return to Lisbon, in what is known as the Dia do Fico.

1822年：Military coup against the parliamentarians. Fearing a move by France against democratic Portugal, or a civil war, Brigadier Saldanha, a grandson of the Marquis of Pombal, raises a small army and expels the 'constitutional extremists' from Lisbon. He proposes instead a compromise constitution in which the powers of the crown will be partially restored to the King. (This is the first of Saldanha's seven coups d'état in his career).
links: João Carlos de Saldanha Oliveira e Daun, 1st Duke of Saldanha

items.text: 1822年9月7日：Prince regent Pedro of Braganza declared Brazil's independence and becomes Emperor Pedro I of Brazil.
1822年9月23日：Portugal's first constitution is ratified.
1822年11月4日：The last meeting of the Constituent Cortes takes place.
1822年11月22日：Parliamentary elections take place under the newly ratified constitution.

1823年5月27日：In May a 'Regency of Portugal' is established by the expelled traditionalists who had opposed the constitution at Valladolid, under the presidency of the Patriarch of Lisbon and becomes a centre for plotting to put Dom Miguel on the throne. This event is known as Vilafrancada.
1824年4月30日：Miguel attempts a coup d'etat but is defeated with British aid and goes into exile in Vienna. This event is known as the April Revolt.
1826年3月10日：Death of João VI. The country is split between liberals and absolutists. Emperor Pedro I of Brazil becomes king Pedro IV of Portugal.
1826年5月2日：Pedro IV of Portugal abdicates in favour of his daughter, Maria II of Portugal.

1826年4月23日：Pedro IV of Portugal draws up a new constitution, somewhat less liberal than that of 1820 and based upon the Brazilian constitution, and invites all parties to accept it. This constitution (the Charter of 1826) assigns authority to the crown to moderate between the legislative, executive and judicial powers of the state and proposes a House of Lords of 72 aristocrats and 19 bishops. Miguel (in Vienna) makes a show of agreement.
1826年：The 1826 Portuguese legislative election takes place, the first under the Charter of 1826.
1827年7月：Pedro names his brother Dom Miguel as Lieutenant and Regent of the Kingdom. Miguel leaves Vienna and visits Paris and London on his way to Portugal.

1828年2月：Miguel returns to Portugal, ostensibly to take the oath of allegiance to the Charter and assume the regency. He was immediately proclaimed king by his supporters, who pressed him to return to absolutism.
1828年3月13日：Dom Miguel abolishes parliament and the constitution, re-instituting the medieval Cortes.

1828年5月18日：The garrison in Porto, the center of Portuguese progressives, declared its loyalty to Pedro IV and his daughter Maria II, and the Constitutional Charter. Beginning of civil war, known as the Liberal Wars.
1828年7月11日：Dom Miguel becomes Miguel I of Portugal, as proclaimed by the medieval Cortes he summed.
1828年5月：The 1828 Portuguese legislative election takes place, electing seats to the People's Branch of the new medieval-styled Three Estates Cortes.

1829年8月11日：In the Battle of Praia da Vitória, the Miguelites under command of José António Azevedo e Lemos attempted to disembark troops on Terceira island, but were defeated by the liberal troops under command of the Duke of Terceira.
links: António José Severim de Noronha, 1st Duke of Terceira

items.text: 1831年4月7日：Emperor Pedro I of Brazil abdicates in favour of his son Pedro II of Brazil and sets out to regain Portugal for his daughter.
links: Abdication of Pedro I of Brazil

items.text: 1832年：Pedro's expeditionary force of Portuguese exiles and foreign mercenaries gathers in Terceira, regains the Azores, then sails for Portugal. Pedro is supported by Britain and France and the Portuguese intelligentsia, including the politically ambitious soldiers Saldanha and Sá da Bandeira.
links: Bernardo de Sá Nogueira de Figueiredo, 1st Marquess of Sá da Bandeira

items.text: 1832年7月9日：Pedro lands at Pampelido north of Porto, where he is closely besieged by some 13,000 Miguelites across the River Douro. His defending force, the city garrison being commanded by Sá da Bandeira, includes an international brigade with a British contingent under Charles Shaw and Colonel George Lloyd Hodges. The city suffers cholera, starvation and bombardment.
1833年：Miguel's navy is defeated by Pedro's Admiral Charles Napier at the fourth Battle of Cape St Vincent. The Duke of Terceira defeats Miguel's army at Almada and occupies Lisbon.

1834年5月16日：The Duke of Terceira wins the Battle of Asseiceira. Miguel capitulates at EvoraMonte on 26 May. End of the civil war: Miguel is exiled to Genoa, where he renounces his capitulation. For many years he plots his return, but is never able to put it into effect. After six years of bitter and destructive war the country is once again bankrupt and beholden to foreign creditors, and the constitutional radicals turn their anger against the landowners and ecclesiastical institutions that had supported Miguel. The crown lands (a quarter of the national territory) are taken over by the state to help pay the national debt.
1834年：The 1834 Portuguese legislative election takes place under the Charter of 1826. The supporters of the Charter win a plurality of votes.

1834年9月24日：Death of Dom Pedro. Maria II of Portugal becomes queen in her own right. Pedro de Sousa Holstein, 1st Duke of Palmela, becomes the first prime minister of Portugal. Dissolution of the monasteries – over 300 monastic communities are abolished – however the sale of church and crown lands does not revitalise Portugal in the way that had been anticipated.
links: Pedro de Sousa Holstein, 1st Duke of Palmela
List of prime ministers of Portugal
Dissolution of the monasteries in Portugal

items.text: 1835年1月26日：Queen Maria II marries Auguste, Duke of Leuchtenberg, who becomes the first Prince Consort of Portugal.
1835年3月28日：Auguste, Prince Consort of Portugal, dies of an illness.

1835年4月15日：After a piece of legislation was drafted on 15 April 1835, which provided for the sale of national property and property of the Catholic Church, and facilitated their disposal among leading members of the liberal party, the Devourism period begins.
1835年5月4日：Vitório Maria de Sousa Coutinho, 2nd Count of Linhares becomes prime minister of Portugal.
links: Vitório Maria de Sousa Coutinho, 2nd Count of Linhares

items.text: 1835年5月27日：João Carlos de Saldanha Oliveira e Daun, 1st Duke of Saldanha becomes prime minister of Portugal.
links: João Carlos de Saldanha Oliveira e Daun, 1st Duke of Saldanha

items.text: 1835年：Revolutionary fervour is rekindled by an urban uprising and a military coup d’etat. The national Guard sides with the insurgents and approved the call for Sá da Bandeira to lead the nation and bring back the constitution of 1822. Queen Maria is forced to swear allegiance to the 1822 constitution but the moderate leader, Saldanha, reaches an accommodation with Sá da Bandeira and a modest programme of modernisation can begin.
1835年11月18日：José Jorge Loureiro becomes prime minister of Portugal.
1836年：The July 1836 Portuguese legislative election takes place under the Charter of 1826. The Cartistas (who support the Charter) win a majority of votes.
1836年4月9日：Queen Maria II marries Prince Ferdinand of Saxe-Coburg-Gotha, who becomes Prince Consort of Portugal.
1836年4月20日：António José Severim de Noronha, 1st Duke of Terceira becomes prime minister of Portugal.
links: António José Severim de Noronha, 1st Duke of Terceira

items.text: 1836年9月9日：The September Revolution coup, led by Passos Manuel, ends the Devourism period. The Constitution of 1822 is restored.
1836年9月10日：José da Gama Carneiro e Sousa becomes Prime Minister of Portugal after the September revolution events.
links: José da Gama Carneiro e Sousa

items.text: 1836年：In the Belenzada, Queen Maria II and her husband Ferdinand II attempt a coup to remove the liberal government established by the September revolution and place José Bernardino de Portugal e Castro as prime minister, but the coup fails and José is nominally prime minister for 2 days (he did not take office). Bernardo de Sá Nogueira de Figueiredo, 1st Marquis of Sá da Bandeira becomes prime minister instead.
links: José Bernardino de Portugal e Castro
Bernardo de Sá Nogueira de Figueiredo, 1st Marquis of Sá da Bandeira

items.text: 1836年11月20日：The November 1836 Portuguese legislative election takes place under the 1822 constitution. The supporters of the September revolution win the majority of votes.
1837年6月1日：António Dias de Oliveira becomes prime minister.
1837年7月12日：In the Revolt of the Marshals, a group of Marshals attempts to bring back the Charter of 1826 but fail.
1837年8月2日：Sá da Bandeira becomes prime minister again.
1837年9月16日：With the birth of Prince Pedro by Queen Maria II, his father, then Prince Consort of Portugal, becomes Ferdinand II of Portugal, co-ruler with Queen Maria II.
1838年3月13日：In the Rossio massacre, forces loyal to the Portuguese government of Prime Minister Sá da Bandeira put down a revolt by radical sections of the National Guard and their supporters.
1838年4月24日：The Portuguese Constitution of 1838 is promulgated.
1838年：The 1838 Portuguese legislative election takes place, the first under the 1838 Constitution. A coalition of Septembrist and Charter supported wins the elections.
1839年4月18日：Rodrigo Pinto Pizarro becomes prime minister, the last government fully composed of members in support of the September revolution.
1839年11月26日：The Conde do Bonfim becomes prime minister with a coalition government.
1840年3月22日：The 1840 Portuguese legislative election takes place, with Conde do Bonfim remaining prime minister.
1841年6月9日：Joaquim António de Aguiar becomes prime minister.
1842年：Marquis of Palmela served briefly as Prime Minister again (for two days, in the so-called Shrovetide Cabinet [pt]).
1842年2月9日：The Duke of Terceira becomes prime minister again. Start of Cabralism, in which António Bernardo da Costa Cabral, 1st Marquis of Tomar dominated Portuguese politics.
links: António Bernardo da Costa Cabral, 1st Marquis of Tomar

items.text: 1842年：The 1842 Portuguese legislative election takes place, with the Charter supporters winning the election with a plurality of votes.
1843年：Fernando II commissions the German architect Baron Eschwege to begin the building of the Pena Palace at Sintra.
1845年：The 1845 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The result was a victory for the Cabralistas, with Miguelistas advising voters to boycott the elections.
links: António Bernardo da Costa Cabral, 1st Marquis of Tomar

items.text: 1846年：The Revolution of Maria da Fonte, a 'peasants' revolt' inaugurates the last phase of the Revolution, starting as an uprising of the peasants of the Minho, largely led by women (their movement is named after the semi-mythical 'Maria da Fonte') against land enclosures and new land taxes demanded by the Costa Cabral government to finance its grandiose public works. They make common cause with the clergy and call for the return of the exiled Miguel as their saviour. Martial law is declared but soldiers refuse to fire on their kin. Fall of the Costa Cabral government and substitution of a government of national reconciliation in Lisbon. Autumn: A revolutionary government is proclaimed in Porto with Sá da Bandeira at its head. He opens negotiations with Britain, whence Costa Cabral has fled into exile, and settles terms for his return to take responsibility for the national debt. Civil war between the supporters of Queen Maria and the radical constitutionalists. The Count of Bonfim, for the Porto junta, is defeated by Saldanha at the siege of Torres Vedras and exiled to Angola.
links: António Bernardo da Costa Cabral, 1st Marquess of Tomar
José Travassos Valdez, 1st Count of Bonfim

items.text: 1846年5月20日：The Marquis of Palmela becomes prime minister for the third time.
1846年10月6日：Duke of Saldanha becomes prime minister for the second time as an outcome of the Emboscada, in which Queen Maria II successfully deposed the Marquis of Palmela.

1846年：As a result of the Emboscada, the Patuleia begins. An eight-month civil war putting those who defended the Constitutional Charter (and the Queen) against a coalition of Septembristas and Miguelistas.
1847年6月29日：Convention of Gramido brings the civil war to an end. The Cartistas win with the support of the 1834 Quadruple Alliance. Return of the political exiles from Angola.
1847年：The 1847 Portuguese legislative election takes place.
1849年6月18日：António Bernardo da Costa Cabral, 1st Marquis of Tomar becomes prime minister.
links: António Bernardo da Costa Cabral, 1st Marquis of Tomar

items.text: 1849年8月25日：In the Passaleão incident, Chinese troops attempt to take Macau but fail to do so.
1851年4月26日：Duke of Terceira becomes prime-minister for the third time.

1851年：Another coup d’etat by Saldanha. He ejects Costa Cabral, appoints himself prime minister and rules reasonably progressively from the house of lords for a full five-year term. Thus a proper parliamentary regime is finally established, with a two-party system and a bourgeois monarchy. Portugal enters its Age of Regeneration, with an old-fashioned cavalry officer in charge. The government embarks on an elaborate programme of public works to modernise the country, beginning with the establishment of a modern post office and a programme of road-building: in the entire country there is less than 200 km of all-weather road surface, and the government uses road taxes to finance 200 km of new road per year.
1851年5月1日：Duke of Saldanha becomes prime-minister for the third time.
1851年：The 1851 Portuguese legislative election takes place, Duke of Saldanha supporters win the elections.
1851年：The Regenerator Party is founded.
1852年12月12日：The 1852 Portuguese legislative election takes place.
1852年：The Historic Party is founded.
1853年11月15日：Queen Maria II dies in childbirth, Pedro V of Portugal, her son, becomes king.
1856年4月30日：Pedro V founds the Associação Naval de Lisboa, Portugal's oldest sports club.
1856年6月6日：Nuno José Severo de Mendoça Rolim de Moura Barreto, 1st Duke of Loulé becomes prime-minister.
links: Nuno José Severo de Mendoça Rolim de Moura Barreto, 1st Duke of Loulé

items.text: 1856年10月28日：Opening of Portugal's first railway line (between Lisbon and Carregado).
1856年11月9日：The 1856 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Historic Party wins an absolute majority.
1858年5月2日：The 1858 Portuguese legislative election takes place with the Historic Party winning a second absolute majority.
1859年3月16日：The Duke of Terceira becomes prime minister for the 4th time.
1860年1月1日：The 1860 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Regenerator Party, together with the Cabralistas, wins an absolute majority.
1860年5月1日：The Duke of Terceira dies due to an illness. Joaquim António de Aguiar becomes prime minister for the second time.
1860年7月4日：The Duke of Loulé becomes prime minister for the second time.
1861年4月22日：The 1861 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Historic Party recovers its absolute majority.
1861年11月11日：Amidst the 1846–1860 cholera pandemic, King Pedro V dies and Luis I of Portugal, his brother, becomes king.
1864年9月11日：The 1834 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Historic Party keeps its absolute majority.
1865年4月17日：The Marquis Sá da Bandeira becomes prime minister for the third time.

1865年7月8日：The 1865 Portuguese legislative election takes place. A coalition of the Historic Party and the Regeneration Party win the election and form a government under Joaquim António de Aguiar, against the Duke of Loulé.
1865年9月4日：Joaquim António de Aguiar becomes prime minister for the third time.
1867年2月4日：The 1867 Portuguese legislative election takes place, with a victory for the parties opposing Joaquim António de Aguiar, but he would not life office until the Janeirinha protests in 1986.
1867年7月1日：After the legislation of 1852 regarding political crimes, the Penal and Prison Reform abolishes the death penalty for all civilian crimes.
1868年1月1日：A movement known as Janeirinha protests against the tax on consumables and went on to carry out administrative reform of the country.
1868年1月4日：The Janeirinha movement forces Joaquim António de Aguiar to resign, António José de Ávila, 1st Duke of Ávila and Bolama becomes prime-minister.
links: António José de Ávila, 1st Duke of Ávila and Bolama

items.text: 1868年：The 1868 Portuguese legislative election takes place. Victory for the Reformist Party, which was founded as a breakaway from the History party over the Janeirinha events, in a coalition with the Duke of Ávila and Bolama supporters.
1868年7月22日：Marquis of Sá da Bandeira becomes prime minister for the 4th time.
1869年：The 1869 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Reformist Party maintains the absolute majority.
1869年：The government of Sá da Bandeira formally abolishes slavery in all Portuguese territories.
1869年8月11日：Duke of Loulé becomes prime-minister for the 3rd time.
1870年3月13日：The March 1870 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Historic Party wins an absolute majority.
1870年5月19日：A financial crisis in the wake of European recession brings the fall of the government and yet another coup d’etat by the aged Duque de Saldanha, who becomes prime-minister.
1870年8月29日：Luis I dismisses Duque de Saldanha and nominates Marquis of Sá da Bandeira who becomes prime-minister for the 5th time.
1870年9月18日：The September 1870 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Reformist Party wins an absolute majority.
1870年10月29日：Marquis of Ávila becomes prime-minister for the 2nd time.
1871年7月9日：The 1871 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Historic Party wins a plurality of votes.
1871年9月13日：Fontes Pereira de Melo becomes prime-minister.
1874年7月12日：The 1874 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Regenerator Party wins an absolute majority.
1876年3月25日：The Portuguese Republican Party is founded.
1876年9月7日：The Progressive Party is founded by merging the Historic and Reformist parties.
1877年3月6日：Marquis of Ávila becomes prime-minister for the 3rd time.
1878年1月26日：Fontes Pereira de Melo becomes prime-minister for the 2nd time.
1878年5月29日：Anselmo José Braamcamp becomes prime-minister.
1878年10月13日：The 1878 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Regenerator Party keeps its absolute majority.
1879年10月19日：The 1879 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Progressive Party wins an absolute majority.
1881年3月23日：António Rodrigues Sampaio becomes prime-minister.
1881年8月21日：The 1881 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Regenerator Party wins an absolute majority.
1881年11月14日：Fontes Pereira de Melo becomes prime-minister for the 3rd time.
1884年6月29日：The 1884 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Regenerator Party keeps its absolute majority.
1884年11月15日：Portugal takes part in the Berlin Conference.
1885年：The Pink Map is published, representing Portugal's claim of sovereignty over a land corridor connecting the Portuguese colonies of Angola and Mozambique during the Scramble for Africa.
1886年2月16日：José Luciano de Castro becomes prime-minister.
1887年3月6日：The 1887 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Progressive Party wins an absolute majority.
1887年12月1日：Portugal and China sign the Sino-Portuguese Treaty of Peking, in the aftermath of the Second Opium War.
1889年10月19日：Luís I dies of neurosyphilis. Carlos I of Portugal, Luís' son, becomes king.
1889年10月20日：The 1889 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Progressive Party keeps its absolute majority.
1890年1月11日：The British Government presents the Kingdom of Portugal with an Ultimatum.
1890年1月14日：António de Serpa Pimentel becomes prime-minister.
1890年3月30日：The 1890 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Regenerator Party wins an absolute majority.
1890年10月11日：João Crisóstomo de Abreu e Sousa becomes prime-minister.

1891年1月31日：Republican insurrection in Porto. It is violently put down by the authorities, who afterwards institute a tight press censorship. Opponents of the government are accused of anarchism and exiled to the colonies.
1891年6月11日：Portugal signs the Anglo-Portuguese Treaty of 1891.
1892年1月18日：José Dias Ferreira becomes prime-minister.
1892年10月23日：The 1892 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Regenerator Party keeps its absolute majority.
1893年2月22日：Ernesto Rodolfo Hintze Ribeiro becomes prime-minister.
1894年4月15日：The 1894 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Regenerator Party again keeps its absolute majority.
1895年11月7日：The Battle of Coolela takes place. Portugal wins, defeating the Gaza Empire.
1895年11月17日：The 1895 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Regenerator Party wins again, but the Progressive Party and the Portuguese Republican Party boycott the elections.
1897年1月30日：An arbitration by Italy finally establishes the international boundary between the British colony of Southern Rhodesia and Portugal's Mozambique colony.
1897年2月5日：José Luciano de Castro Pereira Corte-Real becomes prime-minister.
links: José Luciano de Castro Pereira Corte-Real

items.text: 1897年5月2日：The 1897 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Progressive Party wins a majority of votes.
1899年10月14日：Portugal signs the Treaty of Windsor with the United Kingdom, marking the restoration of Anglo-Portuguese relation.
1899年11月26日：The 1899 Portuguese legislative election takes place. The Progressive Party keeps its majority.
1905年：The Progressive Dissidence party is founded by Minister of Justice José Maria de Alpoim as a breakaway from the Progressive Party.
1906年5月：João Franco is appointed as Prime Minister of Portugal.
1906年：Big strike of the typographers.
1906年：Foundation of the Escola Superior Colonial (Superior Colonial School)
1907年：João Franco establishes a Dictatorship within the framework of the Monarchy.
1907年：Student's strike at the University of Coimbra.
1908年：The Portuguese Republican Party manages to elect all its candidates in the local elections of Lisbon.
1908年1月28日：Failed Republican revolutionary attempt. The conspirators are arrested.

1908年2月1日：Lisbon Regicide: King Carlos I of Portugal and his son and heir, prince Luis Filipe, Duke of Braganza, are killed in the Regicide of Lisbon by Alfredo Luís da Costa and Manuel Buíça, republicans of the Carbonária (the Portuguese section of the Carbonari).
1908年2月1日：Manuel II of Portugal, King Carlos's youngest son, becomes king.
1909年：King Manuel II of Portugal goes on a personal trip to Madrid, London and Paris.
1909年：The Portuguese Republican Party's Conference takes place in Setúbal, where the motion to accelerate the revolutionary movement to establish the Republic is approved.
1909年：In Lisbon a demonstration with more than 100,000 persons protests against the political and economical situation of the Monarchy.
